atc-scenario-0001-card-main-001.audioText: B: Your call sign is Qantas 432, you are parking at gate 24, you have got information Hotel, ask Shanghai Delivery for ATC clearance to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-001.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Qantas 432，停在 24 号登机口，已收到 Hotel 情报，向上海放行申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-001.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, QFA432, gate 24, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-001.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，QFA432，24 号登机口，收到 H 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-002.audioText: C: Qantas 432, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use runway 26, Hotel Zulu 01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure, contact 128.75, squawk 3421.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-002.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，使用跑道 26，Hotel Zulu 01 离场，QNH 上初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-002.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use runway 26, HZ 01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure, contact 128.75, squawk 3421, QFA432.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-002.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，使用跑道 26，HZ 01 离场，QNH 上初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421，QFA432。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-003.audioText: C: Qantas 432, read back correct, report when ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-003.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时报告。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-004.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-004.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-004.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA432, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-004.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA432，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-005.audioText: C: Qantas 432, push back and start up approved.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-005.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, QFA432.

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-006.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi.

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-007.audioText: C: Qantas 432, taxi via taxiway Foxtrot, Charlie 1 and Bravo to holding point runway 26. Caution! work in progress at the end of gate 319.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-007.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，经 Foxtrot、Charlie 1 和 Bravo 滑行道滑行至跑道 26 等待点。注意！319 号登机口末端有施工。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-007.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway F, C1 and B to holding point runway 26, roger, thanks, QFA432.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-007.referenceTextZh: 经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至跑道 26 等待点，收到，谢谢，QFA432。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-008.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, you noticed some smoke coming from APU on Boeing 747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-008.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到前方 Boeing 747 的 APU 冒烟，向 ATC 报告。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-008.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA432, we notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of us.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-008.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA432，我们注意到前方 B747 的 APU 冒烟。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-009.audioText: B: Now you are holding point runway 26, tell ATC you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-009.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 26 等待点，告诉 ATC 你准备好起飞。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-009.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, QFA432, holding point runway 26, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-009.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，QFA432，跑道 26 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-010.audioText: C: Qantas 432, behind landing traffic, line up behind.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-010.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-010.referenceText: Behind landing traffic, line up behind, QFA432.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-010.referenceTextZh: 在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道，QFA432。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-011.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 5100 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request further descent.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-011.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 5100 米，联系北京进近并请求继续下降。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-011.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, reaching 5100 meters, request further descent.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-011.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA432，正到达 5100 米，请求继续下降。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-012.audioText: C: Qantas 432, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-012.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-012.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031, QFA432.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-012.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米，QFA432。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-013.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-013.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-013.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-013.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA432，保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-014.audioText: C: Qantas 432, maintain 3300 meters, opposite traffic at 2 o'clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-014.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，保持 3300 米，相对飞行航空器在 2 点钟方向 10 海里，脱离冲突后报告。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-015.audioText: B: Tell the controller you are clear of traffic and request further descent.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-015.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已脱离该航空器，并请求下降。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-015.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, clear of traffic, request descent.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-015.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA432，已脱离航空器，请求下降。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-016.audioText: B: You are cleared to 1200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, you suspect a sandstorm, tell Beijing Approach the situation and ask ATC if there is sandstorm forecast.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-016.audioTextZh: B：你已获准下降至 1200 米，天空变暗，能见度变差，你怀疑有沙尘暴，告诉北京进近情况，并询问 ATC 是否有沙尘暴预报。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-016.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, descending to 1200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, we suspect a sandstorm, is there sandstorm forecast ?
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-016.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA432，正下降至 1200 米，天空变暗，能见度变差，我们怀疑有沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-017.audioText: B: The sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, inform ATC the situation, ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-017.audioTextZh: B：沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，通知 ATC 情况，请求爬升到更高高度以避开沙尘暴上方。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-017.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, the sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, request climb to a higher level.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-017.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA432，沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，请求爬升到更高高度。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-018.audioText: C: Qantas 432, climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-018.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-018.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230, QFA432.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-018.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230，QFA432。

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-019.audioText: B: Your aircraft is Boeing 747, suddenly, number 1 number 2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, report it to Beijing Approach, ask if weather is clear in Beijing and request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-019.audioTextZh: B：你的飞机是 Boeing 747，突然，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，向北京进近报告，请问北京天气是否晴朗，并请求雷达引导前往北京优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-019.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Approach, QFA432, No.1 and No.2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing. Is weather in Beijing clear?
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-019.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京进近，QFA432，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，请求雷达引导前往北京优先着陆。北京天气晴朗吗？

atc-scenario-0001-card-main-020.audioText: C: Qantas 432, turn right heading 250, the weather in Beijing is clear.
atc-scenario-0001-card-main-020.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 432，右转航向 250，北京天气晴朗。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-021.audioText: B: Your call sign is Qantas 160, a flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over Whiskey X-Ray India, your transponder code is 4525, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-021.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Qantas 160，从东京飞往广州，保持 11000 米，飞越 Whiskey X-Ray India，应答机代码 4525，与郑州管制首次联系。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-021.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4525.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-021.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA160，保持 11000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 4525。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-022.audioText: C: Qantas 160, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10400 meters.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-022.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，郑州管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10400 米。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-023.audioText: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect high level, ask Zhengzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-023.audioTextZh: B：你想知道什么时候可以预期高高度，询问郑州管制。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-023.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, until what time we can expect high level ?
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-023.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA160，我们什么时候可以预期高高度？

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-024.audioText: C: Qantas 160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing Zulu Hotel Oscar, but for now, continue descent to 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed due to temporary airways restriction.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-024.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，郑州管制，飞越 Zulu Hotel Oscar 后可预期继续爬升，但现在继续下降并保持 9200 米，因临时航路限制减至最小速度。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-024.referenceText: Roger, expect further climb after passing ZHO, continue descend and maintain 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed, QFA160.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-024.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞越 ZHO 后预期继续爬升，继续下降并保持 9200 米，减至最小速度，QFA160。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-025.audioText: C: Qantas 160, orbit right from present position until further advised.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-025.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-025.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until further advised, QFA160.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-025.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知，QFA160。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-026.audioText: B: After several orbits, you have calculated that if you hold any longer, the fuel on board will approach the required minimums, inform Zhengzhou Control about your situation.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-026.audioTextZh: B：几次盘旋后，你计算出如果继续等待，机上燃油将接近所需最低量，通知郑州管制你的情况。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-026.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, we will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-026.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA160，如果再被延误，我们将达到最低燃油。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-027.audioText: C: Qantas 160, Zhengzhou Control, roger, after this orbit, direct to AKOMA.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-027.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，郑州管制，收到，本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-027.referenceText: After this orbit, direct to AKOMA, QFA160.

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-028.audioText: B: Now you find you don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou and you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, notify Zhengzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-028.audioTextZh: B：现在你发现燃油不足以飞往广州，决定备降长沙机场，通知郑州管制。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-028.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, we don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou, request divert to Changsha Airport.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-028.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA160，我们没有足够燃油飞往广州，请求备降长沙机场。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-029.audioText: C: Qantas 160, stand by for your request, temporary restriction is now cancelled, resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-029.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，等待你的请求，临时限制现已取消，恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-029.referenceText: Resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK, QFA160.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-029.referenceTextZh: 恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK，QFA160。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-030.audioText: B: You have a navigation system problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control and ask for radar monitoring.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-030.audioTextZh: B：你的导航系统有问题，仪表显示飞机位置不准确，通知郑州管制并请求雷达监控。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-030.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, we have a navigation system problem, our instrument is showing inaccurate position, request radar monitoring.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-030.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA160，我们有导航系统问题，仪表显示位置不准确，请求雷达监控。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-031.audioText: C: Qantas 160, roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 5 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, request diversion from Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-031.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，收到，你稍微向左偏航，右转 5 度，联系武汉管制134.7，向武汉管制请求备降。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-032.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525, contact Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-032.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525，联系武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-032.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA160, maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-032.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA160，保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-033.audioText:
C: Qantas 160, Wuhan Control, radar contact, I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you are performing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to stand by.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-033.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 160，武汉管制，雷达识别，我了解你有导航问题和燃油不足，确认你正在备降长沙。
B：告诉武汉管制你正在执行检查单，并让武汉管制稍等。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-033.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA160, stand by, we are performing the checklist.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-033.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA160，请稍等，我们正在执行检查单。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-034.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you want to change your alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-034.audioTextZh: B：通知武汉管制你正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，并希望将备降机场改为武汉机场。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-034.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA160, we are flying with basic navigation instruments, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-034.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA160，我们正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，请求备降武汉机场。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-035.audioText: C: Qantas 160, roger, divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.45 when reaching.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-035.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，收到，备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，到达时联系武汉进近120.45。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-035.referenceText: Divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, 120.45, QFA160.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-035.referenceTextZh: 备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，120.45，QFA160。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-036.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 4800 meters, you have got information Bravo, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-036.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 4800 米，已收到 Bravo 情报，与武汉进近首次联系。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-036.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA160, reaching 4800 meters, information B.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-036.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA160，正到达 4800 米，收到 B 情报。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-037.audioText: C: Qantas 160, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information Bravo is current, follow Zulu Foxtrot 01 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-037.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 160，武汉进近，雷达识别，Bravo 情报有效，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 01 Alpha 进场，预期 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-037.referenceText: Follow ZF 01A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, QFA160.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-037.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF 01A 进场，预期 ILS 进近跑道 36R，QFA160。

atc-scenario-0002-card-main-038.audioText:
C: Qantas 160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance and you are not declaring a fuel emergency.
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-038.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 160，你是否宣布燃油紧急？
B：通知管制员你仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，并且不宣布燃油紧急。
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-038.referenceText: Negative, we still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance, QFA160
atc-scenario-0002-card-main-038.referenceTextZh: 否定，我们仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，QFA160。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-039.audioText: B: Your call sign is Qantas 923, you are near departure time, however 1 passenger is missing while his checked luggage is still on board, for security reasons, contact Company operations to offload the baggage.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-039.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Qantas 923，接近离场时间，但有 1 名旅客未到而其托运行李仍在机上。出于安全原因，联系公司运行卸下行李。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-039.referenceText: Dispatch, QFA923, we are near departure time, 1 passenger is missing, but his checked luggage is still on board, request offload the baggage.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-039.referenceTextZh: 签派，QFA923，我们接近离场时间，1 名旅客未到，但他的托运行李仍在机上，请求卸下行李。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-040.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 51, you have got information Whiskey, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-040.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 51 号登机口，已收到 Whiskey 情报，请求前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-040.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA923, gate 51, information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-040.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，QFA923，51 号登机口，收到 W 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-041.audioText: C: Qantas 923, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36R, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-041.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道 36 右，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-041.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO 01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, QFA923.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-041.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道 36R，LKO 01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，QFA923。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-042.audioText: C: Qantas 923, expect 10 minutes delay due taxiway Alpha 3 is temporarily blocked by a broken down vehicle.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-042.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，预计延误 10 分钟，因 Alpha 3 滑行道被一辆故障车辆临时阻塞。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-044.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-044.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-044.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA923, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-044.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA923，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-045.audioText: C: Qantas 923, there is a Citation next to you being pushed, once the aircraft is clear, push back onto Zulu 4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-045.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，你旁边有一架 Citation 正在推出，该机离开后，推出至 Zulu 4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-045.referenceText: Roger, once Citation is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, QFA923.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-045.referenceTextZh: 收到，Citation 离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东，QFA923。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-046.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-047.audioText: C: Qantas 923, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-047.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，经 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-047.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, QFA923.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-047.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，QFA923。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-048.audioText: B: As you are taxiing on taxiway Alpha 3, you notice several baggage are scattered on Alpha 3, about 400 meters ahead of your aircraft, tell Ground control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground services to retrieve the baggage.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-048.audioTextZh: B：当你在 Alpha 3 滑行道滑行时，注意到数件行李散落在 Alpha 3，约在飞机前方 400 米处。告诉地面管制你为何停止滑行，并请求地面服务取回行李。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-048.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA923, we notice several baggage are scattered on A3, about 400 meters ahead, we have stopped taxiing, request ground services to retrieve/remove the baggage.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-048.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA923，我们注意到数件行李散落在 A3，约前方 400 米，我们已停止滑行，请求地面服务取回/移除行李。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-049.audioText: C: Qantas 923, hold position, we have notified the ground handling department.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-049.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，保持位置，我们已通知地面保障部门。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-050.audioText: C: Qantas 923, taxiway Alpha 3 is clear, expedite taxi via taxiway Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-050.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，Alpha 3 滑行道已畅通，经 Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行道加速滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-050.referenceText: Roger, expedite taxi via taxiway A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, QFA923.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-050.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，QFA923。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-051.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-051.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，联系武汉离场并请求继续爬升。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-051.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA923, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, request further climb.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-051.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，QFA923，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，请求继续爬升。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-052.audioText: C: Qantas 923, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, expedite climb to 6000 meters due crossing traffic.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-052.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，武汉离场，雷达识别，因穿越航空器，加速爬升至 6000 米。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-052.referenceText: Roger, expedite climb to 6000 meters, QFA923.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-052.referenceTextZh: 收到，加速爬升至 6000 米，QFA923。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-053.audioText: B: During climbing, 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and ask to level off at 4500 meters and then return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-053.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你的 1 套液压系统失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求在 4500 米改平，然后返回武汉机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-053.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, QFA923, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 4500 meters and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-053.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，QFA923，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 4500 米改平并返回武汉机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-054.audioText: C: Qantas 923, climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, expect Lima Kilo Oscar 02 Alpha arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-054.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，爬升并保持 4500 米，左转，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，预期 Lima Kilo Oscar 02 Alpha 进场，ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-054.referenceText: Climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to LKO, expect LKO 02A arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, QFA923.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-054.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 4500 米，左转，直飞 LKO，预期 LKO 02A 进场，ILS 进近跑道 36R，QFA923。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-055.audioText: C: Qantas 923, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-055.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 923，下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-055.referenceText: Descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012, QFA923.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-055.referenceTextZh: 下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米，QFA923。

atc-scenario-0003-card-main-057.audioText: B: The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-057.audioTextZh: B：乘务长通知你有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-057.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA923, a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, request an ambulance to wait at the gate.
atc-scenario-0003-card-main-057.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA923，有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-058.audioText: B: Your call sign is Qantas 029, your destination is Dubai, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 302. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-058.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Qantas 029，目的地是迪拜，将从北京机场 302 号登机口离场。现在呼叫北京放行，请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-058.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, QFA029, Gate 302, request ATC clearance to Dubai.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-058.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，QFA029，302 号登机口，申请前往迪拜的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-059.audioText: C: Qantas 029, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initial climb 6600 meters, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000 meters en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-059.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，北京放行，许可飞往迪拜，按飞行计划航路，初始爬升至 6600 米，RENOB 32 离场，航路中请求高度改变至 11000 米，应答机 1725，跑道 36 右，离场频率 127.75。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-059.referenceText: Cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600 meters, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000 meters en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, QFA029.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-059.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往迪拜，按飞行计划航路，初始爬升至 6600 米，RENOB 32 离场，航路中请求高度改变至 11000 米，应答机 1725，跑道 36R，离场频率 127.75，QFA029。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-060.audioText: C: Qantas 029, read back correct, contact ground 121.9, good day.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-060.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，复诵正确，联系地面 121.9，再见。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-061.audioText: B: You are ready to start up engines, call Ground.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-061.audioTextZh: B：你准备好开车，呼叫地面。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-061.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, ready to start up.

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-064.audioText: B: You are ready for pushback now, call Ground.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-064.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出，呼叫地面。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-066.audioText: B: You have a problem: during pushback, the tow-bar is bent and you have to wait for another 1. Tell the controller.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-066.audioTextZh: B：你有一个问题：推出期间，拖把弯曲，你必须等待另一个。告诉管制员。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-066.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, the tow bar is bent and we have to wait for another 1.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-066.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，QFA029，拖把弯曲，我们必须等待另一个。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-067.audioText:
C: Qantas 029, roger, call me back when ready to taxi.
B: You are ready for taxiing, call Ground.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-067.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 029，收到，准备好滑行时再叫我。
B：你准备好滑行，呼叫地面。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-067.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, ready for taxi.

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-068.audioText: C: Qantas 029, taxi via taxiway Alpha 4 and Bravo 1 to holding point 36 right.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-068.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，经 Alpha 4 和 Bravo 1 滑行道滑行至 36 右等待点。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-068.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A4 and B1 to holding point 36R, QFA029.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-068.referenceTextZh: 经 A4 和 B1 滑行道滑行至 36R 等待点，QFA029。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-069.audioText: C: Qantas 029, taxi slower, give way to the Airbus coming from your right.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-069.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，滑行慢一点，让从你右侧来的 Airbus 先行。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-070.audioText: C: Qantas 029, taxi with caution, work in progress on right side of the taxiway.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-070.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，谨慎滑行，滑行道右侧有施工。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-072.audioText: B: You now find your nose wheel steering seems to be jammed, tell the controller.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-072.audioTextZh: B：现在你发现前轮转弯似乎卡住，告诉管制员。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-072.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, our nose wheel steering seems to be jammed.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-072.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，QFA029，我们的前轮转弯似乎卡住。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-073.audioText:
C: Qantas 029, do you require a tug?
B: Say yes, you need towing assistance.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-073.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 029，你是否需要牵引车？
B：回答是，你需要牵引协助。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-074.audioText: C: Qantas 029, roger, hold and standby for a few minutes while I'll get a tug for you.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-074.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，收到，保持并等待几分钟，我会给你找一辆牵引车。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-075.audioText: B: You are now airborne, time 32, you are passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters, contact Beijing Departure.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-075.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，时间 32，正通过 1200 米并爬升至 1800 米，联系北京离场。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-075.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029, airborne 32, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 1800m.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-075.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，QFA029，离地 32，正通过 1200 米，爬升至 1800 米。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-076.audioText: C: Qantas 029, cancel SID, turn left direct to Charlie Delta, climb to and maintain 6600 meters.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-076.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，取消 SID，左转直飞 Charlie Delta，爬升并保持 6600 米。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-076.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn left direct to CD, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, QFA029.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-076.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，左转直飞 CD，爬升并保持 6600 米，QFA029。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-077.audioText: B: Your primary display system has a fault, request return to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-077.audioTextZh: B：你的主显示系统故障，请求返回北京。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-077.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029, request return to Beijing due primary display system malfunction.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-077.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，QFA029，因主显示系统故障，请求返回北京。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-078.audioText:
C: Qantas 029, say again please, I read you 2.
B: Tell the controller that the primary display system of yours broke down, only the co-pilot's display is working. For safety's sake, you want to return to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-078.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 029，请再说一遍，我听你信号 2。
B：告诉管制员你的主显示系统坏了，只有副驾驶显示器工作。为了安全，你想返回北京。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-078.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029, my primary display system failed, only the co-pilot's display is working, request return to Beijing for safety.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-078.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，QFA029，我的主显示系统失效，只有副驾驶显示器工作，出于安全请求返回北京。

atc-scenario-0004-card-main-079.audioText: C: Qantas 029, roger, turn left heading 180, radar vector to land.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-079.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，收到，左转航向 180，雷达引导着陆。
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-079.referenceText: Turn left heading 180, radar vector to land, QFA029.
atc-scenario-0004-card-main-079.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 180，雷达引导着陆，QFA029。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-080.audioText: B: Your call sign is Qantas 358, from Singapore to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625, contact Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-080.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Qantas 358，从新加坡飞往武汉。你在 DAPRO 上空保持 10100 米，应答机 3625，联系武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-080.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA358, maintaining 10100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-080.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA358，在 DAPRO 上空保持 10100 米，应答机 3625。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-081.audioText: C: Qantas 358, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 6300 meters at your discretion.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-081.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 358，武汉管制，雷达识别，可自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-081.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6300 meters at our discretion, QFA358.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-081.referenceTextZh: 自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米，QFA358。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-082.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of Lima Kilo Oscar, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-082.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达显示 Lima Kilo Oscar 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-082.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA358, our weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-082.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA358，我们的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-083.audioText:
C: Qantas 358, negative heading 050 due to the restricted area.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before you can resume course.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-083.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 358，因限制区，否决航向 050。
B：告诉武汉管制你想飞航向 030 至少 5 分钟，然后才能恢复航路。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-083.referenceText: Roger, request heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before resume course, QFA358.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-083.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求航向 030 至少 5 分钟，然后恢复航路，QFA358。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-084.audioText: C: Qantas 358, roger, heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to Lima Kilo Oscar.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-084.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 358，收到，航向 030 批准，脱离天气后，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-084.referenceText: Heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO, QFA358.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-084.referenceTextZh: 航向 030 批准，脱离天气后，直飞 LKO，QFA358。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-086.audioText: B: You are maintaining 5100 meters, over Lima Kilo Oscar, ATIS Bravo received, now contact Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-086.audioTextZh: B：你保持 5100 米，飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar，已收到 ATIS Bravo，现在联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-086.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA358, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information B.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-086.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA358，保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，收到 B 情报。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-087.audioText: C: Qantas 358, Wuhan Approach, Lima Kilo Oscar 2 Alpha arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, be advised current information Charlie, you are number 1.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-087.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 358，武汉进近，Lima Kilo Oscar 2 Alpha 进场，下降并保持 1200 米，请注意当前情报 Charlie，你是第一架。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-087.referenceText: LKO 2A arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, information C, QFA358.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-087.referenceTextZh: LKO 2A 进场，下降并保持 1200 米，收到 C 情报，QFA358。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-088.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-088.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中你的气象雷达失效，联系武汉进近，请求航路沿线天气信息。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-088.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA358, our weather radar has failed during descent, request weather information along our route.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-088.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA358，我们的气象雷达在下降过程中失效，请求航路沿线天气信息。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-089.audioText: C: Qantas 358, roger, our weather radar shows cumulonimbus in the vicinity of Delta Alpha.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-089.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 358，收到，我们的气象雷达显示 Delta Alpha 附近有积雨云。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-090.audioText: B: Request Wuhan Approach for radar assistance to intercept final cause of runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-090.audioTextZh: B：请求武汉进近提供雷达协助，以截获跑道 36 左的最后进近航道。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-090.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA358, request radar vectors to intercept final course of runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-090.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA358，请求雷达引导截获跑道 36L 最后进近航道。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-091.audioText: C: Qantas 358, turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-091.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 358，右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-091.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters, QFA358.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-091.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米，QFA358。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-092.audioText: C: Qantas 358, turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer runway 36L, contact Tower 124.35.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-092.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 358，左转航向 030，下降并保持 600 米，许可截获跑道 36 左航向道，联系塔台 124.35。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-092.referenceText: Turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 metres, cleared to intercept the localizer runway 36L, 124.35, QFA358.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-092.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 030，下降并保持 600 米，许可截获跑道 36L 航向道，124.35，QFA358。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-093.audioText: B: You encountered the downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, informed Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-093.audioTextZh: B：你在短五边遭遇下沉气流并执行复飞，通知武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-093.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA358, we encountered the downdrafts on short final, going around.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-093.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA358，我们在短五边遭遇下沉气流，正在复飞。

atc-scenario-0005-card-main-094.audioText: C: Qantas 358, roger, when able turn right heading 090, climb to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach 119.7.
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-094.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 358，收到，可以时右转航向 090，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.7。
atc-scenario-0005-card-main-094.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, climb to 1500 meters, 119.7, QFA358.

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-095.audioText: B: Your call sign is Qantas 701, flying from Sydney to Wuhan, you are cruising at 10700 meters and squawking 3211, you are now entering Wuhan Control area, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-095.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Qantas 701，从悉尼飞往武汉，巡航高度 10700 米，应答机 3211，现在进入武汉管制区，与武汉管制首次联系。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-095.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA701, cruising at 10700 meters, squawking 3211.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-095.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA701，巡航高度 10700 米，应答机 3211。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-096.audioText: C: Qantas 701, radar contact, maintain 10700 meters.

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-097.audioText: B: There is a thunderstorm buildup near Lima Kilo Oscar, asked how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-097.audioTextZh: B：Lima Kilo Oscar 附近有雷暴发展，询问前机如何避开天气。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-097.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA701, there is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, how did the preceding aircraft avoid the weather ?
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-097.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA701，LKO 附近有雷暴发展，前机如何避开天气？

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-098.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Control you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid weather.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-098.audioTextZh: B：告诉武汉管制你想向东偏航 20 海里以避开天气。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-098.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA701, request deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid weather.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-098.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA701，请求向东偏航 20 海里以避开天气。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-099.audioText: B: You are approaching the top of decent point but there are CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay your descent.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-099.audioTextZh: B：你正接近下降顶点，但低高度有 CB，请求武汉管制延迟下降。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-099.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA701, request delay descent due CBs at lower level.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-099.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA701，因低高度有 CB，请求延迟下降。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-100.audioText: B: There are thunderstorms sources the south of the airport, arrival through Lima Kilo Oscar is difficult, ask Wuhan Control for an approach from the North and use Zulu Foxtrot arrivals.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-100.audioTextZh: B：机场南侧有雷暴，难以经 Lima Kilo Oscar 进场，请求武汉管制从北侧进近并使用 Zulu Foxtrot 进场。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-100.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA701, request approach from the north and ZF arrival due thunderstorm.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-100.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA701，因雷暴，请求从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-101.audioText: C: Qantas 701, turn right heading 020, expect Zulu Foxtrot 02 arrival.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-101.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 701，右转航向 020，预期 Zulu Foxtrot 02 进场。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-101.referenceText: Turn right heading 020, expect ZF 02 arrival, QFA701.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-101.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 020，预期 ZF 02 进场，QFA701。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-102.audioText: B: There is a small cumulonimbus in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-102.audioTextZh: B：你前方有一小块积雨云，请求向右机动，范围 2 海里内。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-102.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA701, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles due a small CB.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-102.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA701，因一小块 CB，请求向右机动，范围 2 海里内。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-103.audioText: B: During descent, your nose wheel steering failed, informed Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell him that you will stop on the runway after landing.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-103.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你的前轮转弯失效，通知武汉进近情况，并告诉他你将在落地后停在跑道上。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-103.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA701, our nose wheel steering failed, we will stop on the runway after landing.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-103.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA701，我们的前轮转弯失效，落地后将停在跑道上。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-104.audioText: B: You are told to use the runway 22 VOR DME approach, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for an ILS approach runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-104.audioTextZh: B：你被告知使用跑道 22 VOR DME 进近，但天气正在变差，向武汉塔台请求跑道 18 左 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-104.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA701, request ILS approach runway 18L due deteriorating weather.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-104.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA701，因天气变差，请求跑道 18L ILS 进近。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-105.audioText: C: Qantas 701, ILS approach runway 18L is approved.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-105.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 701，跑道 18 左 ILS 进近批准。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-105.referenceTextZh: 许可跑道 18L ILS 进近，QFA701。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-106.audioText: B: The approach lights are not bright enough, asked Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-106.audioTextZh: B：进近灯不够亮，请塔台提高进近灯亮度。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-106.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA701, the approach lights are not bright enough, request brighten up the approach lights.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-106.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA701，进近灯不够亮，请求调亮进近灯。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-107.audioText: B: You executed missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-107.audioTextZh: B：你因能见度差执行复飞，通知塔台。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-107.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA701, going around due poor visibility.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-107.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA701，因能见度差，正在复飞。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-108.audioText: C: Qantas 701, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-108.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 701，收到，执行标准复飞程序。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-108.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, QFA701.

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-109.audioText: B: The visibility has improved, expect radar vectors for another approach.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-109.audioTextZh: B：能见度已改善，预期雷达引导再次进近。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-109.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA701, the visibility has improved, expect radar vectors for another approach.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-109.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA701，能见度已改善，预期雷达引导再次进近。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-110.audioText: C: Qantas 701, turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-110.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 701，右转航向 090，许可跑道 18 左 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-110.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach runway 18L, QFA701.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-110.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，许可跑道 18L ILS 进近，QFA701。

atc-scenario-0006-card-main-111.audioText: B: You have landed at Wuhan Airport, but the tow truck is not in position, ask for a tug.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-111.audioTextZh: B：你已在武汉机场着陆，但拖车未就位，请求牵引车。
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-111.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA701, the tow truck is not in position, request a tug.
atc-scenario-0006-card-main-111.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA701，拖车未就位，请求牵引车。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-112.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 852, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 7, received ATIS Mike, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-112.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 852，在武汉机场 7 号机位，已收到 ATIS Mike，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-112.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA852, stand 7, information M, request clearance to Singapore.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-112.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA852，7 号机位，收到 M 情报，申请前往新加坡的放行许可。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-113.audioText: C: Singapore 852, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow Zulu Foxtrot 03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-113.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 852，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18 左，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-113.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow ZF03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA852.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-113.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 ZF03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18L，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615，SIA852。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-114.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-114.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-114.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-114.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA852，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-115.audioText: C: Singapore 852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-115.referenceText: Push back and start up at our own discretion, SIA852.

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-116.audioText: B: You have completed the push back and start up procedures. You decide to make an intersection departure from Echo 2, contact Ground to request intersection departure from Echo 2.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-116.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车程序。你决定从 Echo 2 交叉口离场，联系地面请求从 Echo 2 交叉口离场。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-116.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, push back and start up completed, request intersection departure from E2.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-116.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA852，推出和开车完成，请求从 E2 交叉口离场。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-117.audioText: C: Singapore 852, roger, intersection departure from Echo 2 is approved, taxi to Echo 2 via Alpha 6, Alpha 2, hold short of runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-117.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 852，收到，Echo 2 交叉口离场批准，经 Alpha 6、Alpha 2 滑行至 Echo 2，跑道 18 左外等待。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-117.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 is approved, taxi to E2 via A6, A2, hold short of runway 18L, SIA852.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-117.referenceTextZh: E2 交叉口离场批准，经 A6、A2 滑行至 E2，跑道 18L 外等待，SIA852。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-118.audioText: B: During taxiing you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway Alpha, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about the situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-118.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，你发现一辆车在 Alpha 滑行道上故障，你已停止飞机，通知 ATC 情况，并请求机场服务将车辆拖走。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-118.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, a vehicle has broken down on taxiway A, we have to stop our aircraft and request airport service to tow the vehicle away.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-118.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA852，一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，我们必须停止飞机，请求机场服务将车辆拖走。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-119.audioText: C: Singapore 852, roger, hold at present position, RAM services will be assume in a few minutes.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-119.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 852，收到，在当前位置等待，RAM 服务几分钟后会处理。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-119.referenceText: Hold at present position, roger, SIA852.

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-120.audioText: B: You are now holding short of runway 18L on Echo 2, request departure.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-120.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Echo 2 上跑道 18 左外等待，请求离场。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-120.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA852, holding short of runway 18L on E2, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-120.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA852，在 E2 上跑道 18L 外等待，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-121.audioText: C: Singapore 852, cleared for takeoff runway 18L.

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-122.audioText: B: During the takeoff role, your nose will run over a sharp object on the runway surface and the nose wheel tire burst, you aborted the takeoff, notify Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-122.audioTextZh: B：起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮压过跑道表面的尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，你中断起飞，通知武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-122.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA852, our nose wheel has run over a sharp object on the runway, the tire got burst, we aborted takeoff.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-122.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA852，我们的前轮压过跑道上的尖锐物，轮胎爆胎，我们中断起飞。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-123.audioText: B: Inform ATC about the situation and request fire trucks and maintenance.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-123.audioTextZh: B：通知 ATC 情况，并请求消防车和维修。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-123.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, we have run over a sharp object, and our nose wheel tire got burst, request fire service and maintenance.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-123.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA852，我们压过尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，请求消防和维修。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-124.audioText:
C: Singapore 852, roger, do you require anything else?
B: Tell the ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after inspection.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-124.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 852，收到，你还需要其他什么吗？
B：告诉 ATC 检查后你需要牵引车将飞机拖回停机坪。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-124.referenceText: Affirm, request a tug to tow us back to the apron after inspection, SIA852.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-124.referenceTextZh: 肯定，请求检查后用牵引车将我们拖回停机坪，SIA852。

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-125.audioText: C: Singapore 852, tug is on the way.

atc-scenario-0007-card-main-126.audioText: B: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-126.audioTextZh: B：请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-126.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
atc-scenario-0007-card-main-126.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-127.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 123, stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information Bravo received, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-127.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 123，215 号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，已收到 Bravo 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-127.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA123, stand 215, information B, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-127.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA123，215 号机位，收到 B 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-128.audioText: C: Singapore 123, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-128.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36 右，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-128.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO 01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runaway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA123.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-128.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO 01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325，SIA123。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-129.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-129.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好了，联系地面请求推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-129.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA123, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-129.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA123，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-130.audioText: C: Singapore 123, push back and start up approved, facing east.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-130.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 123，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-130.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA123.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-130.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA123。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-131.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar bent, contact Ground to request another tow bar.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-131.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖把弯曲，联系地面请求另一根拖把。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-131.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA123, our tow bar was bent, request another tow bar.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-131.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA123，我们的拖把弯曲，请求另一根拖把。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-132.audioText: B: While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-132.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系塔台检查风。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-132.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123, wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-132.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA123，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-133.audioText:
C: Singapore 123, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to runway 18L and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-133.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 123，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台改用跑道 18 左并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-133.referenceText: The tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to runway 18L, SIA123.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-133.referenceTextZh: 顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L，SIA123。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-134.audioText: B: You have departed from runway 18L, shortly after lift off you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an Emergency call, request to maintain runway heading.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-134.audioTextZh: B：你已从跑道 18 左离场，起飞后不久遭遇鸟击，右发失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-134.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA123, we encountered bird strike, right engine failed, request maintain runway heading.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-134.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉塔台，SIA123，我们遭遇鸟击，右发失效，请求保持跑道航向。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-135.audioText: B: Tell the Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-135.audioTextZh: B：告诉塔台你想放油并返回武汉机场。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-135.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123, request dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-135.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA123，请求放油并返回武汉机场。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-136.audioText: C: Singapore 123, roger, turn right heading 240 to intercept Lima Kilo Oscar VOR 030 radial inbound, climb to 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-136.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 123，收到，右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-136.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radio inbound, climb to 3000 meters, SIA123.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-136.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米，SIA123。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-137.audioText:
C: Singapore 123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-137.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 123，告知所需放油时间。
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 25 分钟。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-137.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 25 分钟，SIA123。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-138.audioText: C: Singapore 123, after passing Lima Kilo Oscar, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over Lima Kilo Oscar.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-138.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 123，飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar 时报告。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-138.referenceText: After passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO, SIA123.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-138.referenceTextZh: 飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告，SIA123。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-139.audioText: B: You are over Lima Kilo Oscar, call Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-139.audioTextZh: B：你在 Lima Kilo Oscar 上空，呼叫武汉管制。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-140.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-140.audioTextZh: B：告诉武汉进近放油现已完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-140.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA123, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-140.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA123，放油完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-141.audioText: C: Singapore 123, turn right track direct to Delta Alpha, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect runway 22.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-141.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 123，右转直飞 Delta Alpha，下降并保持 QNH 1015 上 2100 米，预期跑道 22。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-141.referenceText: Turn right track director to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect runway 22, SIA123.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-141.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，下降并保持 QNH 1015 上 2100 米，预期跑道 22，SIA123。

atc-scenario-0008-card-main-142.audioText: B: You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-142.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近，联系塔台。
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-142.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123, established on ILS approach runway 22.
atc-scenario-0008-card-main-142.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA123，已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-143.audioText: B: You are encountering severe icing at FL390 and want lower.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-143.audioTextZh: B：你在 FL390 遭遇严重结冰，想要更低高度。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-143.referenceText:
HongKong Control, SIA101, we are
encountering severe icing at FL390, request descent.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-143.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA101，我们在 FL390 遭遇严重结冰，请求下降。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-144.audioText: C: Singapore 101, descend to FL310, reach 310 within 4 minutes.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-144.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 101，下降至 FL310，4 分钟内到达 310。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-144.referenceText: Descend to FL310, reach FL310 within 4 minutes, SIA101.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-144.referenceTextZh: 下降至 FL310，4 分钟内到达 FL310，SIA101。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-145.audioText: B: During descent, you observed lightning to your right and the aircraft was shaking, you suspect you have suffered lightning strike, tell ATC the situation and request 10 miles deviation to the left.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-145.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你观察到右侧有闪电且飞机晃动，你怀疑遭受雷击，告诉 ATC 情况，并请求向左偏航 10 海里。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-145.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA101, we observed lightning to our right and the aircraft was shaking, we suspect we have suffered lightning strike, request 10 miles deviation to the left.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-145.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA101，我们观察到右侧有闪电且飞机晃动，我们怀疑遭受雷击，请求向左偏航 10 海里。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-146.audioText: C: Singapore 101, deviation 10 miles to the left is approved.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-146.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 101，向左偏航 10 海里批准。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-146.referenceText: Deviation 10 miles to the left is approved, SIA101.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-146.referenceTextZh: 向左偏航 10 海里批准，SIA101。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-147.audioText: B: Now the purser reports there is a strange smell coming from the rear cabin, tell ATC the situation and request further descent as precaution.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-147.audioTextZh: B：现在乘务长报告后客舱有异味，告诉 ATC 情况，并作为预防请求继续下降。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-147.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA101, the purser reports there is a strange smell coming from the rear cabin, request further descent as precaution.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-147.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA101，乘务长报告后客舱有异味，作为预防请求继续下降。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-148.audioText: C: Singapore 101, continue descent to FL250.

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-149.audioText:
C: Singapore 101, are you carrying any dangerous cargo?
B: Tell ATC you are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-149.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 101，你是否载有危险货物？
B：告诉 ATC 你在后货舱载有一些易燃液体。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-149.referenceText: We are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment, SIA101.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-149.referenceTextZh: 我们在后货舱载有一些易燃液体，SIA101。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-150.audioText:
C: Singapore 101, roger that.
B: Now smoke is coming out of the floor in the aft cabin, so you decide immediately to divert to HongKong. Declare an emergency and make a Distress call.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-150.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 101，收到。
B：现在后客舱地板冒烟，所以你决定立即备降香港。宣布紧急并发出遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-150.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, HongKong Control, SIA101, request immediately divert to HongKong due cabin fire.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-150.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，香港管制，SIA101，因客舱火警，请求立即备降香港。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-151.audioText: C: Singapore 101, roger your MAYDAY, fly heading 010 and descend to FL110.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-151.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 101，收到你的 MAYDAY，飞航向 010，下降至 FL110。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-151.referenceText: Fly heading 010 and descend to FL110, SIA101.

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-152.audioText: B: Tell ATC you may stop on the runway and evacuate passengers there.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-152.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你可能会停在跑道上并在那里疏散旅客。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-152.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA101, we may stop on the runway and evacuate passengers there.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-152.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA101，我们可能会停在跑道上并在那里疏散旅客。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-153.audioText:
C: Singapore 101, copy that, what kind of emergency services do you need?
B: Tell ATC you need fire service and medical service to be attendance near the runway.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-153.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 101，收到，你需要哪种应急服务？
B：告诉 ATC 你需要消防和医疗服务在跑道附近待命。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-153.referenceText: Request fire services and medical service to near the runway, SIA101.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-153.referenceTextZh: 请求消防和医疗服务到跑道附近，SIA101。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-154.audioText:
C: Singapore 101, fire and medical services, copy that.
B: After having discharged the fire extinguisher and applied the smoke procedure, the smoke is stopped and is controlled. Tell ATC your situation and cancel the Distress.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-154.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 101，消防和医疗服务，收到。
B：释放灭火瓶并执行烟雾程序后，烟雾停止并受控。告诉 ATC 你的情况并取消遇险。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-154.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA101, the smoke is under control, cancel distress.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-154.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA101，烟雾已受控，取消遇险。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-155.audioText:
C: Singapore 101, roger, do you want to continue to HongKong?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at HongKong as a precaution.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-155.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 101，收到，你是否想继续飞往香港？
B：告诉 ATC 作为预防你仍需在香港落地。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-155.referenceText: We still need to land at HongKong as a precaution, SIA101.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-155.referenceTextZh: 作为预防，我们仍需在香港落地，SIA101。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-158.audioText: C: Singapore 101, descend to 4000 feet, heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-158.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 101，下降至 4000 英尺，航向 340 加入右三边，看到机场报告。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-158.referenceText: Descend to 4000 feet, heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight, SIA101.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-158.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4000 英尺，航向 340 加入右三边，看到机场报告，SIA101。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-159.audioText: B: Tell ATC you need to park in a remote area and disembark the passengers there.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-159.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你需要停在远机位并在那里让旅客下机。
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-159.referenceText: HongKong Approach, SIA101, we need to park in a remote area and disembark the passengers there.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-159.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，SIA101，我们需要停在远机位并在那里让旅客下机。

atc-scenario-0009-card-main-160.audioText: C: Singapore 101, we will relay your request to flight operations department.
atc-scenario-0009-card-main-160.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 101，我们会将你的请求转告飞行运行部门。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-161.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 497, you are parking at gate 215, you have got information Papa, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-161.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 497，停在 215 号登机口，已收到 Papa 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-161.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA497, gate 215, information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-161.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA497，215 号登机口，收到 P 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-162.audioText: C: Singapore 497, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-162.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-162.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO 01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706, SIA497.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-162.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO 01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706，SIA497。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-163.audioText: B: Tell ATC 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-163.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 因重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-163.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA497, 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-163.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA497，因重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-164.audioText: C: Singapore 497, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-165.audioText: B: You are on the taxiway Alpha with engine running, contact Ground.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-165.audioTextZh: B：你在 Alpha 滑行道上，发动机运转，联系地面。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-165.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA497, taxiway A, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-165.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA497，A 滑行道，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-166.audioText: C: Singapore 497, taxi to holding point runway 36R via Zulu 4 and Alpha, hold short of Echo 7.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-166.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，经 Zulu 4 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36 右等待点，Echo 7 外等待。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-166.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4 and A, hold short of E7, SIA497.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-166.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，E7 外等待，SIA497。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-167.audioText: B: Contact Wuhan Tower and request intersection departure Echo 5 runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-167.audioTextZh: B：联系武汉塔台，请求跑道 36 右 Echo 5 交叉口离场。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-167.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA497, request intersection departure E5 runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-167.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA497，请求跑道 36R E5 交叉口离场。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-168.audioText: C: Singapore 497, negative due sequencing, continue to holding point runway 36R, hold short of Echo 7.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-168.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，因排序否决，继续滑行至跑道 36 右等待点，Echo 7 外等待。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-168.referenceText: Roger, continue to holding point runway 36R, hold short of E7, SIA497.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-168.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，E7 外等待，SIA497。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-169.audioText: C: Singapore 497, cleared for takeoff runway 36R, surface wind 350, 5 knots.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-169.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，跑道 36 右可以起飞，地面风 350，5 节。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-171.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-171.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉离场。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-171.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA497, airborne, passing 600 meters.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-171.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA497，已离地，正通过 600 米。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-172.audioText: C: Singapore 497, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to Delta Alpha, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-172.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，武汉离场，雷达识别，左转直飞 Delta Alpha，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-172.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021, SIA497.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-172.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米，SIA497。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-173.audioText: B: You are approaching Singapore Airport, contact Approach.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-173.audioTextZh: B：你正接近新加坡机场，联系进近。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-174.audioText: B: Your landing gear can't be extended normally, report this situation to ATC.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-174.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架不能正常放下，向 ATC 报告这个情况。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-174.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, our landing gear can't be extended normally.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-174.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA497，我们的起落架不能正常放下。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-175.audioText:
C: Singapore 497, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain runway heading, climb to 600 meters to complete the abnormal procedures.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-175.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 497，你的意图是什么？
B：告诉 ATC 你想中止进近，保持跑道航向，爬升至 600 米以完成非正常程序。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-175.referenceText: Request terminate the approach, maintain 600 meters on runway heading to complete the abnormal procedures, SIA497.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-175.referenceTextZh: 请求中止进近，跑道航向保持 600 米以完成非正常程序，SIA497。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-176.audioText: B: Your landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-176.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-176.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, our landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-176.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA497，我们的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-177.audioText: C: Roger, Singapore 497, the tug will be ready upon landing.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-177.audioTextZh: C：收到，Singapore 497，牵引车将在落地时准备好。

atc-scenario-0010-card-main-178.audioText: C: Singapore 497, you are number 1 to land, cleared ILS approach runway 18L, report established.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-178.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，你是第一架落地，许可跑道 18 左 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-178.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 18L, report established, SIA497.
atc-scenario-0010-card-main-178.referenceTextZh: 许可跑道 18L ILS 进近，建立后报告，SIA497。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-179.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 323, a flight from Wuhan to Singapore, you are at gate Echo 3, with information Charlie, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-179.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 323，从武汉飞往新加坡，在 Echo 3 登机口，收到 Charlie 情报，向武汉放行请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-179.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA323, gate E3, information C, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-179.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA323，E3 登机口，收到 C 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-180.audioText: C: Singapore 323, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3763.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-180.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，离场跑道 36 右，执行 Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3763。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-180.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow LKO 01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3763, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-180.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO 01 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3763，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-181.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-181.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-181.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA323, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-181.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA323，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-182.audioText: C: Singapore 323, push back and start up approved, facing east.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-182.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-182.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-182.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-183.audioText: B: You have completed push back with engines running, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-183.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出，发动机运转，准备好滑行。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-183.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA323, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-183.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA323，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-184.audioText: C: Singapore 323, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-184.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，经 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-184.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-184.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-185.audioText: B: During taxiing, a ground truck has broken down on taxiway Alpha 3 and blocked your way, ask Wuhan Ground for a tug to tow the vehicle away.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-185.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，一辆地面车辆在 Alpha 3 滑行道上故障并挡住你的路线，请求武汉地面派牵引车将车辆拖走。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-185.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA323, a ground truck has broken down on taxiway A3 and blocked our way, request a tug to tow the vehicle away.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-185.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA323，一辆地面车辆在 A3 滑行道上故障并挡住我们的路线，请求牵引车将车辆拖走。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-186.audioText: C: Singapore 323, hold position, the tug will come soon.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-186.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，保持位置，牵引车很快会来。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-187.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you notice the wind sock shows strong tailwind, ask Wuhan Tower to check the wind.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-187.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 右等待点，注意到风向袋显示强顺风，请武汉塔台检查风。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-187.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, holding point runway 36R, the wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-187.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA323，跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-188.audioText:
C: Singapore 323, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, ask Wuhan Tower to change to runway 18L for departure.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-188.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 323，风 200 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，请武汉塔台改用跑道 18 左离场。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-188.referenceText: Roger, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to runway 18L, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-188.referenceTextZh: 收到，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-189.audioText: C: Singapore 323, taxi via Alpha, Alpha 3, Tango and November to runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-189.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，经 Alpha、Alpha 3、Tango 和 November 滑行至跑道 18 左。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-189.referenceText: Taxi via A, A3, T and N to runway 18L, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-189.referenceTextZh: 经 A、A3、T 和 N 滑行至跑道 18L，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-190.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of runway 18L, you are ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-190.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 18 左外等待，准备好离场。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-190.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, holding short of runway 18L, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-190.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA323，跑道 18L 外等待，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-191.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-191.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉离场。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-191.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA323，正通过 600 米。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-192.audioText: C: Singapore 323, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn right, direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-192.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，武汉离场，雷达识别，右转，直飞 Whiskey Hotel Alpha，爬升并保持 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-192.referenceText: Turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000m, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-192.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-193.audioText: B: During climb, you hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, report this situation to ATC and hold for check.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-193.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，向 ATC 报告情况并请求等待检查。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-193.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA323, we hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, request hold for check.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-193.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA323，我们听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，请求等待检查。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-194.audioText: C: Singapore 323, hold at Whiskey Hotel Alpha VOR as published.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-194.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，按公布程序在 Whiskey Hotel Alpha VOR 等待。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-194.referenceText: Hold at WHA VOR as published, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-194.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 WHA VOR 等待，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-195.audioText: B: You have shut down the port engine, request immediate descent and return for landing.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-195.audioTextZh: B：你已关停左发，请求立即下降并返回着陆。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-195.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA323, we have shut down the port engine, request immediate descent and return for landing.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-195.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA323，我们已关停左发，请求立即下降并返回着陆。

atc-scenario-0011-card-main-196.audioText: C: Singapore 323, turn left, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-196.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 323，左转，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，预期跑道 36 右 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-196.referenceText: Turn left, direct to LKO, expect ILS approach runway 36R, SIA323.
atc-scenario-0011-card-main-196.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 LKO，预期跑道 36R ILS 进近，SIA323。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-197.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 615, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are parking at gate 232, you are fully ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-197.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 615，从武汉飞往新加坡，停在 232 号登机口，已完全准备好推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-197.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA615, gate 232, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-197.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA615，232 号登机口，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-198.audioText: C: Singapore 615, push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Zulu 4, abeam gate 234.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-198.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 615，推出和开车批准，推出至 Zulu 4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-198.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 234, SIA615.
