atc-scenario-0012-card-main-198.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，推出至 Z4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口，SIA615。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-199.audioText: B: During engine start, you have 1 engine starter failure, you wish to have more time to start the engine on taxiway Zulu 4.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-199.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动期间，你有 1 个发动机启动机故障，希望有更多时间在 Zulu 4 滑行道上启动发动机。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-199.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA615, we have 1 engine starter failure, we need more time to start the engine on taxiway Z4.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-199.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA615，我们有 1 个发动机启动机故障，需要更多时间在 Z4 滑行道上启动发动机。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-200.audioText:
C: Singapore 615, how long do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 5 minutes.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-200.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 615，你需要多长时间？
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 5 分钟。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-200.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 5 分钟，SIA615。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-201.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-201.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-201.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA615, ready for taxi.

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-202.audioText: C: Singapore 615, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-202.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 615，经 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-202.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, SIA615.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-202.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，SIA615。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-203.audioText: B: There is a Boeing 737 approaching you on Echo 3, ask the controller who has the right of the way.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-203.audioTextZh: B：Echo 3 上有一架 Boeing 737 向你接近，询问管制员谁有通行权。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-203.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA615, there is a B737 approaching us on E3, confirm who has the right of the way.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-203.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA615，E3 上有一架 B737 向我们接近，请确认谁有通行权。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-204.audioText: C: Singapore 615, hold at present position, give way to Boeing 737 from your right, he is number 1 for departure.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-204.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 615，在当前位置等待，让你右侧的 Boeing 737 先行，他是第一架离场。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-204.referenceText: Roger, hold at present position, traffic in sight, SIA615.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-204.referenceTextZh: 收到，在当前位置等待，看到航空器，SIA615。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-205.audioText: C: Singapore 615, caution work in progress in the vicinity of Echo 3.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-205.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 615，注意 Echo 3 附近有施工。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-206.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-206.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 右等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-206.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA615, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-206.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA615，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-207.audioText: C: Singapore 615, cleared for takeoff runway 36R, caution birds on the vicinity of airport.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-207.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 615，跑道 36 右可以起飞，注意机场附近有鸟。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-207.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 36R, roger, thanks, SIA615.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-207.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，收到，谢谢，SIA615。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-208.audioText: C: Now you are passing 800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-208.audioTextZh: C：现在你正通过 800 米，联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-208.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA615，正通过 800 米。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-209.audioText: C: Singapore 615, climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-209.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 615，爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-209.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016, SIA615.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-209.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米，SIA615。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-210.audioText: B: During cruise, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, make an Urgency call and advise ATC you want to level off at present level.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-210.audioTextZh: B：巡航期间，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，发出紧急呼叫，并告知 ATC 你想在当前高度改平。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-210.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, SIA615, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, request level off at present level.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-210.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，SIA615，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，请求在当前高度改平。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-211.audioText:
C: Singapore 615, roger PAN, when able, say your further intention.
B: The smoke is removed, you have turned off the air conditioning system, you want radar guidance to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-211.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 615，收到 PAN，可以时说明你的进一步意图。
B：烟雾已消除，你已关闭空调系统，想要雷达引导返回武汉机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-211.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA615, we have turned off the air conditioning system, request radar vectors to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-211.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA615，我们已关闭空调系统，请求雷达引导返回武汉机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-212.audioText: B: You turned off the air conditioning system to avoid high cabin altitude, asked to descend below 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-212.audioTextZh: B：你关闭了空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-212.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA615, we have turned off the air conditioning system, request descend below 3000 meters to avoid high cabin altitude.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-212.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA615，我们已关闭空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。

atc-scenario-0012-card-main-214.audioText:
C: Singapore 615, do you need any emergency services?
B: Tell the controller you don't need any emergency services, because there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-214.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 615，你是否需要任何应急服务？
B：告诉管制员你不需要任何应急服务，因为飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤。
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-214.referenceText: Negative, there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board, SIA615.
atc-scenario-0012-card-main-214.referenceTextZh: 否定，飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤，SIA615。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-215.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 308, a flight from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are parking at gate Mike 5, you have got the latest ATIS Golf, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-215.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 308，从武汉飞往法兰克福，停在 Mike 5 登机口，已收到最新 ATIS Golf，联系武汉放行申请 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-215.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA308, gate M5, information G, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-215.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA308，M5 登机口，收到 G 情报，申请前往法兰克福的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-216.audioText: C: Singapore 308, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, Zulu Foxtrot 05 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-216.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，Zulu Foxtrot 05 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-216.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, ZF 05 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-216.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，ZF 05 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-217.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-217.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-217.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA308, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-217.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA308，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-218.audioText: C: Singapore 308, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point 04 via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 2, Alpha to holding point Echo 5 runway 04.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-218.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，武汉地面，经 Zulu 4、Alpha 2、Alpha 滑行道滑行至 04 等待点，至跑道 04 Echo 5 等待点。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-218.referenceText: Taxi to holding point 04 via taxiway Z4, A2, Alpha to holding point E5 runway 04, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-218.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A2、Alpha 滑行道滑行至 04 等待点，至跑道 04 E5 等待点，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-219.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point Echo 5, runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower, and tell controller you are ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-219.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Echo 5 等待点，跑道 04，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你准备好离场。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-219.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA308, holding point E5, runway 04, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-219.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA308，E5 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-220.audioText: C: Singapore 308, line up runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, traffic on final.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-220.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，五边有航空器。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-220.referenceText: Roger, line up runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-220.referenceTextZh: 收到，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-221.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and ask to cancel SID and proceed to Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-221.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场并请求取消 SID，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-221.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA308, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, request cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-221.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA308，已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，请求取消 SID，直飞 ZF。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-222.audioText: C: Singapore 308, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, climb to and maintain 4500 meters.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-222.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，武汉离场，雷达识别，取消 SID，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，爬升并保持 4500 米。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-222.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4500 meters, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-222.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 4500 米，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-223.audioText: B: Now you are en route Germany, Rhein Radar Control, you are cruising at FL360, make an initial contact with Rhein Radar Control.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-223.audioTextZh: B：现在你在前往德国航路上，莱茵雷达管制，巡航高度 FL360，与 莱茵雷达管制 首次联系。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-223.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA308, en route, cruising at FL360.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-223.referenceTextZh: Rhein Radar，SIA308，航路中，巡航高度 FL360。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-224.audioText: C: Singapore 308, maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track due weather ahead.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-224.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，保持 FL360，因前方天气，航迹右侧偏置 3 海里。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-224.referenceText: Maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-224.referenceTextZh: 保持 FL360，航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-225.audioText: B: Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a Distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-225.audioTextZh: B：现在驾驶舱有烟雾，向 Rhein Radar 发出遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降以排除烟雾。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-225.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Rhein Radar, SIA308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-225.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，Rhein Radar，SIA308，驾驶舱有烟雾，请求紧急下降以排烟。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-226.audioText:
C: Singapore 308, roger MAYDAY, descend to and maintain FL100, keep us advised the situation on board and your intention.
B: Read back the instructions and tell the controller you are working the checklist and will advise.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-226.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 308，收到 MAYDAY，下降并保持 FL100，持续告知机上情况和你的意图。
B：复诵指令并告诉管制员你正在执行检查单，将会通知。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-226.referenceText: Descend to and maintain FL100, we are working the checklist and will advise, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-226.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 FL100，我们正在执行检查单，将会通知，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-227.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, the smoke can't be removed and you decide to divert to Paris, inform the controller your situation and intention.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-227.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，烟雾无法消除，你决定备降巴黎，通知管制员你的情况和意图。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-227.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA308, the smoke can't be removed, request divert to Paris.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-227.referenceTextZh: Rhein Radar，SIA308，烟雾无法消除，请求备降巴黎。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-228.audioText: C: Singapore 308, roger, turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, contact Paris Approach on 119.4.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-228.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，收到，左转航向 350，下降并保持 8000 英尺，联系巴黎进近119.4。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-228.referenceText: Turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, 119.4, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-228.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 350，下降并保持 8000 英尺，119.4，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-229.audioText: C: Singapore 308, descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach runway 08L.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-229.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，下降并保持 6000 英尺，许可跑道 08 左 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-229.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach runway 08L, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-229.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 6000 英尺，许可跑道 08L ILS 进近，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-230.audioText: B: Now you have landed on runway 08L, but you missed the first rapid exit, report it to Paris Tower and request vacate via the second rapid exit.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-230.audioTextZh: B：现在你已在跑道 08 左落地，但错过了第一个快速出口，向巴黎塔台报告，并请求经第二个快速出口脱离。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-230.referenceText: Paris Tower, SIA308, we have missed the first rapid exit, request vacate via the second rapid exit.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-230.referenceTextZh: 巴黎塔台，SIA308，我们错过了第一个快速出口，请求经第二个快速出口脱离。

atc-scenario-0013-card-main-231.audioText: C: Singapore 308, roger, take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-231.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 308，收到，使用第二个快速出口，脱离后联系巴黎地面118.5。
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-231.referenceText: Take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5, SIA308.
atc-scenario-0013-card-main-231.referenceTextZh: 使用第二个快速出口，脱离后联系巴黎地面118.5，SIA308。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-232.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 334 from Chengdu to Beijing, you are at stand 34, information India received, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-232.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 334，从成都飞往北京，在 34 号机位，已收到 India 情报，请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-232.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, SIA1334, stand 34, information I, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-232.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，SIA1334，34 号机位，收到 I 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-233.audioText: C: Singapore 334, stand by, I am going to check your flight plan.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-233.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 334，等待，我将检查你的飞行计划。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-234.audioText:
C: Singapore 334, Delivery, cleared to Beijing as filed, fight level #%$@*^#....
B: The ATC clearance has been disturbed, inform ATC and request repeat the clearance.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-234.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 334，放行，许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，高度 #%$@*^#……
B：ATC 放行许可受到干扰，通知 ATC 并请求重复放行许可。
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-234.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, SIA1334, the ATC clearance has been disturbed, request repeat the clearance.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-234.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，SIA1334，ATC 放行许可受到干扰，请求重复放行许可。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-235.audioText: C: Singapore 334 is cleared to Beijing as filed, 10700 meters, Delta 06 departure, runway 12, runway heading until passing 3000 meters before turning right, squawk 4562.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-235.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 334，许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，10700 米，Delta 06 离场，跑道 12，保持跑道航向直到通过 3000 米后再右转，应答机 4562。
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-235.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing as filed, 10700m, D06 departure, runway 12, runway heading until passing 3000m before turning right, squawk 4562, SIA1334.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-235.referenceTextZh: 许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，10700 米，D06 离场，跑道 12，保持跑道航向直到通过 3000 米后再右转，应答机 4562，SIA1334。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-236.audioText: C: Singapore 334, readback correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground 118.9.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-236.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 334，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时联系地面 118.9。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-237.audioText: B: Before being pushed back, the chief purser calls you that the general declaration form is not on board, inform ATC the situation and request delay the push.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-237.audioTextZh: B：推出前，乘务长通知你总申报单不在机上，通知 ATC 情况并请求延迟推出。
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-237.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA1334, the chief purser reports that the general declaration form is not on board, request delay the push.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-237.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA1334，乘务长报告总申报单不在机上，请求延迟推出。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-238.audioText: C: Singapore 334, roger, call me back when ready.

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-239.audioText:
C: Singapore 334, are you fully ready now? Your slot is 0310.
B: You need to open the cabin door for the release documents, advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-239.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 334，你们现在完全准备好了吗？你的时隙是 0310。
B：你需要打开客舱门取放行文件，告知地面还需要 5 分钟。
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-239.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA1334, we need to open the cabin door for the release documents, request another 5min.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-239.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA1334，我们需要打开客舱门取放行文件，请求再给 5 分钟。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-240.audioText: B: Later, the release documents are fully ready, call Ground you are ready.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-240.audioTextZh: B：稍后，放行文件全部准备好，呼叫地面你已准备好。
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-240.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA1334, ready for pushback and startup.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-240.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA1334，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0014-card-main-241.audioText: C: Singapore 334, push back and startup approved until abeam gate 33, do not block gate 35, there is incoming traffic to the gate.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-241.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 334，推出和开车批准，推出至正对 33 号登机口，不得阻挡 35 号登机口，有进港航空器要进该登机口。
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-241.referenceText: Push back and startup approved until abeam gate 33, do not block gate35, SIA1334.
atc-scenario-0014-card-main-241.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，推出至正对 33 号登机口，不得阻挡 35 号登机口，SIA1334。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-242.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 113, you're holding at holding point Echo 1, runway 04, you are fully ready.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-242.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Air France 113，你在 Echo 1 等待点，跑道 04，已完全准备好。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-242.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR113, holding at holding point E1, runway 04, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-242.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR113，在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-243.audioText: C: Air France 113, hold at present position.

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-244.audioText:
C: Air France 113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
B: Tell the controller yes.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-244.audioTextZh:
C：Air France 113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边航空器了吗？
B：告诉管制员看到了。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-245.audioText: C: Air France 113, behind the China Eastern 737 on short final, line up behind.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-245.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，跟在短五边的 China Eastern 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-245.referenceText: Behind the CES737 on short final, line up behind, AFR113.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-245.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CES737 后面，跟随其后进跑道，AFR113。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-246.audioText: C: Air France 113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-246.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-246.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2, AFR113.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-246.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2，AFR113。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-247.audioText: B: You are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID and proceed to Lima Kilo Oscar.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-247.audioTextZh: B：你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消 SID 并直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-247.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR113, passing 900 meters, request cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-247.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR113，正通过 900 米，请求取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-248.audioText: C: Air France 113, radar identified, continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to Lima Kilo Oscar.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-248.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，雷达识别，继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 Lima Kilo Oscar。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-248.referenceText: Continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to LKO, AFR113.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-248.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 LKO，AFR113。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-249.audioText: C: Air France 113, climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-249.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-249.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7, AFR113.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-249.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7，AFR113。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-250.audioText: B: Your position is just over Lima Kilo Oscar, the next waypoint is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report and request climb.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-250.audioTextZh: B：你的位置刚好在 Lima Kilo Oscar 上空，下一个航路点是 DAPRO，预计到达时间 34，做标准位置报告并请求爬升。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-250.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR113, over LKO, ETA DAPRO 34, request climb.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-250.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR113，飞越 LKO，预计 DAPRO 34，请求爬升。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-251.audioText: C: Air France 113, climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-251.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 113，爬升至5100米，无速度限制。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-251.referenceText: Climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction, AFR113.

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-252.audioText: B: During the climb, your port engine fails, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-252.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中左发失效，请向管制员报告情况并申请返航着陆。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-252.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR113, our port engine fails, request return to land.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-252.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR113，我们左发失效，申请返航着陆。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-253.audioText: C: Roger PAN, Air France 113, descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-253.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到紧急信号，Air France 113，下降至1800米，右转航向360。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-253.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360, AFR113.

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-255.audioText: B: Your altitude is 1800 meters, you have information Sierra, contact Approach.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-255.audioTextZh: 你当前高度1800米，已收到通播Sierra，请联系进近。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-255.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, 1800 meters, information S.

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-256.audioText:
C: Air France 113, current information is Tango, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 36L.
B: Read back and ask to use runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-256.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 113，当前通播为Tango，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36左跑道。请复诵，并因性能限制申请使用36右跑道落地。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-256.referenceText: Information T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 36L, request runway 36R due performance, AFR113.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-256.referenceTextZh: 通播T，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36L；因性能限制申请36R，AFR113。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-257.audioText:
C: Air France 113, change landing runway 36R.
B: You have just got the information from the cabin that 1 of your passengers suffered a stroke during the incident, informed the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-257.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 113，改为36右跑道落地。你刚从客舱获知，一名旅客在事件中突发中风，请通知管制员并申请落地后救护车保障。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-257.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, 1 of our passengers suffered stroke, request ambulance after landing.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-257.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR113，我们有一名旅客中风，申请落地后救护车保障。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-258.audioText: C: Roger, Air France 113, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-258.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，Air France 113，我们会通知机场医疗保障。现在左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36右跑道。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-258.referenceText: Roger, thanks, turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, AFR113.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-258.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36R，AFR113。

atc-scenario-0015-card-main-259.audioText: B: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-259.audioTextZh: 报告你已截获36右跑道航向道。
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-259.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, established on the localizer runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0015-card-main-259.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR113，已建立36R航向道。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-261.audioText: B: You are the pilot of Air France 782 which is bound for Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control, you are over DAPRO at time 35 and your level is 9500 meters, call Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-261.audioTextZh: 你是飞往武汉的Air France 782，刚由广州管制移交，35分过DAPRO，高度9500米，请呼叫武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-261.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR782, over DAPRO at 35, maintain 9500 meters.

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-262.audioText: C: Air France 782, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descend to 5100 meters before reaching Lima Kilo Oscar.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-262.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，武汉管制，雷达识别，在到达LKO前下降至5100米。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-262.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters before LKO, AFR782.

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-263.audioText: B: Now you are over Lima Kilo Oscar at 5100 meters, you have copied the latest ATIS Kilo, call Wuhan Approach control.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-263.audioTextZh: 现在你在LKO上空，高度5100米，已收到最新通播Kilo，请呼叫武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-263.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR782, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information K.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-263.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR782，保持5100米，过LKO，通播K。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-264.audioText: C: Air France 782, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Alpha arrival, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1004.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-264.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，武汉进近，雷达联系，执行LKO 1A进场，按QNH 1004下降并保持3300米。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-264.referenceText: Follow LKO 1A arrival, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1004, AFR782.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-264.referenceTextZh: 执行LKO 1A进场，按QNH 1004下降并保持3300米，AFR782。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-265.audioText: B: You've received a report from the flight attendant saying that there is smoke coming from the lavatory, you think it may develop into fire, so you declare distress to the ATC.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-265.audioTextZh: 乘务员报告洗手间有烟，你认为可能发展成火情，因此向空管宣布遇险。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-265.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, AFR782, there is smoke coming from the lavatory, request priority landing and emergency services.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-265.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，AFR782，洗手间有烟，申请优先落地和应急保障。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-266.audioText: C: Air France 782, Wuhan Approach, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 040, descend to 2100 meters, radar vector to ILS approach runway 36R, you have first priority.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-266.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，武汉进近，收到遇险信号，右转航向040，下降至2100米，雷达引导ILS进近36右跑道，你享有第一优先。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-266.referenceText: Turn right heading 040, descend to 2100 meters, radar vector to ILS approach runway 36R, AFR782.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-266.referenceTextZh: 右转航向040，下降至2100米，雷达引导ILS进近36R，AFR782。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-267.audioText: B: As the captain of the flight, you may want to make a passenger address. The PA may include: don't be panic, remain seated, the flight crew are experienced, ATC assistance is available to us, etc.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-267.audioTextZh: 作为机长，你可以向旅客广播。内容可包括：不要惊慌、保持就座、机组经验丰富、空管正在提供协助等。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-267.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking, fasten your seatbelt and remain seated. Don't worry. Believe us, we are a very experienced flight crew, and we can control this situation, and air controller is ready to help us.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-267.referenceTextZh: 女士们、先生们，我是机长。请系好安全带并保持就座。请不要担心，相信我们，机组经验丰富，能够控制当前情况，空管也已准备好协助我们。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-268.audioText:
C: Air France 782, Wuhan Approach, what is the situation on board now? keep us advised.
B: You are grateful for the reminding, report to ATC that more smoke accumulated in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-268.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，武汉进近，目前机上情况如何？请随时通报。感谢提醒，并向空管报告客舱内烟雾越来越浓，旅客咳嗽严重。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-268.referenceText: Roger, the smoke is becoming more and more dense in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing more and more, AFR782.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-268.referenceTextZh: 收到，客舱内烟雾越来越浓，旅客咳嗽越来越严重，AFR782。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-269.audioText:
C: Air France 782, Wuhan Approach, continue to descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1005, fire service and ambulance will be with you upon your landing.
B: You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-269.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，武汉进近，按QNH 1005继续下降至1200米，消防和救护车将在你落地时待命。请复诵许可并表示感谢。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-269.referenceText: Continue to descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1005, thank you very much, AFR782.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-269.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1005继续下降至1200米，非常感谢，AFR782。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-270.audioText: B: Now you report to ATC that you have already removed the dense smoke, 2 aged people and 1 baby are nearly suffocated, others are not seriously harmed.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-270.audioTextZh: 现在向空管报告，你们已经排除了浓烟，但两名老人和一名婴儿接近窒息，其他人没有严重受伤。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-270.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR782, we have removed the dense smoke, but 2 aged people and 1 baby are nearly suffocated, others are not seriously harmed.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-270.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR782，我们已排除浓烟，但两名老人和一名婴儿接近窒息，其他人没有严重受伤。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-271.audioText:
C: Roger, we'll relay this information to the parties concerned.
C: Air France 782, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R, you are Number 1.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-271.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，我们会把信息转告相关单位。管制员：Air France 782，下降至900米，预计ILS进近36右跑道，你是第一架。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-271.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R, AFR782.

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-272.audioText: B: You are fully established on the ILS runway 36R and your position is 12 Kilometers from touchdown, call Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-272.audioTextZh: 你已完全建立36右跑道ILS，距离接地点12公里，请呼叫武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-272.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR782, established on the ILS runway 36R, 12 km from touchdown.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-272.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR782，已建立36R ILS，距接地点12公里。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-273.audioText: C: Air France 782, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-273.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，继续进近，联系塔台118.6，再见。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-274.audioText: B: Now contact Wuhan Tower, report to ATC that you are 11 Kilometers from touchdown on final, and you are emergency landing aircraft.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-274.audioTextZh: 现在联系武汉塔台，向空管报告你在五边，距接地点11公里，并且是紧急落地航空器。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-274.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR782, 11 km on final, we have declared emergency.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-274.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR782，五边11公里，我们已宣布紧急情况。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-275.audioText: C: Air France 782, radar identified, continue ILS approach runway 36R, you are Number 1, report outer marker.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-275.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，雷达识别，继续ILS进近36右跑道，你是第一架，报告外指点标。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-275.referenceText: Continue ILS approach runway 36R, report outer marker, AFR782.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-275.referenceTextZh: 继续ILS进近36R，报告外指点标，AFR782。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-276.audioText: B: Now you're over outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-276.audioTextZh: 现在你飞越外指点标，请呼叫武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-276.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR782, over outer marker.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-276.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR782，飞越外指点标。

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-277.audioText: C: Air France 782, cleared to land runway 36R, wind 340 degrees at 9 meters per second, QNH 1005.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-277.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，可以36右跑道落地，风向340度，风速9米/秒，QNH 1005。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-277.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, QNH 1005, AFR782.

atc-scenario-0016-card-main-278.audioText:
C: Air France 782, taxi to Number 5 Apron via taxiway Echo 3, Alpha, Alpha 8, the fire services and medical teams are waiting for you on the Apron.
B: You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-278.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 782，经滑行道E3、A、A8滑行至5号机坪，消防和医疗队已在机坪等待。请复诵许可并表示感谢。
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-278.referenceText: Taxi to No.5 Apron via taxiway E3, A, A8, thank you very much, AFR782.
atc-scenario-0016-card-main-278.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道E3、A、A8滑行至5号机坪，非常感谢，AFR782。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-279.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 941, you are descending through 3900 meters for 3600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-279.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 941，正在从3900米下降至3600米，请联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-279.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR941, leaving 3900 meters for 3600 meters.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-279.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR941，离开3900米下降至3600米。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-280.audioText: C: Air France 941, Wuhan Approach, radar identified, information Echo is current, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-280.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为Echo，按QNH 1004下降并保持3000米。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-280.referenceText: Information E, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004, AFR941.

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-281.audioText:
C: Air France 941, descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-281.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度。请复诵指令，并告诉管制员你机型的光洁形态速度是200节。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-281.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed, our clean configuration speed is 200 knots, AFR941.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-281.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度，我们的光洁形态速度是200节，AFR941。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-282.audioText: C: Air France 941, turn right heading 300, you are number 3, 25 miles from touchdown.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-282.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，右转航向300，你是第三架，距接地点25海里。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-283.audioText: C: Air France 941, turn left proceed direct Delta Alpha, descend to and maintain 2100 meters.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-283.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-283.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2100 meters, AFR941.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-283.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米，AFR941。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-284.audioText:
C: Air France 941, hold at Delta Alpha as published.
B: Read back and ask the reason for holding.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-284.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，在DA按公布程序等待。请复诵并询问等待原因。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-284.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, what's the reason for holding? AFR941.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-284.referenceTextZh: 在DA按公布程序等待，请问等待原因？AFR941。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-285.audioText:
C: Air France 941, there are having a runway inspection at the moment, expect to delay more than 15 minutes.
B: Read back the ATC instruction and report that you are entering the hold.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-285.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，目前正在进行跑道检查，预计延误超过15分钟。请复诵空管指令，并报告你正在进入等待。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-285.referenceText: Roger, we are entering the hold, AFR941.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-285.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们正在进入等待，AFR941。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-286.audioText: B: The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state the situation to the controller, ask to leave the holding pattern right away.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-286.audioTextZh: 你的右发排气温度波动，请向管制员说明情况，并申请立即脱离等待程序。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-286.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR941, the EGT of our starboard engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern immediately.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-286.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR941，我们右发排气温度波动，申请立即脱离等待程序。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-287.audioText:
C: Air France 941, roger, stand by, continue your hold, we're changing the landing sequence, expect call you in 2 minutes.
B: The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state the situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-287.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，收到，请稍等，继续等待。我们正在调整落地顺序，预计2分钟后呼叫你。你的右发滑油压力正在快速下降，请向管制员说明情况，申请立即退出等待并下降。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-287.referenceText: The oil pressure of our starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit and descent, AFR941.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-287.referenceTextZh: 我们右发滑油压力正在快速下降，申请立即退出等待并下降，AFR941。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-288.audioText:
C: Air France 941, stand by, a traffic at your 3 o'clock position, is maintaining 1800 meters, crossing from your right to the left, report visual.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-288.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，请稍等。你三点钟方向有冲突飞机，保持1800米，从你右侧向左侧穿越，看到请报告。告诉管制员你已看到冲突飞机。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-289.audioText: B: Your starboard engine has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for landing priority.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-289.audioTextZh: 你的右发已经失效，请发出紧急信号并申请优先落地。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-289.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR941, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-289.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，AFR941，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-290.audioText: C: Air France 941, roger PAN, turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-290.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，收到紧急信号，左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36左跑道。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-290.referenceText: Turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36L, AFR941.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-290.referenceTextZh: 左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36L，AFR941。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-291.audioText: C: Air France 941, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35, goodbye.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-291.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，联系武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-292.audioText: B: Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900 meters, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of the aircraft.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-292.audioTextZh: 你当前航向060，高度900米，请联系武汉塔台并说明飞机状况。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-292.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR941, heading 060, 900 meters, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-292.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR941，航向060，900米，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-293.audioText: C: Roger, Air France 941, maintain present heading.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-293.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，Air France 941，保持当前航向。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-294.audioText: C: Air France 941, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-294.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，左转航向030，截获36左跑道航向道。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-294.referenceText: Turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, AFR941.

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-295.audioText: B: Report you have established localizer runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-295.audioTextZh: 报告你已建立36左跑道航向道。
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-295.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR941, established localizer runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0017-card-main-295.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR941，已建立36L航向道。

atc-scenario-0017-card-main-296.audioText: C: Air France 941, cleared to land.

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-297.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 126, destination Beijing, 8900 meters maintaining, over Tango Mike Romeo, Tango Zulu Hotel 10, squawk 6021, now contact Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-297.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 126，目的地北京，保持8900米，过TMR，TZH 10，squawk 6021，现在联系北京管制。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-297.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021.

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-298.audioText: C: Air France 126, Beijing Control, squawk 6021, radar contact, negative short cut, over fly Tango Zulu Hotel due to Air Force activity.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-298.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，北京管制，squawk 6021，雷达联系。因空军活动，不能直飞，需飞越TZH。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-298.referenceText: Radar contact, over fly TZH due to Air Force movement, AFR126.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-298.referenceTextZh: 雷达联系，因空军活动飞越TZH，AFR126。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-299.audioText: B: Ask the controller which runway is in use.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-299.audioTextZh: 询问管制员当前使用跑道。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-299.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, request runway in use.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-299.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR126，请问使用跑道。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-300.audioText: C: Air France 126, expect Kilo Mike 01 arrival, runway in use 36L.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-300.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，预计KM01进场，使用跑道36左。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-301.audioText: B: Ask whether you can use Kilo Mike 03 arrival and land on runway 01.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-301.audioTextZh: 询问是否可以使用KM03进场并在01跑道落地。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-301.referenceText: If available, request KM03 arrival, land on runway 01, AFR126.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-301.referenceTextZh: 如可用，申请KM03进场，01跑道落地，AFR126。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-302.audioText: C: Air France 126, after Kilo Mike, you can request Beijing Approach for change of runway.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-302.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，过KM后可以向北京进近申请更换跑道。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-302.referenceText: After KM, request change runway, AFR126.

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-303.audioText: C: Air France 126, descend to and maintain 4500 meters over Kilo Mike.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-303.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，过KM下降并保持4500米。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-303.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4500 meters over KM, AFR126.

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-304.audioText: C: Air France 126, contact Beijing Approach 119.7, good day.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-304.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，联系北京进近119.7，再见。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-305.audioText: B: Over Kilo Mike, maintaining 4500 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request runway 01, Kilo Mike 03 arrival.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-305.audioTextZh: 过KM，保持4500米，联系北京进近并申请01跑道、KM03进场。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-305.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, over KM, 4500 meters maintaining, request runway 01 KM03 arrival.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-305.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，过KM，保持4500米，申请01跑道KM03进场。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-306.audioText: C: Air France 126, negative due to spacing, Kilo Mike 01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information Alpha.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-306.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，因间隔原因不能同意。执行KM01进场，使用跑道36左，通播Alpha。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-306.referenceText: KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A, AFR126.

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-307.audioText: B: Tell the controller that your flap has some problem.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-307.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你的襟翼有故障。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-307.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, we're having trouble with our flaps.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-307.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR126，我们襟翼有故障。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-308.audioText:
C: Air France 126, roger, say intention.
B: You have to hold for a check.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-308.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，收到，报告意图。你需要等待检查。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-308.referenceText: Request holing for a check, AFR126.

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-309.audioText: C: Air France 126, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to Hotel Uniform Romeo, hold as published.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-309.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-309.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published, AFR126.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-309.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待，AFR126。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-310.audioText: B: Operations are now normal, request landing.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-310.audioTextZh: 操作已恢复正常，申请落地。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-310.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, operations are now normal, request landing.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-310.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，操作已恢复正常，申请落地。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-311.audioText: C: Air France 126, Beijing Approach, continue holding, runway is being cleaned due thick snow, landing action poor.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-311.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，北京进近，继续等待。因大雪，跑道正在清扫，着陆性能差。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-312.audioText: B: There is something wrong with the nose wheel steering system, request a tug after landing.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-312.audioTextZh: 前轮转弯系统故障，申请落地后牵引车。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-312.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, request a tug after landing, our nose wheel steering system failed.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-312.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，前轮转弯系统失效，申请落地后牵引车。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-313.audioText:
C: Roger, Air France 126, is there anything else abnormal?
B: Other systems normal, ask the controller how long the delay is.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-313.audioTextZh:
管制员：收到，Air France 126，还有其他异常吗？
其他系统正常，询问管制员延误多久。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-313.referenceText: Negative, other systems normal, how long is the delay? AFR126.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-313.referenceTextZh: 没有，其他系统正常，请问延误多久？AFR126。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-314.audioText:
C: Air France 126, snow is getting heavier, you have to hold about 1 hour.
B: The remaining fuel can hold for half hour, you have to request diversion.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-314.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，雪越来越大，你们需要等待约1小时。剩余油量只能等待半小时，你必须申请备降。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-314.referenceText: Our endurance is 30 minutes, request  diversion, AFR126.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-314.referenceTextZh: 我们续航时间30分钟，申请备降，AFR126。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-315.audioText:
C: Air France 126, stand by.
B: Your fuel temperature indicates
abnormal, you can only hold 10 minutes, request diversion to Dalian airport.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-315.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，请稍等。你的燃油温度指示异常，只能再等待10分钟，申请备降大连机场。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-315.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, our fuel temperature indicates abnormal,  endurance only 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian airport.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-315.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，我们燃油温度指示异常，续航只剩10分钟，申请备降大连机场。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-316.audioText: C: Standby 1, we will ask Air Force to use a temporary route.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-316.audioTextZh: 管制员：请稍等，我们将向空军申请使用临时航路。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-317.audioText: C: Air France 126, climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-317.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，按标准气压爬升并保持8100米。
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-317.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard, AFR126.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-317.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升并保持8100米，AFR126。

atc-scenario-0018-card-main-318.audioText: C: Air France 126, direct to Dalian airport, contact Beijing Control 120.35.
atc-scenario-0018-card-main-318.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，直飞大连机场，联系北京管制120.35。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-319.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 101, your destination is Paris, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 301. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-319.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 101，目的地巴黎，准备从北京机场301号登机口出发。现在呼叫北京放行，申请空管放行许可。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-319.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, AFR101, Gate 301, request ATC clearance to Paris.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-319.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，AFR101，301号登机口，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-320.audioText: C: Air France 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, initial climb 6600 meters, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 10400 meters en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-320.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，按计划航路放行至巴黎，初始爬升至6600米，RENOB 32离场，航路中申请改平10400米，squawk 1725，36右跑道，离场频率127.75。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-320.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600 meters, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 10400 meters en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-320.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至巴黎，初始爬升至6600米，RENOB 32离场，航路中申请改平10400米，squawk 1725，36R跑道，离场频率127.75，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-321.audioText: C: Air France 101, correct, contact Ground 121.9 for pushback and startup.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-321.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，正确，联系地面121.9申请推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-322.audioText: B: Contact Ground 121.9 for pushback and startup.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-322.audioTextZh: 联系地面121.9申请推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-322.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR101, Gate 301, request pushback and startup.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-322.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，AFR101，301号登机口，申请推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-323.audioText: C: Air France 101, Beijing Ground, short delay for pushback, an Airbus 340 inbound for Gate 302.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-323.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，北京地面，推出稍有延误，一架Airbus 340正进302号登机口。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-324.audioText:
C: Air France 101, pushback approved.
B: Ask ATC the direction of pushback.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-324.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，可以推出。询问空管推出方向。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-324.referenceText: Roger, in which direction should we pushback? AFR101.

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-325.audioText: C: Air France 101, my apologies, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-325.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，抱歉，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-325.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-325.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-326.audioText: B: All engines have been started, everything checked out normal, received information Golf, request taxi for Beijing Ground.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-326.audioTextZh: 所有发动机已启动，各项检查正常，已收到通播Golf，向北京地面申请滑行。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-326.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR101, information G, ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-326.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，AFR101，通播G，准备好滑行。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-327.audioText:
C: Air France 101, information Golf changed, intersection departure from Hotel is available.
B: Report that you have received Hotel but you want to change runway 01 for a short course.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-327.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，通播已变为Hotel，可从Hotel交叉口离场。报告已收到Hotel，但因航程较短，希望改用01跑道。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-327.referenceText: Roger, information H received, request runway 01 for a short course, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-327.referenceTextZh: 收到，已收到通播H，申请01跑道，因航程较短，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-328.audioText:
C: Air France 101, roger, Boeing 737 inbound approaching from left for Gate 303, once that aircraft is cleared, taxi via Bravo and Delta, hold short of runway 01.
B: You received report from information Hotel that Bravo is closed.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-328.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，收到。一架Boeing 737从左侧进近303号登机口，待该机通过后，经Bravo和Delta滑行，01跑道外等待。你从通播Hotel获知Bravo关闭。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-328.referenceText: Indications say that taxiway B is closed, confirm taxi via Bravo, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-328.referenceTextZh: 通播显示滑行道B关闭，请确认是否经Bravo滑行，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-329.audioText: C: Air France 101, correction taxi via Mike and Delta, hold short of runway 01.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-329.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，更正，经Mike和Delta滑行，01跑道外等待。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-329.referenceText: Taxi via Mike and Delta, hold short of runway 01, AFR101.

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-330.audioText: B: Now you are airborne. Contact Beijing Departure, you are passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-330.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地。联系北京离场，报告正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-330.referenceText: Beijing Departure, AFR101, passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-330.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，AFR101，正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-331.audioText: C: Air France 101, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000 meters on standard.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-331.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，北京离场，雷达识别，按标准气压爬升至6000米。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-331.referenceText: Climb to 6000 meters on standard, AFR101.

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-332.audioText: B: Flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them. Require emergency descent to 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-332.audioTextZh: 乘务员报告一名男子身上携带爆炸物并试图引爆。请求紧急下降至3000米。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-332.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, AFR101, flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them, request descent to 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-332.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京离场，AFR101，乘务员报告一名男子身上携带爆炸物并试图引爆，申请下降至3000米。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-333.audioText:
C: Air France 101, roger, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011, say endurance.
B: Read back and report that you can hold for 2 hours more.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-333.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，收到，按QNH 1011下降至3000米，报告续航时间。请复诵并报告还能等待2小时。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-333.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011, endurance 0200, AFR101.

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-334.audioText:
C: Air France 101, divert immediately to Tongzhou.
B: Request radar vector to Tongzhou.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-334.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，立即备降通州。申请雷达引导至通州。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-334.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR101, request reader vector to Tongzhou.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-334.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR101，申请雷达引导至通州。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-335.audioText:
C: Air France 101, turn right heading 180, maintain 3000 meters. When able, report current conditions on board.
B: Read back and then give a report that the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt 2 passengers.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-335.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，右转航向180，保持3000米。条件允许时报告机上当前情况。请复诵，并报告危险男子仍在挣扎，已伤及两名旅客。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-335.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, maintain 3000 metres, the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt 2 passengers, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-335.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，保持3000米，危险男子仍在挣扎，已伤及两名旅客，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-336.audioText:
C: Air France 101, roger, say intentions.
B: Tell the ATC that the man has finally surrendered, the 2 passengers are in dangerous situation, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-336.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，收到，报告意图。告诉空管该男子已被控制，两名旅客情况危急，申请返回北京机场并优先落地。
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-336.referenceText: The man is under control, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, 2 passengers are in dangerous situation, Request medical assistance on arrival, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-336.referenceTextZh: 该男子已被控制，申请返回北京机场并优先落地，两名旅客情况危急，请求到达后医疗协助，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0019-card-main-337.audioText: C: Air France 101, roger. Cleared runway 18R, you are number 1. Police officers and medical services will be ready on arrival.
atc-scenario-0019-card-main-337.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，收到。可以18右跑道落地，你是第一架。警方和医疗保障将在到达时待命。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-338.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 101, you are at Wuhan Airport, at Gate 215, information Golf received, request ATC clearance to Paris.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-338.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 101，位于武汉机场215号登机口，已收到通播Golf，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-338.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR101, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance to Paris.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-338.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR101，215号登机口，通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-339.audioText: C: Air France 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-339.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO 01离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，04跑道，离场联系119.7，squawk 2521。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-339.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO 01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-339.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO 01离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，04跑道，离场联系119.7，squawk 2521，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-340.audioText: B: You decide 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, ask if 9500 meters is available.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-340.audioTextZh: 你认为因重量较大，10700米不可接受，询问9500米是否可用。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-340.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR101, 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, is 9500 meters available ?
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-340.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR101，因重量较大，10700米不可接受，请问9500米是否可用？

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-341.audioText: C: Air France 101, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-341.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，巡航高度改为9500米。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-342.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground control.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-342.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面管制。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-342.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR101, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-342.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR101，申请推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-343.audioText: C: Air France 101, push back and start up approved, facing east.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-343.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-343.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-343.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-344.audioText: B: You are now on taxiway Zulu 4 with your engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-344.audioTextZh: 你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机已启动，请向地面管制申请滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-344.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR101, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-344.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR101，Z4滑行道，申请滑行。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-345.audioText: C: Air France 101, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Zulu 4 and Alpha, hold short of Alpha 4.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-345.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-345.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-345.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-346.audioText: C: Air France 101, give way to the Boeing 737 vacating on Echo 3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway Alpha and Alpha 9, hold short of runway 04.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-346.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，让行正在E3脱离的Boeing 737，冲突消除后，继续经滑行道A和A9滑行，04跑道外等待。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-346.referenceText: Give way to the B737 vacating on E3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of runway 04, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-346.referenceTextZh: 让行正在E3脱离的B737，冲突消除后继续经滑行道A和A9滑行，04跑道外等待，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-347.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 600 meters climbing, contact Departure.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-347.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，600米爬升中，请联系离场。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-347.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR101, airborne, 600 meters climbing.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-347.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR101，已离地，600米爬升中。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-348.audioText: C: Air France 101, radar contact, turn left, direct to Delta Alpha, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-348.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，雷达联系，左转直飞DA，按QNH 1015爬升至3000米。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-348.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR101.

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-349.audioText: C: Air France 101, climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite until passing 3900 meters.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-349.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，爬升并保持6000米，通过3900米前加快爬升。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-349.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite until passing  3900 meters, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-349.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持6000米，通过3900米前加快爬升，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-350.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000 meters, request higher level and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-350.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时遇到中度结冰，请申请更高高度并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-350.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR101, we are experiencing moderate icing at 6000 meters, request higher level.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-350.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR101，我们在6000米遇到中度结冰，申请更高高度。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-351.audioText: C: Air France 101, negative due traffic, maintain 6000 meters.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-351.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，因冲突飞机不能同意，保持6000米。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-352.audioText: B: Suddenly, your left engine failed at 6000 meters, make an Urgency call to ATC and request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-352.audioTextZh: 突然，你的左发在6000米失效，请向空管发出紧急信号并申请下降、返回武汉机场。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-352.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, AFR101, our left engine failed at 6000 meters, request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-352.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，AFR101，我们左发在6000米失效，申请下降并返回武汉机场。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-353.audioText: C: Air France 101, roger your PAN call, descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-353.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，收到你的紧急呼叫，下降至4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至04跑道。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-353.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04, AFR101.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-353.referenceTextZh: 下降至4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至04跑道，AFR101。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-354.audioText: C: Air France 101, continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-354.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-354.referenceText: Continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR101.

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-355.audioText: B: Now you have successfully restarted the left engine, but you still decide to return to Wuhan for safety concerns, inform ATC about the current situation and cancel the Urgency call.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-355.audioTextZh: 现在你已成功重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍决定返回武汉，请告知空管当前情况并取消紧急状态。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-355.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR101, cancel urgency, we have restarted our left engine, but we still want to return to land for safety concerns.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-355.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR101，取消紧急状态，我们已重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍希望返回落地。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-356.audioText: B: Now you are established on the ILS approach runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-356.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立04跑道ILS进近，请联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-356.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR101, established on the ILS approach runway 04.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-356.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR101，已建立04跑道ILS进近。

atc-scenario-0020-card-main-357.audioText: C: Air France 101, surface wind 070 degrees, 5 meters per second, runway 04, cleared to land.
atc-scenario-0020-card-main-357.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 101，地面风070度，5米/秒，04跑道，可以落地。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-358.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 675, a flight from Guangzhou to Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control to Wuhan Control, you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-358.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 675，从广州飞往武汉，刚由广州管制移交至武汉管制，过DAPRO，保持10100米。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-358.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR675, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-359.audioText: C: Air France 675, omit position reports.

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-360.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, report the situation to Wuhan Control and ask for 20 miles deviation to the west.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-360.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请向武汉管制报告情况，并申请向西偏航20海里。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-360.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR675, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation to the west.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-360.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR675，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，申请向西偏航20海里。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-361.audioText: C: Air France 675, negative due prohibited area.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-361.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，因禁区不能同意。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-362.audioText: B: Now you find the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-362.audioTextZh: 现在你发现导航性能下降，请向空管报告，并请他们核实你的飞行航迹。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-362.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR675, the navigation performance has been downgraded, request verify our flight track.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-362.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR675，导航性能下降，请核实我们的飞行航迹。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-363.audioText: C: Air France 675, you are still on track.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-363.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，你仍在航迹上。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-364.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed, tell Wuhan Control you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-364.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达失效，请告诉武汉管制你希望备降武汉机场。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-364.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR675, our weather radar has failed, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-364.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR675，我们气象雷达失效，申请备降武汉机场。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-365.audioText: C: Air France 675, turn left, direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha, descend to 5100 meters.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-365.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，左转直飞WHA，下降至5100米。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-365.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend to 5100 meters, AFR675.

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-366.audioText: B: Ask Wuhan Control for the current weather information at Wuhan.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-366.audioTextZh: 向武汉管制询问武汉当前天气信息。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-366.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR675, request the current weather information at Wuhan.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-366.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR675，请求武汉当前天气信息。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-367.audioText: C: Air France 675, the weather at Wuhan is fine.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-367.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，武汉天气良好。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-368.audioText: B: During approach, you find your flaps are jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you want to terminate the approach and hold at Whiskey Hotel Alpha for trouble-shooting.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-368.audioTextZh: 进近过程中，你发现襟翼卡阻，请告诉武汉进近你希望终止进近，并在WHA等待排故。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-368.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR675, our flaps are jammed, request terminate the approach and hold at WHA for trouble-shooting.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-368.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR675，我们襟翼卡阻，申请终止进近并在WHA等待排故。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-369.audioText: C: Air France 675, direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-369.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-369.referenceText: Direct to WHA, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published, AFR675.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-369.referenceTextZh: 直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待，AFR675。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-370.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, your flaps are still jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you intend to land at the longest runway, because the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-370.audioTextZh: 完成检查单后，襟翼仍然卡阻。告诉武汉进近你打算在最长跑道落地，因为无襟翼着陆会导致接地速度很高。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-370.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR675, our flaps are still jammed, request land at the longest runway due the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-370.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR675，我们襟翼仍然卡阻；由于无襟翼着陆接地速度会很高，申请使用最长跑道落地。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-371.audioText:
C: Air France 675, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
B: Read back the ATC instructions and ask the controller the braking action of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-371.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，可以ILS进近36右跑道。请复诵空管指令，并询问36右跑道刹车效应。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-371.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR675, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, request the breaking action of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-371.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR675，可以ILS进近36R，请问36R刹车效应。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-372.audioText: C: Air France 675, braking action runway 36R good.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-372.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，36右跑道刹车效应好。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-373.audioText: B: You have skidded off the runway after landing, your nose wheel was bogged, report it to Wuhan Ground and request emergency assistance.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-373.audioTextZh: 落地后你冲出跑道，前轮陷住，请向武汉地面报告并申请应急援助。
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-373.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR675, we have skidded off the runway after landing, our nose wheel was bogged, request emergency assistance.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-373.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR675，我们落地后冲出跑道，前轮陷住，申请应急援助。

atc-scenario-0021-card-main-374.audioText: C: Air France 675, the tug is on the way.
atc-scenario-0021-card-main-374.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 675，牵引车正在赶来。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-375.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 896, you are from Paris to Wuhan, you are flying at 11300 meters, approaching X-Ray India Yankee, call Xi'an Control.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-375.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 896，从巴黎飞往武汉，当前高度11300米，接近XIY，请呼叫西安管制。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-375.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR896, maintaining 11300 meters,approaching XIY.

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-376.audioText: B: You check with Xi'an Control if there is any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10700 meters?
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-376.audioTextZh: 向西安管制询问前机在10700米是否报告过颠簸。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-376.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR896, is there any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10700 meters ?
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-376.referenceTextZh: 西安管制，AFR896，请问前机在10700米是否报告过颠簸？

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-377.audioText:
C: Air France 896, you are the first aircraft in my sector, there is no report here.
B: Tell the controller you want to descend to 10700 meters.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-377.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，你是我扇区内第一架航空器，这里没有报告。告诉管制员你希望下降至10700米。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-377.referenceText: Roger, request descend to 10700 meters, AFR896.

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-378.audioText: C: Air France 896, descend and maintain 10700 meters.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-378.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，下降并保持10700米。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-379.audioText: B: You are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700 meters, the pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned, you want to fly back to 11300 meters to avoid turbulence and ice area. This is an Urgent call.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-379.audioTextZh: 你在10700米遇到严重颠簸，皮托静压加温功能故障，希望回到11300米以避开颠簸和结冰区域。这是紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-379.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Xi'an Control, AFR896, we are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700 meters, the pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned, request fly back to 11300 meters to avoid turbulence and ice area.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-379.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，西安管制，AFR896，我们在10700米遇到严重颠簸，皮托静压加温故障，申请回到11300米以避开颠簸和结冰区域。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-380.audioText: C: Air France 896, climb and maintain 11300 meters.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-380.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，爬升并保持11300米。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-381.audioText: C: Air France 896, contact Zhengzhou Control on 132.35.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-381.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，联系郑州管制132.35。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-382.audioText: C: Air France 896, radar contact, direct to Zulu Hotel Oscar, descend to 11000 meters.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-382.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，雷达联系，直飞ZHO，下降至11000米。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-382.referenceText: Direct to ZHO, descend to 11000 meters, AFR896.

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-383.audioText: B: Ask to climb to 11600 meters due icing.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-383.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, AFR896, request climb to 11600 meters due icing.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-383.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，AFR896，因结冰申请爬升至11600米。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-384.audioText: C: Air France 896, climb to 11600 meters.

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-385.audioText: B: You have established contact with Wuhan Control, initiated descent for runway 36R, during descent, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage, advise Wuhan Control this situation. This is an Urgent call.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-385.audioTextZh: 你已与武汉管制建立联系，开始为36右跑道下降。下降过程中，空速和高度读数异常，可能由结冰堵塞造成，请向武汉管制说明情况。这是紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-385.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR896,our airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-385.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR896，我们的空速和高度读数异常，可能由结冰堵塞造成。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-386.audioText: C: Air France 896, turn right heading 240.

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-387.audioText:
C: Air France 896, advise your intention.
B: Tell controller that your GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate compared to barometric indications, but you can still maintain a stable flight, request descend to leave icing area.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-387.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，报告意图。告诉管制员，与气压高度指示相比，你的GPS高度和地速不准确，但仍能保持稳定飞行，申请下降脱离结冰区域。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-387.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR896, our GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate, but we can still maintain a stable flight, request descend to leave icing area.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-387.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR896，我们的GPS高度和地速不准确，但仍能保持稳定飞行，申请下降脱离结冰区域。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-388.audioText: C: Air France 896, descend to 3600 meters.

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-389.audioText:
C: Air France 896, radar shows you are at 4800 meters, what's your current GPS altitude?
B: Tell the controller GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1800 meters.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-389.audioTextZh:
管制员：Air France 896，雷达显示你在4800米，你当前GPS高度是多少？
告诉管制员GPS高度为3600米，并申请下降至1800米。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-389.referenceText: Our GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1800 meters, AFR896.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-389.referenceTextZh: 我们的GPS高度是3600米，申请下降至1800米，AFR896。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-390.audioText:
C: Air France 896, another aircraft has information with regards to the differences between his barometric and GPS altitude, I have him on 3000 meters, his reported GPS is 3600 meters.
B: Acknowledge the transmission request further descent and leave icing area.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-390.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，另一架航空器提供了气压高度与GPS高度差异的信息。我给他3000米，他报告的GPS高度是3600米。确认收到，并申请继续下降以离开结冰区域。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-390.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR896, roger, request further descent and leave icing area.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-390.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR896，收到，申请继续下降并脱离结冰区域。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-391.audioText: C: Air France 896, contact Tower on 124.35, we have informed them your altimeter errors.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-391.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，联系塔台124.35，我们已通知他们你的高度表误差。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-392.audioText: B: You left the icing area and your instruments have returned to normal, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-392.audioTextZh: 你已离开结冰区域，仪表恢复正常，请向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-392.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR896, we left the icing area and our instruments have returned to normal.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-392.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR896，我们已离开结冰区域，仪表已恢复正常。

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-393.audioText: B: You have established on the ILS runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-393.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR896, established on the ILS runway 36R.

atc-scenario-0022-card-main-394.audioText: C: Air France 896, wind calm, runway 36R, cleared to land.
atc-scenario-0022-card-main-394.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 896，静风，36右跑道，可以落地。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-395.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 332, a flight from Wuhan to Paris, you are at stand 223, ask Wuhan Ground for push back and start up instructions.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-395.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 332，从武汉飞往巴黎，停在223号机位，向武汉地面申请推出和开车指令。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-395.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR332, stand 223, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-395.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR332，223号机位，申请推出和开车。
