atc-scenario-0023-card-main-396.audioText: C: Air France 332, Wuhan Ground, push back and start up approved, long push back.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-396.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，武汉地面，可以推出和开车，长推出。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-396.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, long push back, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-396.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，长推出，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-397.audioText: B: You realize the tow truck is not in position yet, request a tug.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-397.audioTextZh: 你发现牵引车还未就位，申请牵引车。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-397.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR332, the tow truck is not in position, request a tug.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-397.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR332，牵引车尚未就位，申请牵引车。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-398.audioText: C: Air France 332, the tug is on the way.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-398.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，牵引车正在赶来。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-399.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up procedures, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-399.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车程序，准备好滑行。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-399.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR332, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-399.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR332，推出和开车已完成，申请滑行。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-400.audioText: C: Air France 332, taxi via taxiway Alpha 3, Alpha and Echo 5 to holding point runway 22, taxi with caution, the taxiway is slippery due to heavy rain.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-400.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，经滑行道A3、A和E5滑行至22跑道等待点，谨慎滑行，因大雨滑行道湿滑。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-400.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A3, A and E5 to holding point runway 22, roger, thanks, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-400.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道A3、A和E5滑行至22跑道等待点，收到，谢谢，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-401.audioText: B: Now you have reached the holding point runway 22, contact Wuhan Tower and request line up instructions.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-401.audioTextZh: 现在你已到达22跑道等待点，联系武汉塔台并申请进跑道指令。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-401.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR332, reaching holding point runway 22, request line up.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-401.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR332，到达22跑道等待点，申请进跑道。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-402.audioText: C: Air France 332, behind the landing Airbus 330, line up behind.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-402.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，在落地的Airbus 330后进跑道，跟随其后。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-402.referenceText: Behind the landing A330, line up behind, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-402.referenceTextZh: 在落地的A330后进跑道，跟随其后，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-403.audioText: C: Air France 332, follow Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, maintain runway heading until 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Departure on 124.25, cleared for takeoff runway 22, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-403.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，执行ZF 01离场，保持跑道航向至1200米，联系武汉离场124.25，22跑道可以起飞，风向200度，风速8米/秒。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-403.referenceText: Follow ZF 01 departure, maintain runway heading until 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Departure on 124.25, cleared for takeoff runway 22, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-403.referenceTextZh: 执行ZF 01离场，保持跑道航向至1200米，联系武汉离场124.25，22跑道可以起飞，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-404.audioText: C: Air France 332, Wuhan Departure, when passing Hotel Golf, turn left heading 220, then direct to Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-404.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，武汉离场，过HG后左转航向220，然后直飞ZF。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-404.referenceText: When passing HG, turn left heading 220, then direct to ZF, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-404.referenceTextZh: 过HG后左转航向220，然后直飞ZF，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-405.audioText: B: Now you are at 3600 meters, you smelled something unusual in the cockpit, but you haven't found out the source of the smell, report this situation to Wuhan Departure and request hold for doing the checklist.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-405.audioTextZh: 现在你在3600米，驾驶舱闻到异常气味，但尚未找到气味来源。向武汉离场报告情况，并申请等待以执行检查单。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-405.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR332, we smelled something unusual in the cockpit, but we haven't found out the source of the smell, request hold for doing the checklist.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-405.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR332，我们在驾驶舱闻到异常气味，但尚未找到来源，申请等待执行检查单。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-406.audioText: C: Air France 332, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, hold at Zulu Foxtrot as published.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-406.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，右转直飞ZF，在ZF按公布程序等待。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-406.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, hold at ZF as published, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-406.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞ZF，在ZF按公布程序等待，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-407.audioText: B: As you perform the checklist, there is dense smoke in the cockpit, contact Wuhan Departure and make a Distress call for priority landing at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-407.audioTextZh: 执行检查单时，驾驶舱出现浓烟，请联系武汉离场并宣布遇险，申请优先返回武汉机场落地。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-407.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Departure, AFR332, there is dense smoke in the cockpit, request priority landing at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-407.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉离场，AFR332，驾驶舱出现浓烟，申请优先返回武汉机场落地。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-408.audioText:
C: Air France 332, roger MAYDAY, follow Zulu Foxtrot 01 arrival, descend to 1800 meters, when able, report passengers on board.
B: Read back the instructions and tell the controller that you have 220 passengers on board.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-408.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，收到遇险信号，执行ZF 01进场，下降至1800米，条件允许时报告机上人数。请复诵指令，并告诉管制员机上有220名旅客。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-408.referenceText: Follow ZF 01 arrival, descend to 1800 meters, POB 220, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-408.referenceTextZh: 执行ZF 01进场，下降至1800米，机上人数220，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-409.audioText: C: Air France 332, descend and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind runway 22, report when turning base.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-409.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 332，下降并保持600米，右转加入22跑道三边，转四边时报告。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-409.referenceText: Descend and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind runway 22, report when turning base, AFR332.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-409.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持600米，右转加入22跑道三边，转四边时报告，AFR332。

atc-scenario-0023-card-main-410.audioText: B: The smoke situation can't be controlled, request emergency services upon arrival.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-410.audioTextZh: 烟雾情况无法控制，申请到达后应急保障。
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-410.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR332, the smoke situation can't be controlled, request emergency services upon arrival.
atc-scenario-0023-card-main-410.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR332，烟雾无法控制，申请到达后应急保障。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-411.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 939, a flight from Wuhan to Beijing, you are parking at gate 07, you have received information Hotel, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-411.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 939，从武汉飞往北京，停在07号登机口，已收到通播Hotel，向武汉放行申请空管放行许可。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-411.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR9939, gate 07, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-411.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR9939，07号登机口，通播H，申请前往北京的空管放行许可。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-412.audioText: C: Air France 939, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure runway 18, Zulu Foxtrot 02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-412.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，按计划航路放行至北京，18跑道离场，ZF 02离场，初始爬升2700米，航路中申请改平，离场频率127.35，squawk 2615。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-412.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure runway 18, ZF 02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615, AFR9939.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-412.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至北京，18跑道离场，ZF 02离场，初始爬升2700米，航路中申请改平，离场频率127.35，squawk 2615，AFR9939。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-413.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-413.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-413.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR9939, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-413.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR9939，申请推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-414.audioText:
C: Air France 939, push back and start up approved, facing east.
B: Tell the controller you have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, you want to change the push back position in face west.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-414.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，可以推出和开车，机头向东。告诉管制员，强顺风下发动机启动有困难，希望改为机头向西的推出位置。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-414.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, but we have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, request change the push back position in face west, AFR9939.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-414.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，但强顺风下发动机启动有困难，申请改为机头向西推出，AFR9939。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-415.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up procedures, you are ready for taxi, request taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-415.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车程序，准备好滑行，请申请滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-415.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR9939, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-415.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR9939，推出和开车已完成，申请滑行。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-416.audioText: C: Air France 939, taxi to holding point runway 18 via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha and Alpha 1.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-416.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-416.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1, AFR9939.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-416.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR9939。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-417.audioText: C: Air France 939, hold at present position, give way to Airbus 320 vacating via Echo 5.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-417.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，在当前位置等待，让行经E5脱离的Airbus 320。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-417.referenceText: Holding position, traffic in sight, AFR9939.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-417.referenceTextZh: 当前位置等待，看到冲突飞机，AFR9939。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-418.audioText: C: Air France 939, traffic is clear, continue taxi via Alpha and Alpha 1 to holding point runway 18.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-418.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，冲突已解除，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-418.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point runway 18, AFR9939.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-418.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR9939。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-419.audioText: C: Air France 939, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-419.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，联系武汉塔台124.35。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-420.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Alpha 1, runway 18, you have completed pre-takeoff checklist, you are ready for takeoff, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-420.audioTextZh: 现在你在A1等待点、18跑道，起飞前检查单已完成，准备好起飞，请联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-420.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, holding point A1, runway 18, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-420.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR9939，A1等待点，18跑道，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-421.audioText: C: Air France 939, line up runway 18.

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-422.audioText: C: Air France 939, cleared for takeoff runway 18, surface wind calm.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-422.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，18跑道可以起飞，地面静风。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-423.audioText: B: During takeoff role, you notice an Airbus 320 is crossing your runway, you aborted takeoff, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-423.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑过程中，你发现一架Airbus 320正在穿越你的跑道，你中断起飞，请向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-423.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, we aborted takeoff due an A320 crossing runway 18.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-423.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR9939，因一架A320穿越18跑道，我们中断起飞。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-424.audioText:
C: Air France 939, what is the situation like now?
B: Tell the controller your brakes have exceeded the temperature limit, and request taxi back to apron to have the plane checked.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-424.audioTextZh:
管制员：Air France 939，现在情况如何？
告诉管制员刹车已超过温度限制，并申请滑回机坪检查飞机。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-424.referenceText: Our brakes are overheating, request taxi back to apron for check, AFR9939.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-424.referenceTextZh: 我们刹车过热，申请滑回机坪检查，AFR9939。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-425.audioText: C: Air France 939, expedite vacate via Echo 1.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-425.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，尽快经E1脱离。

atc-scenario-0024-card-main-426.audioText:
C: Air France 939, do you need any assistance?
B: Tell the controller you need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-426.audioTextZh:
管制员：Air France 939，你需要任何协助吗？
告诉管制员需要客梯车让旅客下机。
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-426.referenceText: Affirm, we need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers, AFR9939.
atc-scenario-0024-card-main-426.referenceTextZh: 需要，我们需要客梯车让旅客下机，AFR9939。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-427.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 038, from Beijing to London, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 1800 meters, now contact Beijing Departure.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-427.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 038，从北京飞往伦敦，正在通过1200米爬升至1800米，现在联系北京离场。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-427.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, passing 1200 metres, climbing to 1800 metres.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-427.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW038，正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-428.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000 meters on standard.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-428.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京离场，雷达识别，按标准气压爬升至6000米。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-428.referenceText: Climb to 6000 metres on standard, BAW038.

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-429.audioText: B: The aircraft ingested something, request descent to 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-429.audioTextZh: 飞机吸入异物，申请下降至3000米。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-429.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, foreign object ingestion, request descent to 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-429.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW038，飞机吸入异物，申请下降至3000米。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-430.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, roger, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-430.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，按QNH 1011下降至3000米。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-430.referenceText: Descend to 3000 metres on QNH 1011, BAW038.

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-431.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, Beijing Departure, report intention.
B: Your turbine blades appear to be broken, request return to Beijing airport.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-431.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京离场，报告意图。你的涡轮叶片似乎损坏，申请返回北京机场。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-431.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, request return to Beijing airport, our turbine blades appear to be broken.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-431.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW038，申请返回北京机场，我们的涡轮叶片似乎损坏。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-432.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, roger, turn right heading 180, information India, radar vector for landing.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-432.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，右转航向180，通播India，雷达引导落地。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-433.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, report current situation.
B: Tell the controller that the port engine flamed out and you should land as soon as possible.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-433.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，报告当前情况。告诉管制员左发熄火，你需要尽快落地。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-433.referenceText: Beijing Departure, our port engine flames out, request priority landing, BAW038.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-433.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，我们左发熄火，申请优先落地，BAW038。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-434.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, roger, can you execute normal landing? do you require fuel dumping?
B: You can land normally and no need for fuel dumping.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-434.audioTextZh:
管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，能否正常着陆？是否需要放油？
你可以正常着陆，不需要放油。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-434.referenceText: We can make a normal landing without dumping fuel, BAW038.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-434.referenceTextZh: 我们可以正常着陆，不需要放油，BAW038。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-435.audioText: B: 2 minutes later. Tell the controller the fuel passage is blocked, only the auxiliary fuel tank is available, request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-435.audioTextZh: 2分钟后，告诉管制员燃油通路堵塞，只有辅助油箱可用，申请优先落地。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-435.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW038, fuel passage is blocked, now only the auxiliary fuel tank is operative, request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-435.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW038，燃油通路堵塞，目前只有辅助油箱可用，申请优先落地。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-436.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, Beijing roger, report endurance.
B: Tell Control that your endurance is 30 minutes.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-436.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京收到，报告续航时间。告诉管制你的续航时间为30分钟。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-437.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, roger, turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, caution surface wind 240, 12 meters per second, gusting to 18 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-437.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，右转航向300，预计01跑道。注意地面风240度，12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-437.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, BAW038.

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-438.audioText: C:Speedbird 038, turn right heading 340, report established localizer.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-438.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，右转航向340，建立航向道后报告。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-438.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, report established localizer, BAW038.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-438.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，建立航向道后报告，BAW038。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-439.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，BAW038，已建立航向道。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-440.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, continue approach, contact Beijing Tower 118.1, I will advise them of your problem.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-440.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1，我会告知他们你的问题。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-442.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker, caution surface wind 240, 12 meters per second, gusting to 18 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-442.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京塔台，继续进近，报告外指点标。注意地面风240度，12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-442.referenceText: Continue approach, report outer marker, BAW038.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-442.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，报告外指点标，BAW038。

atc-scenario-0025-card-main-444.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, cleared to land runway 01, wind 240, 12 meters per second, report vacated.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-444.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，可以01跑道落地，风240度，12米/秒，脱离后报告。
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-444.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, report vacated, BAW038.
atc-scenario-0025-card-main-444.referenceTextZh: 可以01跑道落地，脱离后报告，BAW038。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-445.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 120, you are maintaining 11000 meters over Whiskey X-Ray India, squawking 4521, make initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-445.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 120，在WXI上空保持11000米，squawk 4521，首次联系郑州管制。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-445.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW120, maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4521.

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-446.audioText:
C: Speedbird 120, Zhengzhou Control, radar identified, descend and maintain 9200 meters.
B: You want to maintain present level and descent after passing AKOMA.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-446.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 120，郑州管制，雷达识别，下降并保持9200米。你希望保持当前高度，过AKOMA后再下降。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-446.referenceText: Request maintain present level and expect descent after passing AKOMA, BAW120.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-446.referenceTextZh: 申请保持当前高度，过AKOMA后再下降，BAW120。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-447.audioText:
C: Speedbird 120, you can either descend now without speed restrictions or maintain 11000 meters and fly heading 260 for 5 minutes, which do you prefer?
B: Tell the controller you prefer to descend to 9200 meters.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-447.audioTextZh:
管制员：Speedbird 120，你可以现在下降且无速度限制，或保持11000米并飞航向260五分钟，你选择哪一个？
告诉管制员你选择下降至9200米。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-447.referenceText: We prefer to descend to 9200 meters, BAW120.

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-448.audioText: C: Speedbird 120, descend to 9200 meters at 2000 feet per minute, offset 3 miles right.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-448.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 120，以每分钟2000英尺下降率下降至9200米，向右偏置3海里。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-448.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters at 2000 feet per minute, offset 3 miles right, BAW120.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-448.referenceTextZh: 以每分钟2000英尺下降率下降至9200米，向右偏置3海里，BAW120。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-449.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters in icing condition, the instrument shows your pitot tube heating system failed, your air speed indications appeared to be inaccurate, report it to Zhengzhou Control and request descent to lower level to avoid icing.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-449.audioTextZh: 现在你在9200米结冰条件下飞行，仪表显示皮托管加温系统失效，空速指示似乎不准确。向郑州管制报告，并申请下降到较低高度以避开结冰。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-449.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW120, we have encountered severe icing at 9200 meters and our pitot tube heating system failed, our air speed indications appear to be inaccurate, request descent to lower level to avoid icing.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-449.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，BAW120，我们在9200米遇到严重结冰，皮托管加温系统失效，空速指示似乎不准确，申请下降到较低高度以避开结冰。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-450.audioText: C: Speedbird 120, descend to 7800 meters, cancel offset, direct to AKOMA, reduce to minimum clean speed due flow control.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-450.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 120，下降至7800米，取消偏置，直飞AKOMA，因流量管制减至最小光洁速度。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-450.referenceText: Descend to 7800 meters, cancel offset, direct to AKOMA, reduce to minimum clean speed, BAW120.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-450.referenceTextZh: 下降至7800米，取消偏置，直飞AKOMA，减至最小光洁速度，BAW120。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-451.audioText: C: Speedbird 120, speed restrictions canceled, descend to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 119.7.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-451.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 120，速度限制取消，下降并保持6600米，联系武汉管制119.7。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-451.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 119.7, BAW120.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-451.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持6600米，联系武汉管制119.7，BAW120。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-452.audioText: B: You are leaving 7200 meters for 6600 meters, squawking 4521, contact Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-452.audioTextZh: 你正离开7200米下降至6600米，squawk 4521，联系武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-452.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW120, leaving 7200 meters for 6600 meters, squawking 4521.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-452.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW120，离开7200米下降至6600米，squawk 4521。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-453.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 4800 meters, you have got information India, contact Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-453.audioTextZh: 现在你保持4800米，已收到通播India，联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-453.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW120, maintaining 4800 meters, information I.

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-454.audioText: C: Speedbird 120, follow Zulu Foxtrot 12 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 18R.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-454.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 120，执行ZF 12进场，预计ILS进近18右跑道。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-454.referenceText: Follow ZF 12 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 18R, BAW120.

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-455.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the localizer runway 18R, you are 10 miles from touchdown.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-455.audioTextZh: 现在你已截获18右跑道航向道，距接地点10海里。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-455.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW120, established on the localizer runway 18R, 10 miles from touchdown.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-455.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW120，已建立18R航向道，距接地点10海里。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-456.audioText: C: Speedbird 120, wind 220, 10 meters per second, gusting to 15, cleared to land runway 18R.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-456.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 120，风220度，10米/秒，阵风15米/秒，可以18右跑道落地。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-457.audioText: B: You encountered strong wind shear on short final, you made a missed approach, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-457.audioTextZh: 短五边遇到强风切变，你复飞了，请向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-457.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW120, strong wind shear on short final, going around.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-457.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW120，短五边遇到强风切变，正在复飞。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-458.audioText: C: Speedbird 120, follow standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1800 meters.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-458.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 120，执行标准复飞程序，爬升至1800米。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-458.referenceText: Follow standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1800 meters, BAW120.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-458.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，爬升至1800米，BAW120。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-459.audioText: B: Ask Wuhan Approach for ILS approach runway 22.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-459.audioTextZh: 向武汉进近申请ILS进近22跑道。
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-459.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW120, request ILS approach runway 22.
atc-scenario-0026-card-main-459.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW120，申请ILS进近22跑道。

atc-scenario-0026-card-main-460.audioText: C: Speedbird 120, contact Wuhan Tower on 120.45.

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-461.audioText:
B: Your call sign is Speedbird 203, you are just over Zulu Foxtrot.
C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Approach, climb to maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-461.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 203，刚过ZF。管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉进近，爬升保持4800米，联系武汉管制118.1。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-462.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control, ask for 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-462.audioTextZh: 首次联系武汉管制，申请8900米。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-462.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW203, maintaining 4800 meters, request climb to 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-462.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW203，保持4800米，申请爬升至8900米。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-463.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 7500 meters, expect 8900 meters at 16.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-463.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉管制，雷达联系，爬升至7500米，预计16分给8900米。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-464.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have encountered severe clear air turbulence, and ask for 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-464.audioTextZh: 告知管制员你遇到严重晴空颠簸，并申请8900米。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-464.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW203, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence, request 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-464.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW203，我们遇到严重晴空颠簸，申请8900米。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-465.audioText: C: Roger, Speedbird 203, climb to 8900 meters.

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-466.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Control, is there any damage to the aircraft or are there any passengers injured?
B: Tell the controller that there isn't any aircraft damage, and the purser told you that passengers are OK.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-466.audioTextZh:
管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉管制，飞机是否受损，是否有旅客受伤？
告诉管制员飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客都没事。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-466.referenceText: There isn't any damage to the aircraft and the purser reported that the passengers are just fine, BAW203.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-466.referenceTextZh: 飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客情况都正常，BAW203。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-467.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control that you have just been told an old passenger has been seriously injured.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-467.audioTextZh: 通知武汉管制，你刚得知一名老年旅客严重受伤。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-467.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW203, we have just told that an old passenger has been seriously injured.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-467.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW203，我们刚得知一名老年旅客严重受伤。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-468.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, roger, report your intention.
B: Tell the controller that you want to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-468.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，收到，报告意图。告诉管制员你希望在武汉机场落地。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-468.referenceText: We would like to land at Wuhan Airport, BAW203.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-468.referenceTextZh: 我们希望在武汉机场落地，BAW203。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-469.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, turn left direct to Zulu Foxtrot and descend to 5100 meters.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-469.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，左转直飞ZF，下降至5100米。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-469.referenceText: Turn left direct to ZF, descend to 5100 meters, BAW203.

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-470.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, do you need any assistance?
B: Inform the controller that you need an ambulance and first aid on arrival.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-470.audioTextZh:
管制员：Speedbird 203，是否需要任何协助？
告知管制员到达后需要救护车和急救。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-470.referenceText: We will need an ambulance and first aid on arrival, BAW203.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-470.referenceTextZh: 到达后我们需要救护车和急救，BAW203。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-471.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, maintain 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-471.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，保持5100米，联系武汉进近118.9。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-472.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach, inform the controller that you have an injured passenger on board.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-472.audioTextZh: 首次联系武汉进近，告知管制员机上有受伤旅客。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-472.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW203, maintaining 5100 meters, over ZF, we have an injured passenger on board.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-472.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW203，保持5100米，过ZF，机上有一名受伤旅客。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-473.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow Zulu Foxtrot 1 Alpha arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, information Charlie.
B: Read back the controller's instruction and inform controller that you have received the Information.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-473.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉进近，雷达联系，执行ZF 1A进场，按QNH 1017下降至2700米，通播Charlie。请复诵管制指令，并告知管制员已收到通播。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-473.referenceText: Follow ZF 1A arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, we have received Information C, BAW203.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-473.referenceTextZh: 执行ZF 1A进场，按QNH 1017下降至2700米，已收到通播C，BAW203。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-474.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
B: Read back the controller's instruction and tell the controller that the passenger has died.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-474.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，下降至900米，预计ILS进近36右跑道。请复诵管制指令，并告诉管制员该旅客已经死亡。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-474.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R, the old passenger has died, BAW203.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-474.referenceTextZh: 下降至900米，预计ILS进近36R，那名老年旅客已经死亡，BAW203。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-475.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, roger, reduce speed to 200 knots, turn left heading 030.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-475.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，收到，减速至200节，左转航向030。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-475.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots, turn left heading 030, BAW203.

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-476.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-476.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，截获36右跑道航向道，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-476.referenceText: Intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established, BAW203.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-476.referenceTextZh: 截获36R航向道，建立后报告，BAW203。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-477.audioText: B: Inform the controller, you have captured the localizer.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-477.audioTextZh: 通知管制员，你已截获航向道。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-478.audioText: C: Roger, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, 13 kilometers from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-478.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，可以ILS进近36右跑道，距接地点13公里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。

atc-scenario-0027-card-main-479.audioText: B: Later, you cannot see the runway at decision altitude during the approach, inform Tower controller that you need to make another approach.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-479.audioTextZh: 稍后，进近至决断高度时你看不到跑道，通知塔台管制员你需要再次进近。
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-479.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW203, no contact at minimum, going around.
atc-scenario-0027-card-main-479.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW203，最低标准无目视，正在复飞。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-480.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 931, you are parking at stand 702, with information Lima, request ATC clearance to London.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-480.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 931，停在702号机位，已收到通播Lima，申请前往伦敦的空管放行许可。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-480.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW931, stand 702, information L, request ATC clearance to London.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-480.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，BAW931，702号机位，通播L，申请前往伦敦的空管放行许可。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-481.audioText: C: Speedbird 931, Wuhan Ground, cleared to London via flight planned route, Zulu Foxtrot 05 Delta departure, initial climb to 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-481.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 931，武汉地面，按计划航路放行至伦敦，ZF 05D离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度10700米，使用跑道18左，离场后联系124.7，squawk 4503。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-481.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, ZF 05D departure, initial climb to 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503, BAW931.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-481.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至伦敦，ZF 05D离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度10700米，使用跑道18L，离场后联系124.7，squawk 4503，BAW931。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-482.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-482.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-482.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW931, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-482.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW931，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-483.audioText: C: Speedbird 931, Wuhan Ground, push back and start up approved, facing north.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-483.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 931，武汉地面，可以推出和开车，机头向北。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-483.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north, BAW931.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-483.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向北，BAW931。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-484.audioText: B: Now you have a problem, 1 of your passengers is seriously ill, you inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger, you have to delay the push back due to disembark the passenger.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-484.audioTextZh: 现在出现问题，一名旅客病情严重。请通知空管并申请让该旅客下机，因此需要推迟推出。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-484.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW931, 1 of our passengers is seriously ill, request delay the push back to disembark the passenger.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-484.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW931，我们有一名旅客病情严重，申请推迟推出，让该旅客下机。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-485.audioText: B: This time, contact your Company to inform this situation, and also request medical assistance.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-485.audioTextZh: 这次联系公司，告知该情况，并申请医疗协助。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-485.referenceText: Dispatch, BAW931, 1 of our passengers is seriously ill, request medical assistance.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-485.referenceTextZh: 签派，BAW931，我们有一名旅客病情严重，请求医疗协助。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-486.audioText: B: Now you have disembark this passenger, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-486.audioTextZh: 现在该旅客已下机，申请滑行。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-486.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW931, we have disembarked this passenger, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-486.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW931，该旅客已下机，申请滑行。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-487.audioText: C: Speedbird 931, taxi to the holding point of runway 18L via taxiway Alpha 7 and Alpha, hold short of Alpha 5.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-487.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 931，经滑行道A7和A滑行至18左跑道等待点，A5外等待。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-487.referenceText: Taxi to the holding point of runway 18L via taxiway A7 and A, hold short of A5, BAW931.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-487.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道A7和A滑行至18L跑道等待点，A5外等待，BAW931。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-488.audioText: C: Speedbird 931, follow company Boeing 777, continue taxi.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-488.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 931，跟随同公司Boeing 777，继续滑行。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-488.referenceText: Follow company B777, continue taxi, BAW931.

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-489.audioText: C: Speedbird 931, give way to the Airbus 320 coming from left to right, when the traffic is clear, continue taxi.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-489.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 931，让行从左向右的Airbus 320，冲突解除后继续滑行。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-489.referenceText: Traffic in sight, when the traffic is clear, continue taxi, BAW931.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-489.referenceTextZh: 看到冲突飞机，冲突解除后继续滑行，BAW931。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-490.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-490.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好离场，请联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-490.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW931, ready for departure.

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-491.audioText: C: Speedbird 931, line up and wait, runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-491.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 931，18左跑道进跑道等待。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-491.referenceText: Line up and wait, runway 18L, BAW931.

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-492.audioText: C: Speedbird 931, cleared for takeoff 18 left, surface wind 160, 3 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-492.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 931，18左跑道可以起飞，地面风160度，3米/秒。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-493.audioText: B: During takeoff roll, your right engine suddenly got fire, you have to abort takeoff, report ATC this situation.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-493.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑过程中，右发突然起火，你必须中断起飞，请向空管报告情况。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-493.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW931, takeoff aborted due right engine fire.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-493.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW931，因右发起火，中断起飞。

atc-scenario-0028-card-main-494.audioText: B: The fire cannot be extinguished, inform this to ATC, this is a Distress call, also you want to carry out evacuation and request emergency equipment.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-494.audioTextZh: 火情无法扑灭，请通知空管。这是遇险呼叫，同时你希望实施撤离并申请应急设备。
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-494.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, BAW931, the fire cannot be extinguished, we are evacuating, request emergency equipment.
atc-scenario-0028-card-main-494.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，BAW931，火情无法扑灭，我们正在撤离，申请应急设备。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-495.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 141, destination Beijing, estimate GUPAD 20, level 8900 meters, Tango Yankee November 35, next ISGOD, contact Beijing Control, report in cloud at 10100 meters.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-495.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 141，目的地北京，预计20分到GUPAD，高度8900米，TYN 35，下一点ISGOD，联系北京管制，并报告在10100米云中飞行。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-495.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, estimate GUPAD 20, maintaining 8900 meters, in cloud, TYN 35, next ISGOD.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-495.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW141，预计20分到GUPAD，保持8900米，云中飞行，TYN 35，下一点ISGOD。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-496.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, Beijing Control, previous aircraft have required diversions right of track due to weather, please advise if you require the same.
B: Meteorological radar shows that you are fine at this stage
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-496.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，北京管制，前机因天气曾要求向航迹右侧绕飞，如你也需要请告知。气象雷达显示你目前情况正常。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-496.referenceText: Radar shows that we are normal at this stage, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-496.referenceTextZh: 雷达显示我们目前正常，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-497.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, Beijing roger, contact me if require diversion.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-497.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，北京收到，如需绕飞请联系我。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-498.audioText: B: There is CB ahead of you, request diversion 5 miles right of track.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-498.audioTextZh: 前方有CB，申请向航迹右侧绕飞5海里。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-498.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, request diversion 5 miles right of track due to CB ahead of us.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-498.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW141，因前方有CB，申请向航迹右侧绕飞5海里。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-499.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, deviate 5 miles right of track approved.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-499.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，同意向航迹右侧偏航5海里。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-499.referenceText: 5 miles right of track approved, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-499.referenceTextZh: 同意向航迹右侧偏航5海里，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-500.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, traffic information, detect primary radar signal at 1 o'clock, 50 kilometres, northwest bound, altitude unknown, we are unable to communicate with the aircraft.
B: Tell the controller that your TCAS has no indication of that aircraft, and confirm whether the traffic is in conflict with you.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-500.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，通报冲突信息，探测到一次雷达信号，方位1点钟，距离50公里，向西北飞行，高度不明，我们无法与该航空器通信。告诉管制员，你的TCAS没有该航空器显示，并确认该冲突飞机是否与你有冲突。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-500.referenceText: Roger, we do not have that aircraft on TCAS, confirm that the unidentified aircraft will not be in conflict with us, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-500.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们TCAS上没有该航空器，请确认该不明航空器不会与我们发生冲突，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-501.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, the aircraft is currently parallel to your track. You are closing on that aircraft, report sighting.
B: Tell the controller that you are closing cloud and you can't see the aircraft.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-501.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 141，该机目前与你航迹平行。你正在接近该机，看到后报告。
B：告诉管制员你正进入云中，无法看见该机。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-501.referenceText: We are closing cloud and we can't see the aircraft, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-501.referenceTextZh: 我们正进入云中，无法看见该机，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-502.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, Beijing Control, probable false signal, proceed normally.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-502.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，北京管制，可能是假信号，正常飞行。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-503.audioText: B: You suffered lightning strike, make a distress call and request descent to 4200 meters.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-503.audioTextZh: B：你遭遇雷击，发出遇险呼叫并请求下降至 4200 米。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-503.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Control, BAW141, lightning strike, request descend to 4200 meters.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-503.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京管制，BAW141，遭遇雷击，请求下降至 4200 米。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-504.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, descend to 4200 meters, report conditions.
B: You are checking and now suspect navigation system is malfunctioning.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-504.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 141，下降至 4200 米，报告情况。
B：你正在检查，目前怀疑导航系统故障。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-504.referenceText: We are assessing the situation, but have no real navigation guidance, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-504.referenceTextZh: 我们正在评估情况，但目前没有可靠的导航引导，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-505.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, Beijing roger, when ready, advise intention.
B: You lost directional indication, if weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-505.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 141，北京收到，准备好后报告意图。
B：你失去方向指示，如天气允许，请求导航协助飞往北京机场。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-505.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, if weather permits, request navigation assistance due directional indication failure.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-505.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW141，如天气允许，因方向指示故障，请求导航协助。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-506.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, Beijing roger, Beijing CAVOK, your position is 25 miles northeast of Victor Yankee Kilo ON a heading of about 070, expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-506.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，北京收到，北京 CAVOK，你的位置在 Victor Yankee Kilo 东北 25 海里，航向约 070，预计 5 海里后小幅左转修正。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-506.referenceText: Expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-506.referenceTextZh: 预计 5 海里后小幅左转修正，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-507.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, this is Beijing Approach, descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-507.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，这里是北京进近，按 QNH 1011 下降至 1800 米，预计使用跑道 36 左。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-507.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-507.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1011 下降至 1800 米，预计跑道 36L，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-508.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, you are 15 miles to touchdown on runway 36L, descend to 900 meters.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-508.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，距跑道 36 左接地点 15 海里，下降至 900 米。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-509.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, position 10 miles northeast of the field, 3 miles north of the extended center line of runway 36L, a correcting heading won't be necessary, descend to 600 meters, report visual.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-509.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，位置在机场东北 10 海里、跑道 36 左延长中心线以北 3 海里，无需修正航向，下降至 600 米，看到地面后报告。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-509.referenceText: Roger, descend to 600 meters, report visual, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-509.referenceTextZh: 收到，下降至 600 米，看到地面后报告，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-510.audioText: B: Tell the ATC that you have sighted the field.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-510.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已看到机场。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-510.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW141, field in sight.

atc-scenario-0029-card-main-511.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, roger, cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, you are number 1, contact Tower 118.1.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-511.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，收到，可以目视进近，加入跑道 36 左最后进近，你是第一架，联系塔台 118.1。
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-511.referenceText: Cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, 118.1, BAW141.
atc-scenario-0029-card-main-511.referenceTextZh: 可以目视进近，加入跑道 36L 最后进近，118.1，BAW141。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-512.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 817, you are at stand 215, contact Wuhan Ground and request a tug.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-512.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Speedbird 817，停在 215 机位，联系武汉地面，请求拖车。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-512.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW817, stand 215, request a tug.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-512.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW817，215 机位，请求拖车。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-513.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, what type of aircraft is it?
B: Tell the controller its Airbus 330.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-513.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，机型是什么？
B：告诉管制员是 Airbus 330。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-514.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, the tug is on the way.

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-515.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, request facing east.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-515.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好推出和开车，请求机头朝东。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-515.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW817, request push back and start up, facing east.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-515.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW817，请求推出开车，机头朝东。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-516.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 04, you notice the wind sock shows strong wind, contact Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-516.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，发现风向袋显示风较强，联系武汉塔台核实风况。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-516.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW817, holding point runway 04, the wind sock shows strong wind, request wind check.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-516.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW817，跑道 04 等待点，风向袋显示风较强，请求风况检查。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-517.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, wind 200, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Wuhan Tower to change to runway 22 and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-517.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，风 200，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系武汉塔台请求改用跑道 22，并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-517.referenceText: The tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to runway 22, BAW817.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-517.referenceTextZh: 顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 22，BAW817。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-518.audioText: B: After departure, you encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked, this is an Urgency call.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-518.audioTextZh: B：离场后你遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，发出紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-518.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure/Approach, BAW817, we encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-518.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场/进近，BAW817，遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-519.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, roger PAN, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to dump fuel and return to land.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-519.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，收到 PAN，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员你想放油并返场着陆。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-519.referenceText: Request dump fuel and return to land, BAW817.

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-520.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, turn right, heading 240 to intercept Lima Kilo Oscar 030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-520.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 817，右转航向 240，切入 Lima Kilo Oscar 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-520.referenceText: Turn right, heading 240 to intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, climb to 3300 meters, BAW817.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-520.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米，BAW817。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-521.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, after passing Lima Kilo Oscar, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over Lima Kilo Oscar.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-521.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 817，过 Lima Kilo Oscar 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar 报告。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-521.referenceText: After passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO, BAW817.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-521.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW817。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-522.audioText: B: Now you are over Lima Kilo Oscar, report it to Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-522.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar，向武汉进近报告。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-523.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, how long do you need to dump fuel?
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-523.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，你需要多长时间放油？
B：告诉管制员大约需要 25 分钟。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-523.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW817, we need approximately 25 minutes.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-523.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW817，我们大约需要 25 分钟。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-524.audioText: B: Now you have completed fuel dumping, report it to the controller and request radar vectors for runway 22.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-524.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，向管制员报告并请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-524.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW817, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-524.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW817，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-525.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, turn right, direct to Delta Alpha, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach runway 22.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-525.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 817，右转直飞 Delta Alpha，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-525.referenceText: Turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach runway 22, BAW817.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-525.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22，BAW817。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-526.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS runway 22, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-526.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-526.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW817, established ILS runway 22.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-526.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW817，已建立跑道 22 ILS。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-527.audioText: B: During landing, you encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-527.audioTextZh: B：着陆过程中，你在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风，向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-527.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW817, we encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-527.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW817，我们在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风。

atc-scenario-0030-card-main-528.audioText: B: After landing, you find the APU is inoperative, report this situation to Wuhan Ground and request ground power unit ready at the gate.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-528.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你发现 APU 失效，向武汉地面报告并请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-528.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW817, our APU is inoperative, request ground power unit ready at the gate.
atc-scenario-0030-card-main-528.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW817，APU 失效，请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-529.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 352, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over X-Ray India Alpha, squawking 3567, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-529.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Speedbird 352，保持 11000 米，飞越 X-Ray India Alpha，应答机 3567，首次联系武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-529.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW2352, maintaining 11000 meters, over XIA, squawking 3567.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-529.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW2352，保持 11000 米，飞越 XIA，应答机 3567。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-530.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10400 meters.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-530.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10400 米。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-531.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, Wuhan Control, descend to 9200 meters, reduced speed to 270 knots until advised.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-531.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，武汉管制，下降至 9200 米，减速至 270 节，保持至另行通知。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-531.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to 270 knots until advised, BAW2352.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-531.referenceTextZh: 下降至 9200 米，减速至 270 节，保持至另行通知，BAW2352。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-532.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed there was a cumulonimbus ahead, contact Wuhan Control and request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-532.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，联系武汉管制，请求向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-532.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW2352, request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes due CB ahead.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-532.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW2352，前方有 CB，请求向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-533.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-533.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，可以向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-533.referenceText: Cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB, BAW2352.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-533.referenceTextZh: 可以向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告，BAW2352。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-534.audioText: B: Now you are clear of CB, ask Wuhan Control to resume flight route.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-534.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离 CB，请求武汉管制恢复航路飞行。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-534.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW2352, clear of CB, request resume flight route.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-534.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW2352，已脱离 CB，请求恢复航路。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-535.audioText: B: You have received the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility of Wuhan is low, ask Wuhan Approach if your alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-535.audioTextZh: B：你已收到最新 ATIS，显示武汉能见度低，询问武汉进近备降场合肥是否可用。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-535.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW2352, the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility of Wuhan is low, is our alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion ?
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-535.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW2352，最新 ATIS 显示武汉能见度低，请问我们的备降场合肥是否可用于备降？

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-536.audioText:
C: Speedbird 352, Hefei Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Hefei?
B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Hefei at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-536.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 352，合肥机场可用，确认你们备降合肥吗？
B：告诉管制员目前不备降合肥，仍希望飞往武汉。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-536.referenceText: We are not diverting to Hefei now, we still want to fly to Wuhan, BAW2352.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-536.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不备降合肥，仍希望飞往武汉，BAW2352。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-537.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, follow Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-537.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-537.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, follow ZF2A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, BAW2352.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-537.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，BAW2352。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-538.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-538.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，下降并保持 4200 米，减速至最低光洁速度。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-538.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, BAW2352.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-538.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速至最低光洁速度，BAW2352。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-540.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-540.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-540.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, established ILS approach runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-540.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-541.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-541.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，地面风静风，RVR 接地点 550 米、中段 600 米、末端 500 米，继续进近跑道 36 右。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-542.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-542.audioTextZh: B：你现在距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-542.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-542.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-543.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-543.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，疏云 700 米，可以落地跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-543.referenceText: Cloud broken 700 metres, cleared to land runway 36R, BAW2352.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-543.referenceTextZh: 疏云 700 米，可以落地跑道 36R，BAW2352。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-544.audioText: B: The weather is deteriorating and below your landing minima, you executed a missed approach, advised Tower.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-544.audioTextZh: B：天气正在恶化并低于你的着陆最低标准，你执行复飞，通知塔台。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-544.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, the weather is deteriorating and below our landing minima, going around.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-544.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，天气正在恶化并低于我们的着陆最低标准，正在复飞。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-545.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-545.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，执行标准复飞程序，条件允许时报告意图。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-545.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, BAW2352.

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-546.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Hefei Airport, informed Tower.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-546.audioTextZh: B：你现在爬升至复飞高度，决定备降合肥机场，通知塔台。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-546.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, request divert to Hefei Airport.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-546.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，请求备降合肥机场。

atc-scenario-0031-card-main-547.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, turn right, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-547.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，右转直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，爬升并保持 2400 米。
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-547.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, BAW2352.
atc-scenario-0031-card-main-547.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，BAW2352。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-548.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 871, from Beijing to London, you are at stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-548.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Speedbird 871，从北京飞往伦敦，停在 215 机位，请求飞往伦敦的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-548.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, BAW871, stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-548.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，BAW871，215 机位，请求飞往伦敦的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-549.audioText: C: Speedbird 871, cleared to London via flight planned route, follow Victor Yankee Kilo 05 Delta departure, initial climb 9800 meters on 1023, cruising level 10400 meters, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-549.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 871，按计划航路放行至伦敦，执行 Victor Yankee Kilo 05 Delta 离场，1023 修压上初始爬升 9800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 4523。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-549.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK 05D Departure, initial climb 9800m on 1023, cruising level 10400m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523, BAW871.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-549.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至伦敦，执行 VYK 05D 离场，1023 修压上初始爬升 9800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 4523，BAW871。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-550.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-550.audioTextZh: B：你现在已准备好，联系地面请求推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-550.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-550.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，BAW871，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-551.audioText: C: Speedbird 871, push back and start up approved, facing west.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-551.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 871，可以推出开车，机头朝西。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-551.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, BAW871.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-551.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，机头朝西，BAW871。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-552.audioText: B: You noticed the tug is not in position yet, ask Ground control for a tug.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-552.audioTextZh: B：你注意到拖车尚未就位，向地面管制请求拖车。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-552.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, request a tug.

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-553.audioText:
C: Speedbird 871, roger, the tug on the way.
B: While taxiing, you notices the wind sock shows a strong tail wind, contact Ground to check the wind.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-553.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 871，收到，拖车正在过来。
B：滑行时你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系地面核实风况。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-553.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, request wind check.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-553.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，BAW871，请求风况检查。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-554.audioText: C: Speedbird 871, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-554.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 871，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-555.audioText: B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to runway 22 and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-555.audioTextZh: B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台请求改用跑道 22，并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-555.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW871, the tailwind exceeds takeoff limit, request change to runway 22.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-555.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，BAW871，顺风超过起飞限制，请求改用跑道 22。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-556.audioText: B: After airborne, you fly into a flock of birds, the left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing. This is an Urgency call.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-556.audioTextZh: B：起飞后你飞入鸟群，左风挡裂纹，请求放油并返场着陆。这是紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-556.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, BAW871, we encountered bird strike and our left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-556.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，BAW871，我们遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，请求放油并返场着陆。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-557.audioText: C: Speedbird 871, roger your PAN, turn right heading 240, intercept Lima Kilo Oscar 030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-557.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 871，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，切入 Lima Kilo Oscar 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-557.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, climb to 3300m, BAW871.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-557.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米，BAW871。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-558.audioText: C: Speedbird 871, after Lima Kilo Oscar, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over Lima Kilo Oscar.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-558.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 871，过 Lima Kilo Oscar 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar 报告。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-558.referenceText: After LKO, turn right heading 220, maintaining 3300m, report over LKO, BAW871.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-558.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW871。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-559.audioText: B: Now you finished fuel dumping, ask for radar vectors to runway 22.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-559.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-559.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW871, fuel dump completed, request radar vector to runway 22.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-559.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW871，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-560.audioText: C: Speedbird 871, turn right direct to Delta Alpha, descend to 2100 meters, QNH 1015, expect runway 22.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-560.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 871，右转直飞 Delta Alpha，下降至 2100 米，QNH 1015，预计跑道 22。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-560.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH 1015, expect runway 22, BAW871.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-560.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，下降至 2100 米，QNH 1015，预计跑道 22，BAW871。

atc-scenario-0032-card-main-561.audioText: B: Your APU has failed, tell this situation to Beijing Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-561.audioTextZh: B：你的 APU 失效，向北京塔台报告并请求地面电源车。
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-561.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW871, request ground power unit due APU failure.
atc-scenario-0032-card-main-561.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，BAW871，因 APU 故障，请求地面电源车。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-562.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 221, you are maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-562.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536，首次联系上海管制。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-562.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL221, maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-562.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-563.audioText: C: United 221, maintain 9200 meters, direct to X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-563.audioTextZh: C：United 221，保持 9200 米，直飞 X-Ray Sierra Hotel。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-563.referenceText: Maintain 9200 meters, direct to XSH, UAL221.

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-564.audioText: B: You are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, contact Shanghai Control and check if any higher level is available.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-564.audioTextZh: B：你在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，联系上海管制，询问是否有更高高度可用。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-564.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL221, we are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, is higher level available ?
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-564.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL221，我们在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，是否有更高高度可用？

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-565.audioText:
C: United 221, 11600 meters is available now, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you are unable to accept 11600 meters because of performance.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-565.audioTextZh:
C：United 221，11600 米现在可用，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员因性能原因无法接受 11600 米。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-565.referenceText: Negative, we are unable to accept 11600 meters due performance, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-565.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，因性能原因无法接受 11600 米，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-566.audioText: C: United 221, maintain present level, expect higher level after X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-566.audioTextZh: C：United 221，保持当前高度，过 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 后预计可上升至更高高度。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-566.referenceText: Maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-566.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，过 XSH 后预计可上升至更高高度，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-567.audioText: B: Now you are over X-Ray Sierra Hotel, maintaining 9200 meters, contact Wuhan Control and request higher level.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-567.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 X-Ray Sierra Hotel，保持 9200 米，联系武汉管制请求更高高度。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-567.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, over XSH, maintaining 9200 meters, request higher level.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-567.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL221，飞越 XSH，保持 9200 米，请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-568.audioText: C: United 221, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10400 meters.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-568.audioTextZh: C：United 221，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10400 米。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-568.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10400 meters, UAL221.

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-569.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, contact Wuhan Control and request descent to lower level.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-569.audioTextZh: B：突然有 1 名旅客心脏病发作，联系武汉管制，请求下降到较低高度。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-569.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, request descent to lower level.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-569.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL221，1 名旅客心脏病发作，请求下降到较低高度。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-570.audioText: C: United 221, maintain 10400 meters due airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-570.audioTextZh: C：United 221，因空域拥挤，保持 10400 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-570.referenceText: Maintain 10400 meters, reduce speed to M.75, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-570.referenceTextZh: 保持 10400 米，减速至 M.75，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-571.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-571.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，向武汉管制报告并请求下降。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-571.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, the flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, request descent.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-571.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL221，乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，请求下降。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-572.audioText: C: United 221, descend to 6600 meters, level at X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-572.audioTextZh: C：United 221，下降至 6600 米，在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 改平。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-572.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-572.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，在 XSH 改平，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-573.audioText: C: United 221, track direct to X-Ray Sierra Hotel, follows Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36 right.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-573.audioTextZh: C：United 221，直飞 X-Ray Sierra Hotel，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-573.referenceText: Track direct to XSH, follows ZF2A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36R, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-573.referenceTextZh: 直飞 XSH，执行 ZF2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-574.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information Oscar, contact Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-574.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 Zulu Foxtrot，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 Oscar，联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-574.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL221, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-574.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL221，飞越 ZF，保持 6600 米，收到通播 O。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-575.audioText: C: United 221, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, current information is Papa, descend to and maintain 4200 meters.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-575.audioTextZh: C：United 221，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为 Papa，下降并保持 4200 米。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-575.referenceText: Information P, descend to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-575.referenceTextZh: 通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-576.audioText: C: United 221, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-576.audioTextZh: C：United 221，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-576.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-576.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0033-card-main-577.audioText: C: United 221, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-577.audioTextZh: C：United 221，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-577.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL221.
atc-scenario-0033-card-main-577.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL221。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-578.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 403, you are at Wuhan Airport, before departure, you received the cabin report said that there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, contact Wuhan Ground and tell the controller you want to have ice removed before start up.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-578.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 403，在武汉机场，离场前收到客舱报告，机翼有冰雪堆积，联系武汉地面，告知需要在开车前除冰。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-578.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, request de-icing.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-578.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL403，机翼有冰雪堆积，请求除冰。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-579.audioText:
C: United 403, where do you want to de-ice?
B: Tell the controller you want to de-ice on taxiway Zulu 4.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-579.audioTextZh:
C：United 403，你想在哪里除冰？
B：告诉管制员想在滑行道 Zulu 4 除冰。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-579.referenceText: Request de-icing on taxiway Z4, UAL403.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-579.referenceTextZh: 请求在滑行道 Z4 除冰，UAL403。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-580.audioText: B: Tell the Ground controller you have completed de-icing and you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-580.audioTextZh: B：告诉地面管制员你已完成除冰，准备滑行。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-580.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, de-icing completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-580.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL403，除冰完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-581.audioText: C: United 403, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-581.audioTextZh: C：United 403，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-581.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, UAL403.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-581.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，UAL403。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-582.audioText: B: The de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, tell the Ground controller you need to takeoff before 0835, and request intersection departure from Zulu 4.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-582.audioTextZh: B：除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，告诉地面管制你需要在 0835 前起飞，并请求从 Zulu 4 交叉口离场。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-582.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, we need to takeoff before 0835, request intersection departure from Z4.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-582.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL403，除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，我们需要在 0835 前起飞，请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-583.audioText: B: You have encountered moderate turbulence, ask Guangzhou Control for a higher level.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-583.audioTextZh: B：你遭遇中度颠簸，向广州管制请求更高高度。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-583.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-583.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL403，我们遭遇中度颠簸，请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-584.audioText:
C: United 403, 10700 meters and 11300 meters are both available, which 1 do you prefer?
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 10700 meters.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-584.audioTextZh:
C：United 403，10700 米和 11300 米都可用，你偏好哪一个？
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 10700 米。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-585.audioText:
C: United 403, radar shows you are a bit higher than your assigned level, check your altitude.
B: Tell the controller you are running into some turbulence.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-585.audioTextZh:
C：United 403，雷达显示你略高于指定高度，请检查高度。
B：告诉管制员你正在遭遇颠簸。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-585.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, we are running into some turbulence.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-585.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL403，我们正在遭遇颠簸。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-586.audioText: B: Ask Guangzhou Control if there is any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 11300 meters.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-586.audioTextZh: B：询问广州管制，前机是否报告 11300 米有颠簸。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-586.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, is there any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 11300 meters ?
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-586.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL403，前机是否报告 11300 米有颠簸？

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-587.audioText:
C: United 403, there is no turbulence report at 11300 meters.
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 11300 meters due turbulence.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-587.audioTextZh:
C：United 403，11300 米没有颠簸报告。
B：告诉管制员因颠簸请求爬升至 11300 米。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-587.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 11300 meters due turbulence, UAL403.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-587.referenceTextZh: 收到，因颠簸请求爬升至 11300 米，UAL403。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-588.audioText: C: United 403, climb and maintain 11300 meters.

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-589.audioText: B: Tell Guangzhou Control you request earlier descent because your landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight, and you will request descent now.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-589.audioTextZh: B：告诉广州管制，因为着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降，并请求现在开始下降。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-589.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, request earlier descent due our landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-589.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL403，因着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-590.audioText: C: United 403, descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-590.audioTextZh: C：United 403，下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-590.referenceText: Descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion, UAL403.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-590.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降，UAL403。
