atc-scenario-0034-card-main-591.audioText: B: There is an indication of thunderstorm ahead, contact Guangzhou Control and request offset 10 miles right to avoid the weather.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-591.audioTextZh: B：前方有雷暴迹象，联系广州管制，请求向右偏航 10 海里避让天气。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-591.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, request offset 10 miles right due CB ahead.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-591.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL403，前方有 CB，请求向右偏航 10 海里。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-592.audioText: C: United 403, 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-592.audioTextZh: C：United 403，同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-592.referenceText: 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather, UAL403.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-592.referenceTextZh: 同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL403。

atc-scenario-0034-card-main-593.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report the situation to Guangzhou Control and request direct to Tango Oscar November.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-593.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，向广州管制报告并请求直飞 Tango Oscar November。
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-593.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, clear of whether, request direct to TON.
atc-scenario-0034-card-main-593.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL403，已脱离天气，请求直飞 TON。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-594.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 831, a flight from Wuhan to San Francisco, you have completed push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-594.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 831，从武汉飞往旧金山，已完成推出和开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-594.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL831, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-594.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL831，推出开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-595.audioText: C: United 831, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Foxtrot, Alpha 7 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-595.audioTextZh: C：United 831，经滑行道 Foxtrot、Alpha 7 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-595.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway F, A7 and A, UAL831.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-595.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，UAL831。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-596.audioText: C: United 831, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.65.

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-597.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 04, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-597.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-597.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL831, holding point runway 04, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-597.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL831，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-598.audioText: C: United 831, cleared for takeoff runway 04, surface wind 060, 10 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-598.audioTextZh: C：United 831，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 060，10 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-599.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-599.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-599.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL831, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-599.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL831，已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-600.audioText: C: United 831, cancel SID, direct to Hotel Foxtrot Echo, climb to 3900 meters on standard.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-600.audioTextZh: C：United 831，取消 SID，直飞 Hotel Foxtrot Echo，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-600.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard, UAL831.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-600.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米，UAL831。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-601.audioText: B: During climb, the purser tells you a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, you decide to level off at 2700 meters, advise Wuhan Departure your intention to level off due possible problem in the cabin.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-601.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，乘务长告诉你有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，你决定在 2700 米改平，向武汉离场说明因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-601.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL831, a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, request level off at 2700 meters due possible cabin problem.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-601.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL831，有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-602.audioText: C: United 831, climb to and maintain 2700 meters, advise intention.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-602.audioTextZh: C：United 831，爬升并保持 2700 米，报告意图。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-602.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 2700 meters, UAL831.

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-603.audioText: B: The aircraft is leveling, no one else can confirm the noise that the particular passenger heard, you check all the instruments are indicating normally, you decide to continue the flight and request a higher level, call Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-603.audioTextZh: B：飞机已改平，没有其他人能确认该旅客听到的声音，各仪表指示正常，你决定继续飞行并请求更高高度，呼叫武汉离场。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-603.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL831, all the instruments are indicating normally, request continue the flight and request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-603.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL831，各仪表指示正常，请求继续飞行并请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-604.audioText: C: United 831, climb to 4500 meters on standard, contact Wuhan Control 120.5.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-604.audioTextZh: C：United 831，按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，联系武汉管制120.5。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-604.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters on standard, 120.5, UAL831.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-604.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，120.5，UAL831。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-605.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 10700 meters, over Hotel Foxtrot Echo, squawking 5316, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-605.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 10700 米，飞越 Hotel Foxtrot Echo，应答机 5316，首次联系上海管制。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-605.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL831, maintaining 10700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-605.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL831，保持 10700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-606.audioText: C: United 831, Shanghai Control, radar contact, proceed direct to Victor Mike Bravo.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-606.audioTextZh: C：United 831，上海管制，雷达识别，直飞 Victor Mike Bravo。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-607.audioText: B: Now you confirm the strange sound from the cabin, your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, slow depressurization is suspected, request immediate descent from 10700 meters to 3000 meters. This is an Urgency call.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-607.audioTextZh: B：你现在确认客舱有异常声音，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求从 10700 米立即下降至 3000 米。这是紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-607.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL831, our instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, suspect slow depressurization, request immediate descent to 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-607.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海管制，UAL831，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求立即下降至 3000 米。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-608.audioText: C: United 831, roger PAN, turn right heading 150, initially descend and maintain 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-608.audioTextZh: C：United 831，收到 PAN，右转航向 150，先下降并保持 8900 米。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-608.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900 meters, UAL831.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-608.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 150，下降并保持 8900 米，UAL831。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-609.audioText:
C: United 831, turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters.
B: Read back ATC instructions and request the nearest suitable airport for landing.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-609.audioTextZh:
C：United 831，左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米。
B：复诵管制指令，并请求前往最近合适机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-609.referenceText: Turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters, request the nearest suitable airport for landing, UAL831.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-609.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米，请求最近合适机场着陆，UAL831。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-610.audioText:
C: United 831, the closest airport is Nanjing Airport, current visibility is marginal, I have to check if they can accommodate an aircraft of your size. Hongqiao and Pudong Airport has longer runway and can definitely accommodate your aircraft, advise your intention?
B: Ask radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-610.audioTextZh:
C：United 831，最近的机场是南京机场，当前能见度临界，我需要确认他们能否接收你们这种机型。虹桥和浦东机场跑道更长，肯定可以接收，请报告意图。
B：请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-610.referenceText: Request radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility, UAL831.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-610.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场，UAL831。

atc-scenario-0035-card-main-611.audioText: C: United 831, direct to Hotel Sierra Hotel, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, contact Shanghai Approach on 128.35.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-611.audioTextZh: C：United 831，直飞 Hotel Sierra Hotel，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，联系上海进近128.35。
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-611.referenceText: Direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, 128.35, UAL831.
atc-scenario-0035-card-main-611.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，128.35，UAL831。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-612.audioText: B: Your aircraft call sign is United 182, you are at the holding point of runway 04, call Wuhan Tower you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-612.audioTextZh: B：你的航空器呼号是 United 182，在跑道 04 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台，报告准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-612.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL182, holding point of runway 04, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-612.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL182，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-613.audioText: C: United 182, behind China Southern Boeing 777 on short final, line up behind runway 04.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-613.audioTextZh: C：United 182，在短五边 China Southern Boeing 777 后，跟随其后进入跑道 04。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-613.referenceText: Behind CSN B777 on short final, line up behind runway 04, UAL182.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-613.referenceTextZh: 跟随短五边 CSN B777 后进入跑道 04，UAL182。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-614.audioText: C: United 182, when airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-614.audioTextZh: C：United 182，离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-614.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, UAL182.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-614.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，UAL182。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-615.audioText: B: Now you are airborne and passing 200 meters, call Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-615.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 200 米，呼叫武汉离场。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-615.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL182, airborne, passing 200 meters.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-615.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL182，已离地，通过 200 米。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-616.audioText: C: United 182, after passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-616.audioTextZh: C：United 182，通过 1200 米后左转直飞 Zulu Foxtrot。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-616.referenceText: After passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF, UAL182.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-616.referenceTextZh: 通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF，UAL182。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-617.audioText: B: Now you are in London Control area, FL350, you encountered volcanic ash, tell ATC the situation and request descent, call London Control.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-617.audioTextZh: B：你现在在伦敦管制区，飞行高度层 350，遭遇火山灰，向 ATC 报告情况并请求下降，呼叫伦敦管制。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-617.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, we encountered volcanic ash at FL350, request descent.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-617.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，我们在 FL350 遭遇火山灰，请求下降。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-618.audioText: C: United 182, turn right heading 300, descend to FL290.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-618.audioTextZh: C：United 182，右转航向 300，下降至飞行高度层 290。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-618.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to FL290, UAL182.

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-619.audioText: B: Tell ATC you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-619.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-619.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-619.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，我们仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-620.audioText: B: During descent, both engines flamed out, make a Distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-620.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，双发熄火，发出遇险呼叫并请求在最近机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-620.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, London Control, UAL182, both engines flamed out, request land at the nearest airport.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-620.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，伦敦管制，UAL182，双发熄火，请求在最近机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-621.audioText: C: United 182, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340.

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-622.audioText: B: 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent, tell ATC the situation.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-622.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启，告诉 ATC 当前情况。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-622.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-622.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-623.audioText:
C: United 182, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-623.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，你的意图？
B：告诉 ATC 因工作发动机不稳定，仍需在最近机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-623.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, request land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-623.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，因工作发动机不稳定，请求在最近机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-624.audioText:
C: United 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, expect to land at Beatle Airport.
B: Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-624.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，继续下降至 9000 英尺，预计在 Beatle Airport 着陆。
B：告诉管制员你不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-624.referenceText: Continue descent to 9000 feet, we are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information, UAL182.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-624.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 9000 英尺，我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息，UAL182。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-625.audioText:
C: United 182, Beatle Airport landing runway 02, elevation 2000 feet, runway 3000 meters long, 45 meters wide, ILS CAT I and II available.
B: Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-625.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，Beatle Airport 使用着陆跑道 02，机场标高 2000 英尺，跑道长 3000 米、宽 45 米，可用 ILS CAT I 和 II。
B：告诉 ATC 你可以在该机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-625.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, we are able to land at this airport.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-625.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，我们可以在该机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-626.audioText: C: United 182, continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-626.audioTextZh: C：United 182，继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-626.referenceText: Continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3, UAL182.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-626.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3，UAL182。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-627.audioText: B: Contact Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-627.audioTextZh: B：联系进近，告知他们你的紧急情况。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-627.referenceText: Approach, UAL182, we encountered volcanic ash, both engines flamed out, 1 engine was successfully restarted but not stable.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-627.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL182，我们遭遇火山灰，双发熄火，1 台发动机已成功重启但不稳定。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-628.audioText:
C: United 182, roger your situation, runway is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.
B: Tell ATC you see the airport.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-628.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，收到你的情况，跑道在你 2 点钟方向 10 海里，看到机场后报告。
B：告诉 ATC 你看到机场。

atc-scenario-0036-card-main-629.audioText: B: Tell Approach you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-629.audioTextZh: B：告诉进近你需要应急服务在跑道附近待命。
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-629.referenceText: Approach, UAL182, request emergency services to be ready near the runway.
atc-scenario-0036-card-main-629.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL182，请求应急服务在跑道附近待命。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-630.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 805 on a flight to Guangzhou, you are approaching Whiskey X-Ray India, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527, contact Zhengzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-630.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 805，飞往广州，正在接近 Whiskey X-Ray India，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527，联系郑州管制。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-630.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-630.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL805，接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-631.audioText: C: United 805, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-631.audioTextZh: C：United 805，雷达识别，向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，因武汉管制限制，减速至马赫 0.75。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-631.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to M.75, UAL805.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-631.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至 M.75，UAL805。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-632.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-632.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-632.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, our weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-632.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL805，我们气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-633.audioText: C: United 805, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-633.audioTextZh: C：United 805，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-633.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL805.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-633.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL805。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-634.audioText:
C: United 805, reduce speed to Mach 0.72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control Mach 0.72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-634.audioTextZh:
C：United 805，减速至马赫 0.72。
B：告知郑州管制 M.72 不能接受，对你们飞机来说太低。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-634.referenceText: Negative, unable M.72, it's too low for our aircraft, UAL805.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-634.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，无法保持 M.72，对我们飞机来说太低，UAL805。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-635.audioText: C: United 805, Zhengzhou Control, maintain Mach 0.75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-635.audioTextZh: C：United 805，郑州管制，保持马赫 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的飞机数量。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-636.audioText:
C: United 805, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638 Zulu.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-636.audioTextZh:
C：United 805，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 0638Z 到达 OBLIK。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-637.audioText: C: United 805, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-637.audioTextZh: C：United 805，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-637.referenceText: Orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646, UAL805.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-637.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646，UAL805。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-638.audioText: B: Now you have completed the orbit, ask Zhengzhou Control to track direct to OBLIK.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-638.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成盘旋，请求郑州管制直飞 OBLIK。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-638.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, request track direct to OBLIK.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-638.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL805，请求直飞 OBLIK。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-639.audioText: C: United 805, negative direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-639.audioTextZh: C：United 805，不能直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-639.referenceText: Turn left heading 130 to intercept A461, UAL805.

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-640.audioText: C: United 805, 50 miles to OBLIK, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-640.audioTextZh: C：United 805，距 OBLIK 50 海里，联系武汉管制118.9。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-641.audioText: B: You are over OBLIK at time 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating Zulu Foxtrot at time 0658, your next way point is Whiskey Uniform Hotel, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-641.audioTextZh: B：你 0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 0658 到达 Zulu Foxtrot，下一航路点 Whiskey Uniform Hotel，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-641.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL805, over OBLIK 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF 0658, next WUH.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-641.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL805，0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 ZF 0658，下一点 WUH。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-642.audioText: C: United 805, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-642.audioTextZh: C：United 805，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 Zulu Foxtrot。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-643.audioText: C: United 805, radar failure, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-643.audioTextZh: C：United 805，雷达故障，为识别，重设应答机 3572。

atc-scenario-0037-card-main-645.audioText: C: United 805, radar identified, resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-645.audioTextZh: C：United 805，雷达已识别，恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO。
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-645.referenceText: Resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO, UAL805.
atc-scenario-0037-card-main-645.referenceTextZh: 恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO，UAL805。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-646.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 219, from New York to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566, call Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-646.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 219，从纽约飞往武汉，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566，呼叫武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-646.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL219, maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3566.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-646.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL219，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-647.audioText: C: United 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters due crossing traffic.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-647.audioTextZh: C：United 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 9200 米，因穿越冲突航空器，通过 9800 米前加快下降。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-647.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters, UAL219.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-647.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 9200 米，通过 9800 米前加快下降，UAL219。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-648.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, you are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, inform ATC this situation and request further descent to 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-648.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 9200 米，遭遇中度晴空颠簸，告知 ATC 并请求继续下降至 8400 米。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-648.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL219, maintaining 9200 meters, we are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, further descent to 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-648.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL219，保持 9200 米，我们遭遇中度晴空颠簸，请求继续下降至 8400 米。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-649.audioText: C: United 219, continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-649.audioTextZh: C：United 219，继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-649.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL219.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-649.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告，UAL219。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-650.audioText: B: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-650.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，向武汉管制确认是否为冲突航空器。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-650.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL219, TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-650.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL219，TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动航空器，请确认是否为冲突航空器。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-651.audioText: C: United 219, negative, the aircraft is a military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly, report clear of traffic.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-651.audioTextZh: C：United 219，不是，该机为军机，与你当前航迹平行飞行，将很快超越你，脱离冲突后报告。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-651.referenceText: Roger, report clear of traffic, UAL219.

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-652.audioText: B: Now that aircraft has passed you, report it to ATC.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-652.audioTextZh: B：现在该机已超过你，向 ATC 报告。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-652.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL219, clear of traffic.

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-653.audioText: C: United 219, reduce to minimum speed, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, expect Zulu Foxtrot 03 arrival runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-653.audioTextZh: C：United 219，减至最小速度，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，预计 Zulu Foxtrot 03 进场跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-653.referenceText: Reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF 03 arrival runway 36R, UAL219.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-653.referenceTextZh: 减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计 ZF 03 进场跑道 36R，UAL219。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-654.audioText: C: United 219, continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-654.audioTextZh: C：United 219，继续下降并保持 4200 米。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-654.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL219.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-654.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 4200 米，UAL219。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-655.audioText: B: You are now levelling at 4200 meters and approaching Zulu Foxtrot, information Alpha received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-655.audioTextZh: B：你现在在 4200 米改平并接近 Zulu Foxtrot，已收到通播 Alpha，首次联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-655.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL219, maintaining 4200 meters, approaching ZF, information A.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-655.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL219，保持 4200 米，接近 ZF，收到通播 A。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-656.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-656.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-656.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL219, established ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-656.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL219，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-658.audioText: C: All stations! All stations! Be advised runway 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, Break, United 219, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-658.audioTextZh: C：各机注意！各机注意！跑道 36 右因故障航空器占用关闭。Break，Break，United 219，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-658.referenceText: Roger, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters, UAL219.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-658.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米，UAL219。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-659.audioText: C: United 219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-659.audioTextZh: C：United 219，右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-659.referenceText: Turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04, UAL219.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-659.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，UAL219。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-660.audioText: C: United 219, turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach runway 04, report inbound.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-660.audioTextZh: C：United 219，右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-660.referenceText: Turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach runway 04, report inbound, UAL219.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-660.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告，UAL219。

atc-scenario-0038-card-main-661.audioText: B: Now you are inbound course for runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-661.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 向台航道上，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0038-card-main-661.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL219，跑道 04 向台。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-662.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 835, you are approaching Tango Oscar Lima, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-662.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 835，接近 Tango Oscar Lima，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566，首次联系上海管制。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-662.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL835, approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-662.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-663.audioText: C: United 835, radar contact, descend and maintain 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-663.audioTextZh: C：United 835，雷达识别，下降并保持 8400 米。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-664.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS warning was triggered, you are executing TCAS climbing, inform this situation to Shanghai Control.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-664.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 TCAS 告警触发，你正在按 TCAS 爬升，向上海管制报告。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-664.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL835, our TACS warning was triggered, TCAS climbing.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-664.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL835，TCAS 告警触发，正在按 TCAS 爬升。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-665.audioText: C: United 835, roger, the conflicting traffic is military, report clear of traffic.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-665.audioTextZh: C：United 835，收到，冲突航空器为军机，脱离冲突后报告。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-665.referenceText: Roger, report clear of traffic, UAL835.

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-666.audioText: B: During TCAS maneuver, the cabin crew reports you have 2 serious and 3 minor injuries on board, make an Urgency call to Shanghai Control.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-666.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 机动过程中，客舱乘务员报告机上有 2 人重伤、3 人轻伤，向上海管制发出紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-666.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL835, we have 2 serious and 3 minor injuries on board during TCAS maneuver.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-666.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海管制，UAL835，TCAS 机动过程中机上有 2 人重伤、3 人轻伤。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-667.audioText: B: Now you are clear of the conflicting, contact Shanghai Control and request resume descent.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-667.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离冲突，联系上海管制，请求恢复下降。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-667.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL835, clear of conflict, request resume descent.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-667.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL835，已脱离冲突，请求恢复下降。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-668.audioText: C: United 835, roger, descend to 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 120.35.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-668.audioTextZh: C：United 835，收到，下降至 5100 米，联系武汉管制120.35。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-669.audioText: B: Now you are passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3125, contact Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-669.audioTextZh: B：你现在通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3125，联系武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-669.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3125.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-669.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL835，通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3125。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-670.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 5100 meters, you have got information Golf, make initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-670.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 Zulu Foxtrot，保持 5100 米，已收到通播 Golf，首次联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-670.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL835, over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, information G.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-670.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL835，飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，收到通播 G。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-671.audioText: C: United 835, radar contact, turn right, direct to X-Ray Sierra Hotel, expect X-Ray Sierra Hotel 03 Alpha arrival and radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-671.audioTextZh: C：United 835，雷达识别，右转直飞 X-Ray Sierra Hotel，预计 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 03 Alpha 进场，并雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-671.referenceText: Turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH 03A arrival and radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL835.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-671.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 XSH，预计 XSH 03A 进场并雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL835。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-672.audioText: C: United 835, turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-672.audioTextZh: C：United 835，右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-672.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, UAL835.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-672.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米，UAL835。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-673.audioText:
C: United 835, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach that you need ambulances on arrival.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-673.audioTextZh:
C：United 835，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉武汉进近，落地后需要救护车。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-673.referenceText: We need ambulances on arrival, UAL835.

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-674.audioText: C: United 835, ambulance will be ready upon your arrival.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-674.audioTextZh: C：United 835，救护车将在你到达时准备好。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-675.audioText: C: United 835, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-675.audioTextZh: C：United 835，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36 右，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-675.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established, UAL835.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-675.referenceTextZh: 可以 ILS 进近跑道 36R，建立后报告，UAL835。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-676.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-676.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-676.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL835, established on ILS runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0039-card-main-676.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL835，已建立跑道 36R ILS。

atc-scenario-0039-card-main-677.audioText: C: United 835, runway 36R, cleared to land.

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-678.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 811, from Los Angeles to Wuhan, you have received an Urgency call from Air France 103, Air France 103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly, relay the message to Zhengzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-678.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 811，从洛杉矶飞往武汉，你收到 Air France 103 的紧急呼叫，Air France 103 出现增压问题且客舱高度快速上升，将该信息转报给郑州管制。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-678.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, we have intercepted an Urgency call from AFR103, AFR103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-678.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，郑州管制，UAL811，我们截收到 AFR103 的紧急呼叫，AFR103 出现增压问题，客舱高度快速上升。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-679.audioText:
C: United 811, roger PAN PAN, break, break, Air France 103, you are number 1 to land, the medical service will be ready for you.
B: You relay the message to Air France 103.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-679.audioTextZh:
C：United 811，收到 PANPAN，Break，Break，Air France 103，你是第一架落地，医疗服务将为你准备好。
B：你将该信息转报给 Air France 103。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-679.referenceText: AFR103, UAL811, you are No.1 to land, the medical service will be ready for you.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-679.referenceTextZh: AFR103，UAL811，你是第一架落地，医疗服务将为你准备好。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-680.audioText: C: United 811, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due radar failure.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-680.audioTextZh: C：United 811，因雷达故障，向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至马赫 0.75。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-680.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to M.75, UAL811.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-680.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至 M.75，UAL811。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-681.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-681.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-681.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-681.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL811，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-682.audioText: C: United 811, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-682.audioTextZh: C：United 811，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-682.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL811.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-682.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL811。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-683.audioText: B: You have encountered severe clear air turbulence at 10400 meters, contact Zhengzhou Control and request climb to a higher level.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-683.audioTextZh: B：你在 10400 米遭遇严重晴空颠簸，联系郑州管制，请求爬升到更高高度。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-683.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence at 10400 meters, request climb to a higher level.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-683.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL811，我们在 10400 米遭遇严重晴空颠簸，请求爬升到更高高度。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-684.audioText: C: United 811, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-684.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, UAL811.

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-685.audioText:
C: United 811, reduce speed to Mach 0.72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control 0.72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-685.audioTextZh:
C：United 811，减速至马赫 0.72。
B：告知郑州管制 M.72 不能接受，对你们飞机来说太低。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-685.referenceText: Negative, M.72 is too low for our aircraft, UAL811.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-685.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，M.72 对我们飞机来说太低，UAL811。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-686.audioText: C: United 811, maintain Mach 0.75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-686.audioTextZh: C：United 811，保持马赫 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的飞机数量。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-687.audioText:
C: United 811, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 1152 Zulu time.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-687.audioTextZh:
C：United 811，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 1152Z 到达 OBLIK。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-688.audioText: C: United 811, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-688.audioTextZh: C：United 811，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-688.referenceText: Make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200, UAL811.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-688.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200，UAL811。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-689.audioText: B: You are over OBLIK at time 1200 Zulu time, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating Zulu Foxtrot at time 1230, your next waypoint is Whiskey Uniform Hotel, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-689.audioTextZh: B：你 1200Z 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 1230 到达 Zulu Foxtrot，下一航路点 Whiskey Uniform Hotel，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-689.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL811, OBLIK 1200Z, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF 1230, WUH next.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-689.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL811，OBLIK 1200Z，保持 11000 米，预计 ZF 1230，下一点 WUH。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-690.audioText: C: United 811, Wuhan Control, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-690.audioTextZh: C：United 811，武汉管制，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 Zulu Foxtrot。

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-691.audioText: C: United 811, for identification, reset squawk 3572.

atc-scenario-0040-card-main-692.audioText: C: United 811, radar contact, omit position reports, resume own navigation to Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-692.audioTextZh: C：United 811，雷达识别，可以省略位置报告，自主导航至 Zulu Foxtrot。
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-692.referenceText: Omit position reports, resume own navigation to ZF, UAL811.
atc-scenario-0040-card-main-692.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报告，自主导航至 ZF，UAL811。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-693.audioText: B: You are parking at the apron and ready for taxi, please request taxi clearance.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-693.audioTextZh: B：你停在停机坪，准备滑行，请求滑行许可。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-694.audioText: C: United 122, stand by, snow removal is in progress.

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-695.audioText: C: United 122, taxi via taxiway Bravo 2, Bravo and Echo 3 to holding point runway 34.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-695.audioTextZh: C：United 122，经滑行道 Bravo 2、Bravo 和 Echo 3 滑行至跑道 34 等待点。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-695.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway B2, B and E3 to holding point runway 34, UAL122.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-695.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 B2、B 和 E3 滑行至跑道 34 等待点，UAL122。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-696.audioText: B: Please call Tower, you are ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-696.audioTextZh: B：呼叫塔台，报告准备离场。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-697.audioText: C: United 122, line up and be ready for immediate departure.

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-698.audioText: C: United 122, cleared for takeoff, report airborne.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-698.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, report airborne, UAL122.

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-699.audioText: B: You are at 1000 feet now, contact Departure.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-699.audioTextZh: B：你现在 1000 英尺，联系离场。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-699.referenceTextZh: 离场，UAL122，通过 1000 英尺爬升中。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-700.audioText: C: United 122, Departure, follow Golf Juliet 2 Delta departure, expect no further instruction until 3000 feet, after 3000 feet, join your planned route.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-700.audioTextZh: C：United 122，离场，执行 Golf Juliet 2 Delta 离场，3000 英尺前预计无进一步指令，过 3000 英尺后加入计划航路。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-700.referenceText: Follow GJ 2D departure, expect no further instruction until 3000 feet, after 3000 feet, join planned route, UAL122.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-700.referenceTextZh: 执行 GJ 2D 离场，3000 英尺前预计无进一步指令，过 3000 英尺后加入计划航路，UAL122。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-701.audioText: C: United 122, expedite climb to keep separation, traffic is in your 2 o'clock converging, report when clear of traffic.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-701.audioTextZh: C：United 122，加快爬升以保持间隔，2 点钟方向有汇聚航空器，脱离冲突后报告。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-701.referenceText: Expedite climb to keep separation, report when clear of traffic, UAL122.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-701.referenceTextZh: 加快爬升以保持间隔，脱离冲突后报告，UAL122。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-702.audioText: B: Tell the controller that you keep well clear of the traffic.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-702.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已与该航空器保持安全间隔。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-702.referenceText: Departure, UAL122, clear of the traffic.

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-703.audioText: C: United 122, continue climbing to FL250, proceed to Hotel Mike, contact Control on 122.10 when reaching FL120.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-703.audioTextZh: C：United 122，继续爬升至飞行高度层 250，飞往 Hotel Mike，到达飞行高度层 120 时联系管制 122.10。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-703.referenceText: Continue climbing to FL250, proceed to HM, contact Control on 122.10 when reaching FL120, UAL122.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-703.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 FL250，飞往 HM，到达 FL120 时联系管制 122.10，UAL122。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-704.audioText: B: You are at FL120, call Control.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-704.audioTextZh: B：你在飞行高度层 120，呼叫管制。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-705.audioText:
C: United 122, can you lose time on route? Landing delays at Oscar Bravo Oscar Airport.
B: Tell the controller that you can.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-705.audioTextZh:
C：United 122，你能在航路上消耗时间吗？Oscar Bravo Oscar 机场落地延误。
B：告诉管制员可以。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-706.audioText: C: United 122, reduce your speed to Mach point 65, maintain FL250.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-706.audioTextZh: C：United 122，减速至马赫 0.65，保持飞行高度层 250。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-706.referenceText: Reduce speed to M.65, maintain FL250, UAL122.

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-707.audioText: B: You tell the controller that your port engine is inoperative.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-707.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你们左发失效。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-707.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Control, UAL122, our port/left engine has failed.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-707.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，管制，UAL122，我们左发失效。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-708.audioText:
C: United 122, roger PAN call, report your current status.
B: You have shut down the engine and are trying to restart it following the checklist.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-708.audioTextZh:
C：United 122，收到 PAN 呼叫，报告当前状态。
B：你已关闭左发，正在按检查单尝试重启。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-708.referenceText: We have shut down left engine, we are trying to restart it, UAL122.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-708.referenceTextZh: 我们已关闭左发，正在尝试重启，UAL122。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-709.audioText:
C: United 122, roger.
B: Engine restart are unsuccessful, you want priority landing.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-709.audioTextZh:
C：United 122，收到。
B：发动机重启不成功，你希望优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-709.referenceText: Control, UAL122, engine restart are unsuccessful, request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-709.referenceTextZh: 管制，UAL122，发动机重启不成功，请求优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0041-card-main-710.audioText: C: United 122, turn left heading 170 and descend to 3000 feet, contact Approach on 130.6.
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-710.audioTextZh: C：United 122，左转航向 170，下降至 3000 英尺，联系进近 130.6。
atc-scenario-0041-card-main-710.referenceText: Turn left heading 170, descend to 3000 feet, 130.6, UAL122.

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-711.audioText: B: Your call sign is KLM 88, you are at gate 504, the boarding hasn't been completed and you have catering delay, you have to delay about 15 minutes, contact Shanghai Delivery and request delay the flight until time 25.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-711.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 KLM 88，在 504 登机口，登机尚未完成且配餐延误，需要延误约 15 分钟，联系上海放行，请求航班延误至 25 分。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-711.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, KLM88, gate 504, the boarding hasn't been completed and we have catering delay, we have to delay about 15 minutes, request delay the flight until time 25.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-711.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，KLM88，504 登机口，登机尚未完成且配餐延误，需要延误约 15 分钟，请求航班延误至 25 分。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-712.audioText: C: KLM 88, roger, report when ready.

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-713.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 504, you have got the information Foxtrot, you are ready to copy ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-713.audioTextZh: B：你现在在 504 登机口，已收到通播 Foxtrot，准备抄收飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-713.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, KLM88, gate 504, information F, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-713.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，KLM88，504 登机口，收到通播 F，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-714.audioText: C: KLM 88, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 34, initial climb 900 meters on QNH, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 127.35, squawk 7423.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-714.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，按计划航路放行至阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道 34，按 QNH 初始爬升 900 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 127.35，应答机 7423。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-714.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 34, initial climb 900 meters on QNH, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 127.35, squawk 7423, KLM88.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-714.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道 34，按 QNH 初始爬升 900 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 127.35，应答机 7423，KLM88。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-715.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Shanghai Ground.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-715.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备推出和开车，联系上海地面。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-715.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-715.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM88，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-716.audioText: C: KLM 88, push back and start up approved, facing west.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-716.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，可以推出开车，机头朝西。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-716.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, KLM88.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-716.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，机头朝西，KLM88。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-717.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-718.audioText: C: KLM 88, taxi to holding point runway 34 via taxiway Zulu, Tango 3, Tango 4 and Romeo.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-718.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，经滑行道 Zulu、Tango 3、Tango 4 和 Romeo 滑行至跑道 34 等待点。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-718.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 34 via taxiway Z, T3, T4 and R, KLM88.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-718.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z、T3、T4 和 R 滑行至跑道 34 等待点，KLM88。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-719.audioText: B: During taxi, you notice an Airbus 320 was broken down on taxiway Tango 3, you have stopped your aircraft, contact Shanghai Ground and request further instructions.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-719.audioTextZh: B：滑行过程中，你发现一架 Airbus 320 在滑行道 Tango 3 上故障，你已停止飞机，联系上海地面请求进一步指令。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-719.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, an A320 was broken down on taxiway T3, we have stopped our aircraft, request further instructions.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-719.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM88，一架 A320 在滑行道 T3 上故障，我们已停止，请求进一步指令。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-720.audioText: C: KLM 88, hold position, expect delay 5 minutes.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-720.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，保持当前位置，预计延误 5 分钟。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-721.audioText: B: You are at holding point runway 34, you are ready for departure, contact Shanghai Tower.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-721.audioTextZh: B：你在跑道 34 等待点，准备离场，联系上海塔台。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-721.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM88, holding point runway 34, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-721.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，KLM88，跑道 34 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-722.audioText: C: KLM 88, runway 34, cleared for takeoff.

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-723.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Shanghai Departure.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-723.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 600 米，联系上海离场。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-723.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM88, airborne, passing 600 meters.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-723.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，KLM88，已离地，通过 600 米。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-724.audioText: C: KLM 88, Shanghai Departure, radar contact, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1012.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-724.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，上海离场，雷达识别，按 QNH 1012 爬升至 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-724.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1012, KLM88.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-724.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1012 爬升至 3000 米，KLM88。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-725.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to 3000 meters. During climbing, you have got a warning, the indication shows electrical power is low, make an Urgency call to Shanghai Departure and request return for landing.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-725.audioTextZh: B：你现在正爬升至 3000 米。爬升过程中出现警告，指示显示电力不足，向上海离场发出紧急呼叫并请求返场着陆。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-725.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Departure, KLM88, climbing to 3000 meters, our electrical power is low, request return for landing.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-725.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海离场，KLM88，正爬升至 3000 米，电力不足，请求返场着陆。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-726.audioText: C: KLM 88, Departure, roger PAN, descend to 1200 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-726.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，离场，收到 PAN，下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-726.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R, KLM88.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-726.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，KLM88。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-727.audioText: B: During approach, you can't establish a stable approach due to low electrical power, you have made a missed approach, contact Departure.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-727.audioTextZh: B：进近过程中，由于电力不足无法建立稳定进近，你已复飞，联系离场。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-727.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM88, we can't establish a stable approach due to low electrical power, going around.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-727.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，KLM88，因电力不足无法建立稳定进近，正在复飞。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-728.audioText:
C: KLM 88, roger, follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to 1200 meters, if able, advise further intentions.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that you want to circle to runway 18L for visual approach.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-728.audioTextZh:
C：KLM 88，收到，执行公布复飞程序，爬升至 1200 米，如可以，报告后续意图。
B：复诵指令，并告诉管制员你想盘旋至跑道 18 左目视进近。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-728.referenceText: Follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to 1200 meters, request circle to runaway 18L for visual approach, KLM88.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-728.referenceTextZh: 执行公布复飞程序，爬升至 1200 米，请求盘旋至跑道 18L 目视进近，KLM88。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-729.audioText: C: KLM 88, Departure, cleared visual approach runway 18L. Caution, runway is wet, braking action medium.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-729.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，离场，可以目视进近跑道 18 左。注意跑道湿，刹车效应中等。

atc-scenario-0042-card-main-730.audioText: B: After landing, the runway is slippery, you skidded off runway 18L, ask Tower for a tug and passenger stairs.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-730.audioTextZh: B：落地后跑道湿滑，你滑出跑道 18 左，向塔台请求拖车和客梯车。
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-730.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM88, the runway is slippery, we skidded off runway 18L, request a tug and passenger stairs.
atc-scenario-0042-card-main-730.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，KLM88，跑道湿滑，我们滑出跑道 18L，请求拖车和客梯车。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-731.audioText: B: Your call sign is Japan Air 602, a flight from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters, make initial contact with Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-731.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Japan Air 602，从东京飞往武汉，现在飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米，首次联系武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-731.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-731.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-732.audioText: B: You now have an indication of a thunderstorm on your radar screen, fifty kilometers ahead of you, request ATC clearance to offset 5 miles to the right.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-732.audioTextZh: B：你现在雷达屏幕显示前方 50 公里有雷暴，请求 ATC 许可向右偏航 5 海里。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-732.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, we have an indication of a thunderstorm 50 km ahead, request offset 5 miles to the right.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-732.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，我们显示前方 50 公里有雷暴，请求向右偏航 5 海里。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-733.audioText: C: Japan Air 602, offset 5 miles to the right approved.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-733.audioTextZh: C：Japan Air 602，同意向右偏航 5 海里。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-733.referenceText: Offset 5 miles to the right approved, JAL602.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-733.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 5 海里，JAL602。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-734.audioText: B: Later you find more thunderstorms ahead of you, request climb to 10700 meters.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-734.audioTextZh: B：随后你发现前方有更多雷暴，请求爬升至 10700 米。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-734.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request climb to 10700 meters due weather.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-734.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，因天气请求爬升至 10700 米。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-735.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, 10700 meters not available due to military activity at the moment, can you accept 11300 meters?
B: Tell the controller you are unable to climb to 11300 meters due performance.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-735.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，目前因军事活动，10700 米不可用，可以接受 11300 米吗？
B：告诉管制员因性能原因无法爬升至 11300 米。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-735.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, negative/unable due performance.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-735.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，不能接受，因性能原因无法爬升。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-737.audioText: B: To avoid thunderstorm, you request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for fifty miles.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-737.audioTextZh: B：为避让雷暴，你请求右转航向 240，并保持该航向 50 海里。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-737.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for 50 miles to avoid thunderstorm.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-737.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，为避让雷暴，请求右转航向 240 并保持该航向 50 海里。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-738.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, negative, heading 240 is not available to restricted area, deviation to the left is available, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to turn left heading 080.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-738.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，不可以，航向 240 因限制区不可用，左侧偏航可用，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员你想左转航向 080。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-738.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, roger, request turn left heading 080.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-738.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，收到，请求左转航向 080。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-739.audioText: C: Japan Air 602, turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-739.audioTextZh: C：Japan Air 602，同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-739.referenceText: Turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather, JAL602.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-739.referenceTextZh: 同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告，JAL602。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-740.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, how many miles do you want to fly on this heading?
B: Tell the controller fifty miles is enough for you.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-740.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，你想沿该航向飞多少海里？
B：告诉管制员 50 海里足够。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-741.audioText: B: Now you are clear of weather, inform Wuhan Control and request direct to Zulu Foxtrot and descent.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-741.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，通知武汉管制，并请求直飞 Zulu Foxtrot 和下降。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-741.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, clear of weather, request direct to ZF and descent.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-741.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，已脱离天气，请求直飞 ZF 并下降。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-742.audioText: C: Japan Air 602, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, descend and maintain 6000 meters.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-742.audioTextZh: C：Japan Air 602，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降并保持 6000 米。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-742.referenceText: Direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters, JAL602.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-742.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，JAL602。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-743.audioText: B: Now you see CBs in front of you, you want to maneuver 2 miles to the right.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-743.audioTextZh: B：你现在看到前方有 CB，想向右机动 2 海里。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-743.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request maneuver 2 miles to the right due to CBs ahead.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-743.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，前方有 CB，请求向右机动 2 海里。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-744.audioText: B: During maneuver, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and ask for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-744.audioTextZh: B：机动过程中，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，向武汉进近报告情况并请求优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-744.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL602, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-744.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL602，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，请求优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0043-card-main-745.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, roger, you are number 1, expect radar vectors, do you require any medical assistance on arrival?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance, and you will open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-745.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，收到，你是第一架，预计雷达引导，落地后需要医疗协助吗？
B：告诉管制员需要医疗协助，并将打开后客舱门，用担架让病患下机。
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-745.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL602, request medical assistance and open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
atc-scenario-0043-card-main-745.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL602，请求医疗协助，并打开后客舱门，用担架让病患下机。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-746.audioText: B: Your call sign is Japan Air 220, from Shanghai to Hongkong, you have intercepted an Urgency call from Air China 105, Air China 105 was transmitting blind due to receiver failure, he intended to request priority landing at Xiamen, relay the message to Xiamen Approach.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-746.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Japan Air 220，从上海飞往香港，你截收到 Air China 105 的紧急呼叫，Air China 105 因接收机故障正在盲发，意图请求在厦门优先着陆，将该信息转报给厦门进近。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-746.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Xiamen Approach, JAL220, we have intercepted an Urgency call from CCA105, CCA105 was transmitting blind due to receiver failure, request priority landing at Xiamen.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-746.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，厦门进近，JAL220，我们截收到 CCA105 的紧急呼叫，CCA105 因接收机故障正在盲发，请求在厦门优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-747.audioText:
C: Air China 105, Xiamen Approach, report your current position and altitude.
B: Tell Xiamen Approach that Air China 105's current position is 10 miles northwest of Foxtrot Quebec Golf, altitude is 9800 meters.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-747.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 105，厦门进近，报告当前位置和高度。
B：告诉厦门进近，Air China 105 当前位置在 Foxtrot Quebec Golf 西北 10 海里，高度 9800 米。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-747.referenceText: Xiamen Approach, JAL220, CCA105's current position is 10 miles northwest of FQG, maintaining 9800 meters.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-747.referenceTextZh: 厦门进近，JAL220，CCA105 当前位置在 FQG 西北 10 海里，保持 9800 米。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-748.audioText: C: Japan Air 220, maintain present heading, maintain 9800 meters, contact Hongkong Center on 112.5.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-748.audioTextZh: C：Japan Air 220，保持当前航向，保持 9800 米，联系香港管制112.5。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-748.referenceText: Maintain present heading, maintain 9800 meters, contact Hongkong Center on 112.5, JAL220.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-748.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，保持 9800 米，联系香港管制112.5，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-749.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining FL320, you are over FISHA, your transponder code is 3062, make an initial contact with Hongkong Center.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-749.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持飞行高度层 320，飞越 FISHA，应答机代码 3062，首次联系香港管制。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-749.referenceText: Hongkong Center, JAL220, maintaining FL320, over FISHA, squawking 3062.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-749.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，JAL220，保持 FL320，飞越 FISHA，应答机 3062。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-750.audioText: B: Suddenly, you encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly volcanic ash, your starboard engine is overheating, you ask Hongkong Center for emergency descent to FL220 and radar vectors to Hongkong for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-750.audioTextZh: B：突然遭遇外来物吸入，可能是火山灰，右发过热，你向香港管制请求紧急下降至飞行高度层 220，并请求雷达引导至香港优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-750.referenceText: Hongkong Center, JAL220, we encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly volcanic ash, our starboard engine is overheating, request emergency descent to FL220 and radar vectors to Hongkong for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-750.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，JAL220，我们遭遇外来物吸入，可能是火山灰，右发过热，请求紧急下降至 FL220，并雷达引导至香港优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-751.audioText: C: Japan Air 220, roger, FL220 is not available due to traffic, maintain FL320, turn right, direct to Tango Delta, contact Hongkong Approach on 123.8.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-751.audioTextZh: C: Japan Air 220，收到，由于交通原因，飞行高度层 220 不可用，保持飞行高度层 320，右转，直飞 Tango Delta，联系香港进近123.8。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-751.referenceText: Maintain FL320, turn right, direct to TD, 123.8, JAL220.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-751.referenceTextZh: 保持 FL320，右转，直飞 TD，123.8，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-752.audioText: B: Now you are 5 miles south of Tango Delta VOR, state your situation to Hongkong Approach and ask for straight in ILS approach runway 07L and priority landing.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-752.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 Tango Delta VOR 以南 5 海里，向香港进近说明情况，并请求跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近和优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-752.referenceText: Hongkong Approach, JAL220, 5 miles south of Tango Delta VOR, we encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly volcanic ash, request straight in ILS approach runway 07L and priority landing.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-752.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，JAL220，在 Tango Delta VOR 以南 5 海里，我们遭遇外来物吸入，可能是火山灰，请求跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近和优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-753.audioText: C: Japan Air 220, Hongkong Approach, turn right heading 240 to intercept Tango Delta VOR 030 radial inbound, descend to FL110.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-753.audioTextZh: C: Japan Air 220，香港进近，右转航向 240，切入 Tango Delta VOR 030 径向线向台，下降到飞行高度层 110。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-753.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept TD VOR 030 radial inbound, descend to FL110, JAL220.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-753.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 TD VOR 030 径向线向台，下降到 FL110，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-754.audioText:
C: Japan Air 220, when able, state persons on board.
B: Tell the controller the persons on board is 188, including 4 children.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-754.audioTextZh:
C: Japan Air 220，可以时报告机上人数。
B: 告诉管制员机上人数 188，包括 4 名儿童。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-754.referenceTextZh: 机上人数 188，包括 4 名儿童，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-755.audioText: C: Japan Air 220, cleared straight in ILS approach runway 07L, you are number 1 to land.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-755.audioTextZh: C: Japan Air 220，可以跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近，你是第 1 架着陆。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-755.referenceText: Cleared straight in ILS approach runway 07L, JAL220.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-755.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-756.audioText:
C: Japan Air 220, surface wind 090, 20 knots.
B: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 25.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-756.audioTextZh:
C: Japan Air 220，地面风 090，20 节。
B: 由于强顺风，你想改用跑道 25。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-756.referenceText: Hongkong Approach, JAL220, request change to runway 25 due strong tailwind.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-756.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，JAL220，由于强顺风，请求改用跑道 25。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-757.audioText: C: Japan Air 220, change to runway 25 approved, maintain 6000 feet, turn right to Tango Delta, you are number 1.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-757.audioTextZh: C: Japan Air 220，批准改用跑道 25，保持 6000 英尺，右转至 Tango Delta，你是第 1 架。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-757.referenceText: Change to runway 25 approved, maintain 6000 feet, turn right to TD, JAL220.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-757.referenceTextZh: 批准改用跑道 25，保持 6000 英尺，右转至 TD，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-758.audioText: B: After landing, you find your APU has failed, tell the situation to Hongkong Ground and ask for ground power unit.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-758.audioTextZh: B: 着陆后，你发现 APU 失效，向香港地面说明情况并请求地面电源车。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-758.referenceText: Hongkong Ground, JAL220, our APU has failed, request ground power unit.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-758.referenceTextZh: 香港地面，JAL220，我们的 APU 失效，请求地面电源车。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-759.audioText:
C: Japan Air 220, Hongkong Ground, roger, do you need any other service?
B: Tell the controller you need a tow truck to tow you to the apron.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-759.audioTextZh:
C: Japan Air 220，香港地面，收到，还需要其他服务吗？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖到停机坪。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-759.referenceText: Affirm, request a tow truck to tow us to the apron, JAL220.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-759.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求拖车把我们拖到停机坪，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0044-card-main-760.audioText:
C: Japan Air 220, roger, do you need medical assistance at the ramp?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance at the ramp.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-760.audioTextZh:
C: Japan Air 220，收到，你在停机坪需要医疗援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你在停机坪需要医疗援助。
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-760.referenceText: Affirm, request need medical assistance at the ramp, JAL220.
atc-scenario-0044-card-main-760.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求在停机坪提供医疗援助，JAL220。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-761.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 121, you are 6 miles from touch down, your fuel warning light is on, call Wuhan Approach for ILS approach and priority landing.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-761.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 121，距接地点 6 海里，燃油警告灯亮，呼叫 武汉进近请求 ILS 进近和优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-761.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA121, our fuel warning light is on, request ILS approach and priority landing.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-761.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA121，我们的燃油警告灯亮，请求 ILS 进近和优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-762.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, Wuhan Approach, roger, cleared ILS approach runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final, you are 5 and half miles from touch down.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-762.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，武汉进近，收到，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，右转航向 300 加入五边，你距接地点 5.5 海里。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-762.referenceText: Cleared ILS runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-762.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，右转航向 300 加入五边，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-763.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, contact 118.7 for Tower, good day.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-763.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，右转至 310 切入航向道，联系塔台 118.7，再见。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-763.referenceText: Turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, 118.7, good day, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-763.referenceTextZh: 右转至 310 切入航向道，118.7，再见，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-764.audioText: B: Contact Wuhan Tower, you are approaching Alpha Kilo Oscar, level at 1100 meters.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-764.audioTextZh: B: 联系武汉塔台，你正接近 Alpha Kilo Oscar，保持 1100 米。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-764.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121 is approaching AKO, level at 1100m.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-764.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121 正接近 AKO，保持 1100 米。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-765.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, for your information there is lighting maintenance in progress near the end of runway.
B: You ask if ILS category II is available.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-765.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，通知你，跑道末端附近正在进行灯光维护。
B: 你询问 ILS II 类是否可用。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-765.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, ILS category II is available?
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-765.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，ILS II 类可用吗？

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-766.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, ILS category II is unserviceable due to the inoperative center line lighting, ILS category I minimum is effective.
B: Read back lighting system information.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-766.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，由于中线灯不工作，ILS II 类不可用，ILS I 类最低标准有效。
B: 复诵灯光系统信息。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-766.referenceText: ILS category II is unserviceable, ILS category I minimum is effective, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-766.referenceTextZh: ILS II 类不可用，ILS I 类最低标准有效，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-767.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor.
B: Read back the runway conditions.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-767.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差。
B: 复诵跑道状况。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-767.referenceText: Runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-767.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-768.audioText: B: You request to dim the approach lights to grade 3, they look 2 bright from your aircraft.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-768.audioTextZh: B: 你请求把进近灯调暗到 3 级，从你的飞机看太亮。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-768.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, please dim the approach light to grade 3, they look 2 bright from here.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-768.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，请把进近灯调暗到 3 级，从这里看太亮。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-769.audioText: C: Roger. Air Canada 121, check gear down and you are cleared to land.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-769.audioTextZh: C: 收到。Air Canada 121，检查起落架放下，可以着陆。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-770.audioText:
B: You have 3 green lights, the PAPI appears to be a little bit low but actually your aircraft is high on the glide path. Report to the Tower.


(PAPI: precision approach path indicator)
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-770.audioTextZh:
B: 你有 3 个绿灯，PAPI 看起来有点低，但实际上飞机在下滑道上方。向塔台报告。


（PAPI：精密进近航径指示器）
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-770.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, we have 3 green lights on, the PAPI appears a little bit low but we are high on the glide path.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-770.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，我们有 3 个绿灯，PAPI 看起来有点低，但我们在下滑道上方。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-771.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, look at the whole airfield and adjust your descent rate.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-771.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，观察整个机场，调整下降率。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-771.referenceText: Look into a whole airfield and adjust the descent rate, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-771.referenceTextZh: 观察整个机场，调整下降率，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-772.audioText: B: You tell controller you're overshooting, your altitude is too high.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-772.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员你复飞了，高度太高。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-772.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, we are too high, going around.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-772.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA121，我们太高，复飞。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-773.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, check your aircraft condition in the holding area, contact Departure on 119.9.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-773.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，在等待区检查飞机状态，联系 Departure 119.9。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-774.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, confirm you are overshooting.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-774.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，确认你正在复飞。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-774.referenceText: Affirm, we are going around, ACA121.

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-775.audioText:
C: Roger, sir, what's your intention, please?
B: Tell Departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-775.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，先生，请问你的意图？
B: 告诉 Departure 你想盘旋回来在跑道 36R 再次着陆。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-775.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA121, we would like to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-775.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA121，我们想盘旋回来在跑道 36R 再次着陆。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-776.audioText: C: Air Canada 121, I am sorry to inform you that runway 36R is closed, there are patches of snow and much debris on the runway. Use runway 04 instead, fly heading 134 to intercept Localizer of runway 04.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-776.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，很抱歉通知你，跑道 36R 关闭，跑道上有片状积雪和大量碎片。改用跑道 04，飞航向 134 切入跑道 04 航向道。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-776.referenceText: Runway 04, heading 134 to intercept localizer of runway04, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-776.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04，航向 134 切入跑道 04 航向道，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-777.audioText: C. Air Canada 121, the wind is northwest about 10 to 15, turn left heading 070 and descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1001.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-777.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 121，风为西北风约 10 到 15，左转航向 070，按 QNH 1001 下降到 1200 米。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-777.referenceText: Turn left heading 070 and descend to 1200m on QNH 1001, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-777.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 070，按 QNH 1001 下降到 1200 米，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0045-card-main-778.audioText:
C: Air Canada 121, what is the status of your aircraft, please?
B: Tell the controller your aircraft is in good condition, but this time you don't have enough fuel for another missed approach, you want a successful landing this time.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-778.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 121，请问你的飞机状态？
B: 告诉管制员飞机状态良好，但这次你没有足够燃油再次复飞，希望这次成功着陆。
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-778.referenceText: My aircraft is in good condition, but I don't have enough fuel for another missed approach, I must make it this time, ACA121.
atc-scenario-0045-card-main-778.referenceTextZh: 我的飞机状态良好，但我没有足够燃油再次复飞，这次必须落地，ACA121。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-779.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 219, from Vancouver to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-779.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 219，从 Vancouver 到 Wuhan，保持 11000 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 3555，与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-779.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-779.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA219，保持 11000 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 3555。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-780.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due flow control.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-780.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，由于流量控制，减速到马赫 0.75。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-781.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-781.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-781.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised, ACA219.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-781.referenceTextZh: 下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知，ACA219。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-782.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at your 2 o'clock, below, climbing, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with you.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-782.audioTextZh: B: 下降过程中，你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在下方，正在爬升，向武汉管制确认是否与你冲突。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-782.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, our TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at our 2 o'clock, below, climbing, is it in conflict with us ?
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-782.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA219，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在我们下方，正在爬升，是否与我们冲突？

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-783.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, negative, the aircraft is climbing to 8900 meters, it will cross behind your shortly.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-783.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，否，该飞机正在爬升到 8900 米，很快将在你后方穿越。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-784.audioText: B: You have just received the latest ATIS, saying the visibility at Wuhan is low, you want to know if your alternate airport Changsha is available for diversion.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-784.audioTextZh: B: 你刚收到最新 ATIS，说 Wuhan 能见度低，你想知道备降机场 Changsha 是否可用于改航。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-784.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, the latest ATIS says the visibility at Wuhan is low, is Changsha available for diversion ?
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-784.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA219，最新 ATIS 说 Wuhan 能见度低，Changsha 是否可用于改航？

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-785.audioText:
C: Air Canada 219, Changsha Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Changsha?
