B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Changsha at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-785.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 219，Changsha Airport 可用，确认你要改航 Changsha？
B: 告诉管制员目前不改航 Changsha，仍想飞往 Wuhan。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-785.referenceText: We won't divert at the moment, we still want to fly to Wuhan, ACA219.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-785.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不改航，仍想飞往 Wuhan，ACA219。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-786.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, roger, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, follow Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-786.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha 进场，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-786.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, follow ZF2A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, ACA219.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-786.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF2A 进场，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近，ACA219。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-787.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-787.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-787.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, ACA219.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-787.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度，ACA219。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-788.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, contact Wuhan Tower 119.6.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-788.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，联系武汉塔台119.6。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-789.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-789.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-789.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, established on ILS approach runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-789.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA219，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-790.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-790.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，地面风静风，RVR 接地点 550 米，中段 600 米，停止端 500 米，继续进近跑道 36R。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-791.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-791.audioTextZh: B: 现在你距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况信息。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-791.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-791.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA219，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-792.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-792.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，疏云 700 米，可以着陆跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-792.referenceText: Cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land runway 36R, ACA219.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-792.referenceTextZh: 疏云 700 米，可以着陆跑道 36R，ACA219。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-793.audioText: B: At the minimum, you are unable to see approach lights, you are carrying out a missed approach, advise Tower.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-793.audioTextZh: B: 在最低标准高度，你看不到进近灯，正在执行复飞，通知塔台。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-793.referenceText:
Wuhan Tower, ACA219, we are unable to see approach lights at minimum, going around.
         (no contact at the minimum)
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-793.referenceTextZh:
武汉塔台，ACA219，我们在最低标准高度看不到进近灯，复飞。
         （最低标准高度无目视）

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-794.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-794.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，执行标准复飞程序，可以时报告意图。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-794.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA219.

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-795.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, inform Tower.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-795.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正在爬升到复飞高度，决定改航 Changsha Airport，通知塔台。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-795.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, request divert to Changsha Airport.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-795.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA219，请求改航 Changsha Airport。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-796.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, roger, turn right, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-796.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，收到，右转，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，爬升并保持 2400 米。
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-796.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, ACA219.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-796.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，ACA219。

atc-scenario-0046-card-main-797.audioText: C: Air Canada 219, contact Wuhan Departure on 120.4.
atc-scenario-0046-card-main-797.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 219，联系 Wuhan Departure 120.4。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-798.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 331, from Wuhan to Vancouver, push back and start up have been completed, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-798.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 331，从 Wuhan 到 Vancouver，推出和开车已完成，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-799.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, taxi to holding point runway 18R via taxiway Alpha 7, Alpha, Zulu 4 and Charlie.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-799.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，经滑行道 Alpha 7、Alpha、Zulu 4 和 Charlie 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-799.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18R via taxiway A7, A, Z4 and C, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-799.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-800.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, follow Airbus 319 on Mike to holding point runway 18R.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-800.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，跟随 Mike 上的 Airbus 319 到跑道 18R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-800.referenceText: Follow A319 on M to holding point runway 18R, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-800.referenceTextZh: 跟随 M 上的 A319 到跑道 18R 等待点，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-801.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, runway 18R is closed due to disabled aircraft on the runway, change your ATC clearance to runway 18L, Zulu Foxtrot 12 departure, the rest unchanged.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-801.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，跑道 18R 因跑道上有故障航空器关闭，将你的 ATC 许可改为跑道 18L，Zulu Foxtrot 12 离场，其余不变。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-801.referenceText: Roger, runway 18L, ZF12 departure, the rest unchanged, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-801.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 18L，ZF12 离场，其余不变，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-802.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, enter runway 18R from Charlie 3, vacate runway via Charlie 4, report vacated.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-802.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，从 Charlie 3 进入跑道 18R，经 Charlie 4 脱离跑道，报告脱离。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-802.referenceText: Enter runway 18R from C3, vacate runway via C4, report vacated, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-802.referenceTextZh: 从 C3 进入跑道 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，报告脱离，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-803.audioText: B: Now you have exited the runway 18R via Charlie 4, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-803.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已通过 Charlie 4 脱离跑道 18R，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-803.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA331, runway 18R vacated via C4.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-803.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA331，已通过 C4 脱离跑道 18R。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-804.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, continue taxi to holding point 18 left via taxiway Mike, Alpha and Alpha 1.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-804.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，继续经滑行道 Mike、Alpha 和 Alpha 1 滑行至 18L 等待点。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-804.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via taxiway M, A and A1, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-804.referenceTextZh: 继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-805.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, you see a helicopter ten o'clock above, it is closing to your aircraft, inform Wuhan Departure and request right turn to avoid the traffic.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-805.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，爬升到 1800 米，看到一架直升机在 10 点钟方向上方，正接近你的飞机，通知 Wuhan Departure 并请求右转避让该交通。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-805.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA331, airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, we see a helicopter 10 o'clock above, closing, request right turn to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-805.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA331，已离地，爬升到 1800 米，我们看到一架直升机在 10 点钟方向上方，正在接近，请求右转避让。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-806.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-806.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，右转航向 240，加快爬升到 2400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-806.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-806.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，加快爬升到 2400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-807.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, after traffic is clear, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-807.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，交通解除后，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-807.referenceText: After traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-807.referenceTextZh: 交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-808.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655, contact Zhengzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-808.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655，联系郑州管制。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-808.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-808.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA331，保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-809.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-809.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，郑州管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10100 米。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-810.audioText: B: Suddenly, your cabin crew report there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, you decided to expedite descent for smoke removal, make a Distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-810.audioTextZh: B: 突然，客舱乘务员报告后客舱有有毒烟雾，你决定为排烟加快下降，向郑州管制发出遇险呼叫并请求在 3000 米改平。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-810.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, the cabin crew report there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, request expedite descent to 3000 meters for smoke removal.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-810.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州管制，ACA331，客舱乘务员报告后客舱有有毒烟雾，请求加快下降到 3000 米以排烟。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-811.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, advise intentions when able.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-811.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，可以时报告意图。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-811.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-811.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-812.audioText: B: After cabin check, tell Zhengzhou Control the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-812.audioTextZh: B: 客舱检查后，告诉 郑州管制，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-812.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-812.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA331，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-813.audioText: B: Several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, tell Zhengzhou Control the situation and request diversion to Zhengzhou.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-813.audioTextZh: B: 数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，向郑州管制说明情况并请求改航 Zhengzhou。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-813.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, request divert to Zhengzhou.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-813.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA331，数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，请求改航 Zhengzhou。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-814.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, Zhengzhou Control, roger, turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-814.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，郑州管制，收到，左转航向 360，联系郑州进近120.35。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-815.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, Zhengzhou Approach, radar contact, track direct to Charlie Golf Oscar, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS runway 12.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-815.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，郑州进近，雷达识别，直飞 Charlie Golf Oscar，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-815.referenceText: Track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS runway 12, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-815.referenceTextZh: 直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0047-card-main-816.audioText:
C: Air Canada 331, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Zhengzhou Approach you need an ambulance and dangerous goods specialists.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-816.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 331，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉 郑州进近 你需要救护车和危险品专家。
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-816.referenceText: Request an ambulance and dangerous goods specialists, ACA331.
atc-scenario-0047-card-main-816.referenceTextZh: 请求救护车和危险品专家，ACA331。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-817.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 909, your destination is Beijing, and you are leaving 1200 meters and say good-bye to Wuhan Tower, contact Wuhan Approach and request to climb.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-817.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 909，目的地 Beijing，正在离开 1200 米，并向武汉塔台告别，联系武汉进近并请求爬升。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-817.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, leaving 1200 meters, request further climb.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-817.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA909，离开 1200 米，请求继续爬升。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-818.audioText: C: Air Canada 909, Wuhan Approach, good morning, radar contact, follow Zulu Foxtrot 1 Delta departure, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1013.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-818.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 909，武汉进近，早上好，雷达识别，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 1 Delta 离场，按 QNH 1013 爬升到 1800 米。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-818.referenceText: Follow ZF 1D departure, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, ACA909.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-818.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF 1D 离场，按 QNH 1013 爬升到 1800 米，ACA909。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-819.audioText: B: You just reached 1800 meters and you got some moderate chop at the level, inform the controller about that and request 4500 meters.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-819.audioTextZh: B: 你刚到达 1800 米，在该高度遇到中度颠簸，通知管制员并请求 4500 米。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-819.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, maintaining 1800 meters, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request 4500 meters.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-819.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA909，保持 1800 米，我们遇到中度颠簸，请求 4500 米。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-820.audioText:
C: Air Canada 909, Approach, unable to approve 4500 meters due traffic, 3900 meters available.
B: Tell the controller that you want to climb to 3900 meters.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-820.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 909，进近，由于交通原因不能批准 4500 米，3900 米可用。
B: 告诉管制员你想爬升到 3900 米。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-821.audioText: B: Inform the controller that the weather radar shows a cumulonimbus on route ahead about 30 Kilometers, and your level is 3900 meters.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-821.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员气象雷达显示航路前方约 30 公里有积雨云，你的高度是 3900 米。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-821.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, maintaining 3900 meters, the weather radar shows a CB ahead of us, about 30 km.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-821.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA909，保持 3900 米，气象雷达显示我们前方有 CB，约 30 公里。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-822.audioText:
C: Roger, Air Canada 909, report your intentions.
B: Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-822.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，Air Canada 909，报告你的意图。
B: 告诉管制员你需要雷达引导绕飞 CB。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-822.referenceText: Request radar vector to circumnavigate the CB, ACA909.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-822.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导绕飞 CB，ACA909。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-823.audioText: C: Air Canada 909, turn left heading 300.

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-824.audioText:
C: Air Canada 909, now you are cleared of the CB, climb to 4500 meters, turn right heading 030 to rejoin the Zulu Foxtrot 1 Delta departure.
B: Acknowledge the controller's instruction and tell him you want to fly to Zulu Foxtrot directly from present position.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-824.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 909，现在你已脱离 CB，爬升到 4500 米，右转航向 030 重新加入 Zulu Foxtrot 1 Delta 离场。
B: 确认管制员指令，并告诉他你想从当前位置直飞 Zulu Foxtrot。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-824.referenceText: Roger, climb to 4500 meters, request direct to ZF, ACA909.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-824.referenceTextZh: 收到，爬升到 4500 米，请求直飞 ZF，ACA909。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-825.audioText: C: Air Canada 909, cleared direct to Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-825.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 909，可以直飞 Zulu Foxtrot。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-826.audioText: C: Air Canada 909, maintain 4500 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-826.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 909，保持 4500 米，联系武汉管制118.1。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-827.audioText: B: You are just over Zulu Foxtrot, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-827.audioTextZh: B: 你刚过 Zulu Foxtrot，与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-827.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA909, maintain 4500 meters, over ZF.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-827.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA909，保持 4500 米，过 ZF。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-828.audioText: C: Air Canada 909, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-828.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 909，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升到 8900 米。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-829.audioText: B: A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack, inform the controller about that and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an Urgent call.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-829.audioTextZh: B: 一名乘务员告诉你有一名男性旅客心脏病发作，通知管制员，并告诉他你想返回 Wuhan。这是紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-829.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA909, We have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request direct back to Wuhan.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-829.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA909，我们有一名男性旅客心脏病发作，请求直飞返回 Wuhan。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-830.audioText: C: Air Canada 909, Wuhan Control, roger PAN PAN, turn right direct to Zulu Foxtrot, and descend to 4200 meters.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-830.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 909，武汉管制，收到 PANPAN，右转直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降到 4200 米。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-830.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, descend to 4200 meters, ACA909.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-830.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 ZF，下降到 4200 米，ACA909。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-831.audioText:
C: Air Canada 909, do you need any medical assistance?
B: Tell the controller that you need a physician and an ambulance upon landing or after landing.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-831.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 909，你们需要医疗援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你们着陆时或着陆后需要医生和救护车。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-831.referenceText: We need a physician and an ambulance upon arrival, ACA909.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-831.referenceTextZh: 我们到达时需要医生和救护车，ACA909。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-832.audioText:
C: Roger, an ambulance and a physician will be ready.
C: Air Canada 909, Wuhan Control, maintain 4200 meters, contact Approach on 118.9.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-832.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，救护车和医生会准备好。
C: Air Canada 909，武汉管制，保持 4200 米，联系 进近 118.9。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-833.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Approach that you have a passenger suffering heart attack and request landing priority.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-833.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉进近 你有一名旅客心脏病发作，并请求着陆优先。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-833.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, we have a passenger suffering heart attack, request priority for landing.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-833.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA909，我们有一名旅客心脏病发作，请求着陆优先。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-834.audioText:
C: Air Canada 909, Wuhan Approach, roger, radar contact, follow Zulu Foxtrot 1 Alpha arrival and descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, information Delta is valid.
B: Read back the controller's instruction and ask the detail of Information Delta, because you could not receive the Information on the radio.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-834.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 909，武汉进近，收到，雷达识别，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 1 Alpha 进场，按 QNH 1013 下降到 1800 米，信息 Delta 有效。
B: 复诵管制员指令，并询问信息 Delta 的详情，因为你无法通过无线电接收该信息。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-834.referenceText: Follow ZF 1A arrival, descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, can you repeat the ATIS ? being unable to pick up on the radio.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-834.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF 1A 进场，按 QNH 1013 下降到 1800 米，请重复 ATIS？无线电无法收到。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-835.audioText: C: Air Canada 909, Approach, surface wind 350 degrees at 3 meters per second, visibility 8 Kilometers, ILS approach runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 hectopascal.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-835.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 909，进近，地面风 350 度 3 米/秒，能见度 8 公里，使用跑道 36R ILS 进近，QNH 1013 百帕。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-835.referenceText: ILS approach runway 36R, QNH 1013 hpa, ACA909.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-835.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R ILS 进近，QNH 1013 hpa，ACA909。

atc-scenario-0048-card-main-836.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you want to land at the runway 18L visually to save time.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-836.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你想目视降落跑道 18L 以节省时间。
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-836.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, request to make a visual approach for runway 18L to save time.
atc-scenario-0048-card-main-836.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA909，请求目视进近跑道 18L 以节省时间。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-837.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 452, you are at stand 203, from Wuhan to Tokyo, you just got informed an illegal stowaway on board, and he must be taken away by police, contact Wuhan Ground to delay the push back.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-837.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 452，在 203 号机位，从 Wuhan 到 Tokyo，刚得知机上有非法偷渡者，必须由警方带走，联系武汉地面请求延迟推出。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-837.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA452, stand 203, request delay the push back due an illegal stowaway must be taken away by police.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-837.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA452，203 号机位，由于一名非法偷渡者必须由警方带走，请求延迟推出。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-838.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, report POB when ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-838.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，准备推出和开车时报告机上人数。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-839.audioText: B: Now tell the Ground controller you are ready for push back and start up, POB 235.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-839.audioTextZh: B: 现在告诉地面管制员你准备推出和开车，机上人数 235。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-839.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA452, request push back and start up, POB235.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-839.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA452，请求推出和开车，机上人数 235。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-840.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, push back and start up approved, facing west.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-840.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-840.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, ACA452.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-840.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，ACA452。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-841.audioText: B: During taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, tell the controller you will hold position until visibility gets better.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-841.audioTextZh: B: 滑行期间，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，告诉管制员你将原地等待，直到能见度好转。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-841.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA452, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, request hold position until visibility gets better.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-841.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA452，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，请求原地等待，直到能见度好转。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-842.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, the visibility now is 1000 meters, continue taxi to holding point runway 18R via taxiway Zulu 4 and Charlie, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-842.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，现在能见度 1000 米，继续经滑行道 Zulu 4 和 Charlie 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，联系武汉塔台124.35。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-842.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point runway 18R via taxiway Z4 and C, 124.35, ACA452.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-842.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，124.35，ACA452。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-843.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 18R, tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-843.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 18R 等待点，告诉塔台你准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-843.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA452, holding point runway 18R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-843.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA452，跑道 18R 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-844.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, when airborne, contact 119.35, follow the abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff runway 18R.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-844.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，跑道 18R 可以起飞。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-844.referenceText: When airborne, contact 119.35, follow the abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff runway 18R, ACA452.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-844.referenceTextZh: 离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，跑道 18R 可以起飞，ACA452。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-845.audioText: B: During takeoff climbing, you encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, contact Wuhan Departure to turn right to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-845.audioTextZh: B: 起飞爬升期间，你遭遇前机尾流，联系 Wuhan Departure 请求右转避让。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-845.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA452, we encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, request turn right to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-845.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA452，我们遭遇前机尾流，请求右转避让。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-846.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, Wuhan Departure, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, climb to and maintain 3300 meters.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-846.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，Wuhan Departure，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，爬升并保持 3300 米。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-846.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 3300 meters, ACA452.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-846.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 3300 米，ACA452。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-847.audioText: B: You are levelling at 10700 meters, your onboard navigation computers failed, you are flying with raw data, inform Wuhan Control the situation and request radar vectors.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-847.audioTextZh: B: 你正在 10700 米改平，机载导航计算机失效，正在用原始数据飞行，向武汉管制说明情况并请求雷达引导。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-847.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA452, levelling at 10700 meters, our onboard navigation computers failed, we are flying with raw data, request radar vectors.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-847.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA452，正在 10700 米改平，我们的机载导航计算机失效，正在用原始数据飞行，请求雷达引导。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-848.audioText:
C: Air Canada 452, what's the situation like on board?
B: Tell the controller you need 1 minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-848.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 452，机上情况如何？
B: 告诉管制员你需要 1 分钟执行检查单，稍后通知。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-848.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA452, we need 1 minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-848.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA452，我们需要 1 分钟执行检查单，稍后通知。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-849.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, maintain present level, turn left heading 010, keep informed if you can't maintain RVSM.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-849.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，保持当前高度，左转航向 010，如不能保持 RVSM，请随时告知。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-849.referenceText: Maintain present level, turn left heading 010, ACA452.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-849.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，左转航向 010，ACA452。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-850.audioText: B: After finishing the checklist, the malfunction can't be solved and your autopilot failed, you are unable RVSM due equipment, inform Wuhan Control your situation.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-850.audioTextZh: B: 完成检查单后，故障无法解决，自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM，向武汉管制通报情况。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-850.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA452, the malfunction can't be solved and our autopilot failed, unable RVSM due equipment.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-850.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA452，故障无法解决，我们的自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-851.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, turn right heading 040, descend to 8100 meters.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-851.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，右转航向 040，下降到 8100 米。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-851.referenceText: Turn right heading 040, descend to 8100 meters, ACA452.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-851.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 040，下降到 8100 米，ACA452。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-852.audioText:
C: Air Canada 452, when able, advise your intention.
B: Tell the control you will maintain 8100 meters and divert to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-852.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 452，可以时报告意图。
B: 告诉管制你将保持 8100 米并改航 Beijing。
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-852.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA452, request maintain 8100 meters and divert to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-852.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA452，请求保持 8100 米并改航 Beijing。

atc-scenario-0049-card-main-853.audioText: C: Air Canada 452, roger, contact Zhengzhou Control 119.35.
atc-scenario-0049-card-main-853.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 452，收到，联系郑州管制119.35。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-854.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 517, you are maintaining 10100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215, contact Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-854.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 517，保持 10100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215，联系武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-854.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA517, maintaining 10100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-854.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA517，保持 10100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-855.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, Wuhan Control, radar identified, omit position reports.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-855.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，武汉管制，雷达识别，省略位置报告。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-856.audioText: B: There is moderate turbulence at 10100 meters, ask Wuhan Control if there is any turbulence reported at 10700 meters.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-856.audioTextZh: B: 10100 米有中度颠簸，询问 武汉管制 10700 米是否有颠簸报告。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-856.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA517, there is moderate turbulence at 10100 meters, is there any turbulence reported at 10700 meters ?
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-856.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA517，10100 米有中度颠簸，10700 米是否有颠簸报告？

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-857.audioText:
C: Air Canada 517, there is no turbulence report at 10700 meters
B: Ask to climb to 10700 meters due moderate turbulence.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-857.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 517，10700 米没有颠簸报告。
B: 因中度颠簸请求爬升到 10700 米。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-857.referenceText: Request climb to 10700 meters due moderate turbulence, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-857.referenceTextZh: 因中度颠簸请求爬升到 10700 米，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-858.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, climb to reach 10700 meters within 2 minutes.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-858.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，爬升并在 2 分钟内到达 10700 米。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-858.referenceText: Climb to reach 1 10700 meters within 2 minutes, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-858.referenceTextZh: 爬升并在 2 分钟内到达 10700 米，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-859.audioText: B: When you are at 10700 meters, your left engine failed, make an Urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300 meters.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-859.audioTextZh: B: 当你在 10700 米时，左发失效，发出紧急呼叫并请求右转下降到 6300 米。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-859.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA517, our left engine failed, request turn right and descend to 6300 meters.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-859.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA517，我们左发失效，请求右转并下降到 6300 米。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-860.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-860.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-860.referenceText: Turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-860.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-861.audioText: B: Advise Wuhan Control you want to divert to Wuhan and track direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha and descend to lower levels.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-861.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉管制 你想改航 Wuhan，直飞 Whiskey Hotel Alpha 并下降到较低高度。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-861.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA517, request divert to Wuhan and track direct to WHA and descend to lower levels.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-861.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA517，请求改航 Wuhan，直飞 WHA，并下降到较低高度。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-862.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, turn left, direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha, descend and maintain 2100 meters.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-862.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，左转，直飞 Whiskey Hotel Alpha，下降并保持 2100 米。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-862.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100 meters, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-862.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 WHA，下降并保持 2100 米，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-863.audioText:
C: Air Canada 517, expect radar vector for VOR DME approach 36 right.
B: The weather is deteriorating and below landing minimum, ask for ILS approach 36 left.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-863.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 517，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近 36R。
B: 天气恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 36L。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-863.referenceText: Expect radar vector for VOR DME approach 36R, request ILS approach 36L due deteriorating weather and below landing minimum, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-863.referenceTextZh: 预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近 36R，因天气恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 36L，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-864.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, runway 36L is not available, runway in use 36R.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-864.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，跑道 36L 不可用，使用跑道 36R。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-865.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, you are number 1 to land, there are no speed restrictions in Wuhan terminal area.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-865.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，你是第 1 架着陆，Wuhan 终端区无速度限制。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-866.audioText: B: You executed a missed approach procedure and try to land on runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-866.audioTextZh: B: 你执行复飞程序，并尝试在跑道 36R 着陆。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-866.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA517, going around, we will try to land on runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-866.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA517，复飞，我们将尝试在跑道 36R 着陆。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-867.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-867.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-867.referenceText: Climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-867.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-868.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, maintain 1200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-868.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，保持 1200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-868.referenceText: Maintain 1200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach runway 36R, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-868.referenceTextZh: 保持 1200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0050-card-main-869.audioText: C: Air Canada 517, runway covered with patches of water, braking action medium.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-869.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 517，跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等。
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-869.referenceText: Runway covered with patches of water, breaking action medium, ACA517.
atc-scenario-0050-card-main-869.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等，ACA517。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-870.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 521, a flight from Wuhan to Toronto, you are at gate 232, you have got the latest ATIS Tango, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-870.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 521，从 Wuhan 到 Toronto，位于 232 号登机口，已收到最新 ATIS Tango，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-870.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA521, gate 232, information T, request ATC clearance to Toronto.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-870.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，ACA521，232 号登机口，信息 T，请求前往 Toronto 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-871.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, Zulu Foxtrot 05 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-871.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，可以按计划航路前往 Toronto，离场跑道 04，初始爬升到 1500 米，Zulu Foxtrot 05 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，途中请求高度变更，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-871.referenceText: Cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, ZF 05 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655, ACA521.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-871.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Toronto，离场跑道 04，初始爬升到 1500 米，ZF 05 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，途中请求高度变更，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655，ACA521。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-872.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-872.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-872.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-872.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA521，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-873.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha, hold short of Echo 5.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-873.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Echo 5 前等待。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-873.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA521.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-873.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待，ACA521。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-874.audioText: B: Now you see there is an obstruction ahead of you on taxiway Alpha 3, you confirm the taxi instructions with Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-874.audioTextZh: B: 现在你看到前方滑行道 Alpha 3 上有障碍物，向武汉地面确认滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-874.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, there is an obstruction ahead of us on A3, confirm the taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-874.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA521，A3 上我们前方有障碍物，请确认滑行指令。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-875.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, hold at present position, the ground handling will deal with it.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-875.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，原地等待，地面保障会处理。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-876.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, the obstruction has been removed, continue taxi via Alpha 3, Alpha to holding point runway 04.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-876.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，障碍物已移除，继续经 Alpha 3、Alpha 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-876.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point runway 04, ACA521.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-876.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，ACA521。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-877.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point Echo 5 runway 04, you are fully ready, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-877.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 Echo 5 等待点等待，完全准备好，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-877.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA521, holding at holding point E5 runway 04, fully ready.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-877.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA521，在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-878.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, surface wind 030 degrees, 8 knots.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-878.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，地面风 030 度 8 节。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-878.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, ACA521.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-878.referenceTextZh: 进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，ACA521。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-879.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters, make an initial contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-879.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米，与 Wuhan Departure 建立初始联系。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-879.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA521, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-879.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA521，通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-880.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, radar contact, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, climb to 4500 meters.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-880.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，雷达识别，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，爬升到 4500 米。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-880.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters, ACA521.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-880.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米，ACA521。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-881.audioText: B: Your TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above your level, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with your aircraft.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-881.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在你高度上方 300 米，向武汉管制确认是否与你的飞机冲突。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-881.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA521, our TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above our level, is it in conflict with us ?
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-881.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA521，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在我们高度上方 300 米，是否与我们冲突？

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-882.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, negative, it is parallel to your flight track.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-882.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，否，它与你的航迹平行。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-883.audioText: B: During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make an Urgency call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-883.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，机长突然心脏病发作，向武汉管制发出紧急呼叫并请求立即返航优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-883.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA521, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-883.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA521，机长突然心脏病发作，请求立即返航优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-884.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, roger PAN PAN, turn left heading 220, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, descend to 3300 meters, you are number 1.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-884.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，收到 PANPAN，左转航向 220，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降到 3300 米，你是第 1 架。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-884.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, ACA521.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-884.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，ACA521。

atc-scenario-0051-card-main-885.audioText:
C: Air Canada 521, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need an ambulance and a physician.
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-885.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 521，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要救护车和医生。
atc-scenario-0051-card-main-885.referenceText: Request an ambulance and a physician, ACA521.

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-886.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 101 at Beijing Airport, your parking bay is 531 with information Sierra, request ATC clearance to HongKong.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-886.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Beijing Airport 的 Air China 101，停机位 531，收到信息 Sierra，请求前往 HongKong 的 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-886.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA101, bay 531, information S, request ATC clearance to HongKong.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-886.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA101，531 号停机位，信息 S，请求前往 HongKong 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-887.audioText: C: Air China 101, cleared to HongKong via flight planned route, runway 36L, RENOB 02 departure, initial altitude 900 meters, expect en-route altitude 10 minutes after departure, departure frequency 119.65. Call me ready for pushback and startup.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-887.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，可以按计划航路前往 HongKong，跑道 36L，RENOB 02 离场，初始高度 900 米，预计离场后 10 分钟给途中高度，离场频率 119.65。准备推出和开车时呼叫我。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-887.referenceText: Cleared to HongKong via flight planned route, runway 36L, RENOB 02 departure, initial altitude 900m, expect en-route altitude 10min after departure, departure frequency 119.65, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-887.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 HongKong，跑道 36L，RENOB 02 离场，初始高度 900 米，预计离场后 10 分钟给途中高度，离场频率 119.65，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-888.audioText:
B: You are now at the holding point of runway 36R.
C: Air China 101, behind the departing Airbus 330, cross runway 36R behind, then taxi via Echo and hold short of runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-888.audioTextZh:
B: 你现在在跑道 36R 等待点。
C: Air China 101，在离场 Airbus 330 后面，跟在其后穿越跑道 36R，然后经 Echo 滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-888.referenceText: Behind A330, cross runway 36R behind, taxi via E and hold short of runway 36L, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-888.referenceTextZh: 跟在 A330 后面，在其后穿越跑道 36R，经 E 滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-889.audioText: B: During taxiing, you observed a cone marker in front of you on the taxiway Echo, you have stopped the aircraft, report the situation to ATC and confirm if the taxiway Echo is closed.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-889.audioTextZh: B: 滑行中，你在滑行道 Echo 前方看到一个锥形标志，你已停住飞机，向 ATC 报告情况并确认滑行道 Echo 是否关闭。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-889.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA101, a cone marker in front of us on the taxiway E, we have stopped, is the taxiway E closed ?
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-889.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA101，滑行道 E 上我们前方有一个锥形标志，我们已停住，滑行道 E 是否关闭？

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-890.audioText:
C: Air China 101, negative, taxiway Echo is fully open, are you able to taxi around it?
B: Tell ATC that you are unable to taxi around it and request ground personnel to remove it.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-890.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 101，否，滑行道 Echo 完全开放，你能绕过它滑行吗？
B: 告诉 ATC 你无法绕过它，请求地面人员移除。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-890.referenceText: We are unable to taxi around it, request ground personnel to remove it, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-890.referenceTextZh: 我们无法绕过它，请求地面人员移除，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-891.audioText: C: Air China 101, roger, hold present position.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-891.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，收到，原地等待。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-892.audioText:
B: Several minutes later.
C: Air China 101, Ground, the safety officer confirms the taxiway is now clear, continue on Echo and hold short of runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-892.audioTextZh:
B: 几分钟后。
C: Air China 101，地面，安全员确认滑行道现在已清空，继续在 Echo 上滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-892.referenceText: Roger, continue on E and hold short of runway 36L, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-892.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续在 E 上滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-893.audioText: B: You are now at the holding point of runway 36L, tell ATC that you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-893.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在跑道 36L 等待点，告诉 ATC 你准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-893.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA101, holding point of runway 36L, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-893.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA101，跑道 36L 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-894.audioText: C: Air China 101, behind landing traffic line up behind.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-894.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，在着陆交通后面，跟在后面进跑道。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-894.referenceText: Behind landing traffic line up behind, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-894.referenceTextZh: 在着陆交通后面进跑道，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-895.audioText: B: It is much later, you initiate approach, you have reached 15000 meters and request further descent, call HongKong Approach.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-895.audioTextZh: B: 很久以后，你开始进近，已到达 15000 米并请求继续下降，呼叫 香港进近。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-895.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, maintain 15000m, request further descent.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-895.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，保持 15000 米，请求继续下降。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-896.audioText:
C: Air China 101, maintain 15000 meters, opposite traffic 2 o’clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
B: Tell the controller you are clear of the other aircraft and request to fly lower.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-896.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 101，保持 15000 米，相对交通 2 点钟方向 10 海里，报告脱离交通。
B: 告诉管制员你已脱离另一架飞机，并请求降低高度。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-896.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, clear of traffic, request to fly lower.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-896.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，脱离交通，请求降低高度。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-897.audioText: B: You were cleared to 5000 meters but notice the sky turning dark and visibility is getting worse quickly, you suspect a sand storm. Tell HongKong Approach this situation and ask ATC if there is a sandstorm forecast.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-897.audioTextZh: B: 你获准下降到 5000 米，但注意到天空变暗、能见度迅速变差，你怀疑有沙尘暴。向香港进近说明情况，并询问 ATC 是否有沙尘暴预报。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-897.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, the sky turning dark and visibility is getting worse quickly, we suspect a sandstorm, is there a sandstorm forecast ?
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-897.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，天空变暗，能见度迅速变差，我们怀疑有沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-898.audioText: B: The sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor. Inform ATC the situation and ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-898.audioTextZh: B: 沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很差。通知 ATC 情况，并请求爬升到较高高度以越过沙尘暴。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-898.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, the sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor, request climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-898.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很差，请求爬升到较高高度以越过沙尘暴。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-899.audioText: C: Air China 101, climb and maintain 7000 meters and turn right heading 210.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-899.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，爬升并保持 7000 米，右转航向 210。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-899.referenceText: Climb and maintain 7000m，turn right heading 210, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-899.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 7000 米，右转航向 210，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-900.audioText: B: Suddenly, your No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, request radar vectors to HongKong Airport for priority landing. This is a Distress call.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-900.audioTextZh: B: 突然，由于沙尘暴，你的 1 号和 2 号发动机熄火，请求雷达引导至 HongKong Airport 优先着陆。这是遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-900.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, HongKong Approach, CCA101, our No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, request radar vectors to HongKong Airport for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-900.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，香港进近，CCA101，由于沙尘暴，我们的 1 号和 2 号发动机熄火，请求雷达引导至 HongKong Airport 优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0052-card-main-901.audioText: C: Air China 101, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 260, this will take you direct to HongKong, the weather at HongKong Airport is clear.
atc-scenario-0052-card-main-901.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，收到 Mayday，右转航向 260，这将使你直飞 HongKong，HongKong Airport 天气晴好。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-902.audioText:
B: You are the pilot of Air China 105 and now waiting for ATC clearance.
C: Air China 105 is cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, cruising level 9200 meters, Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.
B: The tower controllers voice is disturbed, and you didn't hear the words after 9200 meters, ask the controller to repeat the latter part of the instruction.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-902.audioTextZh:
B: 你是 Air China 105 的飞行员，现在等待 ATC 许可。
C: Air China 105 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，巡航高度 9200 米，Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9。
B: 塔台管制员声音受干扰，你没有听到 9200 米之后的话，请管制员重复指令后半部分。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-902.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA105, say again after 9200 meters.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-902.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA105，请重复 9200 米之后内容。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-903.audioText: C: Air China 105, cruising level 9200 meters, Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-903.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，巡航高度 9200 米，Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-903.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzho via flight planned route, cruising level 9200 meters, LKO 1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-903.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，巡航高度 9200 米，LKO 1D 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-904.audioText: B: You have completed the relevant checklist, ask the Tower controller to let you to start your engine.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-904.audioTextZh: B: 你已完成相关检查单，请求塔台管制员允许你起动发动机。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-905.audioText: C: Air China 105, startup is approved, report when ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-905.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，开车批准，准备滑行时报告。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-905.referenceText: Start up approved, call you ready for taxi, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-905.referenceTextZh: 开车批准，准备滑行时呼叫你，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-906.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi out, ask the Tower controller for taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-906.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑出，向塔台管制员请求滑行指令。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-907.audioText: C: Air China 105, taxi via taxiway Alpha 7 and Alpha to holding point of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-907.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，经滑行道 Alpha 7 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-907.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A7 and A to holding point of runway 36R, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-907.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-908.audioText:
C: Air China 105, hold position, traffic ten o'clock, approaching you from your left.
B: Acknowledge the instruction, and inform the controller that you have seen the traffic.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-908.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，原地等待，交通在 10 点钟方向，从你左侧接近。
B: 确认指令，并通知管制员你已看到该交通。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-908.referenceText: Hold position, traffic in sight, CCA105.

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-909.audioText: B: Later, you are approaching the active runway 36R, ask the Tower controller for permission to enter the runway.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-909.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，你接近使用中的跑道 36R，向塔台管制员请求进入跑道许可。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-909.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA105, approaching runway 36R, request line up.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-909.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA105，接近跑道 36R，请求进跑道。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-910.audioText: C: Air China 105, line up and wait.

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-911.audioText: C: Air China 105, cleared for take off runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-911.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，跑道 36R 可以起飞。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-911.referenceText: Cleared for take off runway 36R, CCA105.

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-912.audioText: B: This is a night operation. When you are running out your speed has just retrieved V R, you suddenly see a slow moving object ahead of you, it is crossing the runway from left to right. You pull backs and rotate to avoid the traffic, and you felt a shake from the nose gear. You get airborne at time 23, and report the accident to Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-912.audioTextZh: B: 这是夜间运行。当你加速滑跑速度刚到 VR 时，突然看到前方有一个缓慢移动物体，正从左向右穿越跑道。你拉杆抬轮避让该交通，并感觉前起落架震动。你在 23 分离地，向武汉进近报告事故。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-912.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA105, airborne at time 23, we encountered runway incursion during take off, a slow moving object ahead of us, it is crossing the runway from left to right.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-912.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA105，23 分离地，我们起飞时遭遇跑道侵入，前方有缓慢移动物体，正从左向右穿越跑道。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-913.audioText:
C: Air China 105, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, is there any damage to the aircraft? report your intentions.
B: Tell the Approach controller that you want to land at Wuhan Airport, and you don't know about any damage.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-913.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，武汉进近，雷达识别，飞机是否受损？报告你的意图。
B: 告诉进近管制员你想在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，不知道是否有损伤。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-913.referenceText: We want to land at Wuhan Airport, and we are not sure about any damage, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-913.referenceTextZh: 我们想在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，不确定是否有损伤，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-914.audioText:
C: Air China 105, roger, do you want to hold and have a check?
B: Tell the controller that you do want to hold and check.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-914.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，收到，你想等待并检查吗？
B: 告诉管制员你确实想等待并检查。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-915.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, climb to 900 meters on QNH 1011, turn left direct to Delta Alpha and hold over Delta Alpha.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-915.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，按 QNH 1011 爬升到 900 米，左转直飞 Delta Alpha 并在 Delta Alpha 上空等待。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-915.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters on QNH 1011, turn left direct to DA and hold over DA, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-915.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1011 爬升到 900 米，左转直飞 DA 并在 DA 上空等待，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-916.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you found out that there is something wrong with the nose gear, tell the controller you need to dump fuel before landing.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-916.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你发现前起落架有问题，告诉管制员着陆前需要放油。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-916.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA105, we have something wrong with the nose gear, request dump fuel before landing.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-916.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA105，我们前起落架有问题，请求着陆前放油。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-917.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, climb to 2100 meters on QNH, turn left heading 130, radar vector to the dumping area.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-917.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，按 QNH 爬升到 2100 米，左转航向 130，雷达引导至放油区。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-917.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters on QNH, turn left heading 130, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-917.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 爬升到 2100 米，左转航向 130，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-918.audioText: B: Later, inform the controller that you have finished the fuel dumping and want to be radar guided to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-918.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，通知管制员你已完成放油，并希望雷达引导至 Wuhan Airport。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-918.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA105, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector to Wuhan.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-918.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA105，放油完成，请求雷达引导至 Wuhan。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-919.audioText: C: Air China 105, descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 290, radar vector for ILS approach runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-919.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，下降到 900 米，右转航向 290，雷达引导跑道 36L ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-919.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 290, radar vector for ILS approach runway 36L, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-919.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，右转航向 290，雷达引导跑道 36L ILS 进近，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-920.audioText:
C: Air China 105, do you need any assistance upon landing?
B: Tell the controller that you are going to make a landing without nose gear, you need fire trucks and a foamed runway.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-920.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，着陆时你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你将不放前起落架着陆，需要消防车和铺泡沫跑道。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-920.referenceText: We are going to land without the nose gear, we need fire trucks and a foamed runway, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-920.referenceTextZh: 我们将不放前起落架着陆，需要消防车和铺泡沫跑道，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-921.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, foamed runway and fire trucks will be ready upon landing.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-921.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，铺泡沫跑道和消防车将在着陆时准备好。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-922.audioText: C: Air China 105, reduce speed to 180 knots.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-922.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，减速到 180 节。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-923.audioText: C: Air China 105, turn left heading 330 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, report established.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-923.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，左转航向 330 切入跑道 36L 航向道，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-923.referenceText: Turn left heading 330 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, report established, CCA105.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-923.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 330 切入跑道 36L 航向道，建立后报告，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-924.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have captured the localizer.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-924.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你已截获航向道。

atc-scenario-0053-card-main-925.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, cleared ILS approach runway 36L, 13 miles from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-925.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，可以跑道 36L ILS 进近，距接地点 13 海里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。
atc-scenario-0053-card-main-925.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 36L ILS 进近，124.35，CCA105。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-926.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 425, stand 08, from Wuhan to Tokyo, information Kilo received, request ATC clearance to Tokyo.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-926.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 425，08 号机位，从 Wuhan 到 Tokyo，已收到信息 Kilo，请求前往 Tokyo 的 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-926.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA425, stand 08, information K, request ATC clearance to Tokyo.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-926.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA425，08 号机位，信息 K，请求前往 Tokyo 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-927.audioText: C: Air China 425, cleared to Tokyo via flight planned route, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, climb and maintain 1500 meters initially, cruising level 10100 meters, runway 36R, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-927.audioTextZh: C: Air China 425，可以按计划航路前往 Tokyo，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始爬升并保持 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-927.referenceText: Cleared to Tokyo via flight planned route, LKO 01 departure, climb and maintain 1500m initially, cruising level 10100m, runway 36R, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 6325, CCA425.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-927.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Tokyo，LKO 01 离场，初始爬升并保持 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325，CCA425。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-928.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-928.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备好，联系 地面请求推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-928.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA425, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-928.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA425，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-929.audioText: C: Air China 425, push back and start up approved, facing East.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-929.audioTextZh: C: Air China 425，推出和开车批准，机头朝东。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-929.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing East, CCA425.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-929.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝东，CCA425。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-930.audioText: B: While taxiing, you noticed the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-930.audioTextZh: B: 滑行时，你注意到风袋显示强顺风，联系 塔台 检查风。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-930.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA425, request wind check.

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-931.audioText: C: Air China 425, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-931.audioTextZh: C: Air China 425，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-932.audioText: B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to runway 18L and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-932.audioTextZh: B: 顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系 塔台请求改用跑道 18L 并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-932.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA425, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-932.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA425，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-933.audioText: B: You are now at cruising level 10100 meters, few minutes later, you find out you have flown into volcanic ash cloud, No.1 engine has stalled and then flamed out. Make an urgency call, state your situation and request return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-933.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在巡航高度 10100 米，几分钟后发现飞入火山灰云，1 号发动机喘振后熄火。发出紧急呼叫，说明情况并请求返回 Wuhan Airport。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-933.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CCA425, we have flown into volcanic ash cloud, No.1 engine has stalled and then flamed out, request return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-933.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，CCA425，我们飞入火山灰云，1 号发动机喘振后熄火，请求返回 Wuhan Airport。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-934.audioText: C: Air China 425, roger your PAN, turn left heading 060, descend and maintain 4200 meters, wait for further instructions.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-934.audioTextZh: C: Air China 425，收到你的 PAN，左转航向 060，下降并保持 4200 米，等待进一步指令。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-934.referenceText: Turn left heading 060, descend and maintain 4200m, CCA425.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-934.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 060，下降并保持 4200 米，CCA425。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-935.audioText: B: You are leveling off at 4200 meters, you find out everything is clear, you decide to restart the No.1 engine, tell ATC your decision.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-935.audioTextZh: B: 你正在 4200 米改平，发现一切正常，决定重启 1 号发动机，告诉 ATC 你的决定。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-935.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA425, maintain 4200m, everything is clear, we decide to restart the No.1 engine.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-935.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CCA425，保持 4200 米，一切正常，我们决定重启 1 号发动机。

atc-scenario-0054-card-main-936.audioText: B: Your No.1 engine restarted, tell ATC you decide to continue to the destination, request their approval.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-936.audioTextZh: B: 你的 1 号发动机重启成功，告诉 ATC 你决定继续飞往目的地，请求批准。
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-936.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA425, our No.1 engine restarted, request continue to Tokyo.
atc-scenario-0054-card-main-936.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CCA425，我们的 1 号发动机已重启，请求继续飞往 Tokyo。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-937.audioText: B: Tell the Tower you are ready to taxi.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-937.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 塔台 你准备滑行。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-937.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA878, ready to taxi.

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-938.audioText: C: Air China 878, taxi to holding point of runway 08 via taxiway Echo 2 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-938.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，经滑行道 Echo 2 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 08 等待点。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-938.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 08 via taxiway E2 and A, CCA878.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-938.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 E2 和 A 滑行至跑道 08 等待点，CCA878。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-939.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, the purser calls you on the intercom, you have a passenger who have become very ill and you must return to the gate, tell air traffic controllers this.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-939.audioTextZh: B: 滑行时，乘务长通过内话呼叫你，有一名旅客病情很重，你必须返回登机口，把这件事告诉空中交通管制员。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-939.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA878, we have a passenger who have become very ill and we have to return to the gate.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-939.referenceTextZh: 三亚塔台，CCA878，我们有一名旅客病情很重，必须返回登机口。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-940.audioText: C: Air China 878, roger, continue taxi via Alpha, cleared to enter the runway, then exit left via Echo, continue to gate 7.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-940.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，收到，继续经 Alpha 滑行，可以进入跑道，然后经 Echo 左转脱离，继续到 7 号登机口。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-940.referenceText: Continue taxi via A, cleared to enter the runway, then exit left via E, continue to gate 7, CCA878.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-940.referenceTextZh: 继续经 A 滑行，可以进入跑道，然后经 E 左转脱离，继续到 7 号登机口，CCA878。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-941.audioText:
C: Air China 878, can you tell us the exact problem the passenger has.
B: Tell air traffic control the passenger has suffered a heart attack and you were treating him with oxygen.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-941.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 878，能告诉我们旅客的具体问题吗？
B: 告诉空中交通管制，旅客心脏病发作，你们正在给他吸氧。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-941.referenceText: The passenger has suffered a heart attack and we are treating him with oxygen, CCA878.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-941.referenceTextZh: 该旅客心脏病发作，我们正在给他吸氧，CCA878。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-942.audioText: B: It is now thirty minutes later in the day, the sick passenger has disembarked and you were at the holding point for runway 08, tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-942.audioTextZh: B: 现在是当天 30 分钟后，患病旅客已下机，你在跑道 08 等待点，告诉 塔台 你准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-942.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA878, hold at holding point runway 08, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-942.referenceTextZh: 三亚塔台，CCA878，在跑道 08 等待点等待，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-943.audioText: C: Air China 878, line up and wait.

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-944.audioText: C: Air China 878, hold position for 5 minutes due flow control.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-944.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，由于流量控制，原地等待 5 分钟。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-945.audioText: C: Air China 878, after departure, maintain runway heading and climb 900 meters, cleared for takeoff, runway 08, surface wind calm.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-945.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，离场后保持跑道航向并爬升 900 米，跑道 08 可以起飞，地面风静风。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-945.referenceText: After departure, maintain runway heading and climb 900 meters, cleared for takeoff, runway 08, CCA878.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-945.referenceTextZh: 离场后保持跑道航向并爬升 900 米，跑道 08 可以起飞，CCA878。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-946.audioText: B: It is now later in the flight and you are experiencing some light turbulence, request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-946.audioTextZh: B: 现在飞行后段，你正在经历轻度颠簸，请求更高高度。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-946.referenceText: Sanya Control, CCA878, we are experiencing light turbulence, request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-946.referenceTextZh: 三亚管制，CCA878，我们正在经历轻度颠簸，请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-947.audioText: C: Air China 878, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-947.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，爬升并保持 10100 米。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-948.audioText: B: You reach 10100 meters, but the turbulence is now worse and is now class to severe, ask to climb to 10700 meters.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-948.audioTextZh: B: 你到达 10100 米，但颠簸现在更严重，已接近严重，请求爬升到 10700 米。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-948.referenceText: Sanya Control, CCA878, request climb to 10700 meters due severe turbulence.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-948.referenceTextZh: 三亚管制，CCA878，因严重颠簸请求爬升到 10700 米。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-949.audioText:
C: 10700 meters not available, we can give you a lower level if you require.
B: Tell the controller you require a lower level.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-949.audioTextZh:
C: 10700 米不可用，如需要，我们可以给你较低高度。
B: 告诉管制员你需要较低高度。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-949.referenceText: Roger, request a lower level, CCA878.

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-950.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of your engines separates, tell air traffic control this and say you would like to descend to 8100 meters and divert to Shanghai, this is a Distress call.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-950.audioTextZh: B: 突然，你的一台发动机脱落，告诉空中交通管制，并说你想下降到 8100 米并改航 Shanghai，这是遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-950.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Sanya Control, CCA878, 1 of our engines separated, request descend to 8100 meters and divert to Shanghai.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-950.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，三亚管制，CCA878，我们一台发动机脱落，请求下降到 8100 米并改航 Shanghai。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-951.audioText: C: Air China 878, roger MAYDAY, turn left heading 230, and descent to 8100 meters.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-951.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，收到 MAYDAY，左转航向 230，下降到 8100 米。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-951.referenceText: Turn left heading 230, and descent to 8100 meters, CCA878.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-951.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 230，下降到 8100 米，CCA878。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-952.audioText: C: Air China 878, all runway is will be available at Shanghai Pudong for you, surface wind calm.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-952.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，Shanghai Pudong 所有跑道都将可供你使用，地面风静风。

atc-scenario-0055-card-main-953.audioText: C: Air China 878, descend to 3300 meters, flight direct DUMET.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-953.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，下降到 3300 米，直飞 DUMET。
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-953.referenceText: Descend to 3300 meters, flight direct DUMET, CCA878.
atc-scenario-0055-card-main-953.referenceTextZh: 下降到 3300 米，直飞 DUMET，CCA878。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-954.audioText: B: You are parked on stand Delta 3 and have listened to the ATIS with information Papa, please ask Beijing Delivery for your ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-954.audioTextZh: B: 你停在 Delta 3 机位，已收听 ATIS 信息 Papa，请向北京放行请求 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-954.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA124, stand D3, information P, request ATC clearance to London.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-954.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA124，D3 机位，信息 P，请求前往 London 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-955.audioText: C: Air China 124, is cleared to London via flight planned route, cruising level 10400 meters, initial climb 900 meters on 1023, follow Victor Yankee Kilo 05 Delta departure, contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-955.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，可以按计划航路前往 London，巡航高度 10400 米，初始爬升 900 米按 1023，执行 Victor Yankee Kilo 05 Delta 离场，联系 120.6，应答机 4523。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-955.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, cruising level 10400 meters, initial climb 900 meters on 1023, follow VYK 05D departure, contact 120.6, squawk 4523, CCA124.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-955.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 London，巡航高度 10400 米，初始爬升 900 米按 1023，执行 VYK 05D 离场，联系 120.6，应答机 4523，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-956.audioText: B: You are now ready to push back and start up, contact ATC.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-956.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备推出和开车，联系 ATC。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-956.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA124, ready for pushback and startup.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-956.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA124，准备推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-957.audioText: C: Air China 124, push back approved, facing east, start up at your own discretion, report when ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-957.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，推出批准，机头朝东，自行决定开车，准备滑行时报告。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-957.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, start up at own discretion, CCA124.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-957.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，机头朝东，自行决定开车，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-958.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, call ATC.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-958.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑行，呼叫 ATC。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-958.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA124, ready to taxi.

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-959.audioText: C: Air China 124, taxi via Zulu 6 and Foxtrot to the holding point runway 36R, caution work in progress on the intersection of taxiway Zulu 3 and Zulu 6.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-959.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，经 Zulu 6 和 Foxtrot 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，注意滑行道 Zulu 3 和 Zulu 6 交叉口有施工。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-959.referenceText: Roger, taxi via Z6 and F to holding point runway 36R, CCA124.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-959.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 Z6 和 F 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-960.audioText: B: A ground vehicle crossing taxiway Foxtrot, suddenly appears in front of you near the intersection of Zulu 3 and Zulu 6, you nearly hit it, inform to controller about this.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-960.audioTextZh: B: 一辆穿越滑行道 Foxtrot 的地面车辆突然出现在你前方，靠近 Zulu 3 和 Zulu 6 交叉口，你差点撞上，向管制员通报。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-960.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA124, a ground vehicle crossing taxiway F, suddenly appears in front of me near the intersection of Z3 and Z6, we nearly hit it.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-960.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA124，一辆穿越滑行道 F 的地面车辆突然出现在我前方，靠近 Z3 和 Z6 交叉口，我们差点撞上。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-961.audioText:
C: Air China 124, yeah, it's an online vehicle, um just been informed that it was an ambulance attending an injured workman, is everything okay with your aircraft?
B: Tell the controller that you applied maximum brake to stop the airplane, but the flight attendant has not given you any injury reports.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-961.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 124，是的，那是一辆在线车辆，呃刚获知它是去处理受伤工人的救护车，你的飞机一切正常吗？
B: 告诉管制员你使用最大刹车停住飞机，但乘务员没有给你任何受伤报告。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-961.referenceText: We applied maximum brake to stop the airplane, but there was no injury report, CCA124.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-961.referenceTextZh: 我们使用最大刹车停住飞机，但没有受伤报告，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-962.audioText: C: Air China 124, continue taxi to the holding point of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-962.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-962.referenceText: Continue taxi to the holding point of runway 36R, CCA124.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-962.referenceTextZh: 继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-963.audioText: C: Air China 124, Ground, contact Beijing on 118.7, good day.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-963.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，地面，联系 Beijing 118.7，再见。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-964.audioText: B: Contact the Tower and tell them you are approaching the end of your taxi at the holding point, and you are now ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-964.audioTextZh: B: 联系 塔台，告诉他们你接近滑行终点的等待点，现在准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-964.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA124, we are approaching the holding point of runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-964.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA124，我们正接近跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-965.audioText: C: Air China 124, roger, line up and wait.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-965.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，收到，进跑道等待。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-966.audioText: B: Now you are ready for takeoff, call the Tower.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-966.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备起飞，呼叫 塔台。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-966.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA124, ready for departure.

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-967.audioText: C: Air China 124, cleared for takeoff, wind 340 at 7 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-967.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，可以起飞，风 340，7 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-968.audioText: C: Air China 124, continue Victor Yankee Kilo 05 Delta departure, contact Departure on 120.6, good bye.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-968.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，继续 Victor Yankee Kilo 05 Delta 离场，联系 Departure 120.6，再见。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-968.referenceText: Continue VYK 05D departure, contact Departure on 120.6, good bye, CCA124.
