atc-scenario-0056-card-main-968.referenceTextZh: 继续 VYK 05D 离场，联系 Departure 120.6，再见，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-969.audioText: B: You fly through a flock of birds, called Beijing Departure and tell them you may have hit a bird during takeoff, the left engine EGT is higher and you want to hold at Charlie Delta Yankee to carry out a check.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-969.audioTextZh: B: 你穿过一群鸟，呼叫 Beijing Departure 并告诉他们你起飞时可能撞鸟，左发 EGT 较高，想在 Charlie Delta Yankee 等待以进行检查。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-969.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CCA124, we fly through a flock of birds, maybe we hit a bird during takeoff, the left engine EGT is higher, request hold at CDY for check.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-969.referenceTextZh: Beijing Departure，CCA124，我们穿过一群鸟，起飞时可能撞鸟，左发 EGT 较高，请求在 CDY 等待检查。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-970.audioText: C: Air China 124, continue climb to 900 meters on QNH 1023, turn right, direct to Charlie Delta Yankee and hold at Charlie Delta Yankee at 900 meters.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-970.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，按 QNH 1023 继续爬升到 900 米，右转，直飞 Charlie Delta Yankee，并在 Charlie Delta Yankee 900 米等待。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-970.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters on QNH 1023, turn right direct to CDY and hold at CDY at 900 meters, CCA124.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-970.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1023 爬升到 900 米，右转直飞 CDY，并在 CDY 900 米等待，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-971.audioText: B: Inform the controller you now have a right engine flame out, and you wish to return to Beijing after the fuel dumping, this is an Urgency call.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-971.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你现在右发熄火，希望放油后返回 Beijing，这是紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-971.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, CCA124, right engine flame out, request return to Beijing after dump fuel.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-971.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Beijing Departure，CCA124，右发熄火，请求放油后返回 Beijing。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-972.audioText: C: Air China 124, roger PAN, maintain 900 meters on QNH, turn left heading 020 degrees, radar vectors to the dumping area.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-972.audioTextZh: C: Air China 124，收到 PAN，按 QNH 保持 900 米，左转航向 020 度，雷达引导至放油区。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-972.referenceText: Maintain 900 meters on QNH, turn left heading 020 degrees, CCA124.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-972.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 保持 900 米，左转航向 020 度，CCA124。

atc-scenario-0056-card-main-973.audioText: B: You have arrived at the dumping area and have finished dumping fuel, inform the controller that you have completed fuel dumping and request radar guidance back to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-973.audioTextZh: B: 你已到达放油区并完成放油，通知管制员放油完成，请求雷达引导返回 Beijing。
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-973.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CCA124, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector back to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0056-card-main-973.referenceTextZh: Beijing Departure，CCA124，放油完成，请求雷达引导返回 Beijing。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-974.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 101 and you are at Wuhan Airport, you are now taxiing on taxiway Alpha 3 to taxiway Alpha.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-974.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 101，位于 Wuhan Airport，现在正在从滑行道 Alpha 3 滑向滑行道 Alpha。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-974.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA101, taxiing from taxiway A3 to A.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-974.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA101，正从滑行道 A3 滑向 A。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-975.audioText: C: Air China 101, taxi with extreme caution and keep close to the centerline of your taxiway.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-975.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，极其谨慎滑行，并靠近你所在滑行道中心线。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-975.referenceText: Keep close to the centerline of the taxiway, CCA101.

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-976.audioText: B: You want to check with Wuhan Ground for NOTAM bulletin Alpha 0011.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-976.audioTextZh: B: 你想向武汉地面确认 NOTAM 通告 Alpha 0011。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-976.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA124, confirm NOTAM A0011.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-976.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA124，确认 NOTAM A0011。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-977.audioText: C: Air China 101, latest bulletin Alpha 0011 says taxiway Alpha 3 is newly repaired on the second mid section of the left side.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-977.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，最新通告 Alpha 0011 说滑行道 Alpha 3 左侧第二中段新近修复。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-977.referenceText: Roger, taxiway A3 is newly repaired on the second mid section of the left side, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-977.referenceTextZh: 收到，滑行道 A3 左侧第二中段新近修复，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-978.audioText: B: You are approaching the holding point of runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-978.audioTextZh: B: 你正接近跑道 36R 等待点，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-978.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA101, approaching the holding point of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-978.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA101，接近跑道 36R 等待点。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-979.audioText: C: Air China 101, hold short, traffic on final.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-979.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，等待，五边有交通。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-980.audioText:
C: Air China 101, we've just been informed a large bird was sacked into your port engine a moment, please check.
B: Say your EGT of port engine is not in normal range, you figure something is wrong and you ask the controller for his instruction.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-980.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 101，我们刚被告知一只大鸟刚才被吸入你的左发，请检查。
B: 说你的左发 EGT 不在正常范围，你判断有问题，并向管制员请求指令。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-980.referenceText: Roger, our EGT of port engine is not in normal range, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-980.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们左发 EGT 不在正常范围，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-981.audioText: C: Air China 101, hold at your present position.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-981.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，在当前位置等待。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-982.audioText: C: Air China 101, the maintenance department asked you to shut down the right engine straight away.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-982.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，维修部门要求你立即关停右发。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-982.referenceText: We will shut down the engine, CCA101.

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-983.audioText: C: Air China 101, we send you a tug to tow you back to the maintenance bay.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-983.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，我们派拖车把你拖回维修机位。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-984.audioText:
B: After settling the problem, you took off, now you are under Departure control.
C: Air China 101, cancel SID, track direct to Golf Hotel, climb and maintain 1800 meters.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-984.audioTextZh:
B: 解决问题后，你起飞了，现在由 Departure 管制。
C: Air China 101，取消 SID，直飞 Golf Hotel，爬升并保持 1800 米。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-984.referenceText: Cancel SID, track direct to GH, climb and maintain 1800 meters, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-984.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 GH，爬升并保持 1800 米，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-985.audioText: B: You are now over Golf Hotel, report to ATC that you have observed a balloon at your eleven o'clock position 3 miles away.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-985.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在 Golf Hotel 上空，向 ATC 报告在 11 点钟方向 3 海里处看到一个气球。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-985.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA101, over GH, we observed a balloon at our 11 o'clock position 3 miles away.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-985.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA101，过 GH，我们在 11 点钟方向 3 海里处看到一个气球。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-986.audioText:
C: Roger, 101, climb to and maintain 3900 meters on standard, i'll check the balloon.
B: Report to ATC you collided with an unknown foreign object, the windshield is broken.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-986.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，101，按标准气压爬升并保持 3900 米，我会查明该气球。
B: 向 ATC 报告你撞上了不明外来物，风挡破裂。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-986.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3900 meters on standard, we collided with an unknown foreign object, the windshield is broken, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-986.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升并保持 3900 米，我们撞上不明外来物，风挡破裂，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-987.audioText:
C: Roger, 101, say your intention.
B: Tell ATC that you decide to go back to the departing airport.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-987.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，101，说明你的意图。
B: 告诉 ATC 你决定返回起飞机场。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-987.referenceText: Request go back to the departing airport, CCA101.

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-988.audioText: C: Air China 101, turn left heading 280.

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-989.audioText: C: Air China 101, turn left heading 240.

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-990.audioText: B: Your TCAS is activated, and your aircraft is descending under TCAS control, report to ATC.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-990.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 启动，飞机正在 TCAS 控制下下降，向 ATC 报告。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-991.audioText:
C: Roger, what is the problem?
B: Tell the controller you have a conflicting traffic, it's Boeing 757, at about 2 o'clock from right to left.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-991.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，是什么问题？
B: 告诉管制员你有冲突交通，是 Boeing 757，约在 2 点钟方向从右向左。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-991.referenceText: We have a conflicting traffic, it's B757, at about 2 o'clock from right to left, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-991.referenceTextZh: 我们有冲突交通，是 B757，约在 2 点钟方向从右向左，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-992.audioText: C: Roger, 101, turn left heading 210, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1002.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-992.audioTextZh: C: 收到，101，左转航向 210，按 QNH 1002 下降到 1200 米。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-992.referenceText: Turn left heading 210, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1002, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-992.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 210，按 QNH 1002 下降到 1200 米，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0057-card-main-993.audioText: C: Air China 101, turn left heading 070, this will lead you ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-993.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，左转航向 070，这将引导你进行跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-993.referenceText: Turn left heading 070, ILS approach runway 36R, report established, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0057-card-main-993.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 070，跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-994.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 512, you are at Wuhan Airport, parking at gate 211, you have got information Victor, request ATC clearance to Changsha from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-994.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 512，位于 Wuhan Airport，停在 211 号登机口，已收到信息 Victor，向武汉放行请求前往 Changsha 的 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-994.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA512, gate 211, information V, request ATC clearance to Changsha.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-994.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA512，211 号登机口，信息 V，请求前往 Changsha 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-995.audioText: C: Air China 512, cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, runway 04, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2016.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-995.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，可以按计划航路前往 Changsha，Lima Kilo Oscar 02 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 8400 米，跑道 04，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2016。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-995.referenceText: Cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO 02 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, runway 04, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2016, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-995.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Changsha，LKO 02 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 8400 米，跑道 04，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2016，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-996.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-996.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-996.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA512, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-996.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA512，准备推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-997.audioText: C: Air China 512, push back and start up approved, facing east.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-997.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，推出和开车批准，机头朝东。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-997.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-997.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝东，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-998.audioText: B: You are now on the taxiway Zulu 4 with engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-998.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在滑行道 Zulu 4，发动机运转，向 地面 管制请求滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-998.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA512, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-998.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA512，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-999.audioText: C: Air China 512, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Zulu 4 and Alpha, hold short of Alpha 4.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-999.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，经滑行道 Zulu 4 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Alpha 4 前等待。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-999.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-999.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1000.audioText: C: Air China 512, caution work in progress near the right side of Alpha 3.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1000.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，注意 Alpha 3 右侧附近有施工。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1001.audioText: C: Air China 512, give way to Airbus 320 vacating on Echo 3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via Alpha, hold short of runway 04.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1001.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，给正在 Echo 3 脱离的 Airbus 320 让路，交通解除后，继续经 Alpha 滑行，在跑道 04 前等待。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1001.referenceText: Traffic in sight, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via A, hold short of runway 04, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1001.referenceTextZh: 看到交通，交通解除后，继续经 A 滑行，在跑道 04 前等待，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1002.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 900 meters climbing, contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1002.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，900 米爬升，联系 Wuhan Departure。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1002.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA512, airborne, 900 meters climbing.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1002.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA512，已离地，900 米爬升。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1003.audioText: C: Air China 512, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left, direct to Delta Alpha, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1020.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1003.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，左转，直飞 Delta Alpha，按 QNH 1020 爬升到 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1003.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1020, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1003.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，按 QNH 1020 爬升到 3000 米，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1004.audioText: C: Air China 512, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, expedite until passing 3900 meters.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1004.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，爬升并保持 6600 米，通过 3900 米前加快爬升。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1004.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600 meters, expedite until passing 3900 meters, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1004.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 6600 米，通过 3900 米前加快爬升，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1005.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6600 meters, request a higher level and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1005.audioTextZh: B: 你保持 6600 米时遭遇中度积冰，请求更高高度并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1005.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA512, maintaining 6600 meters, we are experiencing moderate icing, request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1005.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CCA512，保持 6600 米，我们遭遇中度积冰，请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1006.audioText: C: Air China 512, climb to and maintain 7200 meters.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1006.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，爬升并保持 7200 米。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1006.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 7200 meters, CCA512.

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1007.audioText: B: Suddenly, your starboard engine failed at 7200 meters, make an Urgency call to ATC and request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1007.audioTextZh: B: 突然，你的右侧发动机在 7200 米失效，向 ATC 发出紧急呼叫，并请求下降和返回 Wuhan Airport。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1007.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CCA512, our starboard engine failed at 7200 meters, request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1007.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，CCA512，我们的右侧发动机在 7200 米失效，请求下降并返回 Wuhan Airport。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1008.audioText: C: Air China 512, roger PAN, descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect ILS approach runway 04.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1008.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，收到 PAN，下降到 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计跑道 04 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1008.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect ILS approach runway 04, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1008.referenceTextZh: 下降到 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计跑道 04 ILS 进近，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1009.audioText: C: Air China 512, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1019.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1009.audioTextZh: C: Air China 512，按 QNH 1019 下降到 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1009.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1019, CCA512.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1009.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1019 下降到 3000 米，CCA512。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1010.audioText: B: You fail to restart the right engine, ask ATC for priority landing and also ask for the longest runway for safety concern.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1010.audioTextZh: B: 你未能重启右发，向 ATC 请求优先着陆，并出于安全考虑请求最长跑道。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1010.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA512, we fail to restart the right engine, request priority landing and the longest runway for safety concern.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1010.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA512，我们未能重启右发，出于安全考虑，请求优先着陆和最长跑道。

atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1011.audioText: B: You have established on ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1011.audioTextZh: B: 你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1011.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA512, established on ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0058-card-main-1011.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA512，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1012.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 527, you are at gate 211, you have received ATIS Charlie, your destination is Guangzhou, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1012.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 527，位于 211 号登机口，已收到 ATIS Charlie，目的地 Guangzhou，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1012.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA527, gate 211, information C, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1012.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA527，211 号登机口，信息 C，请求前往 Guangzhou 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1013.audioText: C: Air China 527, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1013.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1013.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, LKO 01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1013.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，LKO 01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1014.audioText: B: Now you are on the taxiway Zulu 4, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground and request taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1014.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在滑行道 Zulu 4，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1014.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA527, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1014.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA527，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1015.audioText: C: Air China 527, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1015.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1015.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1015.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1016.audioText: C: Air China 527, follow China Southern 737 on Alpha 7, you are number 2 for departure.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1016.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跟随 Alpha 7 上的 China Southern 737，你是第 2 架离场。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1016.referenceText: Roger, follow CSN737 on A7, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1016.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A7 上的 CSN737，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1017.audioText: B: Now you are at threshold of runway 36R, you are ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1017.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 入口，准备离场。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1017.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA527, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1017.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA527，跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1018.audioText: C: Air China 527, cleared for takeoff runway 36R, surface wind 350, 5 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1018.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跑道 36R 可以起飞，地面风 350，5 米/秒。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1018.referenceText: Roger, cleared for takeoff runway 36R, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1018.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 可以起飞，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1019.audioText: B: After you just takeoff, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1019.audioTextZh: B: 刚起飞后，通过 600 米，联系 Wuhan Departure。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1020.audioText: C: Air China 527, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1020.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1020.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1020.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1021.audioText: B: Now you are at cruising level, the thunderstorm is detected in front of you, you want to make a fifteen miles deviation to the east of the current track from Guangzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1021.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在巡航高度，前方探测到雷暴，你想向广州管制请求偏离当前航迹以东 15 海里。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1021.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA527, our weather radar shows a CB ahead, request 15 miles to the east from current track.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1021.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA527，我们的气象雷达显示前方有 CB，请求从当前航迹向东偏置 15 海里。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1022.audioText: C: Air China 527, offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1022.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1022.referenceText: Offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1022.referenceTextZh: 批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1023.audioText: C: Air China 527, descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1023.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1023.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1023.referenceTextZh: 准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1024.audioText: C: Air China 527, increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1024.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1024.referenceText: Increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1024.referenceTextZh: 通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1025.audioText: B: Now you are established with Guangzhou Approach, your assigned landing runway is 02 right, you want to land runway 02L due performance.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1025.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已与 广州进近 建立联系，指定着陆跑道为 02R，由于性能原因你想落跑道 02L。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1025.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CCA527, request runway 02L due performance.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1025.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CCA527，因性能原因请求跑道 02L。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1026.audioText: C: Air China 527, runway 02L is not available due runway inspection, runway in use 02R.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1026.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跑道 02L 因跑道检查不可用，使用跑道 02R。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1027.audioText: B: You have established on the localizer runway 02R, contact Tower.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1027.audioTextZh: B: 你已建立跑道 02R 航向道，联系 塔台。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1027.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CCA527, established on the localizer runway 02R.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1027.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CCA527，已建立跑道 02R 航向道。

atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1028.audioText: C: Air China 527, cleared to land 02 right, expedite vacating runway after landing.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1028.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道。
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1028.referenceText: Cleared to land 02R, expedite vacating runway after landing, CCA527.
atc-scenario-0059-card-main-1028.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道，CCA527。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1029.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 725, you are parking at 812, you have got information Yankee, your destination is Beijing, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1029.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 725，停在 812，已收到信息 Yankee，目的地 Beijing，向武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1029.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA725, gate 812, information Y, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1029.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA725，812 号登机口，信息 Y，请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1030.audioText: C: Air China 725, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 4721.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1030.audioTextZh: C: Air China 725，可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，离场跑道 36R，Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 4721。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1030.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, ZF 01 departure, initially climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 4721, CCA725.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1030.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，离场跑道 36R，ZF 01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 4721，CCA725。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1031.audioText: B: Contact Delivery to tell them you want to use runway 36L due parking position.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1031.audioTextZh: B: 联系 放行，告诉他们你因停机位置想使用跑道 36L。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1031.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA725, request runway 36L due parking position.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1031.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA725，因停机位置请求跑道 36L。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1032.audioText: C: Air China 725, runway 36L is not available due rubber removal, runway in use 36R.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1032.audioTextZh: C: Air China 725，跑道 36L 因除胶不可用，使用跑道 36R。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1033.audioText: B: While you are starting the engines, 1 of the engine starters failed, contact Ground to request hold at present position to carry out emergency procedure.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1033.audioTextZh: B: 开车时，一台发动机起动机失效，联系 地面请求在当前位置等待以执行应急程序。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1033.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA725, 1 of the engine starters failed, request hold at present position to carry out emergency procedure.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1033.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA725，一台发动机起动机失效，请求在当前位置等待以执行应急程序。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1034.audioText: B: Now you have solved the problem, you are holding at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1034.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已解决问题，正在跑道 36R 等待点等待，准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1034.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA725, holding at holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1034.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA725，在跑道 36R 等待点等待，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1035.audioText: B: During initial climb, an old lady on board suffered from a heart attack, this is an Urgency call, tell the controller you want to return to the airport and request priority landing in medical assistance.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1035.audioTextZh: B: 初始爬升期间，机上一名老妇人心脏病发作，这是紧急呼叫，告诉管制员你想返回机场，并请求优先着陆和医疗援助。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1035.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CCA725, an old lady suffered from a heart attack, request return to Wuhan for priority landing and medical assistance.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1035.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Wuhan Departure，CCA725，一名老妇人心脏病发作，请求返回 Wuhan 优先着陆并提供医疗援助。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1036.audioText: C: Air China 725, roger PAN, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, descend and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1011, Zulu Foxtrot 02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36 left.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1036.audioTextZh: C: Air China 725，收到 PAN，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，按 QNH 1011 下降并保持 3000 米，Zulu Foxtrot 02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1036.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1011, ZF 02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36L, CCA725.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1036.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，按 QNH 1011 下降并保持 3000 米，ZF 02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L，CCA725。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1037.audioText:
C: Air China 725, descend and maintain 2100 meters
B: Read back and ask for QNH.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1037.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 725，下降并保持 2100 米。
B: 复诵并请求 QNH。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1037.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2100 meters, request QNH, CCA725.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1037.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2100 米，请求 QNH，CCA725。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1039.audioText: C: Air China 725, cleared to land 36 left, surface wind 340, 5 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1039.audioTextZh: C: Air China 725，跑道 36L 可以着陆，地面风 340，5 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1040.audioText: B: After landing, your nose wheel steering has malfunctioned, you are unable to vacate 36 left, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1040.audioTextZh: B: 着陆后，你的前轮转弯故障，无法脱离 36L，向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1040.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA725, our nose wheel steering has malfunctioned, unable to vacate 36L.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1040.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA725，我们的前轮转弯故障，无法脱离 36L。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1041.audioText:
C: Air China 725, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need a tug to tow you back to the terminal.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1041.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 725，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖回航站楼。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1041.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA725, request a tug to tow us to the terminal.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1041.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA725，请求拖车把我们拖到航站楼。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1042.audioText: C: Air China 725, the tug will arrive in 5 minutes.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1042.audioTextZh: C: Air China 725，拖车将在 5 分钟内到达。

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1043.audioText: B: Now the lady's condition is deteriorating, you confirm with the controller if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1043.audioTextZh: B: 现在这位女士情况正在恶化，你向管制员确认登机口医疗服务是否准备好。
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1043.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA725, the lady's condition is deteriorating, is medical service ready at the gate ?
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1043.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA725，这位女士情况正在恶化，登机口医疗服务准备好了吗？

atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1044.audioText: C: Air China 725, affirm, the ambulance and medical services have been ready at the gate.
atc-scenario-0060-card-main-1044.audioTextZh: C: Air China 725，是的，救护车和医疗服务已在登机口准备好。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1045.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 985, from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are at bay 221, with information Hotel, contact Wuhan Delivery for Airway clearance.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1045.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 985，从 Wuhan 到 Frankfurt，位于 221 号停机位，收到信息 Hotel，联系武汉放行请求航路许可。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1045.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA985, bay 221, information H, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1045.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA985，221 号停机位，信息 H，请求前往 Frankfurt 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1046.audioText: C: Air China 985, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, runway 04, follow Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters on QNH, cruising level 9500 meters, departure frequency 119.35.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1046.audioTextZh: C: Air China 985，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Frankfurt，跑道 04，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升到 1500 米，巡航高度 9500 米，离场频率 119.35。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1046.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, runway 04,  follow ZF 01 departure, initially climb to 1500 meters on QNH, cruising level 9500 meters, departure frequency 119.35, CCA985.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1046.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Frankfurt，跑道 04，执行 ZF 01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升到 1500 米，巡航高度 9500 米，离场频率 119.35，CCA985。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1047.audioText: C: Air China 985, read back correct, your slot time is 1435, contact Wuhan Ground 121.85.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1047.audioTextZh: C: Air China 985，复诵正确，你的放行时刻是 1435，联系武汉地面121.85。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1048.audioText: B: During push back, you have a small avionics problem, you wish to remain on taxiway Zulu 4 for approximately 5 minutes, inform Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1048.audioTextZh: B: 推出期间，你有一个小的航电问题，希望在滑行道 Zulu 4 上停留约 5 分钟，通知 武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1048.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, request remain on taxiway Z4 due small avionics problem.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1048.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA985，因小的航电问题，请求停留在滑行道 Z4。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1049.audioText:
C: Roger, Air China 985, advise when you are ready.
B: You decide the maintenance are needed before departure, tell Wuhan Ground you want to return to gate 221 to have plane checked by engineers.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1049.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，Air China 985，准备好时通知。
B: 你决定起飞前需要维修，告诉 武汉地面 你想返回 221 号登机口，让工程师检查飞机。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1049.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, request taxi back to gate 221 to have plane checked by engineers.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1049.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA985，请求滑回 221 号登机口，让工程师检查飞机。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1050.audioText: C: Air China 985, gate 221 will be occupied by another aircraft in a minute, stand by for a while, I will assign you another gate.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1050.audioTextZh: C: Air China 985，221 号登机口一分钟后将被另一架飞机占用，稍等，我会给你分配另一个登机口。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1051.audioText: B: The engineers have fixed the avionics problem, request Wuhan Ground for engine start up.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1051.audioTextZh: B: 工程师已修复航电问题，向武汉地面请求发动机开车。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1051.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, the engineers have fixed the avionics problem, request start up.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1051.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA985，工程师已修复航电问题，请求开车。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1052.audioText: C: Air China 985, your slot time is expired, your new slot time is 1615, start up at own discretion.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1052.audioTextZh: C: Air China 985，你的放行时刻已过期，新放行时刻是 1615，自行决定开车。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1052.referenceText: Slot time 1615, start up at own discretion, CCA985.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1052.referenceTextZh: 放行时刻 1615，自行决定开车，CCA985。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1053.audioText: B: Now you have completed the engine start up procedures, call Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1053.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成发动机开车程序，呼叫 武汉地面请求滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1053.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1053.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA985，开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1054.audioText: C: Air China 985, taxi via taxiway Charlie, Mike and Alpha to holding point runway 04, hold short of Zulu 4.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1054.audioTextZh: C: Air China 985，经滑行道 Charlie、Mike 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Zulu 4 前等待。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1054.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway C, M and A to holding point runway 04, hold short of Z4, CCA985.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1054.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 C、M 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Z4 前等待，CCA985。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1055.audioText: B: You are now at holding point runway 04, you are ready for takeoff, call Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1055.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 等待点，准备起飞，呼叫 武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1055.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, holding point runway 04, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1055.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA985，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1056.audioText: C: Air China 985, surface wind 070 degrees, 3 meters per second, cleared for takeoff, runway 04.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1056.audioTextZh: C: Air China 985，地面风 070 度，3 米/秒，跑道 04 可以起飞。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1057.audioText: B: Shortly after airborne, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, make a Distress call to Wuhan Tower and ask for immediate return for landing.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1057.audioTextZh: B: 离地后不久，航电舱冒烟，向武汉塔台发出遇险呼叫并请求立即返回着陆。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1057.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CCA985, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, request immediate return for landing.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1057.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，CCA985，航电舱冒烟，请求立即返回着陆。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1058.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to level off at 600 meters and remain on the tower frequency.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1058.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 武汉塔台 你想在 600 米改平，并保持在塔台频率。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1058.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request level off at 600 meters and remain this frequency.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1058.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA985，请求在 600 米改平并保持本频率。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1059.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to fly a right-hand circuit for immediate landing runway 04.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1059.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 武汉塔台 你想加入右起落航线，立即在跑道 04 着陆。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1059.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request join right-hand circuit for immediate landing runway 04.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1059.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA985，请求加入右起落航线，立即在跑道 04 着陆。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1060.audioText: C: Air China 985, maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind runway 04, report turning base.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1060.audioTextZh: C: Air China 985，保持 600 米，右转加入跑道 04 下风，转基线时报告。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1060.referenceText: Maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind runway 04, report turning base, CCA985.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1060.referenceTextZh: 保持 600 米，右转加入跑道 04 下风，转基线时报告，CCA985。

atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1061.audioText: B: The smoke situation cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1061.audioTextZh: B: 烟雾情况无法控制，请求着陆时提供应急服务。
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1061.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, smoke cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.
atc-scenario-0061-card-main-1061.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA985，烟雾无法控制，请求着陆时提供应急服务。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1062.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 976, you are parking at gate 26, you have received information Papa, request ATC clearance to Beijing from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1062.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 976，停在 26 号登机口，已收到信息 Papa，向武汉放行请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1062.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA976, gate 26, information P, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1062.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA976，26 号登机口，信息 P，请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1063.audioText: C: Air China 976, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100 meters, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, runway in use 04.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1063.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100 米，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，使用跑道 04。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1063.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, ZF 01 departure, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100 meters, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, runway in use 04, CCA976.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1063.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，ZF 01 离场，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100 米，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，使用跑道 04，CCA976。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1064.audioText: C: Air China 976, push back approved, report ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1064.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，推出批准，准备滑行时报告。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1065.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1065.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑行，联系武汉地面。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1066.audioText: C: Air China 976, there is a disabled Boeing 737 on the taxiway Alpha, follow the follow-me car on Alpha 9, hold short of runway 04.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1066.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，滑行道 Alpha 上有一架故障 Boeing 737，跟随 Alpha 9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1066.referenceText: Roger, follow the follow-me car on A9, hold short of runway 04, CCA976.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1066.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待，CCA976。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1067.audioText: C: Air China 976, hold short of runway 04.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1067.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，在跑道 04 前等待。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1068.audioText: C: Air China 976, contact Wuhan Tower 118.2.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1068.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，联系武汉塔台118.2。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1069.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1069.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1069.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA976, ready for departure.

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1070.audioText: C: Air China 976, traffic on 11 kilometers final, wind calm, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1070.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，11 公里五边有交通，风静，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1070.referenceText: Roger, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, CCA976.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1070.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，CCA976。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1071.audioText: B: As you apply power, you hear a master warning alarm, tell Wuhan Tower you are stopping.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1071.audioTextZh: B: 当你加推力时，听到主警告警报，告诉 武汉塔台 你正在中止。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1071.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA976, stopping due to master warning.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1071.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA976，因主警告中止起飞。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1072.audioText: C: Air China 976, expedite taxi and vacated at Foxtrot, contact Ground when clear of runway.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1072.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，加快滑行并在 Foxtrot 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1072.referenceText: Expedite taxi and vacated at F, contact Ground when clear of runway, CCA976.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1072.referenceTextZh: 加快滑行并在 F 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面，CCA976。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1073.audioText: B: Tell Ground you are clear of runway 04 at Foxtrot, and that you had to abort takeoff because flap setting is incorrect.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1073.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 地面 你已在 Foxtrot 脱离跑道 04，并因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1073.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA976, runway vacated at F, we had to abort takeoff due to incorrect flap setting.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1073.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA976，已在 F 脱离跑道，我们因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1074.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1074.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1074.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA976, ready for departure.

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1075.audioText: C: Air China 976, line up runway 04.

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1076.audioText: C: Air China 976, cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, runway 04, cleared for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1076.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，跑道 04，可以起飞。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1076.referenceText: Cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to ZF, runway 04, cleared for takeoff, CCA976.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1076.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 ZF，跑道 04，可以起飞，CCA976。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1077.audioText: B: During initial climb, you have a smoke warning, report it to Wuhan Departure and request immediate return for priority landing runway 04, this is a Distress call.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1077.audioTextZh: B: 初始爬升期间，你有烟雾警告，向 Wuhan Departure 报告并请求立即返回跑道 04 优先着陆，这是遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1077.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Departure, CCA976, we have a smoke warning, request immediate return for priority landing runway 04.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1077.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，Wuhan Departure，CCA976，我们有烟雾警告，请求立即返回跑道 04 优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1078.audioText: C: Air China 976, climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS runway 04.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1078.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1078.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS runway 04, CCA976.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1078.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04，CCA976。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1079.audioText: B: Now the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, notify Wuhan Tower you hope to turn left, and make a landing on the nearest available runway 22, this is a Distress call.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1079.audioTextZh: B: 现在烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，通知 武汉塔台 你希望左转，并在最近可用跑道 22 着陆，这是遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1079.referenceText: Mayday MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CCA976, the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, request turn left to make a landing on the nearest available runway 22.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1079.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，CCA976，烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，请求左转在最近可用跑道 22 着陆。

atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1080.audioText: C: Air China 976, turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach runway 22.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1080.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22。
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1080.referenceText: Turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach runway 22, CCA976.
atc-scenario-0062-card-main-1080.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22，CCA976。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1081.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 937, you are parking at gate 213, you have got information November, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1081.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 937，停在 213 号登机口，已收到信息 November，呼叫 武汉放行请求前往 Amsterdam 的 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1081.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA937, gate 213, information N, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1081.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA937，213 号登机口，信息 N，请求前往 Amsterdam 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1082.audioText: C: Air China 937, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, follow Zulu Foxtrot 12 departure, cruising level 9500 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, after departure, contact 125.65, squawk 3251, runway in use 18L.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1082.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Amsterdam，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 12 离场，巡航高度 9500 米，初始爬升 1500 米，离场后联系 125.65，应答机 3251，使用跑道 18L。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1082.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, follow ZF12 departure, cruising level 9500 meters, initially climb 1500 meters, after departure, contact 125.65, squawk 3251, runway in use 18L, CCA937.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1082.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Amsterdam，执行 ZF12 离场，巡航高度 9500 米，初始爬升 1500 米，离场后联系 125.65，应答机 3251，使用跑道 18L，CCA937。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1083.audioText: C: Air China 937, expect slot time 20 due to temporary departure restriction, report when ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1083.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，由于临时离场限制，预计放行时刻 20，准备推出和开车时报告。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1084.audioText: B: Tell the controller that there are 2 passengers missing and the bags have already removed from the aircraft, the loading sheet is amended, contact the controller to report the situation and state you are ready for push.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1084.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员有 2 名旅客缺失，行李已从飞机上卸下，装载单已修改，联系管制员报告情况并说明准备推出。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1084.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA937, there are 2 passengers missing, the bags have removed, the loading sheet is amended, ready for push.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1084.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA937，有 2 名旅客缺失，行李已卸下，装载单已修改，准备推出。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1085.audioText: C: Air China 937, the slot time restriction is cancelled, contact Ground 121.75.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1085.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，放行时刻限制取消，联系 地面 121.75。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1086.audioText: B: Tell the controller you started the engines and request taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1086.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员你已起动发动机，请求滑行指令。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1087.audioText: C: Air China 937, taxi to holding point runway 18L via the taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 2, Alpha, hold short of Echo 1.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1087.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 2、Alpha 滑行至跑道 18L 等待点，在 Echo 1 前等待。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1087.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18L via the taxiway Z4, A2, A, hold short of E1, CCA937.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1087.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A2、A 滑行至跑道 18L 等待点，在 E1 前等待，CCA937。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1088.audioText: B: Your company has advised the ground service personnel have made a mistake during the baggage removal procedure of missing passenger, you have to taxi back to the gate.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1088.audioTextZh: B: 公司通知你，地面服务人员在缺失旅客行李卸载程序中出错，你必须滑回登机口。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1088.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA937, our company has advised the ground service personnel have made a mistake during the baggage removal procedure of missing passenger, request taxi back to the gate.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1088.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA937，公司通知我们地面服务人员在缺失旅客行李卸载程序中出错，请求滑回登机口。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1089.audioText: C: Air China 937, taxi to gate 213 via taxiway Mike, Mike 3, Zulu 4.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1089.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，经滑行道 Mike、Mike 3、Zulu 4 滑行至 213 号登机口。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1089.referenceText: Taxi to gate 213 via taxiway M, M3, Z4, CCA937.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1089.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 M、M3、Z4 滑行至 213 号登机口，CCA937。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1090.audioText: B: Now the baggage problem has been fixed, you ask for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1090.audioTextZh: B: 现在行李问题已解决，你请求推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1090.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA937, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1090.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA937，准备推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1091.audioText: C: Air China 937, a cold front is advancing to the airport, expect change runway 04, stand by for new departure clearance, push back and start up approved.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1091.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，冷锋正向机场推进，预计改用跑道 04，等待新的离场许可，推出和开车批准。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1091.referenceText: Roger, expect runway 04, push back and start up approved, CCA937.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1091.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计跑道 04，推出和开车批准，CCA937。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1092.audioText:
C: Air China 937, recleared to Amsterdam, follow Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, rest unchanged.
B: Read back the instructions and advise you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1092.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 937，重新许可前往 Amsterdam，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，其余不变。
B: 复诵指令并告知你准备滑行。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1092.referenceText: Follow ZF01 departure, runway 04, initially climb 1500 meters, rest unchanged, request taxi, CCA937.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1092.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF01 离场，跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，其余不变，请求滑行，CCA937。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1093.audioText: B: Now you are rotating normally, report you are airborne, passing 900 meters, climbing to 1500 meters and request cancel SID, contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1093.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正常抬轮，报告已离地，通过 900 米，爬升到 1500 米，并请求取消 SID，联系 Wuhan Departure。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1093.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA937, airborne, passing 900 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, request cancel SID.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1093.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA937，已离地，通过 900 米，爬升到 1500 米，请求取消 SID。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1094.audioText: C: Air China 937, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, proceed to Zulu Foxtrot, climb and maintain 4500 meters.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1094.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，取消 SID，飞往 Zulu Foxtrot，爬升并保持 4500 米。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1094.referenceText: Cancel SID, proceed to ZF, climb and maintain 4500 meters, CCA937.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1094.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，飞往 ZF，爬升并保持 4500 米，CCA937。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1095.audioText: B: The number 2 engine produced intermittent noises, as a precaution, you want to terminate the flight and return, notify Wuhan Departure and request level off at 2700 meters.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1095.audioTextZh: B: 2 号发动机出现间歇性噪声，作为预防措施，你想终止飞行并返回，通知 Wuhan Departure 并请求在 2700 米改平。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1095.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA937, the No.2 engine produced intermittent noises, request level off at 2700 meters and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1095.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA937，2 号发动机出现间歇性噪声，请求在 2700 米改平并返回 Wuhan Airport 着陆。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1096.audioText: C: Air China 937, climb and maintain 2700 meters, turn left heading 220, radar vector for ILS approach runway 04.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1096.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，爬升并保持 2700 米，左转航向 220，雷达引导跑道 04 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1096.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2700 meters, turn left heading 220, radar vector for ILS approach runway 04, CCA937.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1096.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2700 米，左转航向 220，雷达引导跑道 04 ILS 进近，CCA937。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1097.audioText: B: In order to reduce weight to maximum landing weight, you request fifteen minutes for fuel dumping.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1097.audioTextZh: B: 为了减重到最大着陆重量，你请求 15 分钟放油。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1097.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA937, request 15 minutes for fuel dumping to reduce weight to maximum landing weight.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1097.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA937，请求 15 分钟放油，以减重到最大着陆重量。

atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1098.audioText: C: Air China 937, stand by, continue present heading.
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1098.audioTextZh: C: Air China 937，等待，继续当前航向。
atc-scenario-0063-card-main-1098.referenceText: Stand by, continue present heading, CCA937.

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1099.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 321, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 10100 meters, squawking 3120, your captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated, make a Distress call with Guangzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1099.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 321，从 Beijing 到 Guangzhou，保持 10100 米，应答机 3120，你的机长心脏骤停并失能，向广州管制发出遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1099.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, maintaining 10100 meters, squawking 3120, our captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1099.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，广州管制，CCA321，保持 10100 米，应答机 3120，我们的机长心脏骤停并失能。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1100.audioText:
C: Air China 321, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, roger MAYDAY, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller to stand by and you are checking if there is a doctor on board.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1100.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 321，广州管制，雷达识别，收到 MAYDAY，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员稍等，你正在查看机上是否有医生。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1100.referenceText: Stand by, we are checking if there is a doctor on board, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1100.referenceTextZh: 稍等，我们正在查看机上是否有医生，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1101.audioText: B: The purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing, inform Guangzhou Control about the situation.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1101.audioTextZh: B: 乘务长在机上找到一名医生，并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难，向广州管制通报情况。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1101.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, the purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1101.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA321，乘务长在机上找到一名医生并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1102.audioText:
C: Air China 321, when able, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller that you'd like to divert to Wuhan and you need physician and first aid upon landing.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1102.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 321，可以时说明意图。
B: 告诉管制员你想改航 Wuhan，并且着陆时需要医生和急救。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1102.referenceText: Request divert to Wuhan and request a physician and first aid upon landing, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1102.referenceTextZh: 请求改航 Wuhan，并请求着陆时提供医生和急救，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1103.audioText: C: Air China 321, roger, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1103.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，收到，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降并保持 6000 米，联系武汉进近119.35。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1103.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, 119.35, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1103.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，119.35，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1104.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 6000 meters, inform your situation to Wuhan Approach and request priority landing and medical services.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1104.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 Zulu Foxtrot 上空，保持 6000 米，向武汉进近说明情况并请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1104.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CCA321, over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, our captain got incapacitated, he is having difficulty in breathing, request priority landing and medical services.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1104.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，CCA321，过 ZF，保持 6000 米，我们的机长失能，他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1105.audioText: C: Air China 321, follow Zulu Foxtrot 02 Alpha arrival, descend to 4200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1105.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 02 Alpha 进场，下降到 4200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1105.referenceText: Follow ZF 02A arrival, descend to 4200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1105.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF 02A 进场，下降到 4200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1106.audioText: C: Air China 321, descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1106.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1106.referenceText: Descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1106.referenceTextZh: 下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1107.audioText: C: Air China 321, descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1107.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，下降到 900 米，右转航向 330，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1107.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1107.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，右转航向 330，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1108.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1108.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1108.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA321, established on ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1108.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA321，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1109.audioText: C: Air China 321, continue approach runway 36R, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1109.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，继续进近跑道 36R，地面风 350 度，3 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1110.audioText: C: Air China 321, runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 340 degrees, 3 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1110.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，跑道 36R，可以着陆，地面风 340 度，3 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1111.audioText: B: During final approach, you find the ILS area is not clear and you are going around, inform Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1111.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，你发现 ILS 区域未净空，正在复飞，通知 武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1111.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA321, ILS area is not clear, going around.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1111.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA321，ILS 区域未净空，复飞。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1112.audioText: C: Air China 321, my apologies for that, follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1112.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，对此表示歉意，执行标准复飞程序，爬升到 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.35。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1112.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1500 meters, 119.35, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1112.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，爬升到 1500 米，119.35，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1113.audioText: B: Now you have vacated the runway 36R, tell the controller you need a follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1113.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已脱离跑道 36R，告诉管制员你需要引导车。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1113.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA321, runway 36R vacated, request a follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1113.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA321，已脱离跑道 36R，请求引导车。

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1114.audioText:
C: Air China 321, hold position, the follow-me car is on the way for you.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1114.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 321，原地等待，引导车正在前往你处。
B: 告诉管制员你已看到引导车。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1114.referenceText: Hold position, follow-me car in sight, CCA321.

atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1115.audioText: C: Air China 321, follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway Tango 4 and Delta.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1115.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，跟随引导车经滑行道 Tango 4 和 Delta 到 557 号登机口。
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1115.referenceText: Follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway T4 and D, CCA321.
atc-scenario-0064-card-main-1115.referenceTextZh: 跟随引导车经滑行道 T4 和 D 到 557 号登机口，CCA321。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1116.audioText: B: Your callsign is Air China 983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, level 9800 meters, SABEN 45, contact Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1116.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 983，从 Los Angeles 到 Beijing，DABMA 30，保持 9800 米，SABEN 45，联系北京管制。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1116.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, maintaining 9800 metres, SABEM 45.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1116.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA983，从 Los Angeles 到 Beijing，DABMA 30，保持 9800 米，SABEM 45。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1117.audioText:
C: Air China 983, Beijing Control, confirm squawk 1230.
B: Your squawk is 1232.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1117.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，北京管制，确认应答机 1230。
B: 你的应答机是 1232。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1118.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 983, squawk 1232, radar contact.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1118.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 983，应答机 1232，雷达识别。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1119.audioText: B: You are experiencing severe turbulence, request descend to low level.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1119.audioTextZh: B: 你正在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1119.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, we are experiencing severe turbulence, request descend to low level.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1119.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA983，我们正在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1120.audioText: C: Air China 983, roger, descend to 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1120.audioTextZh: C: Air China 983，收到，下降到 8400 米。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1121.audioText:
C: Air China 983, what is the detailed ride condition?
B: Tell the ATC, the turbulence is caused by cumulonimbus.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1121.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，详细颠簸情况如何？
B: 告诉 ATC，颠簸由积雨云造成。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1121.referenceText: There are severe large CB in the air, CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1121.referenceTextZh: 空中有严重的大型 CB，CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1122.audioText:
C: Air China 983, roger, thanks.
B: Report to the controller that you have been struck by lightning.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1122.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，收到，谢谢。
B: 向管制员报告你们被雷击。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1122.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, we have been struck by lightning.

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1123.audioText:
C: Air China 983, roger, confirm your operations are normal?
B: Tell the controller that flight is smooth, but the main power doesn't work, now you are using the auxiliary power supply.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1123.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，收到，确认你们运行正常吗？
B: 告诉管制员飞行平稳，但主电源不工作，现在使用辅助电源。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1123.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, flight is smooth, but the main power doesn't work, we are using the auxiliary power supply now.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1123.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA983，飞行平稳，但主电源不工作，我们现在使用辅助电源。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1124.audioText:
C: Air China 983, roger, any other problem?
B: There is something wrong with the navigation system, ask ATC to monitor you closely.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1124.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，收到，还有其他问题吗？
B: 导航系统有问题，请 ATC 密切监控你。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1124.referenceText: Our navigation system is out of action, please keep a close eye on us, CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1124.referenceTextZh: 我们的导航系统失效，请密切监控我们，CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1125.audioText:
C: Air China 983, roger, where did the lightning strike you?
B: Only the left hand windshield was struck, others are all normal.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1125.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，收到，雷击击中哪里？
B: 只有左侧风挡被击中，其他都正常。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1125.referenceText: Lightning hit us above the left hand windshield, 0 damage, CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1125.referenceTextZh: 雷击击中我们左侧风挡上方，无损伤，CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1126.audioText:
C: Air China 983, roger, say intention.
B: Request priority landing at Beijing airport.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1126.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，收到，说明意图。
B: 请求在 Beijing airport 优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1126.referenceText: Request priority landing at Beijing airport, CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1126.referenceTextZh: 请求在 Beijing airport 优先着陆，CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1127.audioText: C: Air China 983, roger, turn left direct to Hotel Uniform Romeo, descend to and maintain 3600 meters, expect runway 01.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1127.audioTextZh: C: Air China 983，收到，左转直飞 Hotel Uniform Romeo，下降并保持 3600 米，预计跑道 01。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1127.referenceText: Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600 meters, expect runway 01, CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1127.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 HUR，下降并保持 3600 米，预计跑道 01，CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1128.audioText: B: You want to know weather condition at Beijing airport.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1128.audioTextZh: B: 你想了解 Beijing airport 天气情况。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1128.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, advice weather at Beijing airport.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1128.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA983，请告知 Beijing airport 天气。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1129.audioText: C: Air China 983, weather is clearing except for a little ice on the runway, expect a visual approach runway 01.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1129.audioTextZh: C: Air China 983，天气正在转好，跑道上除少量结冰外无其他情况，预计目视进近跑道 01。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1129.referenceText: Roger, expect visual approach runway 01, CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1129.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计目视进近跑道 01，CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1130.audioText: B: As a passenger was bruised on the head during the turbulence, request medical service on arrival.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1130.audioTextZh: B: 由于一名旅客在颠簸中头部擦伤，请求到达时提供医疗服务。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1130.referenceText: Request medical service on arrival as a passenger was hurt during the turbulence, CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1130.referenceTextZh: 由于一名旅客在颠簸中受伤，请求到达时提供医疗服务，CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1131.audioText:
C: Air China 983, medical services will be ready on arrival.
B: You have established localizer, contact Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1131.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，到达时医疗服务会准备好。
B: 你已建立航向道，联系北京塔台。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1131.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA983, established localizer runway 01.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1131.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA983，已建立跑道 01 航向道。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1132.audioText:
C: Air China 983, cleared to land runway 01, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, use caution.
B: Read back and ask the Tower whether the preceding aircraft can land normally.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1132.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 983，跑道 01 可以着陆，跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差，注意。
B: 复诵并询问 塔台 前机是否能正常着陆。
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1132.referenceText: Runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, did the preceding aircraft land normally? CCA983.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1132.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差，前机是否正常着陆？CCA983。

atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1133.audioText: C: All preceding aircraft had normal landings, standing ice is not that serious.
atc-scenario-0065-card-main-1133.audioTextZh: C: 所有前机均正常着陆，积冰没有那么严重。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1134.audioText: B: You are at Beijing Airport, your call sign is Air China 101, there's ice accumulated on your plane, you want to have the ice removed before start-up. Contact Beijing Ground to request de-icing service.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1134.audioTextZh: B: 你在 Beijing Airport，呼号 Air China 101，飞机上有积冰，想在开车前除冰。联系北京地面请求除冰服务。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1134.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA101, there's ice accumulated on our plane, request de-icing service.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1134.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA101，我们飞机上有积冰，请求除冰服务。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1135.audioText:
C: Air China 101, Beijing Ground, where do you want to de-ice?
B: Tell Ground you want to de-ice on taxiway Delta 7.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1135.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 101，北京地面，你想在哪里除冰？
B: 告诉 地面 你想在滑行道 Delta 7 除冰。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1135.referenceText: Request to de-ice on taxiway D7, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1135.referenceTextZh: 请求在滑行道 D7 除冰，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1136.audioText: B: Inform Ground de-icing completed on Delta 7, ready to taxi.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1136.audioTextZh: B: 通知 地面，在 Delta 7 除冰完成，准备滑行。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1136.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA101, de-icing completed on D7, ready to taxi.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1136.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA101，D7 除冰完成，准备滑行。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1137.audioText: C: Air China 101, taxi to holding point runway 36R via Whiskey 2, Zulu 4 and Bravo, caution, taxiway is covered with ice patches.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1137.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，经 Whiskey 2、Zulu 4 和 Bravo 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，注意，滑行道有片状结冰。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1137.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, roger, thanks, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1137.referenceTextZh: 经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，收到，谢谢，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1138.audioText: B: Your de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, tell Ground that you need to take off before 0900 and request an intersection departure from Zulu 4.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1138.audioTextZh: B: 你的除冰液只有效 30 分钟，告诉 地面 你需要在 0900 前起飞，并请求从 Zulu 4 交叉口离场。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1138.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA101, our de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, we need to take off before 0900, request intersection departure from Z4.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1138.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA101，我们的除冰液只有效 30 分钟，需要在 0900 前起飞，请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1139.audioText: C: Air China 101, negative due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via Whiskey 2, Zulu 4 and Bravo.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1139.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，因排序原因不批准，继续经 Whiskey 2、Zulu 4 和 Bravo 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1139.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, CCA101.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1139.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA101。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1140.audioText:
C: Air China 101, stop immediately, a catering truck has just knocked an engine of your plane.
B: Ask Ground which engine it is.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1140.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 101，立即停止，一辆配餐车刚撞到了你飞机的一台发动机。
B: 询问 地面 是哪台发动机。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1140.referenceText: Roger，Which engine has been knocked ? CCA101.

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1141.audioText:
C: No.4, the right outboard engine.
B: Tell controller that you have to shut down all 4 engines and discharge fire extinguishers of engine number 4.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1141.audioTextZh:
C: 4 号，右外侧发动机。
B: 告诉管制员你必须关停全部 4 台发动机，并释放 4 号发动机灭火瓶。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1141.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA101, we have to shut down all 4 engines and discharge fire extinguishers of engine No.4.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1141.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA101，我们必须关停全部 4 台发动机，并释放 4 号发动机灭火瓶。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1142.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 101, I’ll send out the fire brigade.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1142.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 101，我会派消防队。

atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1143.audioText: B: The fire cannot be extinguished, inform this to ATC, this is a Distress call, also you want to carry out evacuation and request emergency equipment.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1143.audioTextZh: B: 火无法扑灭，向 ATC 通知，这是遇险呼叫，同时你想进行撤离并请求应急设备。
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1143.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Ground, CCA101, the fire cannot be extinguished, we are evacuating, request emergency equipment.
atc-scenario-0066-card-main-1143.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京地面，CCA101，火无法扑灭，我们正在撤离，请求应急设备。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1144.audioText: B: You are currently at gate 325, with information Uniform copied, the time is 7 AM, request ATC clearance to Sanya.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1144.audioTextZh: B: 你当前在 325 号登机口，已收到信息 Uniform，时间是早上 7 点，请求前往 Sanya 的 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1144.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA1089, gate 325, information U, request ATC clearance to Sanya.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1144.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA1089，325 号登机口，信息 U，请求前往 Sanya 的 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1145.audioText: C: Air China 1089, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Sanya via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow RENOB 31 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, QNH 1022, after departure, contact 120.6, squawk 1212.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1145.audioTextZh: C: Air China 1089，北京放行，可以按计划航路前往 Sanya，使用跑道 36R，执行 RENOB 31 离场，初始爬升到 1200 米，QNH 1022，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 1212。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1145.referenceText: Cleared to Sanya via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow RENOB 31 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, QNH 1022, after departure, contact 120.6, squawk 1212, CCA1089.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1145.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Sanya，使用跑道 36R，执行 RENOB 31 离场，初始爬升到 1200 米，QNH 1022，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 1212，CCA1089。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1146.audioText: C: Air China 1089, read back correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground on 121.75.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1146.audioTextZh: C: Air China 1089，复诵正确，准备推出和开车时联系 地面 121.75。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1147.audioText: B: Tell Ground you are ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1147.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 地面 你准备推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1147.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1089, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1147.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1089，准备推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1148.audioText: C: Air China 1089, Beijing Ground, good morning, departure time is 30, push back and start up at your own discretion.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1148.audioTextZh: C: Air China 1089，北京地面，早上好，离场时间 30，自行决定推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1148.referenceText: Departure time is 30, push back and start up at own discretion, CCA1089.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1148.referenceTextZh: 离场时间 30，自行决定推出和开车，CCA1089。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1149.audioText: B: You have been pushed back and started your engines, tell the controller you are ready to taxi.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1149.audioTextZh: B: 你已推出并起动发动机，告诉管制员你准备滑行。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1149.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1089, ready to taxi.

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1150.audioText: C: Air China 1089, taxi to the holding point of runway 36R via taxiway Golf 1 and Echo 1.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1150.audioTextZh: C: Air China 1089，经滑行道 Golf 1 和 Echo 1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1150.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway G1 and E1, CCA1089.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1150.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 G1 和 E1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA1089。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1151.audioText: B: Tell the controller that China Southern aircraft is now clear and you want to continue to taxi.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1151.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员 China Southern 航空器现在已离开，你想继续滑行。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1151.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1089, clear of traffic, request continue taxi.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1151.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1089，脱离交通，请求继续滑行。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1152.audioText: C: Air China 1089, taxi to the holding point of runway 36R via taxiway Golf 1 and Echo 1.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1152.audioTextZh: C: Air China 1089，经滑行道 Golf 1 和 Echo 1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
