atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1152.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 36R via taxiway G1 and E1, CCA1089.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1152.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 G1 和 E1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA1089。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1153.audioText: B: You are now at the holding point of runway 36R, you've already contacted Tower, now tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1153.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，已联系 塔台，现在告诉 塔台 你准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1153.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1089, hold at holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1153.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1089，在跑道 36R 等待点等待，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1154.audioText: B: You are now twenty minutes into the flight and you are cruising at 6000 meters, ask climb to a higher level.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1154.audioTextZh: B: 现在飞行 20 分钟后，你以 6000 米巡航，请求爬升到更高高度。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1154.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA1089, cruising at 6000 meters, request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1154.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA1089，6000 米巡航，请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1155.audioText: B: As you were climbing, suddenly the cabin altitude warning horn sounds and you are slowly losing cabin pressure, tell the controller the due to depressurization, you're initiating an emergency descent. You do not consider this to be a Distress or Urgency situation.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1155.audioTextZh: B: 爬升时，客舱高度警告喇叭突然响起，客舱正在缓慢失压，告诉管制员由于失压，你正在开始紧急下降。你不认为这是遇险或紧急情况。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1155.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA1089, the cabin altitude warning horns, we are slowly losing cabin pressure, emergency descent due to depressurization.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1155.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA1089，客舱高度警告喇叭响起，我们正在缓慢失压，因失压紧急下降。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1156.audioText:
C: Roger, Air China 1089, fly heading 230 degrees.
B: Reply to the controller and request QNH.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1156.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，Air China 1089，飞航向 230 度。
B: 回复管制员并请求 QNH。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1157.audioText:
C: Air China 1089, QNH is 1020, what level do you require?
B: Reply to the transmission, tell the controller you will descend to 3000 meters on QNH.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1157.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 1089，QNH 是 1020，你需要什么高度？
B: 回复电台，告诉管制员你将按 QNH 下降到 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1157.referenceText: QNH 1020, request descend to 3000 meters on QNH, CCA1089.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1157.referenceTextZh: QNH 1020，请求按 QNH 下降到 3000 米，CCA1089。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1158.audioText: C: Air China 1089, roger, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1020, report passing 5400 meters.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1158.audioTextZh: C: Air China 1089，收到，按 QNH 1020 下降到 3000 米，通过 5400 米报告。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1158.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1020, report passing 5400 meters, CCA1089.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1158.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1020 下降到 3000 米，通过 5400 米报告，CCA1089。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1159.audioText:
C: Air China 1089, are you declaring an Emergency? are there any injuries on board?
B: Tell the controller that you now consider it an Emergency, because you have several unconscious passengers, also report passing 5400 meters.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1159.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 1089，你是否宣布紧急情况？机上有伤员吗？
B: 告诉管制员你现在认为这是紧急情况，因为有数名旅客失去意识，同时报告通过 5400 米。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1159.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Control, CCA1089, we have several unconscious passengers, passing 5400 meters.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1159.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京管制，CCA1089，我们有数名旅客失去意识，正在通过 5400 米。

atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1160.audioText: B: You are now level of 3000 meters and are considering diverting to Hangzhou, ask for the weather at Hangzhou Airport.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1160.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在 3000 米平飞，正在考虑改航 Hangzhou，询问 Hangzhou Airport 天气。
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1160.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA1089, level at 3000 meters, request divert to Hangzhou and weather at Hangzhou Airport.
atc-scenario-0067-card-main-1160.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA1089，3000 米平飞，请求改航 Hangzhou，并请求 Hangzhou Airport 天气。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1161.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 301, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at gate 215, you are ready for push back and start up, contact Beijing Ground.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1161.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 301，从 Beijing 到 Guangzhou，停在 215 号登机口，准备推出和开车，联系北京地面。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1161.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, gate 215, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1161.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1301，215 号登机口，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1162.audioText: C: Air China 301, Beijing Ground, push back and start up approved, facing west.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1162.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，北京地面，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1162.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CCA1301.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1162.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，CCA1301。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1163.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1163.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1163.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1163.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1301，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1164.audioText: C: Air China 301, Beijing Ground, taxi via taxiway Yankee 4 and Golf 2, hold short of Hotel.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1164.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，北京地面，经滑行道 Yankee 4 和 Golf 2 滑行，在 Hotel 前等待。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1164.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Y4 and G2, hold short of H, CCA1301.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1164.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Y4 和 G2 滑行，在 H 前等待，CCA1301。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1165.audioText: B: During taxiing, you notice the Airbus 330 in front of you is leaking fluid from the right engine, report it to Beijing Ground.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1165.audioTextZh: B: 滑行期间，你注意到前方 Airbus 330 右发漏液，向北京地面报告。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1165.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, the A330 ahead is leaking fluid from the right engine.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1165.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1301，前方 A330 右发漏液。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1166.audioText:
C: Roger, thank you, Air China 301, continue taxi.
B: Tell the controller that you are unable to taxi because you find the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1166.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，谢谢，Air China 301，继续滑行。
B: 告诉管制员你无法滑行，因为发现滑行道表面被泄漏液体污染。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1166.referenceText: We are unable to taxi, the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid, CCA1301.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1166.referenceTextZh: 我们无法滑行，滑行道表面被泄漏液体污染，CCA1301。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1167.audioText: C: Air China 301, roger, turn left, taxi via Yankee 1, then turn left, taxi via Yankee 2.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1167.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，收到，左转，经 Yankee 1 滑行，然后左转，经 Yankee 2 滑行。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1167.referenceText: Turn left, taxi via Y1, then turn left, taxi via Y2, CCA1301.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1167.referenceTextZh: 左转，经 Y1 滑行，然后左转，经 Y2 滑行，CCA1301。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1168.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1168.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场，联系北京塔台。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1168.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1168.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1169.audioText: C: Air China 301, line up and be ready for immediate departure.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1169.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，进跑道，准备立即离场。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1169.referenceText: Line up and be ready for immediate departure, CCA1301.

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1170.audioText: C: Air China 301, runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, surface wind 340 degrees, 2 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1170.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，跑道 36R，可以立即起飞，地面风 340 度，2 米/秒。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1170.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, CCA1301.

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1171.audioText:
C: Air China 301, stop immediately! I say again! stop immediately!
B: Tell the controller you use the maximum brakes and you are stopping on the runway.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1171.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，立即停止！我再说一遍！立即停止！
B: 告诉管制员你使用最大刹车，正在跑道上停止。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1171.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, we used the maximum breaks and we are stopping on the runway.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1171.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，我们使用最大刹车，正在跑道上停止。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1172.audioText: C: Air China 301, vacate runway via Echo 2.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1172.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，经 Echo 2 脱离跑道。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1173.audioText: B: Now you have vacated runway 36R via Echo 2 and ask Beijing Tower the reasons for rejected takeoff.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1173.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已通过 Echo 2 脱离跑道 36R，并询问 北京塔台 中断起飞的原因。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1173.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, runway 36R vacated via E2, confirm the reasons for rejected takeoff.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1173.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，已通过 E2 脱离跑道 36R，确认中断起飞原因。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1174.audioText: C: Air China 301, the landing aircraft on the short final just made the go around.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1174.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，短五边上的着陆航空器刚复飞。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1175.audioText: B: Now you find your brakes are overheating, tell the controller you need 2 minutes to cool the brakes.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1175.audioTextZh: B: 现在你发现刹车过热，告诉管制员你需要 2 分钟冷却刹车。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1175.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, our brakes are overheating, we need 2 minutes to cool the brakes.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1175.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，我们刹车过热，需要 2 分钟冷却刹车。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1176.audioText:
C: Air China 301, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ground services to cool the wheels.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1176.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要地面服务冷却机轮。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1176.referenceText: Request ground services to cool the wheels, CCA1301.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1176.referenceTextZh: 请求地面服务冷却机轮，CCA1301。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1177.audioText:
C: Air China 301, what else do you need?
B: Tell the controller 1 of your nose wheel tires was deflated, you have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1177.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，还需要什么？
B: 告诉管制员你一个前轮轮胎泄气，必须在当前位置等待维修检查。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1177.referenceText: 1 of our nose wheel tires was deflated, we have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection, CCA1301.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1177.referenceTextZh: 我们一个前轮轮胎泄气，必须在当前位置等待维修检查，CCA1301。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1178.audioText: B: After the check, the maintenance staff told you that your parking brakes have seized, report it to the controller.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1178.audioTextZh: B: 检查后，维修人员告诉你停车刹车卡滞，向管制员报告。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1178.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, our parking breaks have seized.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1178.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，我们的停车刹车卡滞。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1179.audioText:
C: Air China 301, what assistance do you require?
B: Tell the controller you need a tug to tow you back to the maintenance apron.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1179.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖回维修机坪。
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1179.referenceText: Request a tug to tow us back to the maintenance apron, CCA1301.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1179.referenceTextZh: 请求拖车把我们拖回维修机坪，CCA1301。

atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1180.audioText: C: Air China 301, hold position, the tug will come soon.
atc-scenario-0068-card-main-1180.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，原地等待，拖车很快到。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1181.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 432, you are performing a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655, make initial contact with Beijing Approach.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1181.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 432，执行 Guangzhou 到 Beijing 航班，保持 5400 米，过 IKUBA，应答机 5655，与 北京进近 建立初始联系。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1181.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1181.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA1432，保持 5400 米，过 IKUBA，应答机 5655。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1182.audioText: C: Air China 432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.2.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1182.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，北京进近，雷达识别，爬升并保持 6600 米，联系北京管制118.2。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1182.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600 meters, 118.2, CCA1432.

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1183.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control and request further climb.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1183.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 6600 米，联系北京管制并请求继续爬升。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1183.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA1432, maintaining 6600 meters, requests further climb.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1183.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA1432，保持 6600 米，请求继续爬升。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1184.audioText: C: Air China 432, negative due traffic, maintain 6600 meters.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1184.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，因交通原因不批准，保持 6600 米。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1185.audioText: C: Air China 432, climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, fly direct to OBLIK.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1185.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，爬升并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1185.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, fly direct to OBLIK, CCA1432.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1185.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK，CCA1432。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1186.audioText: B: During cruise, your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1186.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，你的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1186.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA1432, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1186.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA1432，我们的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1187.audioText: C: Air China 432, negative due military activity, continue present heading for 20 miles.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1187.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，因军事活动不批准，继续当前航向 20 海里。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1187.referenceText: Roger, continue present heading for 20 miles, CCA1432.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1187.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续当前航向 20 海里，CCA1432。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1188.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report it to Beijing Control and request resume flight route.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1188.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已脱离天气，向北京管制报告并请求恢复航路。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1188.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA1432, clear of whether, request resume flight route.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1188.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA1432，已脱离天气，请求恢复航路。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1189.audioText: C: Air China 432, turn left heading 240 to rejoin Amber 461, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1189.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，左转航向 240 重新加入 Amber 461，爬升并保持 10100 米。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1189.referenceText: Turn left heading 240 to rejoin A461, climb and maintain 10100 meters, CCA1432.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1189.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 240 重新加入 A461，爬升并保持 10100 米，CCA1432。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1190.audioText: C: Air China 432, maintain 10100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1190.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，保持 10100 米，向左偏置 10 海里，以避让报告的强下沉气流。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1190.referenceText: Maintain 10100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft, CCA1432.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1190.referenceTextZh: 保持 10100 米，向左偏置 10 海里，以避让报告的强下沉气流，CCA1432。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1191.audioText: B: Now you are flying into a small cumulonimbus, contact Beijing Control and tell the controller you'd like to hold at Papa Echo Kilo VOR for weather improvement.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1191.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正飞入一小块积雨云，联系北京管制，告诉管制员你想在 Papa Echo Kilo VOR 等待，等待天气好转。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1191.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA1432, we are flying into a small cumulonimbus, request hold at PEK VOR for weather improvement.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1191.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA1432，我们正飞入一小块积雨云，请求在 PEK VOR 等待，等待天气好转。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1192.audioText: C: Air China 432, hold at Papa Echo Kilo VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1192.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，按公布程序在 Papa Echo Kilo VOR 等待，天气解除后联系北京进近119.25。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1192.referenceText: Hold at PEK VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25, CCA1432.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1192.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 PEK VOR 等待，天气解除后联系北京进近119.25，CCA1432。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1193.audioText: B: Now you are approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, you have got information Lima, contact Beijing Approach.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1193.audioTextZh: B: 现在你接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，已收到信息 Lima，联系北京进近。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1193.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, information L.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1193.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA1432，接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，信息 L。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1194.audioText: C: Air China 432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB 2 Bravo arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1194.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，北京进近，雷达识别，下降并保持 2400 米，RENOB 2 Bravo 进场，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1194.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB 2B arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, CCA1432.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1194.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2400 米，RENOB 2B 进场，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近，CCA1432。

atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1195.audioText: C: Air China 432, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 01, report established.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1195.audioTextZh: C: Air China 432，右转航向 330，下降到 900 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1195.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 01, report established, CCA1432.
atc-scenario-0069-card-main-1195.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降到 900 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA1432。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1196.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 368, a flight from Shenzhen to Beijing, your weather radar indicates a squall line near Victor Yankee Kilo, contact Beijing Approach and request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until Papa Echo Kilo VOR.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1196.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 368，从 Shenzhen 到 Beijing，气象雷达显示 Victor Yankee Kilo 附近有飑线，联系北京进近，请求平行偏置航迹右侧 10 海里，直到 Papa Echo Kilo VOR。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1196.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1368, our weather radar indicates a squall line near VYK, request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until PEK VOR.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1196.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA1368，我们的气象雷达显示 VYK 附近有飑线，请求平行偏置航迹右侧 10 海里，直到 PEK VOR。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1197.audioText: C: Air China 368, Beijing Approach, radar contact, negative due prohibited area, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1197.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，北京进近，雷达识别，因禁区不批准，左转航向 230，向外飞 25 海里。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1197.referenceText: Roger, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1197.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转航向 230，向外飞 25 海里，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1198.audioText: C: Air China 368, when clear of weather, fly direct to Alpha Alpha 443.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1198.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，天气解除后，直飞 Alpha Alpha 443。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1198.referenceText: When clear of weather, fly direct to AA443, CCA1368.

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1199.audioText: C: Air China 368, turn right, direct to Alpha Alpha 442, hold at Alpha Alpha 442 as published.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1199.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，右转，直飞 Alpha Alpha 442，按公布程序在 Alpha Alpha 442 等待。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1199.referenceText: Turn right, direct to AA442, hold at AA442 as published, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1199.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 AA442，按公布程序在 AA442 等待，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1200.audioText: C: Air China 368, orbit right from present position until advised, runway 18L is not available now.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1200.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，从当前位置右盘旋，直到通知，跑道 18L 现在不可用。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1200.referenceText: Roger, orbit right from present position until advised, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1200.referenceTextZh: 收到，从当前位置右盘旋，直到通知，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1201.audioText: B: After several orbit, you find the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, report it to Beijing Approach and request leave the hold and request priority landing runway 01.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1201.audioTextZh: B: 经过几圈盘旋后，你发现机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，向北京进近报告，请求离开等待并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1201.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1368, the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, request leave the hold and request priority landing runway 01.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1201.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA1368，机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，请求离开等待，并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1202.audioText: C: Air China 368, after this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1202.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，完成这圈盘旋后，离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1202.referenceText: After this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1202.referenceTextZh: 完成这圈盘旋后，离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1203.audioText: B: Now you are over Papa Echo Kilo, maintaining 4200 meters, you have received information Sierra, tell Beijing Approach you are ready for approach.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1203.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 Papa Echo Kilo 上空，保持 4200 米，已收到信息 Sierra，告诉 北京进近 你准备进近。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1203.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1368, over PEK, maintaining 4200 meters, information S, ready for approach.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1203.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA1368，过 PEK，保持 4200 米，信息 S，准备进近。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1204.audioText: C: Air China 368, Beijing Approach, follow Papa Echo Kilo 05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach runway 01.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1204.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，北京进近，执行 Papa Echo Kilo 05 进场，按 QNH 1008 下降到 2100 米，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1204.referenceText: Follow PEK 05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach runway 01, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1204.referenceTextZh: 执行 PEK 05 进场，按 QNH 1008 下降到 2100 米，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1205.audioText: C: Air China 368, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 01, report established.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1205.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，下降并保持 1500 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1205.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 01, report established, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1205.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 1500 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1206.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the ILS signals of runway 01, contact Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1206.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已截获跑道 01 的 ILS 信号，联系北京塔台。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1206.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1368, established ILS approach runway 01.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1206.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1368，已建立跑道 01 ILS 进近。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1207.audioText: C: Air China 368, runway 01, cleared to land.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1207.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，跑道 01，可以着陆。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1208.audioText: B: During final approach, an aircraft is crossing runway 01, you executed a missed approach, report it to Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1208.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，你执行复飞，向北京塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1208.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1368, an aircraft is crossing runway 01, going around.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1208.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1368，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，复飞。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1209.audioText: C: Air China 368, climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to Papa Echo Kilo, hold at Papa Echo Kilo at 600 meters.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1209.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，直线爬升到 230 米，右转直飞 Papa Echo Kilo，在 Papa Echo Kilo 600 米等待。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1209.referenceText: Climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1209.referenceTextZh: 直线爬升到 230 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK 600 米等待，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1210.audioText: B: Now you have landed on runway 01, you find the runway surface is slippery, the braking action is medium, report it to Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1210.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已在跑道 01 着陆，发现跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等，向北京塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1210.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1368, the runway surface is slippery, the breaking action is medium.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1210.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1368，跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等。

atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1211.audioText: C: Air China 368, roger, thanks, vacate runway 01 via rapid exit Echo 2.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1211.audioTextZh: C: Air China 368，收到，谢谢，经快速出口 Echo 2 脱离跑道 01。
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1211.referenceText: Vacate runway 01 via rapid exit E2, CCA1368.
atc-scenario-0070-card-main-1211.referenceTextZh: 经快速出口 E2 脱离跑道 01，CCA1368。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1212.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 542, from Chengdu to Shanghai, you are at gate Kilo 10 with information Bravo, request clearance from Chengdu Delivery.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1212.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 China Southern 542，从 Chengdu 到 Shanghai，位于 Kilo 10 登机口，收到信息 Bravo，向成都放行请求许可。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1212.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, CSN542, Gate K10, information B, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1212.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，CSN542，K10 登机口，信息 B，请求 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1213.audioText: C: China Southern 542, Chengdu Delivery, good afternoon, information Bravo is valid, clear to destination via flight planned route, runway 02, after departure, turn right direct Bravo Hotel Sierra, initial climb to 1200 meters on QNH 1021, after departure, contact 125.6.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1213.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 542，成都放行，下午好，信息 Bravo 有效，可以按计划航路前往目的地，跑道 02，离场后右转直飞 Bravo Hotel Sierra，按 QNH 1021 初始爬升到 1200 米，离场后联系 125.6。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1213.referenceText: Information B is valid, cleared to destination via flight planned route, runway 02, after departure turn right direct BHS, initial climb to 1200 meters on QNH 1021, after departure contact 125.6, CSN542.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1213.referenceTextZh: 信息 B 有效，可以按计划航路前往目的地，跑道 02，离场后右转直飞 BHS，按 QNH 1021 初始爬升到 1200 米，离场后联系 125.6，CSN542。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1214.audioText: C: China Southern 542, read back correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground 121.85.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1214.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 542，复诵正确，准备推出和开车时联系 地面 121.85。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1215.audioText: B: You are now ready for startup, request push back and permission to start your engines from Chengdu Ground.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1215.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备开车，向成都地面请求推出和开车许可。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1215.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN542, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1215.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，CSN542，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1216.audioText: C: China Southern 542, push back and start up approved.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1216.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 542，推出和开车批准。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1216.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, CSN542.

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1217.audioText:
C: China Southern 542, we just had a reports the bomb left in the first class passenger section, please advise your intentions.
B: Acknowledge the transmission and tell the controller that you will have the crew check the first class cabin.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1217.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 542，我们刚收到报告，头等舱旅客区域有炸弹，请告知你的意图。
B: 确认该通话，并告诉管制员你会让机组检查头等舱。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1217.referenceText: Roger, we will have the crew check the first class cabin, CSN542.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1217.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们会让机组检查头等舱，CSN542。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1218.audioText: B: During the search, the cabin crew find a bag that is not claimed by any passengers, inform Ground about this and tell them that because there are no aircraft around you, you will hold position.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1218.audioTextZh: B: 搜查期间，客舱机组发现一个无人认领的包，通知 地面，并告诉他们由于你周围没有飞机，你将原地等待。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1218.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN542, the cabin crew found a bag that is not claimed by any passenger, request hold position due there are no aircraft around us.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1218.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，CSN542，客舱机组发现一个无人认领的包，由于我们周围没有飞机，请求原地等待。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1219.audioText:
C: Roger, China Southern 542, do you need any further assistance?
B: Tell the controller you will disembark the passengers, and request passenger steps and a bomb squad.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1219.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，China Southern 542，你还需要其他援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你将让旅客下机，并请求客梯和排爆小组。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1219.referenceText: We will disembark the passengers, request passenger steps and a bomb squad, CSN542.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1219.referenceTextZh: 我们将让旅客下机，请求客梯和排爆小组，CSN542。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1220.audioText: B: It is now later in the day, the suspected bomb was an empty bag, you are at the holding point of runway 02, tell the traffic controller you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1220.audioTextZh: B: 当天稍后，疑似炸弹是一个空包，你在跑道 02 等待点，告诉交通管制员你准备起飞。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1220.referenceText: Chengdu Tower, CSN542, the suspected bomb was an empty bag, holding point of runway 02, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1220.referenceTextZh: 成都塔台，CSN542，疑似炸弹是一个空包，在跑道 02 等待点，准备离场。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1221.audioText: C: China Southern 542, after departure maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff runway 02, surface wind 010 at 2 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1221.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 542，离场后保持跑道航向，跑道 02 可以起飞，地面风 010，2 米/秒。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1221.referenceText: After departure maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff runway 02, CSN542.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1221.referenceTextZh: 离场后保持跑道航向，跑道 02 可以起飞，CSN542。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1222.audioText: C: China Southern 542, contact Departure on 125.6.

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1223.audioText: B: Contact Departure your altitude is now passing 200 meters.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1223.audioTextZh: B: 联系 Departure，你的高度现在通过 200 米。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1224.audioText: C: Good afternoon, China Southern 542, maintain runway heading, climb to 3000 meters, be advised we have received some reports of a large unmanned weather balloons in your area.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1224.audioTextZh: C: 下午好，China Southern 542，保持跑道航向，爬升到 3000 米，通知你，我们收到一些报告称你所在区域有大型无人气象气球。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1224.referenceText: Maintain runway heading, climb to 3000 meters, roger, thanks, CSN542.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1224.referenceTextZh: 保持跑道航向，爬升到 3000 米，收到，谢谢，CSN542。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1225.audioText: B: As you are climbing you notice a large unmanned balloon, your position is 4 miles North of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters, report this to ATC.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1225.audioTextZh: B: 爬升时你发现一个大型无人气球，你的位置在机场以北 4 海里，当前高度 2000 米，向 ATC 报告。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1225.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN542, we notice a large balloon, position North of airfield 4 miles 2000 meters.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1225.referenceTextZh: Chengdu Departure，CSN542，我们发现一个大型气球，位置机场以北 4 海里，2000 米。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1226.audioText: B: Before ATC replies, you suddenly hit another balloon you did not see, the aircraft becomes difficult to control and you want to return to land at Chengdu, tell ATC this. This is an Urgency call.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1226.audioTextZh: B: 在 ATC 回复前，你突然撞上另一个没看到的气球，飞机变得难以控制，你想返回 Chengdu 着陆，告诉 ATC。这是紧急呼叫。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1226.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Chengdu Departure, CSN542, we hit another balloon we did not see, the aircraft becomes difficult to control, request return to land at Chengdu.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1226.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Chengdu Departure，CSN542，我们撞上另一个未看到的气球，飞机变得难以控制，请求返回 Chengdu 着陆。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1227.audioText: C: China Southern 542, roger PAN, turn left heading 200, descend to 1200 meters, all runways available for landing.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1227.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 542，收到 PAN，左转航向 200，下降到 1200 米，所有跑道均可用于着陆。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1227.referenceText: Turn left heading 200, descend to 1200 meters, roger, CSN542.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1227.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 200，下降到 1200 米，收到，CSN542。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1228.audioText:
C: China Southern 542, radar vectors are available or you can fly a visual circuit and join left downwind, please advise.
B: Tell the controller you will join left downwind.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1228.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 542，可以提供雷达引导，或你可以飞目视起落航线并加入左下风，请告知。
B: 告诉管制员你将加入左下风。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1229.audioText:
C: China Southern 542, roger, report downwind and when able can you tell us what is the damage to your aircraft?
B: Reply to the transmission and tell them you have a large hole in your wing and the control surfaces are damaged.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1229.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 542，收到，报告下风，可以时告诉我们你的飞机损伤情况。
B: 回复通话，告诉他们机翼上有一个大洞，操纵面受损。
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1229.referenceText: We have a large hole in our wing and the control surfaces are damaged, CSN542.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1229.referenceTextZh: 我们的机翼上有一个大洞，操纵面受损，CSN542。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1230.audioText: B: You are now on downwind, report this to ATC.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1230.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在下风，向 ATC 报告。

atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1231.audioText: C: China Southern 542, you are number 1, cleared to land runway 02, report on final.
atc-scenario-0071-card-main-1231.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 542，你是第 1 架，跑道 02 可以着陆，五边报告。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1232.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 342, you are just over Zulu Foxtrot and maintaining 4500 meters, you are about to enter the Area control airspace. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1232.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 China Southern 342，刚过 Zulu Foxtrot，保持 4500 米，即将进入区域管制空域。与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1232.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN342, over ZF, maintaining 4500 meters.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1232.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN342，过 ZF，保持 4500 米。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1233.audioText: B: Ask Wuhan Control for 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1233.audioTextZh: B: 向武汉管制请求 8900 米。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1233.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN342, request climb to 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1233.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN342，请求爬升到 8900 米。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1234.audioText: C: China Southern 342, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 7500 meters, expect 8900 meters at time 16.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1234.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 342，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升到 7500 米，预计 16 分给 8900 米。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1235.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have encountered a severe clear air turbulence, and ask for 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1235.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你遭遇严重晴空颠簸，并请求 8900 米。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1235.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN342, we have encountered a severe clear air turbulence, request 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1235.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN342，我们遭遇严重晴空颠簸，请求 8900 米。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1236.audioText: C: Roger, China Southern 342, climb to 8900 meters.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1236.audioTextZh: C: 收到，China Southern 342，爬升到 8900 米。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1237.audioText:
C: China Southern 342, Wuhan Control, is there any damage to the aircraft of passenger injuries?
B: Tell the controller that there isn't any aircraft damage, and the purser told you that passengers are OK.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1237.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 342，武汉管制，飞机是否受损或旅客受伤？
B: 告诉管制员飞机没有受损，乘务长告诉你旅客都没事。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1237.referenceText: There isn't any damage to the aircraft, and the purser reported that the passengers are just fine, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1237.referenceTextZh: 飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客都没事，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1238.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control that you have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1238.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉管制，你刚收到匿名电话称飞机上有炸弹。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1238.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN342, we have just received an anonymous calls saying there is a bomb on board our aircraft.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1238.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN342，我们刚收到匿名电话称我们飞机上有炸弹。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1239.audioText:
C: Roger, China Southern 342, report your intentions.
B: Tell the controller that you wish to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1239.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，China Southern 342，报告你的意图。
B: 告诉管制员你希望在 Wuhan Airport 着陆。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1239.referenceText: Request to land at Wuhan Airport, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1239.referenceTextZh: 请求在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1240.audioText: C: China Southern 342, roger, turn left direct to Zulu Foxtrot and descend to 4800 meters.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1240.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 342，收到，左转直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降到 4800 米。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1240.referenceText: Turn left direct to ZF and descend to 4800 meters, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1240.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 ZF，下降到 4800 米，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1241.audioText:
C: China Southern 342, do you need any assistance?
B: Inform the controller that you need a bomb disposal squad upon landing, and you will use the emergency sliders to deplane the passengers.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1241.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 342，你需要什么援助？
B: 通知管制员着陆时需要排爆小组，并将使用应急滑梯让旅客下机。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1241.referenceText: We will use the emergency sliders for evacuation, request a bomb disposal squad on arrival, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1241.referenceTextZh: 我们将使用应急滑梯撤离，请求到达时提供排爆小组，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1242.audioText: C: China Southern 342, maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1242.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 342，保持 4800 米，联系武汉进近118.9。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1243.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach, inform the controller that you have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft, and you are returning to Wuhan.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1243.audioTextZh: B: 与 武汉进近 建立初始联系，通知管制员你收到匿名电话称飞机上有炸弹，并且正在返回 Wuhan。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1243.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN342, maintaining 4800 meters, over ZF, we have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board our aircraft, and we are turning back to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1243.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN342，保持 4800 米，过 ZF，我们收到匿名电话称飞机上有炸弹，正在返回 Wuhan Airport 着陆。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1244.audioText: C: China Southern 342, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow Zulu Foxtrot 1 Alpha arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, information Charlie.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1244.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 342，武汉进近，雷达识别，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 1 Alpha 进场，按 QNH 1017 下降到 2700 米，信息 Charlie。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1244.referenceText: Follow ZF 1A arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, information C, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1244.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF 1A 进场，按 QNH 1017 下降到 2700 米，信息 C，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1245.audioText: C: China Southern 342, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1245.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 342，下降到 900 米，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1245.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1245.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1246.audioText: C: China Southern 342, reduce speed to 200 knots, turn right heading 330.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1246.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 342，减速到 200 节，右转航向 330。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1246.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots, turn right heading 330, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1246.referenceTextZh: 减速到 200 节，右转航向 330，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1247.audioText: C: China Southern 342, intercept the localizer for runway 36R, report established.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1247.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 342，切入跑道 36R 航向道，建立后报告。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1247.referenceText: Intercept the localizer for runway 36R, report established, CSN342.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1247.referenceTextZh: 切入跑道 36R 航向道，建立后报告，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1248.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have captured the signal of the localizer.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1248.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你已截获航向道信号。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1249.audioText: C: Roger, China Southern 342, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, 13 miles from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1249.audioTextZh: C: 收到，China Southern 342，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 13 海里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1249.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，124.35，CSN342。

atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1250.audioText: B: Later, you cannot see the runway at decision altitude during approach, inform Tower controller that you need to make another approach.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1250.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，进近中在决断高度看不到跑道，通知塔台管制员你需要再进近一次。
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1250.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN342, no contact at minimum, going around.
atc-scenario-0072-card-main-1250.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN342，最低标准高度无目视，复飞。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1251.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 319, you are parking at gate 51, you have received information Charlie, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1251.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 319，停在 51 号登机口，已收到通播 Charlie，从武汉飞往广州，请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1251.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN319, gate 51, information C, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1251.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN319，51 号登机口，通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1252.audioText: C: China Southern 319, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1252.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1252.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow LKO 01 departure, initially climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN319.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1252.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO 01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，CSN319。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1253.audioText: C: China Southern 319, due to military activity, expect 1 hour delay, you are number 5 for departure.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1253.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，因军事活动，预计延误 1 小时，你是第 5 架离场。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1254.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1254.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1254.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN319, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1254.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN319，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1255.audioText: C: China Southern 319, after Boeing 737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Zulu 4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1255.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，后方 Boeing 737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Zulu 4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1255.referenceText: After B737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, CSN319.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1255.referenceTextZh: 后方 B737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东，CSN319。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1256.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1256.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1257.audioText: C: China Southern 319, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha, hold short of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1257.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1257.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of runway 36R, CSN319.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1257.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待，CSN319。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1258.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff, contact Tower.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1258.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好起飞，联系塔台。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1258.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN319, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1258.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN319，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1259.audioText: C: China Southern 319, behind Boeing 737 on final, line up runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1259.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，在五边 Boeing 737 后，进入跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1259.referenceText: Behind B737 on final, line up runway 36R, CSN319.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1259.referenceTextZh: 在五边 B737 后，进入跑道 36R，CSN319。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1260.audioText: B: Now you are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1260.audioTextZh: B：现在你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1261.audioText: C: China Southern 319, climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1261.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1261.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CSN319.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1261.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN319。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1262.audioText: C: China Southern 319, stop climbing due to converging traffic, level off at 2700 meters.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1262.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，因汇聚冲突飞机，停止爬升，在 2700 米改平。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1262.referenceText: Stop climb, level off at 2700 meters, CSN319.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1262.referenceTextZh: 停止爬升，在 2700 米改平，CSN319。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1263.audioText: C: China Southern 319, continue climb to 4500 meters.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1263.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，继续爬升至 4500 米。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1264.audioText: B: During climb, you found 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900 meters and then return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1264.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现 1 套液压系统失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，告知 ATC 该情况，并请求在 3900 米改平后返回武汉机场。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1264.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CSN319, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 3900 meters and return to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1264.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，CSN319，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 3900 米改平并返回武汉机场。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1265.audioText: C: China Southern 319, roger PAN, maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1265.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，收到 PAN，保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，Lima Kilo Oscar 02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1265.referenceText: Maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO 02 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, CSN319.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1265.referenceTextZh: 保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 LKO，LKO 02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN319。

atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1266.audioText: B: A thunderstorm was detected near Lima Kilo Oscar, report it to Wuhan Approach and ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1266.audioTextZh: B：Lima Kilo Oscar 附近探测到雷暴，向武汉进近报告并请求向左偏置 20 海里。
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1266.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN319, there is a thunderstorm near LKO, request offset 20 miles to the left.
atc-scenario-0073-card-main-1266.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN319，LKO 附近有雷暴，请求向左偏置 20 海里。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1267.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 817, you are at gate 213, you have got information Golf, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1267.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 817，在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 Golf，向武汉放行请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1267.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN817, gate 213, information G, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1267.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN817，213 号登机口，通播 G，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1268.audioText: C: China Southern 817, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 3115.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1268.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 817，武汉放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 3115。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1268.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, LKO 01 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 3115, CSN817.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1268.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO 01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 3115，CSN817。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1269.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and engine have been started up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxiing instructions.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1269.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出并已开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1269.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN817, push backand start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1269.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN817，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1270.audioText: C: China Southern 817, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1270.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 817，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1270.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CSN817.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1270.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN817。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1271.audioText: C: China Southern 817, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway Alpha.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1271.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 817，谨慎滑行，Alpha 滑行道以东有人和设备作业。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1272.audioText: B: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between 200 meters and 400 meters, report it to Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1272.audioTextZh: B：刚离地后，你在 200 米至 400 米之间遭遇强风切变，向武汉进近报告。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1272.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN817, we encountered strong wind shear between 200 meters and 400 meters.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1272.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN817，我们在 200 米至 400 米之间遭遇强风切变。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1273.audioText: B: Now you are cruising at 8400 meters, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1273.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 8400 米巡航，接近 DAPRO，与广州管制首次联系。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1273.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN817, maintaining 8400 meters, approaching DAPRO.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1273.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN817，保持 8400 米，接近 DAPRO。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1274.audioText: C: China Southern 817, Guangzhou Control, radar identified, omit position reports.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1274.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 817，广州管制，雷达识别，省略位置报告。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1275.audioText: B: As you are descending to 4200 meters, you executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver, report the situation to the controller.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1275.audioTextZh: B：你下降至 4200 米时，执行了 TCAS RA 爬升机动，向管制员报告情况。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1275.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN817, descending to 4200 meters, TCAS climbing.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1275.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN817，下降至 4200 米，TCAS 爬升。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1276.audioText: B: Now the conflicting traffic is clear, resumed descent, report the situation to the controller.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1276.audioTextZh: B：现在冲突飞机已脱离，恢复下降，向管制员报告情况。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1276.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN817, clear of traffic, resume descent.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1276.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN817，冲突已解除，恢复下降。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1277.audioText: C: China Southern 817, continue descent to 3600 meters.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1277.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 817，继续下降至 3600 米。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1278.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach runway 36R, tell the controller you can't see the PAPI lights.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1278.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，告诉管制员你看不到 PAPI 灯。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1278.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN817, established on ILS approach runway 36R, we can't see the PAPI lights.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1278.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN817，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，我们看不到 PAPI 灯。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1279.audioText: C: China Southern 817, cleared to land runway 36R, the PAPI is out of service.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1279.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 817，跑道 36R 可以落地，PAPI 不工作。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1279.referenceText: Roger, cleared to land runway 36R, CSN817.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1279.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 可以落地，CSN817。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1280.audioText: B: After landing, due to the thick fog, you can't find the taxiway clearly, ask Tower for a follow-me car to taxi.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1280.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于浓雾，你看不清滑行道，向塔台请求引导车滑行。
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1280.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN817, due to the thick fog, we can't find the taxiway clearly, request a follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1280.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN817，由于浓雾，我们看不清滑行道，请求引导车。

atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1281.audioText: C: China Southern 817, the follow-me car will be waiting for you on the taxiway Alpha.
atc-scenario-0074-card-main-1281.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 817，引导车将在 Alpha 滑行道上等你。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1282.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 557, you are flying from Wuhan to Rome, you are taxiing southbound on taxiway Charlie to holding point runway 36L, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1282.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 557，从武汉飞往罗马，你正在 Charlie 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1282.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN557, taxiing on taxiway C to holding point runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1282.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN557，在 C 滑行道滑行至跑道 36L 等待点。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1283.audioText: C: China Southern 557, line up runway 36L.

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1284.audioText: C: China Southern 557, wind calm, contact Approach on 119.25 when airborne, cleared for takeoff runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1284.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，风静，离地后联系进近 119.25，跑道 36L 可以起飞。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1285.audioText: B: After airborne, you have an undercarriage warning, your left main gear has not fully retracted, call Wuhan Approach and request maintain 1200 meters and speed 180 knots.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1285.audioTextZh: B：离地后，你有起落架警告，左主起落架未完全收上，呼叫武汉进近并请求保持 1200 米、速度 180 节。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1285.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN557, we have an undercarriage warning, our left main gear has not fully retracted, request maintain 1200 meters and speed 180 knots.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1285.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN557，我们有起落架警告，左主起落架未完全收上，请求保持 1200 米、速度 180 节。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1286.audioText: C: China Southern 557, climb and maintain 1200 meters, speed 180 knots approved, advise intentions when able.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1286.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，爬升并保持 1200 米，速度 180 节同意，能够时告知意图。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1286.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1200 meters, speed 180 knots approved, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1286.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 1200 米，速度 180 节同意，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1287.audioText: B: After performing the checklist, you still can't verify the landing gear position, tell Wuhan Approach you want to return to Wuhan Airport and fly a low pass over airfield for visual inspection.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1287.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，你仍无法确认起落架位置，告诉武汉进近你想返回武汉机场，并在机场上空低通场进行目视检查。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1287.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN557, we can't verify the landing gear position, request return to Wuhan Airport and request a low pass over airfield for visual inspection.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1287.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN557，我们无法确认起落架位置，请求返回武汉机场，并请求在机场上空低通场进行目视检查。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1288.audioText: C: China Southern 557, turn right, track direct to Delta Alpha NDB, descend to 900 meters, follow published procedure, cleared ILS approach 36 right.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1288.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，右转，直飞 Delta Alpha NDB，下降至 900 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1288.referenceText: Turn right, track direct to DA NDB, descend to 900 meters, follow published procedure, cleared ILS approach 36R, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1288.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 DA NDB，下降至 900 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1289.audioText: C: China Southern 557, you are 10 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower 118.5.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1289.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，你距接地点 10 海里，联系武汉塔台118.5。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1290.audioText: B: Call tower and tell them you are established on ILS runway 36R, you are ready for low pass.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1290.audioTextZh: B：呼叫塔台并告诉他们你已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1290.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN557, established on ILS runway 36R, ready for low pass.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1290.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN557，已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1291.audioText: C: China Southern 557, wind calm, cleared low pass runway 36R, not below 100 meters above the runway.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1291.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，风静，跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 100 米。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1291.referenceText: Cleared low pass runway 36R, not below 100 meters above the runway, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1291.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 100 米，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1292.audioText: C: China Southern 557, after low pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 900 meters.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1292.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 900 米。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1292.referenceText: After low pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 900 meters, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1292.referenceTextZh: 低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 900 米，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1293.audioText:
C: China Southern 557, we have a good look at your undercarriage, your left main landing gear is stuck halfway, it is not in the extended position, advise intention.
B: Tell Tower you want to perform hold near the airport.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1293.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 557，我们看清了你的起落架，你的左主起落架卡在半程，未在放下位置，告知意图。
B：告诉塔台你想在机场附近等待。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1293.referenceText: Roger, request hold near the airport, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1293.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求在机场附近等待，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1294.audioText: C: China Southern 557, turn left, direct to Delta Alpha, climb to 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1294.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，左转，直飞 Delta Alpha，爬升至 1200 米，联系武汉进近119.25。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1294.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1294.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，联系武汉进近119.25，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1295.audioText: B: Now you are tracking direct to Delta Alpha, maintaining 1200 meters, call Wuhan Approach and request holding instructions.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1295.audioTextZh: B：现在你正直飞 Delta Alpha，保持 1200 米，呼叫武汉进近并请求等待指令。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1295.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN557, tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1200 meters, request holding instructions.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1295.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN557，正直飞 DA，保持 1200 米，请求等待指令。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1296.audioText: C: China Southern 557, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, hold at Delta Alpha NDB as published, expect further clearance at 50, report entering the hold.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1296.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，武汉进近，雷达识别，在 Delta Alpha NDB 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可 50，报告进入等待。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1296.referenceText: Hold at DA NDB as published, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1296.referenceTextZh: 在 DA NDB 按公布程序等待，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1297.audioText: B: During hold, another warning is triggered, 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid slowly, this is an Urgency call, you want to dump fuel and return for emergency landing.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1297.audioTextZh: B：等待中，另一个警告触发，1 套液压系统缓慢漏油，这是紧急情况呼叫，你想放油并返回紧急着陆。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1297.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN557, 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid slowly, request dump fuel and return for emergency landing.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1297.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN557，1 套液压系统缓慢漏油，请求放油并返回紧急着陆。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1298.audioText: C: China Southern 557, roger PAN, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, turn left heading 310, radar vector to dump fuel, we will have emergency services ready and foam the runway slowly.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1298.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 557，收到 PAN，爬升并保持 3000 米，左转航向 310，雷达引导航空放油，我们将准备好应急服务并缓慢给跑道铺泡沫。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1298.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters, turn left heading 310, radar vector to dump fuel, roger, thanks, CSN557.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1298.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 3000 米，左转航向 310，雷达引导航空放油，收到，谢谢，CSN557。

atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1299.audioText: B: After emergency landing at runway 36R, the aircraft is still intact, you want to make an emergency evacuation.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1299.audioTextZh: B：在跑道 36R 紧急着陆后，飞机仍保持完整，你想进行紧急撤离。
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1299.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN557, the aircraft is still intact, request emergency evacuation.
atc-scenario-0075-card-main-1299.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN557，飞机仍保持完整，请求紧急撤离。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1300.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 371, a flight from Wuhan to Moscow, you are at bay 224, you have got information Charlie, request ATC clearance to Moscow from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1300.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 371，从武汉飞往莫斯科，在 224 号机位，已收到通播 Charlie，向武汉放行请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1300.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN371, bay 224, information C, request ATC clearance to Moscow.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1300.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN371，224 号机位，通播 C，请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1301.audioText: C: China Southern 371, cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, cruising level 8900 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1301.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，许可飞往莫斯科，按飞行计划航路，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，巡航高度 8900 米，起始爬升 1500 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3223。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1301.referenceText: Cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF 01 departure, cruising level 8900 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223, CSN371.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1301.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往莫斯科，按飞行计划航路，执行 ZF 01 离场，巡航高度 8900 米，起始爬升 1500 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3223，CSN371。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1302.audioText: C: China Southern 371, read back correct, contact Wuhan Ground on 121.9.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1302.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，复诵正确，联系武汉地面121.9。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1303.audioText: B: The maintenance staff has deferred an MEL item regarding APU, contact Ground and tell the controller you will be ready to start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1303.audioTextZh: B：维修人员已保留一项关于 APU 的 MEL 项目，联系地面并告诉管制员你将在 5 分钟后准备好在机位启动 1 台发动机。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1303.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN371, request start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes due to APU problem.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1303.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN371，因 APU 问题，请求 5 分钟后在机位启动 1 台发动机。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1304.audioText: C: China Southern 371, slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, call me back when ready for push back.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1304.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，准备好推出时再呼叫我。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1304.referenceText: Slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, CSN371.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1304.referenceTextZh: 时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，CSN371。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1305.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1305.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN371, ready for push back.

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1306.audioText: C: China Southern 371, push back onto Foxtrot, facing south.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1306.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，推出至 Foxtrot，机头朝南。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1306.referenceText: Push back onto F, facing south, CSN371.

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1307.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1308.audioText: C: China Southern 371, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Foxtrot, Alpha 9, hold short of Alpha.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1308.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，经滑行道 Foxtrot、Alpha 9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，Alpha 外等待。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1308.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway F, A9, hold short of A, CSN371.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1308.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，A 外等待，CSN371。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1309.audioText: B: During taxi an auto brake caution message is displayed on the aircraft warning system, so you stop taxiing, advise Ground.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1309.audioTextZh: B：滑行中飞机警告系统显示自动刹车警戒信息，所以你停止滑行，告知地面。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1309.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN371, we have an auto brake caution message, we stopped taxiing.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1309.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN371，我们有自动刹车警戒信息，我们已停止滑行。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1310.audioText:
C: China Southern 371, roger, hold at present position, advise your intention when able.
B: Tell the controller you are still able to taxi, but you need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, ask to hold at the convenient position.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1310.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 371，收到，在当前位置等待，能够时告知意图。
B：告诉管制员你仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1310.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN371, we are still able to taxi, but we need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, request hold at the convenient position.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1310.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN371，我们仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1311.audioText: B: While communicating with mechanic and dispatcher, you discovered that some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, report it to ATC and ask for returning to the gate.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1311.audioTextZh: B：与机务和签派沟通时，你发现机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，向 ATC 报告并请求返回登机口。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1311.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN371, some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, request return to the gate.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1311.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN371，机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，请求返回登机口。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1312.audioText: C: China Southern 371, taxi to bay 224 via taxiway Alpha 8, Alpha, Alpha 5.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1312.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，经滑行道 Alpha 8、Alpha、Alpha 5 滑行至 224 号机位。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1312.referenceText: Taxi to bay 224 via taxiway A8, A, A5, CSN371.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1312.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A8、A、A5 滑行至 224 号机位，CSN371。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1313.audioText: B: 2 hours later, now you are maintaining 9500 meters, approaching Whiskey X-Ray India, squawking 3223, contact Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1313.audioTextZh: B：2 小时后，现在你保持 9500 米，接近 Whiskey X-Ray India，应答机 3223，联系北京管制。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1313.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN371, maintaining 9500 meters, approaching WXI, squawking 3223.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1313.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN371，保持 9500 米，接近 WXI，应答机 3223。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1314.audioText: C: China Southern 371, maintain 9500 meters, report Victor Yankee Kilo.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1314.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，保持 9500 米，报告 Victor Yankee Kilo。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1315.audioText: B: Now you are over Victor Yankee Kilo, maintaining 9500 meters, report it to Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1315.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Victor Yankee Kilo 上空，保持 9500 米，向北京管制报告。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1315.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN371, over VYK, maintaining 9500 meters.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1315.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN371，VYK 上空，保持 9500 米。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1316.audioText:
C: China Southern 371, climb to and maintain 10700 meters.
B: Tell Beijing Control you are too heavy, request a step climb to 10700 meters in about 1 hour.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1316.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 371，爬升并保持 10700 米。
B：告诉北京管制你太重，请求约 1 小时后阶梯爬升至 10700 米。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1316.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN371, request a step climb to 10700 meters in about 1 hour due heavy weight.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1316.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN371，因重量大，请求约 1 小时后阶梯爬升至 10700 米。

atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1317.audioText: C: China Southern 371, due separation, maintain not greater than Mach 0.80.
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1317.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 371，因间隔，保持不大于马赫 0.80。
atc-scenario-0076-card-main-1317.referenceText: Maintain not greater than M.80, CSN371.

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1318.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 102, a flight from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at gate 213, you have got information Kilo, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1318.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 102，从武汉飞往广州，在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 Kilo，请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1318.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN3102, gate 213, information K, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1318.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN3102，213 号登机口，通播 K，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1319.audioText: C: China Southern 102, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 departure, initial altitude 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.75, squawk 2736.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1319.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，使用跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 02 离场，起始高度 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.75，应答机 2736。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1319.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, LKO 02 departure, initial altitude 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.75, squawk 2736, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1319.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，使用跑道 36R，LKO 02 离场，起始高度 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.75，应答机 2736，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1320.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1320.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1320.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3102, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1320.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN3102，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1321.audioText: C: China Southern 102, push back and start up approved, facing north.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1321.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意推出和开车，机头朝北。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1321.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1321.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，机头朝北，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1322.audioText: B: During engine start up, your APU has malfunctioned, ask Wuhan Ground to start 1 engine at the gate.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1322.audioTextZh: B：开车过程中，你的 APU 故障，请求武汉地面在登机口启动 1 台发动机。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1322.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3102, request start 1 engine at the gate due APU malfunction.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1322.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN3102，因 APU 故障，请求在登机口启动 1 台发动机。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1323.audioText: C: China Southern 102, start 1 engine at the gate approved, report when ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1323.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意在登机口启动 1 台发动机，准备滑行时报告。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1323.referenceText: Start 1 engine at the gate approved, wilco, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1323.referenceTextZh: 同意在登机口启动 1 台发动机，照办，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1324.audioText: B: Now you have started up your engines, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1324.audioTextZh: B：现在你已启动发动机，准备好滑行。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1324.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3102, start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1324.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN3102，开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1325.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1325.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1325.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1325.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1326.audioText: C: China Southern 102, hold position, give way to Boeing 747 passing from left to right.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1326.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，原地等待，避让从左至右经过的 Boeing 747。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1326.referenceText: Holding position, give way to B747 passing from left to right, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1326.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，避让从左至右经过的 B747，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1327.audioText: C: China Southern 102, traffic passed and clear, continue taxi.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1327.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，飞机已通过并脱离，继续滑行。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1328.audioText: C: China Southern 102, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1329.audioText: B: Now you are approaching holding point runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you are ready for takeoff.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1329.audioTextZh: B：现在你正接近跑道 36R 等待点，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你准备好起飞。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1329.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3102, approaching holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1329.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN3102，接近跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1330.audioText: C: China Southern 102, hold short of runway 36R, expect 15 minutes delay due thunderstorm approaching the upwind of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1330.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，跑道 36R 外等待，因雷暴接近跑道 36R 上风边，预计延误 15 分钟。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1330.referenceText: Roger, hold short of runway 36R, CSN3102.

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1331.audioText: B: After ten minutes, you find you need to refuel the aircraft due to a long time delay, you have to taxi back for refueling the aircraft.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1331.audioTextZh: B：十分钟后，由于长时间延误，你发现需要给飞机加油，必须滑回给飞机加油。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1331.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3102, request taxi back for refueling the aircraft due to long time delay.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1331.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN3102，因长时间延误，请求滑回给飞机加油。

atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1332.audioText: C: China Southern 102, enter runway 36R, vacate runway via Alpha 2, then Tango 5 to gate 211.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1332.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，进入跑道 36R，经 Alpha 2 脱离跑道，然后经 Tango 5 到 211 号登机口。
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1332.referenceText: Enter runway 36R, vacate runway via A2, then T5 to gate 211, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0077-card-main-1332.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 36R，经 A2 脱离跑道，然后经 T5 到 211 号登机口，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1333.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 109, you are approaching Victor Yankee Kilo, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125, make initial contact with Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1333.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 109，正接近 Victor Yankee Kilo，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125，与北京管制首次联系。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1333.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3109, approaching VYK, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1333.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3109，接近 VYK，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1334.audioText: C: China Southern 109, Beijing Control, radar contact, direct to Victor Yankee Kilo, after passing Victor Yankee Kilo, climb to 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1334.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，北京管制，雷达识别，直飞 Victor Yankee Kilo，过 Victor Yankee Kilo 后爬升至 8400 米。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1334.referenceText: Direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters, CSN3109.
