atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1334.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VYK，过 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米，CSN3109。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1335.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request Beijing Control for a right turn to avoid the thunderstorm.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1335.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求北京管制右转避开雷暴。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1335.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3109, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request right turn to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1335.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3109，我们的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求右转避让。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1336.audioText: C: China Southern 109, negative due military activity, turn left heading 010.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1336.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，不能同意，因军事活动，左转航向 010。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1337.audioText: C: China Southern 109, turn left heading 350.

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1338.audioText: B: Now there is a strong echo of thunderstorm, you are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1338.audioTextZh: B：现在有强雷暴回波，你离天气太近，请求左转避让。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1338.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3109, there is a strong echo of thunderstorm, we are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1338.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3109，有强雷暴回波，我们离天气太近，请求左转避让。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1339.audioText: C: China Southern 109, left turn is not permitted due restricted area.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1339.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，因限制区，不允许左转。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1340.audioText: B: Suddenly, you have suffered from hail strike, the wind shield is cracked on the outside, report it to Beijing Control and request return to land.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1340.audioTextZh: B：突然，你遭遇冰雹撞击，风挡外层开裂，向北京管制报告并请求返回着陆。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1340.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3109, we have suffered from hail strike, the wind shield is cracked on the outside, request return to land.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1340.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3109，我们遭遇冰雹撞击，风挡外层开裂，请求返回着陆。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1341.audioText: C: China Southern 109, roger, turn right heading 340, direct to Victor Yankee Kilo, descend to and maintain 5100 meters.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1341.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，收到，右转航向 340，直飞 Victor Yankee Kilo，下降并保持 5100 米。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1341.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters, CSN3109.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1341.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降并保持 5100 米，CSN3109。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1342.audioText: C: China Southern 109, descend to 4200 meters, contact Beijing Approach 119.25.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1342.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，下降至 4200 米，联系北京进近119.25。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1343.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 4200 meters, over Victor Yankee Kilo, you have got information Kilo, contact Beijing Approach.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1343.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 4200 米，在 Victor Yankee Kilo 上空，已收到通播 Kilo，联系北京进近。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1343.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN3109, maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, information K.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1343.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN3109，保持 4200 米，VYK 上空，通播 K。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1344.audioText: C: China Southern 109, Beijing Approach, radar contact, follow Victor Yankee Kilo 05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1344.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，北京进近，雷达识别，执行 Victor Yankee Kilo 05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1344.referenceText: Follow VYK 05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, CSN3109.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1344.referenceTextZh: 执行 VYK 05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN3109。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1345.audioText: B: During approach, neither of you can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, you ask Beijing Tower if Beijing Airport permits auto-land.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1345.audioTextZh: B：进近中，由于风挡开裂，你们两人都无法透过风挡看清，询问北京塔台北京机场是否允许自动着陆。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1345.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3109, neither of us can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, does your airport permit auto-land ?
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1345.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN3109，由于风挡开裂，我们两人都无法透过风挡看清，你机场是否允许自动着陆？

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1346.audioText: C: China Southern 109, runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 350, 3 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1346.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，跑道 36R，可以落地，地面风 350，3 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1347.audioText: B: After landing, you can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1347.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于风挡开裂，你看不清滑行道，请求拖车。
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1347.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3109, we can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1347.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN3109，由于风挡开裂，我们看不清滑行道，请求拖车。

atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1348.audioText: C: China Southern 109, hold position, the tug will come soon.
atc-scenario-0078-card-main-1348.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 109，原地等待，拖车很快会来。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1349.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 310, performing a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at gate 221, you have received information Bravo, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1349.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 310，执行北京至广州航班，停在 221 号登机口，已收到通播 Bravo，联系北京放行并请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1349.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN1310, gate 221, information B, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1349.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN1310，221 号登机口，通播 B，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1350.audioText: C: China Southern 310, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, BOBAK 03 departure, departure runway 36R, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 9500 meters, squawk 2536.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1350.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，北京放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，BOBAK 03 离场，离场跑道 36R，起始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1350.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, BOBAK 03 departure, departure runway 36R, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 9500 meters, squawk 2536, CSN1310.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1350.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，BOBAK 03 离场，离场跑道 36R，起始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536，CSN1310。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1351.audioText: C: China Southern 310, expect slot time 0215 due to temporary departure restrictions, report when ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1351.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，因临时离场限制，预计时隙 0215，准备好推出和开车时报告。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1352.audioText: C: China Southern 310, slot time restriction has canceled, monitored Beijing Ground 121.975.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1352.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，时隙限制已取消，守听北京地面 121.975。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1353.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back, contact Beijing Ground.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1353.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出，联系北京地面。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1353.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN1310, request push back.

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1354.audioText: C: China Southern 310, Beijing Ground, push back approved, facing east.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1354.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，北京地面，同意推出，机头朝东。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1354.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, CSN1310.

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1355.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back, you are on taxiway Zulu 4, you are ready for start up.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1355.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，在滑行道 Zulu 4，准备好开车。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1355.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN1310, taxiway Z4, request start up.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1355.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN1310，滑行道 Z4，请求开车。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1356.audioText: C: China Southern 310, your slot time has expired, your new slot time is 0325, start up at own discretion.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1356.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，你的时隙已过期，新时隙是 0325，自行决定开车。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1356.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0325, start up at own discretion, CSN1310.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1356.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙 0325，自行决定开车，CSN1310。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1357.audioText: B: Now you have completed startup and before taxiing checklist, you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Ground for taxiing instructions.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1357.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成开车和滑行前检查单，准备好滑行，联系北京地面获取滑行指令。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1358.audioText: C: China Southern 310, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Zulu 3, Tango 5, Delta 6.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1358.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Zulu 3、Tango 5、Delta 6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1358.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, Z3, T5, D6, CSN1310.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1358.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、Z3、T5、D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN1310。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1359.audioText: C: China Southern 310, hold short of Tango 5, give way to Boeing 747 passing from left to right.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1359.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，Tango 5 外等待，避让从左至右经过的 Boeing 747。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1359.referenceText: Hold short of T5, traffic in sight, CSN1310.

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1360.audioText: B: Now the traffic is clear, you decide to make intersection departure from Whiskey 2, contact Beijing Ground to request intersection departure from Whiskey 2.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1360.audioTextZh: B：现在飞机已脱离，你决定从 Whiskey 2 交叉口离场，联系北京地面请求从 Whiskey 2 交叉口离场。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1360.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN1310, clear of traffic, request intersection departure from W2.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1360.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN1310，飞机已脱离，请求从 W2 交叉口离场。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1361.audioText: C: China Southern 310, negative intersection departure due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Tango 5 and Delta 6.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1361.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，因排序不能同意交叉口离场，继续经滑行道 Tango 5 和 Delta 6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1361.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway T5 and D6, CSN1310.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1361.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 T5 和 D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN1310。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1362.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff, contact Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1362.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好起飞，联系北京塔台。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1362.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN1310, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1362.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN1310，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1363.audioText: C: China Southern 310, hold short of runway 36R, expect 15 minutes delay due thunderstorms in the vicinity of the airport.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1363.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，跑道 36R 外等待，因机场附近雷暴预计延误 15 分钟。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1363.referenceText: Roger, hold short of runway 36R, CSN1310.

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1364.audioText: C: China Southern 310, runway 36R, line up and cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1364.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，跑道 36R，进跑道并可以起飞，地面风 350 度，3 米/秒。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1364.referenceText: Runway 36R, line up and cleared for takeoff, CSN1310.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1364.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，进跑道并可以起飞，CSN1310。

atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1365.audioText: B: You find you have no enough fuel to the destination due to long ground delay, tell Beijing Tower you have to taxi back to refuel your aircraft.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1365.audioTextZh: B：由于长时间地面延误，你发现燃油不足以到达目的地，告诉北京塔台你必须滑回给飞机加油。
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1365.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN1310, we have no enough fuel to the destination due long ground delay, request taxi back to refuel the aircraft.
atc-scenario-0079-card-main-1365.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN1310，由于长时间地面延误，我们没有足够燃油到达目的地，请求滑回给飞机加油。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1366.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 202, destination Harbin. You just departed from Beijing airport at 23. You are passing 1200 meters and want to climb to 1800 meters, contact Beijing Departure.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1366.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 202，目的地哈尔滨。你 23 从北京机场刚起飞，正通过 1200 米，想爬升至 1800 米，联系北京离场。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1366.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, from Beijing to Harbin, airborne 23, passing 1200 meters, request climb to 1800 meters.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1366.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN6202，从北京飞往哈尔滨，23 离地，通过 1200 米，请求爬升至 1800 米。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1367.audioText: C: China Southern 202, Beijing Departure, radar contact, due to slower preceding traffic, cancel SID, turn right heading 010.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1367.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，北京离场，雷达识别，因前机速度较慢，取消 SID，右转航向 010。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1367.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right heading 010, CSN6202.

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1368.audioText: C: China Southern 202, climb to 5400 meters on standard, resume own navigation, direct to Yankee Victor, via flight planned route.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1368.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，标准气压爬升至 5400 米，恢复自主导航，直飞 Yankee Victor，按飞行计划航路。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1368.referenceText: Climb to 5400 meters on standard, resume own navigation, direct to YV via flight planned route, CSN6202.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1368.referenceTextZh: 标准气压爬升至 5400 米，恢复自主导航，直飞 YV，按飞行计划航路，CSN6202。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1369.audioText: B: Inform the controller that your weather radar shows a build-up around Yankee Victor, request direct to KAKAT.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1369.audioTextZh: B：告知管制员你的气象雷达显示 Yankee Victor 附近有云团发展，请求直飞 KAKAT。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1369.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, our weather radar shows a build-up around YV, request direct to KAKAT.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1369.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN6202，我们的气象雷达显示 YV 附近有云团发展，请求直飞 KAKAT。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1370.audioText: C: China Southern 202, contact Beijing Control 125.9 for request.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1370.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，请联系北京管制125.9 提出请求。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1371.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 5400 meters maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due to weather.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1371.audioTextZh: B：与北京管制首次联系，保持 5400 米，因天气请求直飞 KAKAT。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1371.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, 5400 meters maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due weather.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1371.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，保持 5400 米，因天气请求直飞 KAKAT。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1372.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, climb to and maintain 10700 meters due Air Force restriction, suggest heading 020.
B: Because the CB is 2 large, you want heading 030.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1372.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，因空军限制，爬升并保持 10700 米，建议航向 020。
B：由于 CB 太大，你想航向 030。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1372.referenceText: Climb to maintaining 10700 meters, request heading 030 due CB, CSN6202.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1372.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10700 米，因 CB 请求航向 030，CSN6202。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1373.audioText: C: China Southern 202, turn right heading 030 approved.

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1374.audioText: B: Now, you have clear weather, back on course.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1374.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离天气，回到航路。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1374.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, cleared weather, back on course.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1374.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，脱离天气，回到航路。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1375.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, Beijing roger.
B: Tell the controller that you are getting an ice build-up as a result of suspected de-icing equipment failure, request descent below freezing level.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1375.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，北京收到。
B：告诉管制员，疑似除冰设备故障导致结冰积聚，请求下降到冰点高度以下。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1375.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, possible de-icing equipment failure, ice is building up, request descent below freezing level.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1375.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，可能除冰设备故障，正在积冰，请求下降到冰点高度以下。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1376.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, roger, descend to 6300 meters, report when require lower, do emergency conditions exist?
B: Tell the controller this level should be sufficient and emergency conditions do not exist.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1376.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，收到，下降至 6300 米，需要更低高度时报告，是否存在紧急情况？
B：告诉管制员该高度应足够，且不存在紧急情况。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1376.referenceText: Descend to 6300 meters, it should be low enough and no emergency conditions exists, CSN6202.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1376.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6300 米，应该足够低，没有紧急情况，CSN6202。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1377.audioText: B: There may be a problem about flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1377.audioTextZh: B：飞控系统可能有问题，请求返回北京机场。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1377.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, possible problem with flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1377.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，飞控系统可能有问题，请求返回北京机场。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1378.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, roger, confirm approach and landing normal?
B: Say no problem.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1378.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，收到，确认进近和着陆正常？
B：回答没问题。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1379.audioText: C: China Southern 202, turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600 meters.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1379.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，右转直飞 GITUM，下降并保持 3600 米。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1379.referenceText: Turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600 meters, CSN6202.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1379.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 GITUM，下降并保持 3600 米，CSN6202。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1381.audioText: B: Descend to 3600 meters, contact Approach, tell him you have a further problem with your leading edge flap extension and believe it is because of the prior icing issue.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1381.audioTextZh: B：下降至 3600 米，联系进近，告诉他前缘襟翼伸展又有问题，并认为这是先前结冰问题造成的。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1381.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN6202, descend to 3600 meters, we have a further problem with our leading edge flap extension, possibly due to earlier icing issues.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1381.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN6202，下降至 3600 米，我们的前缘襟翼伸展又有问题，可能由于先前结冰问题。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1382.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, Beijing Approach, roger, do you require any other assistance?
B: Tell Approach you have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1382.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，北京进近，收到，你需要其他协助吗？
B：告诉进近你有微动开关故障，将执行无襟翼着陆，并请求跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1382.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN6202, we have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1382.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN6202，我们有微动开关故障，将执行无襟翼着陆，请求跑道 36R。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1383.audioText: C: China Southern 202, roger, change of runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700 meters on QNH 1013, information Charlie.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1383.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，改用跑道 36R，左转航向 090，QNH 1013 下降并保持 2700 米，通播 Charlie。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1383.referenceText: Runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700 meters on QNH 1013, information C, CSN6202.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1383.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，左转航向 090，QNH 1013 下降并保持 2700 米，通播 C，CSN6202。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1384.audioText: C: China Southern 202, turn right heading 270, descend to 1800 meters.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1384.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，右转航向 270，下降至 1800 米。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1384.referenceText: Turn right heading 270, descend to 1800 meters, CSN6202.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1384.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 270，下降至 1800 米，CSN6202。

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1385.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, the field is 11 miles away, report visual contact.
B: Tell the Approach, you have the runway in sight.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1385.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，机场距你 11 海里，报告目视。
B：告诉进近你看到跑道。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1385.referenceText: We have the field and runway in sight, CSN6202.

atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1386.audioText: C: China Southern 202, make visual approach 36 right, turn final when ready.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1386.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，执行目视进近 36R，准备好时转五边。
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1386.referenceText: Make visual approach 36R, turn final when ready, CSN6202.
atc-scenario-0080-card-main-1386.referenceTextZh: 执行目视进近 36R，准备好时转五边，CSN6202。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1387.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 353, a flight from Wuhan to Los Angeles, the cargo manifest shows that there is dangerous goods on board, report it to company operations and request offload the luggage.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1387.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 353，从武汉飞往洛杉矶，货物舱单显示机上有危险品，向公司运行报告并请求卸下行李。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1387.referenceText: Dispatch, CSN7353, the cargo manifest shows that there is dangerous goods on board, request offload the luggage.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1387.referenceTextZh: 签派，CSN7353，货物舱单显示机上有危险品，请求卸下行李。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1388.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 23, you have got the information November, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1388.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 23 号登机口，已收到通播 November，向武汉放行请求飞往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1388.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN7353, gate 23, information N, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1388.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN7353，23 号登机口，通播 N，请求飞往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1389.audioText: C: China Southern 353, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36R, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 Delta departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8900 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1389.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 Delta 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8900 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2515。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1389.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO 01D departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8900 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN7353.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1389.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，LKO 01D 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8900 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2515，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1390.audioText: C: China Southern 353, expect 15 minutes delay, the airport is temporarily closed due heavy fog, call you back.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1390.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，预计延误 15 分钟，机场因大雾临时关闭，稍后呼叫你。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1390.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1391.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1391.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1391.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN7353, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1391.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN7353，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1392.audioText: C: China Southern 353, after traffic taxiing behind is clear, push back and start up approved, pushed back onto taxiway Zulu 4, abeam gate 232, facing east.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1392.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，后方滑行飞机脱离后，同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Zulu 4，正对 232 号登机口，机头朝东。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1392.referenceText: After traffic taxing behind is clear, push back and start up approved, pushed back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 232, facing east, CSN7353.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1392.referenceTextZh: 后方滑行飞机脱离后，同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 232 号登机口，机头朝东，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1393.audioText: B: Now you are on taxiway Zulu 4, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1393.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Zulu 4，准备好滑行。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1393.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN7353, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1393.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN7353，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1394.audioText: C: China Southern 353, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1394.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1394.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, CSN7353.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1394.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1395.audioText: B: During taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to heavy fog, you are unable to taxi, tell the controller that you will hold at present position until visibility gets better.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1395.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，由于大雾能见度变差，你无法滑行，告诉管制员你将在当前位置等待，直到能见度好转。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1395.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN7353, the visibility is getting worse due to heavy fog, we are unable to taxi, request hold at present position until visibility gets better.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1395.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN7353，由于大雾能见度变差，我们无法滑行，请求在当前位置等待，直到能见度好转。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1396.audioText: C: China Southern 353, the visibility is improving, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Alpha 3 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1396.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，能见度正在好转，继续经滑行道 Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1396.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway A3 and A, CSN7353.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1396.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1397.audioText: C: China Southern 353, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1398.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1398.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1398.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN7353, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1398.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN7353，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1399.audioText: C: China Southern 353, runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact 119.7.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1399.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，跑道 36R，可以起飞，离地后联系 119.7。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1399.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact 119.7, CSN7353.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1399.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以起飞，离地后联系 119.7，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1400.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 1200 meters, contact Departure.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1400.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，联系离场。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1400.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN7353, airborne, passing 1200 meters.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1400.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CSN7353，已离地，通过 1200 米。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1401.audioText: C: China Southern 353, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters at 3000 feet per minute or greater.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1401.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，武汉离场，雷达识别，以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大爬升率爬升至 3900 米。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1401.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters at 3000 feet per minute or greater, CSN7353.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1401.referenceTextZh: 以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大爬升率爬升至 3900 米，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1402.audioText: C: China Southern 353, continue climb to 8900 meters, report passing 6000 meters.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1402.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，继续爬升至 8900 米，报告通过 6000 米。
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1402.referenceText: Continue climb to 8900 meters, report passing 6000 meters, CSN7353.
atc-scenario-0081-card-main-1402.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 8900 米，报告通过 6000 米，CSN7353。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1403.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 112, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, the preceding aircraft reported a squall line 100 miles ahead on the weather radar, contact Beijing Control and request turn right to circumnavigate the weather.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1403.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 112，从北京飞往广州，前机报告气象雷达上前方 100 海里有飑线，联系北京管制并请求右转绕飞天气。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1403.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, the preceding aircraft reported a squall line 100 miles ahead on the weather radar, request turn right to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1403.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3112，前机报告气象雷达上前方 100 海里有飑线，请求右转避让。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1404.audioText: C: China Southern 112, Beijing Control, negative due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, report clear of CB.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1404.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，北京管制，因禁区不能同意，左转 30 度，偏航 35 公里，报告脱离 CB。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1404.referenceText: Turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, report clear of CB, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1404.referenceTextZh: 左转 30 度，偏航 35 公里，报告脱离 CB，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1405.audioText: B: Now you are clear of CB and closing back to the course, contact Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1405.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离 CB，正回到航路，联系北京管制。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1405.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, clear of CB and closing back to the course.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1405.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3112，已脱离 CB，正回到航路。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1406.audioText:
C: China Southern 112, the preceding aircraft reported severe turbulence of 10400 meters, 11000 meters is available, what's your intention?
B: Acknowledge the transmission and tell the controller you'd like to climb to 11000 meters.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1406.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 112，前机报告 10400 米有严重颠簸，11000 米可用，你的意图？
B：确认收到并告诉管制员你想爬升至 11000 米。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1406.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 11000 meters, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1406.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求爬升至 11000 米，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1407.audioText: C: China Southern 112, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1407.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，爬升并保持 11000 米。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1407.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, CSN3112.

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1408.audioText: C: China Southern 112, after passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1408.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，过 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1408.referenceText: After passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1408.referenceTextZh: 过 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1409.audioText: C: China Southern 112, orbit right from present position until advised to weather ahead.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1409.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，从当前位置右盘旋，直到另行通知，因前方天气。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1409.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until advised, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1409.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到另行通知，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1410.audioText: B: After several orbits, you find you don't have enough fuel to hold any further, report the situation to Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1410.audioTextZh: B：几圈盘旋后，你发现没有足够燃油继续等待，向北京管制报告情况。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1410.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, we don't have enough fuel to hold any further.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1410.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3112，我们没有足够燃油继续等待。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1411.audioText:
C: China 7112, roger, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you require radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1411.audioTextZh:
C：China 7112，收到，说明意图。
B：告诉管制员你需要雷达引导到北京优先落地。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1411.referenceText: Request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1411.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导到北京优先落地，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1412.audioText: C: China Southern 112, roger, turn left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1412.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，收到，左转航向 190，直飞 GUVBA。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1412.referenceText: Then left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA, CSN3112.

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1413.audioText: C: China Southern 112, turn left heading 150, direct to Alpha Alpha 446, hold at Alpha Alpha 446 as published due weather.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1413.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，左转航向 150，直飞 Alpha Alpha 446，因天气在 Alpha Alpha 446 按公布程序等待。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1413.referenceText: Turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1413.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 150，直飞 AA446，在 AA446 按公布程序等待，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1414.audioText: B: You have been holding at Alpha Alpha 446 for about 30 minutes, you are reaching the minimum fuel situation, contact Beijing Control and request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1414.audioTextZh: B：你已在 Alpha Alpha 446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，联系北京管制并请求离开等待并尽快着陆。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1414.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, we have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, we are reaching the minimum fuel situation, request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1414.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN3112，我们已在 AA446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，请求离开等待并尽快着陆。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1415.audioText: C: China Southern 112, roger, leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descent to 6000 meters, contact Beijing Approach on 119.35, we have informed them about your situation.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1415.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，收到，离开等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6000 米，联系北京进近119.35，我们已通知他们你的情况。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1415.referenceText: Leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descent to 6000 meters, 119.35, roger, thanks, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1415.referenceTextZh: 离开等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6000 米，119.35，收到，谢谢，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1416.audioText: B: Now you are over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, you have received information Lima, contact Beijing Approach.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1416.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，已收到通播 Lima，联系北京进近。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1416.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN3112, over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, information L.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1416.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN3112，LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，通播 L。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1417.audioText: C: China 7112, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descent to 4200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1417.audioTextZh: C：China 7112，北京进近，雷达识别，下降至 4200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1417.referenceText: Descent to 4200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach runway 36R, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1417.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1418.audioText:
C: China 7112, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Tell the controller that you are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1418.audioTextZh:
C：China 7112，你是否宣布燃油紧急情况？
B：告诉管制员你宣布燃油紧急情况，并请求跑道 36R 优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1418.referenceText: We are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing runway 36R, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1418.referenceTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急情况，请求跑道 36R 优先着陆，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1419.audioText: C: China Southern 112, roger, you are number 1 to land, cleared straight in ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1419.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，收到，你是落地第 1 架，许可直线 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1419.referenceText: Cleared straight in ILS approach runway 36R, report established, CSN3112.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1419.referenceTextZh: 许可直线 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立，CSN3112。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1420.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach runway 36R, contact Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1420.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，联系北京塔台。
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1420.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3112, established on ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1420.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN3112，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R。

atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1421.audioText: C: China Southern 112, Beijing Tower, runway 36R, clear to land.
atc-scenario-0082-card-main-1421.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 112，北京塔台，跑道 36R，可以落地。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1422.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 102, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are at gate 211, you are ready for push back and start up, contact Beijing Apron.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1422.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 102，从北京飞往广州，在 211 号登机口，准备好推出和开车，联系北京机坪。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1422.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN3102, gate211, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1422.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN3102，211 号登机口，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1423.audioText: C: China Southern 102, push back and start up approved, runway 19R, QNH 1014.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1423.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意推出和开车，跑道 19R，QNH 1014。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1423.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, runway 19right, QNH 1014, CSN3102.

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1424.audioText: B: You have completed push back and start up, but the chocks are still in position, inform the controller of the situation and ask ground handling to remove the chocks.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1424.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车，但轮挡仍在位，告知管制员情况并请求地面保障移除轮挡。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1424.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN3102, the chocks are still in position, request ground handling to remove the chocks.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1424.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN3102，轮挡仍在位，请求地面保障移除轮挡。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1425.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Apron.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1425.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系北京机坪。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1426.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi to holding point runway 19R via taxiway Zulu 18, Mike 5, hold short of Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1426.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经滑行道 Zulu 18、Mike 5 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，Foxtrot 外等待。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1426.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M5, hold short of F, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1426.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z18、M5 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，F 外等待，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1427.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of taxiway Foxtrot, contact Beijing Apron.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1427.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Foxtrot 滑行道外等待，联系北京机坪。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1427.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN3102, holding short of taxiway F.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1427.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN3102，在 F 滑行道外等待。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1428.audioText: C: China Southern 102, hold short of Foxtrot, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1428.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，Foxtrot 外等待，联系北京地面121.95。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1429.audioText: B: During taxi, you find there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, contact Beijing Ground and tell the controller you want to have the ice and snow removed before takeoff.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1429.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，你发现机翼上有冰雪，联系北京地面并告诉管制员你想在起飞前除冰雪。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1429.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3102, there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, request de-icing.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1429.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3102，机翼上有冰雪，请求除冰。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1430.audioText:
C: China Southern 102, de-ice on taxiway Zulu 4.
B: Tell Beijing Ground the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes and your slot time is 35.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1430.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 102，在滑行道 Zulu 4 除冰。
B：告诉北京地面除冰液只有效 30 分钟，你的时隙是 35。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1430.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3102, the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes and our slot time 35.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1430.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3102，除冰液只有效 30 分钟，我们的时隙是 35。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1431.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4 and Foxtrot to holding point runway 19R.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1431.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经滑行道 Zulu 4 和 Foxtrot 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1431.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4 and F to holding point runway 19R, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1431.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4 和 F 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1432.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 600 meters, make initial contact with Beijing Departure.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1432.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，与北京离场首次联系。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1432.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1432.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3102，已离地，通过 600 米。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1433.audioText: C: China Southern 102, Beijing Departure, radar contact, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1014.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1433.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，北京离场，雷达识别，QNH 1014 爬升至 1800 米。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1433.referenceText: Climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1014, CSN3102.

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1434.audioText: B: You are maintaining 1800 meters, you are encountering severe icing, tell the controller you want a higher level.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1434.audioTextZh: B：你保持 1800 米，正在遭遇严重结冰，告诉管制员你想要更高高度。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1434.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3102, maintaining 1800 meters, we are encountering severe icing, request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1434.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3102，保持 1800 米，我们正在遭遇严重结冰，请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1435.audioText: C: China Southern 102, negative due traffic, maintain 1800 meters until advised.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1435.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，因交通不能同意，保持 1800 米直到通知。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1435.referenceText: Roger, maintain 1800 meters until advised, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1435.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 1800 米直到通知，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1436.audioText: B: Now the icing condition is deteriorating, your left engine anti-ice has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for a higher level to leave icing area.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1436.audioTextZh: B：现在结冰情况恶化，你的左发防冰失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求更高高度离开结冰区。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1436.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, CSN3102, the icing condition is deteriorating, our left engine anti-ice has failed, request a higher level to leave icing area.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1436.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，CSN3102，结冰情况正在恶化，我们左发防冰失效，请求更高高度离开结冰区。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1437.audioText: C: China Southern 102, roger PAN PAN, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1437.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，收到 PANPAN，爬升并保持 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1437.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters, CSN3102.

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1438.audioText: B: Now you have left icing area, tell the controller that you have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1438.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离开结冰区，告诉管制员你在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1438.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3102, we have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1438.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3102，我们在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1439.audioText:
C: China Southern 102, descend to 900 meters on QNH 1014.
B: You confirm with Beijing Departure if you should descend to 900 meters because it is below the minimum safe altitude.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1439.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 102，QNH 1014 下降至 900 米。
B：你向北京离场确认是否应下降至 900 米，因为这低于最低安全高度。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1439.referenceText: Confirm descend to 900 meters, it is below the minimum safe altitude, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1439.referenceTextZh: 确认下降至 900 米，这低于最低安全高度，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1440.audioText: C: China Southern 102, my apologies, cancel speed restrictions, recleared to descend to 1500 meters on QNH 1014.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1440.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，抱歉，取消速度限制，重新许可 QNH 1014 下降至 1500 米。
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1440.referenceText: Cancel speed restrictions, descend to 1500 meters on QNH 1014, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0083-card-main-1440.referenceTextZh: 取消速度限制，QNH 1014 下降至 1500 米，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1441.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 001, a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are cruising at 9200 meters, squawking 3625.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1441.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 001，从广州飞往北京，在 9200 米巡航，应答机 3625。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1441.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3001, maintaining 9200 meters, squawking 3625.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1441.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN3001，保持 9200 米，应答机 3625。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1442.audioText: C: China Southern 001, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, maintain present level.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1442.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，广州管制，雷达识别，保持当前高度。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1443.audioText:
C: China Southern 001, there was a severe ride report by previous pilot at 10700 meters, what's your intention?
B: Tell the controller that you'd like to climb to 11300 meters.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1443.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 001，前机飞行员报告 10700 米有严重颠簸，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 11300 米。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1444.audioText: C: China Southern 001, roger, climb to and maintain 11300 meters.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1444.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，收到，爬升并保持 11300 米。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1444.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11300 meters, CSN3001.

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1445.audioText: B: During climb, the purser reports that an old lady was injured, report it to Guangzhou Control and request descend to 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1445.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，乘务长报告一位老太太受伤，向广州管制报告并请求下降至 8400 米。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1445.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3001, the purser reports that an old lady was injured, request descend to 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1445.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN3001，乘务长报告一位老太太受伤，请求下降至 8400 米。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1446.audioText: C: China Southern 001, roger, descend to maintain 8400 meters, expedite descent until passing 10100 due crossing traffic.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1446.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，收到，下降并保持 8400 米，因穿越飞机，通过 10100 前加快下降。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1446.referenceText: Descend to maintain 8400 meters, expedite descent until passing 10100 meters, CSN3001.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1446.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 8400 米，通过 10100 米前加快下降，CSN3001。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1447.audioText:
C: China Southern 001, when able, say you are further intention.
B: Tell Guangzhou Control that 2 passengers in Seat 35 Lima and 35 Hotel were seriously injured, and you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1447.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 001，能够时说明进一步意图。
B：告诉广州管制 35 Lima 和 35 Hotel 座位的 2 名旅客严重受伤，你想备降武汉机场。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1447.referenceText: 2 passengers in Seat 35L and 35H were seriously injured and we'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport, CSN3001.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1447.referenceTextZh: 35L 和 35H 座位的 2 名旅客严重受伤，我们想备降武汉机场，CSN3001。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1448.audioText: C: China Southern 001, roger, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9, we have informed them of your situation.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1448.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，收到，联系武汉管制118.9，我们已告知他们你的情况。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1449.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 8100 meters, you are over IKUBA, squawking 3625, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1449.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 8100 米，在 IKUBA 上空，应答机 3625，与武汉管制首次联系。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1449.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN3001, maintaining 8100 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 3625.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1449.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN3001，保持 8100 米，IKUBA 上空，应答机 3625。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1450.audioText: C: China Southern 001, Wuhan Control, radar contact, continue descent to 6300 meters, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1450.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，武汉管制，雷达识别，继续下降并保持 6300 米，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1450.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 6300 meters, turn right, direct to ZF, CSN3001.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1450.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 6300 米，右转，直飞 ZF，CSN3001。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1451.audioText: C: China 7001, descend and maintain 4500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1451.audioTextZh: C：China 7001，下降并保持 4500 米，联系武汉进近119.25。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1452.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 4500 meters, you have received the ATIS November, tell your situation to Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1452.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Zulu Foxtrot 上空，保持 4500 米，已收到 ATIS November，向武汉进近说明你的情况。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1452.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN3001, over ZF, maintaining 4500 meters, information N.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1452.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN3001，ZF 上空，保持 4500 米，通播 N。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1453.audioText:
C: China Southern 001, Wuhan Approach, roger, do you require any emergency services?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach you need ambulance and first aid upon arrival.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1453.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 001，武汉进近，收到，你需要任何应急服务吗？
B：告诉武汉进近你抵达时需要救护车和急救。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1453.referenceText: Request ambulance and first aid upon arrival, CSN3001.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1453.referenceTextZh: 请求抵达时救护车和急救，CSN3001。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1454.audioText: C: China Southern 001, we will relay your message to the related parties, you are number 1, now turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1454.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，我们会把你的信息转告相关单位，你是第 1 架，现在左转航向 120，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1454.referenceText: Turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CSN3001.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1454.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 120，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN3001。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1455.audioText: C: China Southern 001, runway 36R, cleared to land, the ambulance will be ready near the runway.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1455.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，跑道 36R，可以落地，救护车将在跑道附近准备好。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1456.audioText: B: You are unfamiliar with Wuhan Airport, contact Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you need a follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1456.audioTextZh: B：你不熟悉武汉机场，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你需要引导车。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1456.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3001, we are unfamiliar with Wuhan Airport, request a follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1456.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN3001，我们不熟悉武汉机场，请求引导车。

atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1457.audioText: C: China Southern 001, when vacated, follow the follow-me car to gate 213.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1457.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，脱离跑道后，跟随引导车到 213 号登机口。
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1457.referenceText: When vacated, follow the follow-me car to gate 213, CSN3001.
atc-scenario-0084-card-main-1457.referenceTextZh: 脱离跑道后，跟随引导车到 213 号登机口，CSN3001。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1458.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 102, a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are at gate 223, contact Guangzhou Ground and request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1458.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 102，从广州飞往北京，在 223 号登机口，联系广州地面并请求推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1458.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN3102, gate 223, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1458.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN3102，223 号登机口，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1459.audioText: C: China Southern 102, push back and start up approved, facing west.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1459.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意推出和开车，机头朝西。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1459.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1459.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，机头朝西，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1460.audioText: C: China Southern 102, stand by, expect 30 minutes delay, lightning and thunder were reported in the vicinity of the airport.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1460.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，等待，因机场附近报告闪电和雷声，预计延误 30 分钟。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1461.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, contact Ground and request taxi.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1461.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，联系地面并请求滑行。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1461.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN3102, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1461.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN3102，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1462.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi via Juliet 1, Zulu to holding point runway 19.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1462.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经 Juliet 1、Zulu 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1462.referenceText: Taxi via J1, Z to holding point runway 19, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1462.referenceTextZh: 经 J1、Z 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1463.audioText: B: You are holding at holding point Foxtrot 1 runway 19, you are ready for departure, contact Guangzhou Tower.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1463.audioTextZh: B：你在跑道 19 Foxtrot 1 等待点等待，准备好离场，联系广州塔台。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1463.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, holding point F1 runway 19, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1463.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，跑道 19 F1 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1464.audioText: B: Weather forecast says the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, you decide to taxi back to the apron for holding.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1464.audioTextZh: B：天气预报称雷暴约半小时内不会好转，你决定滑回机坪等待。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1464.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, request taxi back to the apron for holding.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1464.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，雷暴约半小时内不会好转，请求滑回机坪等待。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1465.audioText: C: China Southern 102, line up and wait runway 19, expect 30 minutes delay.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1465.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，进入跑道 19 等待，预计延误 30 分钟。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1465.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 19, CSN3102.

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1466.audioText: B: Thirty minutes later, the weather is improving, you observed a small cell 3 miles from runway 19, you ask to turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters to avoid it.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1466.audioTextZh: B：三十分钟后，天气正在好转，你观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，申请右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米以避开。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1466.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, we observed a small cell 3 miles from runway 19, request turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1466.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，我们观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，请求右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1467.audioText: C: China 7102, when airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff runway 19, contact Departure on 121.95.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1467.audioTextZh: C：China 7102，离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，跑道 19 可以起飞，联系离场 121.95。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1467.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff runway 19, 121.95, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1467.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，跑道 19 可以起飞，121.95，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1468.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Guangzhou Departure.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1468.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系广州离场。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1468.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN3102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1468.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN3102，已离地，通过 600 米。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1469.audioText: C: China Southern 102, Guangzhou Departure, radar contact, turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1469.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，广州离场，雷达识别，右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1469.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1469.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1470.audioText: C: China Southern 102, climb to 3000 meters on standard.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1470.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，标准气压爬升至 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1470.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters on standard, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1470.referenceTextZh: 标准气压爬升至 3000 米，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1471.audioText: B: During climb, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, contact Guangzhou Departure and request return to land.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1471.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，联系广州离场并请求返回着陆。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1471.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN3102, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, request return to land.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1471.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN3102，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，请求返回着陆。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1472.audioText:
C: China Southern 102, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need medical services upon landing.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1472.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 102，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员落地后你需要医疗服务。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1472.referenceText: Request medical services upon landing, CSN3102.

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1473.audioText: C: China Southern 102, medical services will be ready upon landing.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1473.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，医疗服务将在落地后准备好。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1474.audioText: C: China Southern 102, descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 19.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1474.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 19。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1474.referenceText: Descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 19, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1474.referenceTextZh: 下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 19，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1475.audioText: C: China Southern 102, cleared for ILS approach runway 19, report established.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1475.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，许可 ILS 进近跑道 19，报告建立。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1475.referenceText: Cleared for ILS approach runway 19, report established, CSN3102.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1475.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近跑道 19，报告建立，CSN3102。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1476.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS approach runway 19, contact Guangzhou Tower.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1476.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 19，联系广州塔台。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1476.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, established ILS approach runway 19.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1476.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 19。

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1477.audioText: B: Now you confirm if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1477.audioTextZh: B：现在你确认医疗服务是否会在登机口准备好。
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1477.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, is medical service ready at the gate ?
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1477.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，医疗服务是否已在登机口准备好？

atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1478.audioText: C: China Southern 102, the ambulance and medical staff have been ready at the gate.
atc-scenario-0085-card-main-1478.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，救护车和医护人员已在登机口准备好。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1479.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 235, a flight from Beijing to Shanghai Hongqiao, you are parking at 217, you have got information Golf, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1479.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 235，从北京飞往上海虹桥，停在 217，已收到通播 Golf，联系北京放行并请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1479.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN3235, gate 217, information G, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1479.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN3235，217 号登机口，通播 G，请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1480.audioText: C: China Southern 235, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, Lima Mike November 41 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1480.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，北京放行，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 08L，Lima Mike November 41 离场，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1480.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, LMN 41 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223, CSN3235.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1480.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 08L，LMN 41 离场，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223，CSN3235。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1481.audioText: C: China Southern 235, your slot time is 0800, expect 15 minutes delay due temporary airway restriction.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1481.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，你的时隙是 0800，因临时航路限制预计延误 15 分钟。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1481.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0800, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN3235.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1481.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙 0800，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN3235。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1482.audioText: C: China Southern 235, the airway restriction has been cancelled, report ready for start up.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1482.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，航路限制已取消，报告准备好开车。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1482.referenceText: Roger, report ready for start up, CSN3235.

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1483.audioText: B: All the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, you are fully ready.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1483.audioTextZh: B：所有旅客已登机，所有客舱门已关闭，你完全准备好。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1483.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, all passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, fully ready.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1483.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3235，所有旅客已登机，所有客舱门已关闭，完全准备好。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1484.audioText: C: China Southern 235, start up approved.

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1485.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1485.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, ready for push back.

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1486.audioText: C: China Southern 235, push back approved, facing south.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1486.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，同意推出，机头朝南。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1486.referenceText: Push back approved, facing south, CSN3235.

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1487.audioText: B: Now you have completed the push back, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1487.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，准备好滑行。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1487.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, push back completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1487.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3235，推出完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1488.audioText: C: China Southern 235, taxi via taxiway Tango 4, Delta and Alpha to holding point runway 08L.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1488.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，经滑行道 Tango 4、Delta 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 08L 等待点。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1488.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway T4, D and A to holding point runway 08L, CSN3235.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1488.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 T4、D 和 A 滑行至跑道 08L 等待点，CSN3235。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1489.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of runway 08L, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1489.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 08L 外等待，准备好离场，联系北京塔台。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1489.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3235, holding short of runway 08L, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1489.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN3235，跑道 08L 外等待，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1490.audioText: C: China Southern 235, line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, caution strong wind shear at the departure end of the runway.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1490.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，进入跑道 08L 并可以起飞，注意跑道离场端有强风切变。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1490.referenceText: Line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, roger, thanks, CSN3235.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1490.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 08L 并可以起飞，收到，谢谢，CSN3235。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1491.audioText: B: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters, report it to Beijing Departure.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1491.audioTextZh: B：刚离地后，你在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变，向北京离场报告。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1491.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3235, we encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1491.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3235，我们在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1492.audioText: C: China Southern 235, roger, climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to Lima Mike November.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1492.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，收到，爬升至 4200 米，恢复自主导航至 Lima Mike November。
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1492.referenceText: Climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN, CSN3235.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1492.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4200 米，恢复自主导航至 LMN，CSN3235。

atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1493.audioText: C: China Southern 235, continue climb to 5100 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.9.
atc-scenario-0086-card-main-1493.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 235，继续爬升至 5100 米，联系北京管制118.9。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1494.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 682, you are at stand Kilo 38 with information Bravo, your destination is Guangzhou, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1494.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 682，在 Kilo 38 号停机位，通播 Bravo，目的地广州，向武汉放行请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1494.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN6682, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1494.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN6682，K38 停机位，通播 B，请求 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1495.audioText:
C: China Southern 682, I read you 3, loud background whistle, check your transmitter.
B: You have the transmitter checked and carry out radio check with Wuhan Delivery on the frequency 118.3.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1495.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 682，我听你 3，背景有很大的哨音，检查你的发射机。
B：你检查发射机后，在 118.3 频率与武汉放行进行无线电检查。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1495.referenceText:
Wuhan Delivery, CSN6682, radio check on frequency 118.3,
1，2，3，4，5, how do you read?
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1495.referenceTextZh:
武汉放行，CSN6682，在频率 118.3 无线电检查，
1，2，3，4，5，你听我怎样？

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1496.audioText:
C: China Southern 682, I read you 5.
B: Acknowledge the transmission and request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1496.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 682，我听你 5。
B：确认收到并请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1496.referenceText: Roger, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance, CSN6682.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1496.referenceTextZh: 收到，K38 停机位，通播 B，请求 ATC 放行许可，CSN6682。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1497.audioText: C: China Southern 682, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 01 Departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1497.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，武汉放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1497.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow LKO 01 Departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115, CSN6682.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1497.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO 01 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115，CSN6682。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1498.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, and you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1498.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1499.audioText: C: China Southern 682, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1499.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1499.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, CSN6682.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1499.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN6682。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1500.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1500.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1500.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN6682, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1500.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN6682，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1501.audioText: C: China Southern 682, runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 5 knots.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1501.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，跑道 36R，可以起飞，地面风 350 度，5 节。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1502.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1502.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1502.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, airborne, passing 600 meters.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1502.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN6682，已离地，通过 600 米。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1503.audioText: C: China Southern 682, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1503.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，武汉进近，雷达识别，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1503.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters, CSN6682.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1503.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN6682。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1504.audioText: B: During climb, you find that the flaps are jammed at takeoff position, inform Wuhan Approach this situation, and ask to fly direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha for trouble shooting.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1504.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现襟翼卡在起飞位置，告知武汉进近该情况，并请求直飞 Whiskey Hotel Alpha 排故。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1504.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, our flaps are jammed at takeoff position, request fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1504.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN6682，我们的襟翼卡在起飞位置，请求直飞 WHA 排故。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1505.audioText: C: China Southern 682, roger, turn right, direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at Whiskey Hotel Alpha as published.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1505.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，收到，右转，直飞 Whiskey Hotel Alpha，爬升并保持 3000 米，在 Whiskey Hotel Alpha 按公布程序等待。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1505.referenceText: Turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published, CSN6682.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1505.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米，在 WHA 按公布程序等待，CSN6682。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1506.audioText: B: During hold, you notice that 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid rapidly, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach and request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1506.audioTextZh: B：等待中，你注意到 1 套液压系统正在快速漏液，向武汉进近发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求下降返回武汉机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1506.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, 1 of the hydraulic system is leaking fuel rapidly, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1506.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN6682，1 套液压系统正在快速漏燃油，请求下降并返回武汉机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1507.audioText: C: China Southern 682, roger PAN, turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1507.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，下降至 2400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1507.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R, CSN6682.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1507.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，下降至 2400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN6682。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1508.audioText: C: China Southern 682, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1508.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1508.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, report established, CSN6682.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1508.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立，CSN6682。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1509.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the localizer runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1509.audioTextZh: B：现在你已截获跑道 36R 航向道，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1509.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN6682, established localizer runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1509.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN6682，已建立跑道 36R 航向道。

atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1510.audioText: C: China Southern 682, cleared to land runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0087-card-main-1510.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 682，跑道 36R 可以落地。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1511.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 302, you are at parking bay 235, you are ready for push back, contact Guangzhou Ground.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1511.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 302，在 235 号停机位，准备好推出，联系广州地面。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1511.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, bay 235, ready for push back.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1511.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN9302，235 号机位，准备好推出。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1512.audioText: C: China Southern 302, stand by, expect 20 minutes delay, thunderstorm is approaching the airport, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1512.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，等待，预计延误 20 分钟，雷暴正接近机场，多架飞机因等待天气好转而等待。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1513.audioText:
C: China Southern 302, report tug is ready.
B: Tell the controller the tug is in position and you are ready for push back.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1513.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 302，报告拖车准备好。
B：告诉管制员拖车已到位，你准备好推出。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1513.referenceText: The tug is ready and we are ready for push back, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1513.referenceTextZh: 拖车已准备好，我们准备好推出，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1514.audioText: C: China Southern 302, push back approved, facing east, runway 19, stand by for start up.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1514.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，同意推出，机头朝东，跑道 19，等待开车。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1514.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, runway 19, stand by for start up, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1514.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝东，跑道 19，等待开车，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1515.audioText: B: Now you have been waiting for the start of clearance for about 15 minutes, contact Guangzhou Ground for start up.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1515.audioTextZh: B：现在你已等待开车许可约 15 分钟，联系广州地面请求开车。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1515.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, we have been waiting for about 15 minutes, request start up.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1515.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN9302，我们已等待约 15 分钟，请求开车。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1516.audioText: C: China Southern 302, expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, report when ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1516.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，预计 49 离场，自行决定开车，QNH 1008，准备滑行时报告。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1516.referenceText: Expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1516.referenceTextZh: 预计 49 离场，自行决定开车，QNH 1008，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1517.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1518.audioText: C: China Southern 302, taxi via Juliette, Delta, Tango 3 and Tango 4 to holding point runway 19.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1518.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，经 Juliette、Delta、Tango 3 和 Tango 4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1518.referenceText: Taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to holding point runway 19, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1518.referenceTextZh: 经 J、D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1519.audioText: C: China Southern 302, hold short of Tango 3, give way to Airbus 320 crossing from right to left.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1519.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，Tango 3 外等待，避让从右至左穿越的 Airbus 320。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1519.referenceText: Hold short of T3, give way to A320, CSN9302.

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1520.audioText: C: China Southern 302, traffic is clear, continue taxi via Delta, Tango 3 and Tango 4 to holding point runway 19.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1520.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，交通已脱离，继续经 Delta、Tango 3 和 Tango 4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1520.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to holding point runway 19, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1520.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1521.audioText: B: Now you are holding point Foxtrot 1, runway 19, you are fully ready, contact Guangzhou Tower.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1521.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Foxtrot 1、跑道 19 等待点，完全准备好，联系广州塔台。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1521.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN9302, holding point F1, runway 19, fully ready.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1521.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN9302，F1 等待点，跑道 19，完全准备好。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1522.audioText:
C: China Southern 302, line up and wait runway 19, caution thunderstorm building up at the departure end of runway 19.
B: Read back ATC clearance and request right turn when airborne due weather.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1522.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 302，跑道 19 进跑道等待，注意跑道 19 离场端雷暴正在发展。
B：复诵 ATC 许可并因天气请求离地后右转。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1522.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 19, request right turn when airborne due weather, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1522.referenceTextZh: 跑道 19 进跑道等待，因天气请求离地后右转，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1523.audioText: C: China Southern 302, turn right heading 120, direct to Lima Mike November, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 180 degrees, 5 meters per second.
