atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1523.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，右转航向 120，直飞 Lima Mike November，跑道 19 可以起飞，地面风 180 度，5 米/秒。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1523.referenceText: Turn right heading 120, direct to LMN, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1523.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，跑道 19 可以起飞，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1524.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120, contact Guangzhou Approach.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1524.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120，联系广州进近。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1524.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1524.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN9302，已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1525.audioText: C: China Southern 302, climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1525.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，QNH 1008 爬升至 2700 米。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1525.referenceText: Climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008, CSN9302.

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1526.audioText: B: During climb, suddenly you have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, your instruments are indicating incorrectly, report it to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1526.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你突然被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，向广州进近报告并请求返回着陆。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1526.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, we have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1526.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN9302，我们被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，请求返回着陆。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1527.audioText: C: China Southern 302, roger, descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final runway 19.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1527.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，收到，下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导至跑道 19 五边。
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1527.referenceText: Descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final runway 19, CSN9302.
atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1527.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导至跑道 19 五边，CSN9302。

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1528.audioText: C: China Southern 302, contact Guangzhou Tower on 118.5.

atc-scenario-0088-card-main-1529.audioText: C: China Southern 302, runway 19, cleared to land.

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1530.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 556, from Seoul to Wuhan, you are maintaining 9200 meters, approaching Juliet Tango November, squawking 1532, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1530.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 556，从首尔飞往武汉，保持 9200 米，接近 Juliet Tango November，应答机 1532，与上海管制首次联系。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1530.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES556, maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1530.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES556，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1531.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, direct to Tango Oscar Lima, reduce speed to Mach 0.79.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1531.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，直飞 Tango Oscar Lima，减速至马赫 0.79。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1531.referenceText: Direct to TOL, reduce speed to M.79, CES556.

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1532.audioText: B: Near Tango Oscar Lima, you are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, contact Shanghai Control and request climb.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1532.audioTextZh: B：在 Tango Oscar Lima 附近，你在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，联系上海管制并请求爬升。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1532.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES556, we are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, request climb.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1532.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES556，我们在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，请求爬升。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1533.audioText:
C: China Eastern 556, the alternative level is 11600 meters, what's your intention?
B: Tell the controller you can accept 11600 meters.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1533.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 556，备选高度为 11600 米，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你可以接受 11600 米。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1534.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1534.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1534.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1534.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1535.audioText: B: You receive the report from the cabin that a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, you suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, you want to fly lower levels.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1535.audioTextZh: B：你收到客舱报告，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，你怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，想飞较低高度。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1535.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES556, a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, we suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, request descent to lower levels.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1535.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES556，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，我们怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，请求下降至较低高度。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1536.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, maintain 11600 meters due to airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1536.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，因空域拥挤，保持 11600 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1536.referenceText: Maintain 11600 meters, reduce speed to M.75, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1536.referenceTextZh: 保持 11600 米，减速至 M.75，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1537.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, contact Wuhan Control on 128.55.

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1538.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent now.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1538.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，向武汉管制报告并请求立即下降。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1538.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, the flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, request descent now.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1538.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES556，乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，请求立即下降。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1539.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, descend to 6600 meters and level by X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1539.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，下降至 6600 米，并在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 前改平。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1539.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1539.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1540.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, due to temporary airspace restriction is effective immediately, after passing X-Ray Sierra Hotel, follow Zulu Foxtrot 03 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1540.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，因临时空域限制立即生效，过 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 后，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 03 Alpha 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1540.referenceText: After passing XSH, follow ZF 03A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1540.referenceTextZh: 过 XSH 后，执行 ZF 03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1541.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, contact Wuhan Approach 120.4.

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1542.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information Oscar, contact Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1542.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Zulu Foxtrot 上空，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 Oscar，联系武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1542.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1542.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，通播 O。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1543.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information is Papa, descend and maintain 4200 meters.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1543.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，武汉进近，雷达识别，通播是 Papa，下降并保持 4200 米。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1543.referenceText: Roger, information P, descend and maintain 4200 meters, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1543.referenceTextZh: 收到，通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1544.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a cumuliform clouds ahead, contact Wuhan Approach and request turn left and track direct to Hotel Golf.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1544.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方积状云，联系武汉进近并请求左转直飞 Hotel Golf。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1544.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, our weather radar observed CB ahead, request turn left and track direct to HG.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1544.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，我们的气象雷达观察到前方 CB，请求左转并直飞 HG。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1545.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1545.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1545.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1545.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1546.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1546.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1546.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1546.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1547.audioText: B: While intercepting the localizer, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, the purser make an emergency call said there are still passengers standing in the cabin, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1547.audioTextZh: B：截获航向道时，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，乘务长紧急呼叫称客舱仍有旅客站立，通知武汉进近该情况并请求终止进近，前往等待区。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1547.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, there are still passengers standing in the cabin, request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1547.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，客舱仍有旅客站立，请求终止进近并前往等待区。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1548.audioText: C: China Eastern 556, turn left, direct to Delta Alpha, climb to 1200 meters, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1548.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 556，左转，直飞 Delta Alpha，爬升至 1200 米，按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 50。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1548.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, expect further clearance at time 50, CES556.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1548.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，预计进一步许可时间 50，CES556。

atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1549.audioText: B: Now the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, advise the Approach controller you are ready to leave the hold.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1549.audioTextZh: B：现在问题旅客已被妥善约束，告知进近管制员你准备好离开等待。
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1549.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, request leave the hold.
atc-scenario-0089-card-main-1549.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES556，问题旅客已被妥善约束，请求离开等待。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1550.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 232, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are taxiing Southbound on taxiway Charlie to holding point runway 36L, call Wuhan Tower for takeoff clearance.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1550.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 232，从武汉飞往新加坡，正在 Charlie 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台请求起飞许可。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1550.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES232, taxiing Southbound on taxiway C to holding point runway 36L, request takeoff clearance.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1550.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES232，正在 C 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，请求起飞许可。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1551.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, Wuhan Tower, line up and wait runway 36L.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1551.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，武汉塔台，跑道 36L 进跑道等待。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1551.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 36L, CES232.

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1552.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, wind calm, cleared for takeoff runway 36L, contact Wuhan Departure 118.25 when airborne.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1552.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，风静，跑道 36L 可以起飞，离地后联系武汉离场 118.25。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1553.audioText: B: After airborne, you have an undercarriage warning, the indication shows your right main gear has not been retracted, call Wuhan Approach and request maintain 1500 meters and speed 200 knots.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1553.audioTextZh: B：离地后，你有起落架警告，指示显示右主起落架未收上，呼叫武汉进近并请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1553.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES232, we have an undercarriage warning, our right main gear has not been retracted, request maintain 1500m and speed 200kts.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1553.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES232，我们有起落架警告，右主起落架未收上，请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1554.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, Wuhan Approach, roger, climb and maintain 1500 meters, speed 200 knots approved, advise intentions when able.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1554.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，武汉进近，收到，爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节同意，能够时告知意图。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1554.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1500m, speed 200 knots, CES232.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1554.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节，CES232。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1555.audioText: B: After performing the abnormal checklist, you still cannot confirm the landing gear position, tell Wuhan Approach you want to return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1555.audioTextZh: B：完成非正常检查单后，你仍无法确认起落架位置，告诉武汉进近你想返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1555.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES232, we cannot confirm the landing gear position, request return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1555.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES232，我们无法确认起落架位置，请求返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1556.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, turn right track direct to Echo Bravo NDB, descend and maintain 1200 meters, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1556.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，右转直飞 Echo Bravo NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1556.referenceText: Turn right track direct to EB NDB, descend and maintain 1200m, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CES232.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1556.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 EB NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES232。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1557.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, you are 11 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.5.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1557.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，你距接地点 11 海里，联系武汉塔台118.5。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1558.audioText: B: Call Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you have established ILS runway 36R and you are ready for the low-pass.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1558.audioTextZh: B：呼叫武汉塔台并告诉管制员你已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1558.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES232, established ILS runway 36R, ready for low-pass.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1558.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES232，已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1559.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, wind calm, cleared low-pass runway 36R, not below 200 meters above the runway.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1559.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，风静，跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1559.referenceText: Cleared low-pass runway 36R, not below 200m above the runway, CES232.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1559.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米，CES232。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1560.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, after low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200 meters.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1560.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1560.referenceText: After low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200m, CES232.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1560.referenceTextZh: 低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米，CES232。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1561.audioText:
C: China Eastern 232, we’ve had a good look at your undercarriage, your right main gear seems to be in the extended position, advise intentions.
B: Tell Wuhan Tower the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, you want to perform a hold over Whiskey Hotel Alpha as published.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1561.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 232，我们已看清你的起落架，你的右主起落架似乎在放下位置，告知意图。
B：告诉武汉塔台指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，你想在 Whiskey Hotel Alpha 上空按公布程序等待。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1561.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES232, the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, request hold over WHA as published.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1561.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES232，指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，请求在 WHA 按公布程序等待。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1562.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, turn left proceed direct to Delta Alpha, climb and maintain 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.225.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1562.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，左转直飞 Delta Alpha，爬升并保持 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.225。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1562.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct to DA, climb and maintain 1500m, 119.225, CES232.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1562.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 1500 米，119.225，CES232。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1563.audioText: B: You are tracking direct to Delta Alpha, maintaining 1500 meters, call Wuhan Approach and request holding instructions.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1563.audioTextZh: B：你正直飞 Delta Alpha，保持 1500 米，呼叫武汉进近并请求等待指令。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1563.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES232, tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1500m, request holding instructions.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1563.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES232，正直飞 DA，保持 1500 米，请求等待指令。

atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1564.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, hold at Delta Alpha as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1564.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，武汉进近，雷达识别，在 Delta Alpha 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待。
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1564.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold, CES232.
atc-scenario-0090-card-main-1564.referenceTextZh: 在 DA 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待，CES232。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1565.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 529, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1565.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 529，保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1566.audioText: C: China Eastern 529, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10400 meters.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1566.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 529，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10400 米。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1567.audioText: B: Now you are cruising at 10400 meters, your instruments indicate 1 of your air conditioning packs has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1567.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 10400 米巡航，仪表显示 1 个空调组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1567.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES529, maintaining 10400 meters, our instruments indicate 1 of our air conditioning packs has malfunctioned, request descend to lower levels.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1567.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES529，保持 10400 米，我们的仪表显示 1 个空调组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1568.audioText: C: China Eastern 529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1568.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 529，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1568.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially, CES529.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1568.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米，CES529。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1569.audioText: B: During descent, your right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned and request emergency descent, this is a Distress call.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1569.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降，这是遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1569.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES529, our right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1569.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES529，我们的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1570.audioText: B: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a Distress call.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1570.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1570.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES529, our cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1570.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES529，我们的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1571.audioText: C: China Eastern 529, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1571.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 529，QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1571.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES529.

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1572.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel Distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1572.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险，向上海进近报告。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1572.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES529, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel Distress.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1572.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES529，保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1573.audioText: B: The cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are seriously injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request diversion to Hangzhou.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1573.audioTextZh: B：客舱机组报告 5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1573.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES529, 5 passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1573.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES529，5 名旅客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1574.audioText:
C: China Eastern 529, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances upon arrival.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1574.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 529，同意备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员抵达时需要救护车。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1574.referenceText: Divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances upon arrival, CES529.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1574.referenceTextZh: 同意备降杭州，请求抵达时救护车，CES529。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1575.audioText: C: China Eastern 529, roger, ambulance will be ready upon arrival.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1575.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 529，收到，救护车将在抵达时准备好。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1576.audioText: C: China Eastern 529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach runway 06.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1576.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 529，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1576.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach runway 06, CES529.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1576.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06，CES529。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1577.audioText: B: Now tell Hangzhou Tower about your situation and request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1577.audioTextZh: B：现在告诉杭州塔台你的情况并请求优先着陆。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1577.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES529, 5 passengers were seriously injured during emergency descent, request priority landing.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1577.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES529，5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，请求优先着陆。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1578.audioText: C: China Eastern 529, straight ILS approach runway 06, report established.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1578.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 529，直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1578.referenceText: Straight ILS approach runway 06, report established, CES529.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1578.referenceTextZh: 直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立，CES529。

atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1579.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach runway 06.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1579.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1579.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES529, established on ILS approach runway 06.
atc-scenario-0091-card-main-1579.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES529，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1580.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 565, from Wuhan to Los Angeles, you are parking at gate 227, with information Mike, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1580.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 565，从武汉飞往洛杉矶，停在 227 号登机口，通播 Mike，请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1580.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES565, gate 227, information M, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1580.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES565，227 号登机口，通播 M，请求飞往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1581.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, runway in use 36L, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10100 meters, squawk 5655.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1581.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，使用跑道 36L，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，应答机 5655。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1581.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, ZF 01 departure, runway in use 36L, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10100 meters, squawk 5655, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1581.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，ZF 01 离场，使用跑道 36L，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，应答机 5655，CES565。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1582.audioText: B: You are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1582.audioTextZh: B：你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1582.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES565, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1582.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES565，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1583.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, after company Airbus 340 is clear, push back and start up approved, facing west.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1583.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，同公司 Airbus 340 脱离后，同意推出和开车，机头朝西。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1583.referenceText: After company Airbus 340 is clear, push back and start up approved, facing west, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1583.referenceTextZh: 同公司 Airbus 340 脱离后，同意推出和开车，机头朝西，CES565。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1584.audioText: B: Now the push back and start up is completed, ask for taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1584.audioTextZh: B：现在推出和开车已完成，请求滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1584.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES565, push back and start up is completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1584.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES565，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1585.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, taxi to holding point 36 left via taxiway Zulu 4, Charlie and Charlie 1.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1585.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Charlie 和 Charlie 1 滑行至 36L 等待点。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1585.referenceText: Taxi to holding point 36L via taxiway Z4, C and C1, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1585.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、C 和 C1 滑行至 36L 等待点，CES565。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1586.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36L, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1586.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36L 等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1586.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES565, holding point runway 36L, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1586.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES565，跑道 36L 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1587.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, behind landing Air China Boeing 747 on short final, line up and wait behind.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1587.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，在短五边落地的 Air China Boeing 747 后，跟在后面进跑道等待。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1587.referenceText: Behind landing Air China B747 on short final, line up and wait behind, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1587.referenceTextZh: 在短五边落地的 Air China B747 后，跟在后面进跑道等待，CES565。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1588.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, wind 350 degrees, 2 meters per second, cleared for takeoff runway 36L, after departure, contact Wuhan Departure 125.35.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1588.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，风 350 度，2 米/秒，跑道 36L 可以起飞，离场后联系武汉离场 125.35。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1588.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 36L, after departure, contact Wuhan Departure 125.35, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1588.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36L 可以起飞，离场后联系武汉离场 125.35，CES565。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1589.audioText: B: You are cruising at 3300 meters, you are encountering moderate icing, contact Wuhan Control and ask for a higher level.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1589.audioTextZh: B：你在 3300 米巡航，遭遇中度结冰，联系武汉管制并请求更高高度。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1589.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES565, we are encountering moderate icing at 3300 meters, request a higher level.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1589.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES565，我们在 3300 米遭遇中度结冰，请求更高高度。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1590.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, climb and maintain 9500 meters.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1590.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，爬升并保持 9500 米。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1591.audioText: B: Suddenly, you got a warning, you are leaking the bleed air and the cabin altitude is rising slowly, inform Wuhan Control you want to level off and might expect emergency descent soon.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1591.audioTextZh: B：突然你收到警告，正在漏引气，客舱高度缓慢上升，通知武汉管制你想改平，并可能很快需要紧急下降。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1591.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES565, we have a warning that the bleed air is leaking, the cabin altitude is rising slowly, request level off and emergency descent.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1591.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES565，我们有引气泄漏警告，客舱高度缓慢上升，请求改平并紧急下降。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1592.audioText: B: The bleed air is no longer supplying and the high cabin altitude warning is triggered, make an Emergency call and tell the controller you want to make an emergency descent to 3000 meters, and request radar vectors.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1592.audioTextZh: B：引气不再供应，高客舱高度警告触发，发布紧急呼叫并告诉管制员你想紧急下降至 3000 米，并请求雷达引导。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1592.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CES565, the high cabin altitude warning is triggered, request emergency descent to 3000 meters and request radar vectors.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1592.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，CES565，高客舱高度警告触发，请求紧急下降至 3000 米并请求雷达引导。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1593.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, turn right heading 180, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1018.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1593.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，右转航向 180，QNH 1018 下降至 3000 米。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1593.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1018, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1593.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，QNH 1018 下降至 3000 米，CES565。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1594.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 3000 meters in icing condition, contact Wuhan Approach and ask for landing information.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1594.audioTextZh: B：现在你在结冰条件下到达 3000 米，联系武汉进近并请求落地信息。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1594.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES565, reaching 3000 meters in icing condition, request landing information.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1594.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES565，在结冰条件下到达 3000 米，请求落地信息。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1595.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, direct to Hotel Golf, Zulu Foxtrot 01 arrival, expect ILS approach 36 left.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1595.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，直飞 Hotel Golf，Zulu Foxtrot 01 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1595.referenceText: Direct to HG, ZF 01 arrival, expect ILS approach 36L, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1595.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HG，ZF 01 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L，CES565。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1596.audioText: B: During approach, your slats can't be extended, request the longer runway 36R and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1596.audioTextZh: B：进近中，你的缝翼无法放出，请求较长的跑道 36R 并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1596.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES565, our slats can't be extended, request the longer runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1596.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES565，我们的缝翼无法放出，请求较长的跑道 36R。

atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1597.audioText: C: China Eastern 565, change runway 36R, continue present heading, descend to 900 meters.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1597.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 565，改用跑道 36R，继续当前航向，下降至 900 米。
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1597.referenceText: Runway 36R, continue present heading, descend to 900 meters, CES565.
atc-scenario-0092-card-main-1597.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，继续当前航向，下降至 900 米，CES565。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1598.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 728, you are parking at gate 212, you have received information Whiskey, ask Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1598.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 728，停在 212 号登机口，已收到通播 Whiskey，向武汉放行请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1598.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES728, gate 212, information W, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1598.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES728，212 号登机口，通播 W，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1599.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.6, squawk 3615.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1599.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 728，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 02 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.6，应答机 3615。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1599.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via fight planned route, departure runway 36R, LKO 02 departure, initially climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.6, squawk 3615, CES728.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1599.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO 02 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.6，应答机 3615，CES728。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1600.audioText: B: Now you have been pushed back with engines running, request taxi instructions.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1600.audioTextZh: B：现在你已推出，发动机运转，请求滑行指令。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1601.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1601.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 728，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1601.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CES728.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1601.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES728。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1602.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, give way to Air China Airbus 319 on Alpha 7, you are number 2 for departure.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1602.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 728，避让 Alpha 7 上的 Air China Airbus 319，你是第 2 架离场。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1603.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, contact Tower for takeoff clearance.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1603.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，联系塔台请求起飞许可。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1603.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES728, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1603.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES728，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1604.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, line up and wait, expect 1 minute delay, there will be a helicopter crossing the runway from left to right.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1604.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 728，进跑道等待，预计延误 1 分钟，将有直升机从左至右穿越跑道。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1604.referenceText: Line up and wait, roger, CES728.

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1605.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, wind 010 degrees, 2 meters per second, cleared for takeoff, caution storm approaching north of the airport.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1605.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 728，风 010 度，2 米/秒，可以起飞，注意机场北侧有风暴接近。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1605.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 36R, roger, thanks, CES728.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1605.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，收到，谢谢，CES728。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1606.audioText: B: It's much later in the flight, you are at cruising level, ask Wuhan Control if 10400 meters is available, and if there is any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft on that level.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1606.audioTextZh: B：飞行后段，你在巡航高度，询问武汉管制 10400 米是否可用，以及前机是否报告该高度有颠簸。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1606.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES728, is 10400 meters available? is there any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10400 meters?
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1606.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES728，10400 米是否可用？前机是否报告 10400 米有颠簸？

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1607.audioText:
C: China Eastern 728, 10400 meters is available. There is no turbulence report at 10400 meters.
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 10400 meters.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1607.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 728，10400 米可用。10400 米没有颠簸报告。
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 10400 米。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1608.audioText: B: Now you are in Guangzhou Control, cruising at 10400 meters because you are encountering severe icing, you want to descend to a lower level.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1608.audioTextZh: B：现在你在广州管制区，由于在 10400 米遭遇严重结冰，你想下降至较低高度。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1608.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CES728, we are encountering severe icing at 10400 meters, request descend to a lower level.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1608.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CES728，我们在 10400 米遭遇严重结冰，请求下降至较低高度。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1609.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, descend to and maintain 4200 meters, maintain high speed.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1609.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 728，下降并保持 4200 米，保持大速度。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1609.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200 meters, maintain high speed, CES728.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1609.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，保持大速度，CES728。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1610.audioText: B: You are now with Guangzhou Approach, you want to maintain high speed as long as possible to avoid ice accumulation, tell ATC.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1610.audioTextZh: B：你现在与广州进近联系，你想尽可能长时间保持大速度以避免积冰，告诉 ATC。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1610.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CES728, request maintain high speed to avoid ice accumulation
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1610.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CES728，请求保持大速度以避免积冰。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1611.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, no speed restrictions.

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1612.audioText: B: While on final approach, you notice the approach lights are 2 dim, ask the controller to increase the intensity of the approach lights.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1612.audioTextZh: B：在最后进近时，你注意到进近灯太暗，请求管制员增加进近灯亮度。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1612.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CES728, the approach lights are 2 dim, request brighten the approach lights.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1612.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CES728，进近灯太暗，请求调亮进近灯。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1613.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, roger, the approach flights will be turned up shortly, cleared to land runway 20L, surface wind calm, caution runway is wet, braking action medium.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1613.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 728，收到，进近灯很快会调亮，跑道 20L 可以落地，地面风静，注意跑道湿，刹车效应中等。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1613.referenceText: Roger, thanks, cleared to land runway 20L, CES728.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1613.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，跑道 20L 可以落地，CES728。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1614.audioText: B: After landing, you have difficulty in taxiing in poor visibility, contact Guangzhou Ground for a follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1614.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你在低能见度下滑行困难，联系广州地面请求引导车。
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1614.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CES728, we have difficulty in taxing in poor visibility, request a follow-me car.
atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1614.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CES728，我们在低能见度下滑行困难，请求引导车。

atc-scenario-0093-card-main-1615.audioText: C: China Eastern 728, the follow-me car will come soon.

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1616.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 769, a flight from Wuhan to Amsterdam, you are parking at stand 221, you have received information Charlie, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1616.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 769，从武汉飞往阿姆斯特丹，停在 221 号停机位，已收到通播 Charlie，请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1616.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, stand 221, information C, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1616.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES769，221 号停机位，通播 C，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1617.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, Hotel Zulu 01 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1617.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，武汉放行，许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 1800 米，Hotel Zulu 01 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1617.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, HZ 01 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562, CES769.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1617.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 1800 米，HZ 01 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562，CES769。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1618.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1618.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1618.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES769, request push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1618.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES769，请求推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1619.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1619.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1619.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south, CES769.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1619.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南，CES769。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1620.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1620.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1621.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, taxi via Delta, Delta 4, hold short of runway 36.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1621.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，经 Delta、Delta 4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1621.referenceText: Taxi via D, D4, hold short of runway 36, CES769.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1621.referenceTextZh: 经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待，CES769。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1622.audioText: B: During taxiing, a passenger opened an emergency exit, inform the controller of this situation and airport security is needed to remove the passenger.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1622.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，一名旅客打开了应急出口，通知管制员该情况并需要机场安保带走该旅客。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1622.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES769, a passenger opened an emergency exit, request airport security to remove the passenger.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1622.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES769，一名旅客打开了应急出口，请求机场安保带走该旅客。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1623.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, Hotel Zulu 02 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, the rest unchanged.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1623.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，起始爬升 2100 米，Hotel Zulu 02 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，其余不变。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1623.referenceText: Recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, HZ 02 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, the rest unchanged, CES769.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1623.referenceTextZh: 重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，起始爬升 2100 米，HZ 02 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，其余不变，CES769。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1624.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point Whiskey 2 runway 36, contact Wuhan Tower and ask the permission to cross runway 36.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1624.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 Whiskey 2 等待点等待，联系武汉塔台并请求穿越跑道 36。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1624.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, holding point W2 runway36, request cross runway 36.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1624.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES769，跑道 36 W2 等待点，请求穿越跑道 36。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1625.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, expedite cross runway 36, when vacated, taxi the taxiway Zulu 5, Alpha 4 and Alpha, hold short of runway 04.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1625.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，快速穿越跑道 36，脱离后，经滑行道 Zulu 5、Alpha 4 和 Alpha 滑行，跑道 04 外等待。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1625.referenceText: Expedite cross runway 36, when vacated, taxi the taxiway Z5, A4 and A, hold short of runway 04, CES769.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1625.referenceTextZh: 快速穿越跑道 36，脱离后，经滑行道 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行，跑道 04 外等待，CES769。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1626.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of runway 04, you are ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1626.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1626.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, holding short of runway 04, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1626.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES769，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1627.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, line up runway 04.

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1628.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, cleared for takeoff runway 04, surface wind 020, 2 meters per second.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1628.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 020，2 米/秒。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1629.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 11000 meters, over Whiskey X-Ray India, squawking 3562, contact Beijing Control.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1629.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 11000 米，在 Whiskey X-Ray India 上空，应答机 3562，联系北京管制。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1629.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES769, maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 3562.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1629.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CES769，保持 11000 米，WXI 上空，应答机 3562。

atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1630.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, increase speed to Mach 0.83 or greater, fly direct to Papa Echo Kilo.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1630.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，增速至马赫 0.83 或更大，直飞 Papa Echo Kilo。
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1630.referenceText: Increase speed to M.83 or greater, fly direct to PEK, CES769.
atc-scenario-0094-card-main-1630.referenceTextZh: 增速至 M.83 或更大，直飞 PEK，CES769。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1631.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 151, you are at gate 232, you have got information Sierra, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1631.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 151，在 232 号登机口，已收到通播 Sierra，向武汉放行请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1631.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES2151, gate 232, information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1631.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES2151，232 号登机口，通播 S，请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1632.audioText: C: China Eastern 151, Wuhan Delivery, information Sierra is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, squawk 4125.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1632.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 151，武汉放行，通播 Sierra 有效，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，起始爬升至 1800 米，Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1632.referenceText: Information Sierra is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, ZF 01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, squawk 4125, CES2151.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1632.referenceTextZh: 通播 Sierra 有效，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，起始爬升至 1800 米，ZF 01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125，CES2151。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1633.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1633.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1633.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES2151, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1633.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES2151，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1634.audioText: C: China Eastern 151, push back and start up approved, push back to taxiway Zulu 4, facing west.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1634.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 151，同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Zulu 4，机头朝西。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1634.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push back to taxiway Z4, facing west, CES2151.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1634.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Z4，机头朝西，CES2151。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1635.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar was broke and slash bent, report it to Ground controller and request a new tow bar.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1635.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖杆断裂并弯曲，向地面管制员报告并请求新的拖杆。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1635.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES2151, the tow bar was bent during push back, request a new tow bar.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1635.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES2151，推出过程中拖杆弯曲，请求新的拖杆。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1636.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back with engines running on taxiway Zulu 4, ask Ground for taxiing instructions.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1636.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Zulu 4 已完成推出，发动机运转，向地面请求滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1636.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES2151, push back and start up completed, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1636.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES2151，推出和开车完成，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1637.audioText: C: China Eastern 151, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1637.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 151，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1637.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, CES2151.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1637.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES2151。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1638.audioText: C: China Eastern 151, hold short of Alpha 7, give way to Airbus 320 coming from your right, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway Alpha to holding point runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1638.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 151，Alpha 7 外等待，避让从你右侧来的 Airbus 320，交通脱离后继续经滑行道 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1638.referenceText: Hold short of A7, traffic in sight, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point runway 36R, CES2151.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1638.referenceTextZh: A7 外等待，看到飞机，交通脱离后继续经滑行道 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES2151。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1639.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, report it to Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1639.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，向武汉塔台报告并核实风。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1639.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES2151, holding point runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, request wind check.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1639.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES2151，跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，请求风检查。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1640.audioText:
C: China Eastern 151, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tail wind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to runway 18L and state the reason.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1640.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 151，风 200 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台改用跑道 18L 并说明原因。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1640.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES2151, the tail wind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1640.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES2151，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1641.audioText: B: Now you are airborne from runway 18L, you encountered a bird strike during the initial climb, 1 of your engines failed, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and tell the controller you intend to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1641.audioTextZh: B：现在你从跑道 18L 离地，初始爬升中遭遇鸟击，1 台发动机失效，向武汉进近通报情况并告诉管制员你打算返回武汉机场着陆。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1641.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CES2151, we encountered a bird strike during initial climb, 1 of our engines failed, request return to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1641.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CES2151，我们在初始爬升中遭遇鸟击，1 台发动机失效，请求返回武汉机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1642.audioText: C: China Eastern 151, climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1642.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 151，爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1642.referenceText: Climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS runway 36R, CES2151.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1642.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 跑道 36R，CES2151。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1643.audioText: B: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1643.audioTextZh: B：由于强顺风，你想改用跑道 18L。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1643.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES2151, request change to runway 18L due strong tailwind.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1643.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES2151，因强顺风，请求改用跑道 18L。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1644.audioText: C: China Eastern 151, change to runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to Whiskey Hotel Alpha, contact Wuhan Approach 121.7.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1644.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 151，同意改用跑道 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 Whiskey Hotel Alpha，联系武汉进近121.7。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1644.referenceText: Change to runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, 121.7, CES2151.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1644.referenceTextZh: 同意改用跑道 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，121.7，CES2151。

atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1645.audioText: C: China Eastern 151, climb to and maintain 900 meters, after Whiskey Hotel Alpha, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1645.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 151，爬升并保持 900 米，过 Whiskey Hotel Alpha 后，飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 18L。
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1645.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 18L, CES2151.
atc-scenario-0095-card-main-1645.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 900 米，过 WHA 后，飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 18L，CES2151。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1646.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 102, destination Beijing, 4800 meters maintaining, estimating DOGAR 05, information Foxtrot, now contact Beijing Approach.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1646.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 102，目的地北京，保持 4800 米，预计 DOGAR 05，通播 Foxtrot，现在联系北京进近。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1646.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, 4800 metres maintaining, estimating DOGAR 05, information F.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1646.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，保持 4800 米，预计 DOGAR 05，通播 F。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1647.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, Beijing Approach, DOGAR 03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800 meters.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1647.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，北京进近，DOGAR 03 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 01，保持 4800 米。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1647.referenceText: DOGAR 03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800 metres, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1647.referenceTextZh: DOGAR 03 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 01，保持 4800 米，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1648.audioText: B: Flight attendants reported that a loud noise is coming from the backward right of the cabin, report this to the controller.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1648.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告客舱后右方传来很大噪音，向管制员报告。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1648.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, we have a loud noise coming from the cabin.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1648.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，我们客舱有很大噪音。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1649.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, descend to and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1012.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1649.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，QNH 1012 下降并保持 2100 米。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1649.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2100 metres on QNH 1012, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1649.referenceTextZh: QNH 1012 下降并保持 2100 米，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1650.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, can you describe the sound in more detail?
B: It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1650.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，你能更详细描述声音吗？
B：似乎是外部气流声或轻微失压问题。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1650.referenceText: It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1650.referenceTextZh: 似乎是外部气流声或轻微失压问题，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1651.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, roger.
B: The engineers advised that it may be a problem with the door seal. They suggested you reduce speed to minimum, report to the controller.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1651.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，收到。
B：工程师建议可能是门封问题。他们建议你减速到最小，向管制员报告。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1651.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, maybe a problem with the door seal. The engineers suggested we reduce speed to minimum.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1651.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，可能是门封问题。工程师建议我们减速到最小。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1652.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, affirm, do you require emergency services on arrival?
B: You have 3 passengers injured during emergency descent, so you will need medical service on arrival, require priority lending.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1652.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，肯定，抵达时你需要应急服务吗？
B：你有 3 名旅客在紧急下降中受伤，所以抵达时需要医疗服务，并请求优先落地。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1652.referenceText: We have 3 injured persons during emergency descent, require ambulance on arrival, request priority landing, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1652.referenceTextZh: 我们有 3 名人员在紧急下降中受伤，抵达时需要救护车，请求优先落地，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1653.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, roger, you are number 1, doctor and ambulance will be ready on arrival.
B: Request change runway 36R to save time.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1653.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，收到，你是第 1 架，医生和救护车将在抵达时准备好。
B：请求改用跑道 36R 以节省时间。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1653.referenceText: Request runway change to 36R to save time, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1653.referenceTextZh: 请求改用跑道 36R 以节省时间，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1654.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, roger, turn left heading 300, radar vector for landing.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1654.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，收到，左转航向 300，雷达引导着陆。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1655.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, the weather is deteriorating, say intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to continue approach.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1655.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，天气正在恶化，说明意图。
B：告诉管制员你想继续进近。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1656.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, descend to and maintain 900 meters, turn right heading 330, report established on localizer.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1656.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，下降并保持 900 米，右转航向 330，报告建立航向道。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1656.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 900 metres, turn right heading 330, report established on the localizer, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1656.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 900 米，右转航向 330，报告建立航向道，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1657.audioText: B: Report established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1657.audioTextZh: B：报告已建立跑道 36R 五边 5 海里航向道。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1657.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1657.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，已建立跑道 36R 五边 5 海里航向道。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1658.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1658.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1659.audioText: B: Report to Tower that you have established ILS.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1659.audioTextZh: B：向塔台报告你已建立 ILS。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1660.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, Beijing Tower, expect low visibility for your arrival, say intention.
B: You want to try landing.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1660.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，北京塔台，预计你抵达时低能见度，说明意图。
B：你想尝试着陆。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1660.referenceText: Roger, I want to try landing, CES5102.

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1661.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, continue approach, report outer marker.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1661.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，继续进近，报告外指点标。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1661.referenceText: Continue approach, report outer marker, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1661.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，报告外指点标，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1663.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, cleared to land runway 36R, surface wind 160, 7 meters per second, report vacated.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1663.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，跑道 36R 可以落地，地面风 160，7 米/秒，报告脱离。
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1663.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, report vacated, CES5102.
atc-scenario-0096-card-main-1663.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以落地，报告脱离，CES5102。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1664.audioText: B: You are the pilot of China Eastern 325 which is bound for Wuhan. You have just been handed over from Hefei Control, you are over IKUBA at 23, and your level is 8400 meters, call Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1664.audioTextZh: B：你是飞往武汉的 China Eastern 325 飞行员。你刚从合肥管制移交过来，23 在 IKUBA 上空，高度 8400 米，呼叫武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1664.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, over IKUBA at 23, maintain 8400 meters.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1664.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES5325，23 在 IKUBA 上空，保持 8400 米。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1665.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descent to and maintain 6000 meters, report reaching.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1665.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 6000 米，报告到达。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1665.referenceText: Wilco, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, CES5325.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1665.referenceTextZh: 照办，下降并保持 6000 米，CES5325。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1666.audioText: B: You have just followed your TCAS RA instruction. You have stopped your descent at nearly 6800 meters and track out 9 kilometers right of the course, report to ATC.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1666.audioTextZh: B：你刚按 TCAS RA 指令执行。你在约 6800 米停止下降，并向航路右侧偏出 9 公里，向 ATC 报告。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1666.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, our TCAS instructed us to stop descent at 6800 meters, and we are tracking out 9 km right of the course.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1666.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES5325，我们的 TCAS 指令我们在 6800 米停止下降，并正向航路右侧偏出 9 公里。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1667.audioText: C: Roger, China Eastern 325, you have just passed the traffic, descent to 6000 meters and turn left heading 170 immediately, there is military activity in the area right now.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1667.audioTextZh: C：收到，China Eastern 325，你刚通过冲突飞机，下降至 6000 米并立即左转航向 170，该区域现在有军事活动。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1667.referenceText: Roger, descend to 6000 meters and turn left heading 170 immediately, CES5325.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1667.referenceTextZh: 收到，下降至 6000 米并立即左转航向 170，CES5325。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1668.audioText: B: You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has a banking tendency. Declare Urgency to ATC and request priority landing and emergency services.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1668.audioTextZh: B：你听到一声巨响，似乎左翼被什么东西击中，并感觉飞机有坡度趋势。向 ATC 宣布紧急情况并请求优先着陆和应急服务。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1668.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CES5325, the left wing was hit by some foreign object, and the plane has a banking tendency. Request priority landing and emergency services.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1668.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉管制，CES5325，左翼被某个外来物击中，飞机有坡度趋势。请求优先着陆和应急服务。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1669.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, roger PAN. Descend to and maintain 4800 meters, report passing X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1669.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，收到 PAN。下降并保持 4800 米，报告通过 X-Ray Sierra Hotel。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1669.referenceText: Continue descend to 4800 meters, report passing XSH, CES5325.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1669.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 4800 米，报告通过 XSH，CES5325。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1670.audioText:
C: China Eastern 325, we have notified the other relevant parties, please give us more description about your present situation.
B: Report to ATC that No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. You guess that might be some more damages to the left wing.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1670.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 325，我们已通知其他相关单位，请给我们更多你当前情况的描述。
B：向 ATC 报告 3 号发动机已熄火，克服坡度趋势更加困难。你猜测左翼可能还有更多损伤。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1670.referenceText: No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency, we suspect there might be some more damages to the left wing, CES5325.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1670.referenceTextZh: 3 号发动机已熄火，克服坡度趋势更加困难，我们怀疑左翼可能还有更多损伤，CES5325。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1671.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, keep us advised.

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1672.audioText: B: Now, you are over X-Ray Sierra Hotel at 4800 meters, call Wuhan Control.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1672.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 上空，高度 4800 米，呼叫武汉管制。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1672.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, over XSH at 4800 meters.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1672.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES5325，XSH 上空，高度 4800 米。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1673.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, maintain present level and contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, good day.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1673.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，保持当前高度，联系武汉进近118.9，再见。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1674.audioText: B: Now you are over X-Ray Sierra Hotel at 4800 meters, call Wuhan Approach and inform them that you are in distress now.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1674.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 上空，高度 4800 米，呼叫武汉进近并告知他们你现在处于遇险状态。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1674.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES5325, we have been struck by foreign object, No.3 engine flame out and the aircraft tends to bank, we are now passing XSH at 4800 meters.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1674.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，武汉进近，CES5325，我们被外来物击中，3 号发动机熄火，飞机有坡度趋势，我们现在通过 XSH，高度 4800 米。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1675.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, roger MAYDAY, the center controller as told us your situation, you will have the top priority. Descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach runway 36R, you are number 1.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1675.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，收到 MAYDAY，管制中心已告诉我们你的情况，你将有最高优先级。QNH 1008 下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，你是第 1 架。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1675.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1008, ILS approach runway 36R, No.1, CES5325.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1675.referenceTextZh: QNH 1008 下降至 1200 米，ILS 进近跑道 36R，第 1 架，CES5325。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1676.audioText: B: Now you want to verify the wind data, ask ATC to give detailed wind information.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1676.audioTextZh: B：现在你想核实风数据，请 ATC 提供详细风信息。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1676.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request wind information.

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1677.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, eh, let me see, the latest ATIS shows, wind 310 degrees, at 11 meters per second, but it is variable.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1677.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，呃，让我看看，最新 ATIS 显示，风 310 度，11 米/秒，但风向不定。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1678.audioText: B: You consider there might be some problem with your landing, so you ask ATC to provide emergency assistance upon you landing.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1678.audioTextZh: B：你认为着陆可能有问题，所以请求 ATC 在你着陆时提供应急协助。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1678.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request emergency assistance upon our landing due to possible landing problem.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1678.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES5325，因可能存在着陆问题，请求着陆时应急协助。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1679.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, roger, well, fire services and ambulance will be ready upon you landing.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1679.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，收到，嗯，消防和救护车将在你着陆时准备好。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1680.audioText: B: Now, you have fully established on the ILS runway 36R, call Wuhan Approach.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1680.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完全建立跑道 36R ILS，呼叫武汉进近。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1680.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, established on the ILS runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1680.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES5325，已建立跑道 36R ILS。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1681.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1681.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，继续进近，联系塔台 118.6，再见。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1681.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day, CES5325.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1681.referenceTextZh: 继续进近并联系塔台 118.6，再见，CES5325。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1682.audioText: B: Now contact Tower, report to air traffic control that you are on emergency landing.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1682.audioTextZh: B：现在联系塔台，向空中交通管制报告你正在紧急着陆。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1682.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, we are on emergency landing.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1682.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5325，我们正在紧急着陆。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1683.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, radar identified, continue ILS approach runway 36R, you are No.1, report the outer marker.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1683.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，雷达识别，继续 ILS 进近跑道 36R，你是第 1 架，报告外指点标。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1683.referenceText: Continue ILS approach runway 36R, we are No.1, report the outer marker, CES5325.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1683.referenceTextZh: 继续 ILS 进近跑道 36R，我们是第 1 架，报告外指点标，CES5325。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1684.audioText: B: Now you are over the outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1684.audioTextZh: B：现在你在外指点标上空，呼叫武汉塔台。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1684.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, over outer marker.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1684.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5325，外指点标上空。

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1685.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, cleared land runway 36R, wind 300 degrees at 12 meters per second, QNH 1008.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1685.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，跑道 36R 可以落地，风 300 度，12 米/秒，QNH 1008。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1685.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, QNH 1008, CES5325.

atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1686.audioText: B: You have just skidded off the runway but managed to stop the aircraft on the grass strip, report to ATC and request emergency services.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1686.audioTextZh: B：你刚滑出跑道，但设法将飞机停在草地带上，向 ATC 报告并请求应急服务。
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1686.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, we skidded off the runway and manage to stop the aircraft on the grass, request emergency services.
atc-scenario-0097-card-main-1686.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5325，我们滑出跑道并设法将飞机停在草地上，请求应急服务。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1687.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 5118, from Wuhan to Beijing, parking at gate 223, when you are ready request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1687.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 5118，从武汉飞往北京，停在 223 号登机口，准备好时请求 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1687.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, gate 223, request ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1687.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES5118，223 号登机口，请求 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1688.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, stand by, I will check your flight plan.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1688.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，等待，我检查你的飞行计划。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1689.audioText: B: All flight attendants told you passengers have boarded, all cargo doors are closed, now report ready for clearance.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1689.audioTextZh: B：所有乘务员告诉你旅客已登机，所有货舱门已关闭，现在报告准备好接收放行许可。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1689.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, gate 223, ready to copy ATC clearance to Beijing.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1689.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES5118，223 号登机口，准备好抄收飞往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1690.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, is cleared to Beijing, cruising level 10700 meters, runway 18L, Zulu Foxtrot 11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1690.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，许可飞往北京，巡航高度 10700 米，跑道 18L，Zulu Foxtrot 11 离场，起始 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1690.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing, cruising level 10700 meters, runway 18L, ZF 11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021, CES5118.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1690.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往北京，巡航高度 10700 米，跑道 18L，ZF 11 离场，起始 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021，CES5118。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1691.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, read back correct, remain this frequency, call you back.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1691.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，复诵正确，保持本频率，稍后呼叫你。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1692.audioText: B: 5 minutes later, no call from Delivery, ask about the duration and reason of the delay.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1692.audioTextZh: B：5 分钟后，放行没有呼叫，询问延误时长和原因。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1692.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, what's the delay like and what's the reason for the delay ?
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1692.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES5118，延误情况如何，延误原因是什么？

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1693.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, due to thunderstorm activity, flow control is now in effect, expect 8 minutes separation between each aircraft going the same direction.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1693.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，由于雷暴活动，流量控制现已生效，预计同方向每架飞机间隔 8 分钟。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1694.audioText:
B: Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompanied with lightning and thunder.
C: All the aircraft on my frequency, airport will temporarily close, thunderstorms on final, expect delay until the weather improves, squawk ident if you copy this message.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1694.audioTextZh:
B：大雨开始落下，并伴随闪电和雷声。
C：我频率上的所有飞机，机场将临时关闭，五边有雷暴，预计延误至天气好转，如收到此信息请应答机识别。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1695.audioText: B: 1 hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open, now ask for your departure sequence.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1695.audioTextZh: B：1 小时后，天气好转，机场开放，现在询问你的离场顺序。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1695.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, request departure sequence.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1695.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES5118，请求离场顺序。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1696.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, you are currently number 1 in your direction, expect about 20 minutes delay, contact Ground on 121.8.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1696.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，你当前在你方向上排第 1，预计约 20 分钟延误，联系地面 121.8。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1697.audioText: B: Inform Ground that you are ready for push back and start.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1697.audioTextZh: B：通知地面你准备好推出和开车。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1697.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, ready for push back and start up.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1697.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES5118，准备好推出和开车。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1698.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, push back approved, facing north.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1698.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，同意推出，机头朝北。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1698.referenceText: Push back approved, facing north, CES5118.

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1699.audioText: B: You realize that the tug is not in position yet, advise Ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1699.audioTextZh: B：你意识到拖车还未到位，告知地面管制你还需要 5 分钟准备。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1699.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, tug is not in position, request 5 minutes to be ready.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1699.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES5118，拖车未到位，请求 5 分钟准备。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1700.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, roger, stand by for push, I will call you back.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1700.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，收到，等待推出，我稍后呼叫你。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1701.audioText:
C: China Eastern 5118, are you fully ready now?we have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
B: You need to open the cabin door to add passenger food and drinks due to the long delay, advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1701.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 5118，你现在完全准备好了吗？我们有一个 10 分钟后离场的时隙。
B：由于长时间延误，你需要打开客舱门添加旅客餐食和饮料，告知地面你还需要 5 分钟配餐。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1701.referenceText: We need to open the cabin door to add passenger's food and drinks due long delay, we need another 5 minutes for catering, CES5118.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1701.referenceTextZh: 由于长时间延误，我们需要打开客舱门添加旅客餐食和饮料，我们需要另外 5 分钟配餐，CES5118。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1702.audioText:
C: China Eastern 5118, roger, report ready.
B: 5 minutes later, catering completed, call ready.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1702.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 5118，收到，报告准备好。
B：5 分钟后，配餐完成，呼叫准备好。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1702.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, catering completed, ready for pushback.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1702.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES5118，配餐完成，准备好推出。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1703.audioText: C: Push back approved until abeam gate 221, do not block gate 222, there is incoming traffic to that gate.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1703.audioTextZh: C：同意推出至正对 221 号登机口，不要阻挡 222 号登机口，有进港飞机要去该登机口。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1703.referenceText: Push back approved until abeam gate 221, don't block gate 222, CES5118.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1703.referenceTextZh: 同意推出至正对 221 号登机口，不要阻挡 222 号登机口，CES5118。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1704.audioText: B: Engine start completed, now request taxi.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1704.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动完成，现在请求滑行。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1704.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, startup completed, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1704.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES5118，开车完成，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1705.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, taxi via Mike, Alpha, hold short of Echo 1.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1705.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，经 Mike、Alpha 滑行，Echo 1 外等待。
