atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1705.referenceText: Taxi via M, A, hold short of E1, CES5118.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1705.referenceTextZh: 经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待，CES5118。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1706.audioText:
C: Can you accept Echo 1 intersection for departure?Takeoff roll distance available 3300 meters.
B: Tell the Tower you can accept.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1706.audioTextZh:
C：你能接受 Echo 1 交叉口离场吗？可用起飞滑跑距离 3300 米。
B：告诉塔台你可以接受。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1706.referenceText: Affirm, we can accept intersection departure from E1, CES5118.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1706.referenceTextZh: 可以，我们可以接受 E1 交叉口离场，CES5118。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1707.audioText:
C: China Eastern 5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway Echo 1.
B: Report to the Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking Echo 1.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1707.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 5118，收到，经 Echo 1 滑行道进跑道等待。
B：向塔台报告你前方的飞机阻挡 Echo 1。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1707.referenceText: Negative, the aircraft in front of us is blocking E1, CES5118.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1707.referenceTextZh: 不能，前方飞机阻挡 E1，CES5118。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1708.audioText:
C: China Eastern 5118, roger, break! break! China Southern 328, taxi forward to be clear of Echo 1.
B: The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1708.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 5118，收到，break！break！China Southern 328，向前滑行以让开 Echo 1。
B：该飞机移动后，你可以继续滑行并进跑道。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1708.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5118, traffic is clear, we are able to continue taxi and line up.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1708.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5118，交通已脱离，我们可以继续滑行并进跑道。

atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1709.audioText: C: China Eastern 5118, cleared for takeoff, runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1709.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 5118，可以起飞，跑道 18L，起始保持跑道航向，爬升至 1500 米。
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1709.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters, CES5118.
atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1709.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道 18L，起始保持跑道航向，爬升至 1500 米，CES5118。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1710.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 277, you are parking at gate 213, you have received information Mike, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow from Wuhan Delivery.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1710.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 277，停在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 Mike，向武汉放行请求飞往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1710.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5277, gate 213, information M, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1710.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES5277，213 号登机口，通播 M，请求飞往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1711.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1711.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 277，许可飞往伦敦希思罗，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 2700 米，Lima Kilo Oscar 02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1711.referenceText: Cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, LKO 02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512, CES5277.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1711.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往伦敦希思罗，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 2700 米，LKO 02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512，CES5277。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1712.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1712.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1713.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Alpha 4, Echo 2, hold short of runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1713.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 277，经滑行道 Alpha 4、Echo 2 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1713.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway A4, E2, hold short of runway 36R, CES5277.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1713.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A4、E2 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待，CES5277。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1714.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of runway 36R, contact the controller to request cross the runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1714.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 外等待，联系管制员请求穿越跑道 36R。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1714.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5277, holding short of runway 36R, request cross the runway 36R.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1714.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5277，跑道 36R 外等待，请求穿越跑道 36R。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1715.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, expedite cross runway 36R, report vacated.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1715.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 277，快速穿越跑道 36R，报告脱离。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1715.referenceText: Expedite cross runway 36R, report vacated, CES5277.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1715.referenceTextZh: 快速穿越跑道 36R，报告脱离，CES5277。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1716.audioText: B: Now you have exited runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1716.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离跑道 36R，向武汉塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1716.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5277，跑道 36R 已脱离。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1717.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of runway 04, you are ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1717.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1717.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5277, holding short of runway 04, ready for departure.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1717.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5277，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1718.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, after departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, contact Wuhan Departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff runway 04.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1718.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 277，离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，联系武汉离场 120.2，跑道 04 可以起飞。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1718.referenceText: After departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to LKO, contact Wuhan Departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff runway 04, CES5277.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1718.referenceTextZh: 离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 LKO，联系武汉离场 120.2，跑道 04 可以起飞，CES5277。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1719.audioText: B: After takeoff, your flaps seem to be jammed, report the situation to Wuhan Approach and request hold for further check.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1719.audioTextZh: B：起飞后，你的襟翼似乎卡住，向武汉进近报告情况并请求等待以进一步检查。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1719.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5277, our flaps seem to be jammed, request hold for further check.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1719.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES5277，我们的襟翼似乎卡住，请求等待以进一步检查。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1720.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, roger, turn right, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, hold at Lima Kilo Oscar VOR 210 radio, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1720.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 277，收到，右转，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，在 Lima Kilo Oscar VOR 210 径向等待，等待高度 3300 米，入航航迹 280 度，左等待，出航时间 1 分钟。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1720.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, hold at LKO VOR 210 radio, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute, CES5277.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1720.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，在 LKO VOR 210 径向等待，等待高度 3300 米，入航航迹 280 度，左等待，出航时间 1 分钟，CES5277。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1721.audioText: B: After performing the checklist, the flap problem can't be solved, report it to Wuhan Approach and request return to land.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1721.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，襟翼问题无法解决，向武汉进近报告并请求返回着陆。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1721.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5277, the flap problem can't be solved, request return to land.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1721.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES5277，襟翼问题无法解决，请求返回着陆。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1722.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, turn right heading 340, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 03 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 04.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1722.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 277，右转航向 340，执行 Lima Kilo Oscar 03 Alpha 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 04。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1722.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, follow LKO 03A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 04, CES5277.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1722.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，执行 LKO 03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 04，CES5277。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1723.audioText: B: You can't fully extend the flaps, tell Wuhan Tower that you need to land on the longest runway.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1723.audioTextZh: B：你无法完全放出襟翼，告诉武汉塔台你需要在最长跑道上着陆。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1723.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5277, we can't fully extend the flaps, request the longest runway for landing.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1723.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5277，我们无法完全放出襟翼，请求最长跑道着陆。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1724.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind runway 04.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1724.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 277，右转航向 030，加入跑道 04 右三边。
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1724.referenceText: Turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind runway 04, CES5277.
atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1724.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，加入跑道 04 右三边，CES5277。

atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1725.audioText: C: China Eastern 277, cleared to land, runway 04.

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1726.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 102, now call Wuhan Departure and report you are 400 meters, climbing.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1726.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Air China 102，现在呼叫武汉离场并报告你 400 米，正在爬升。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1726.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CCA102，400 米爬升中。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1727.audioText:
C: Air China 102, Wuhan Departure is with you. Continue climb to 4200 meters. Pass Hekou at 4200 meters.
B: Acknowledge the controller’s instruction
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1727.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，武汉离场收到。继续爬升至 4200 米。以 4200 米通过河口。
B：确认收到管制员指令。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1727.referenceText: Continue climb to 4200 meters. Pass Hekou at 4200 meters, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1727.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 4200 米。以 4200 米通过河口，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1728.audioText: B: As the aircraft is reaching 4200 meters, you suddenly find No.1 engine has flamed out. You declare an emergency.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1728.audioTextZh: B：飞机到达 4200 米时，你突然发现 1 号发动机熄火。你宣布紧急情况。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1728.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CCA102, No.1 engine has flamed out at 4200 meters.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1728.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，CCA102，1 号发动机在 4200 米熄火。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1729.audioText:
C: Roger PAN, Air China 102, what is your intention?
B: Tell controller you intend to return to land as soon as possible.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1729.audioTextZh:
C：收到 PAN，Air China 102，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你打算尽快返回着陆。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1729.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA102, we would like to return to land on the departure airport.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1729.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CCA102，我们想返回起飞机场着陆。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1730.audioText: C: Air China 102, turn left proceed to Hotel Golf, make straight in ILS approach runway 18L.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1730.audioTextZh: C：Air China 102，左转前往 Hotel Golf，执行跑道 18L 直线 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1730.referenceText: Turn left proceed to HG, make straight in ILS approach runway 18 left, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1730.referenceTextZh: 左转前往 HG，执行跑道 18L 直线 ILS 进近，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1731.audioText:
C: Air China 102, contact Tower 124.35.
B: Call Tower.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1731.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，联系塔台 124.35。
B：呼叫塔台。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1732.audioText: B: You have another problem. The hydraulic pressure is dropping rapidly.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1732.audioTextZh: B：你有另一个问题。液压压力正在快速下降。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1732.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, we have another problem, the hydraulic pressure is dropping rapidly.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1732.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我们还有一个问题，液压压力正在快速下降。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1733.audioText:
C: Air China 102, Can you extend the landing gear?
B: You are not certain if you could extend the gear. You are going around.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1733.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，你能放下起落架吗？
B：你不确定是否能放下起落架。你正在复飞。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1733.referenceText: We can not sure if we could extend the landing gear, going around, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1733.referenceTextZh: 我们不能确定是否能放下起落架，正在复飞，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1734.audioText:
C: Air China 102, standard missed approach.
B: You are flying to the holding for further check of the landing gear.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1734.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，标准复飞。
B：你正飞往等待区进一步检查起落架。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1734.referenceText: We are going to the holding for further check. Call you back, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1734.referenceTextZh: 我们去等待区进一步检查。稍后呼叫你，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1735.audioText: B: You have tried several ways, but you could not extend the landing gear. You decided to make a belly landing. Tell the controller about it
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1735.audioTextZh: B：你尝试了几种方法，但无法放下起落架。你决定进行机腹着陆。告诉管制员。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1735.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, I have tried several ways, but I could not extend the landing gear. We would like to make a belly landing.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1735.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我尝试了几种方法，但无法放下起落架。我们想进行机腹着陆。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1736.audioText:
C: Air China 102, any airport assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you like the runway to be foamed at the touch down zone of the landing runway.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1736.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，你需要任何机场协助吗？
B：告诉管制员你希望在落地跑道接地区铺设泡沫。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1736.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, request a foam carpet at the touch down zone of the runway.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1736.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，请求在跑道接地区铺设泡沫。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1737.audioText:
C: Air China 102, roger. We will spray foam around the touch down.
B: You ask how long will foam spray last.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1737.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，收到。我们将在接地区周围喷洒泡沫。
B：你询问泡沫喷洒将持续多久。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1737.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, how long will foam spray last?
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1737.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，泡沫喷洒会持续多久？

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1738.audioText:
C: Air China 102, foam spraying will last 15 minutes. I will call you back.
B: Tell controller you would like to land as soon as possible
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1738.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，泡沫喷洒将持续 15 分钟。我稍后呼叫你。
B：告诉管制员你想尽快着陆。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1738.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, we would like to land as soon as possible.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1738.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我们想尽快着陆。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1739.audioText:
C: Air China 102, cleared to land runway 18L, wind 120, 10 knots.
B: You confirm with the controller if the landing runway is 18 Left.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1739.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，跑道 18L 可以落地，风 120，10 节。
B：你向管制员确认落地跑道是否为 18L。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1739.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, confirm landing runway is 18 left.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1739.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，确认落地跑道是 18L。

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1740.audioText:
C: Correct, Air China 102, landing runway 18L, report runway in sight.
B: You have runway in sight, report to Tower.
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1740.audioTextZh:
C：正确，Air China 102，落地跑道 18L，报告看到跑道。
B：你看到跑道，向塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1740.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, runway in sight.

atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1741.audioText: C: Air China 102, cleared to land.

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1742.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 544. Now you are on the way taxiing to the holding point.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1742.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 544。现在你正在滑行前往等待点。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1742.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, we are on the way taxiing to the holding point.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1742.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA544，我们正在滑行前往等待点。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1743.audioText: C: Singapore 544, frozen icy patches on your taxiway, I suggest turning right and using taxiway Golf instead.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1743.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 544，你的滑行道上有结冰斑块，我建议右转改用 Golf 滑行道。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1743.referenceText: Roger, thanks, we will turn right to taxiway G, SIA544.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1743.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，我们将右转至 G 滑行道，SIA544。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1744.audioText:
C: Singapore 544, go beyond Airbus 320 on your left, then turn right.
B: Read back the instruction. Then tell the controller an aircraft is approaching to you from the opposite direction
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1744.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 544，越过你左侧的 Airbus 320，然后右转。
B：复诵指令。然后告诉管制员有一架飞机从相反方向接近你。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1744.referenceText: Go beyond A320 on the left, then turn right, an aircraft is approaching to us from the opposite direction, SIA544.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1744.referenceTextZh: 越过左侧 A320，然后右转，有一架飞机从相反方向接近我们，SIA544。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1745.audioText: C: Singapore 544, disregard the traffic, Boeing 737, he is on his way to the parking stand after you.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1745.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 544，不用管那架飞机，Boeing 737，他在你之后前往停机位。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1746.audioText: B: Call Ground and ask if the Ground controller may ask the Airbus 320 to pull in to further left, you want to pass it due your slot time will be expired at 30.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1746.audioTextZh: B：呼叫地面，询问地面管制员是否可以让 Airbus 320 再向左靠一些，你想通过，因为你的时隙将在 30 过期。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1746.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, please ask the A320 to pull in to the left so that we can pass it, our slot time will expire at 30.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1746.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA544，请让 A320 向左靠一些，以便我们通过，我们的时隙将在 30 过期。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1747.audioText:
C: Singapore 544, your airplane has been impounded by the airport authorities.
B: You ask the reason.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1747.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 544，你的飞机已被机场当局扣押。
B：你询问原因。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1747.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, why has our airplane been impounded?
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1747.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA544，为什么我们的飞机被扣押？

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1748.audioText:
C: I don’t know the exact reason. The only thing I know is that you have not been cleared by Customs.
B: You tell the controller that you have the clearance sheet together with a waybill.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1748.audioTextZh:
C：我不知道确切原因。我只知道你们还没有获得海关放行。
B：你告诉管制员你有放行单和运单。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1748.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, we have a clearance sheet together with a waybill right here with us.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1748.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA544，我们这里有放行单和运单。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1749.audioText:
C: It is not an ATC matter. I am only passing the message.
B: You ask the controller to help you find the reason.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1749.audioTextZh:
C：这不是 ATC 事务。我只是转达信息。
B：你请管制员帮你查明原因。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1749.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, will you please do us a favor by asking them the reason?
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1749.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA544，能否请你帮我们询问他们原因？

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1750.audioText:
C: Singapore 544, I have just received the airport authority information that there is a suspected person, perhaps a criminal with a bomb aboard your aircraft.
B: Ask the control what you should do.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1750.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 544，我刚收到机场当局信息，你的飞机上有一名可疑人员，可能是一名带有炸弹的罪犯。
B：询问管制你应该怎么做。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1750.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, what should we do?

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1751.audioText:
C: Singapore 544, tell the passengers that there is a technical problem. You have to return to the remote apron for repairing.
B: You make a captain announcement.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1751.audioTextZh:
C: Singapore 544，告诉旅客飞机有技术问题。你们必须返回远机位维修。
B: 你进行机长广播。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1751.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, your captain speaking, I am sorry to tell you we have to return to the terminal due to the technical problem of the aircraft. Please take your seats and fasten your seatbelts. Thank you for your cooperation.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1751.referenceTextZh: 女士们，先生们，我是机长。很抱歉通知大家，由于飞机技术问题，我们必须返回航站楼。请各位就座并系好安全带。感谢您的配合。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1752.audioText: C: Singapore 544, enter the runway and expedite taxiing on the runway. Exit the runway via Echo 4.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1752.audioTextZh: C: Singapore 544，进入跑道并在跑道上加速滑行。经 Echo 4 脱离跑道。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1752.referenceText: Enter the runway and expedite taxiing on the runway. Exit the runway via E4, SIA544.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1752.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道并在跑道上加速滑行。经 E4 脱离跑道，SIA544。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1753.audioText: B: You contact Ground and report you have vacated the runway 36R via Echo 4.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1753.audioTextZh: B: 联系地面，报告你们已通过 Echo 4 脱离跑道 36 right。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1753.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, we have vacated the runway 36 right via E4.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1753.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA544，我们已通过 E4 脱离跑道 36 right。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1754.audioText: C: Singapore 544, take taxiway Alpha 8, direct to apron No.5.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1754.audioTextZh: C: Singapore 544，走滑行道 Alpha 8，直达 5 号机坪。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1754.referenceText: Taxiway A8, direct to apron No.5, SIA544.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1754.referenceTextZh: 滑行道 A8，直达 5 号机坪，SIA544。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1755.audioText: B: Report you have reached Apron No.5.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1755.audioTextZh: B: 报告你们已到达 5 号机坪。
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1755.referenceText: Ground, SIA544, we have reached Apron No.5.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1755.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA544，我们已到达 5 号机坪。

atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1756.audioText: C: Singapore 544, wait there. Don’t let the passengers get off the aircraft. The policemen will be on the scene in a minute.
atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1756.audioTextZh: C: Singapore 544，在那里等待。不要让旅客下机。警察一分钟后到现场。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1757.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 426, at gate 410, ask Beijing East Ground for taxi instruction.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1757.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 China Southern 426，在 410 登机口，请向北京东地面申请滑行指令。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1757.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN3426, gate 410, request taxi.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1757.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN3426，410 登机口，请求滑行。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1758.audioText: C: China Southern 426, taxi to holding point of runway 36R via Yankee 1 and Charlie 1.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1758.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 426，经 Yankee 1 和 Charlie 1 滑行至跑道 36 right 等待点。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1758.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 36R via Y1 and C1, CSN3426.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1758.referenceTextZh: 经 Y1 和 C1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN3426。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1759.audioText: B: Now you’re on the taxiway Charlie 1, you got the report from the purser that 1 passenger had boarded the wrong airplane. Request back to the gate.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1759.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在滑行道 Charlie 1，乘务长报告有 1 名旅客登错飞机。请求返回登机口。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1759.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN3426, request back to gate due to 1 passenger boarding the wrong aircraft.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1759.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN3426，由于 1 名旅客登错飞机，请求返回登机口。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1760.audioText: C: China Southern 426, backtrack at present position, back to the gate via Charlie 1 and Yankee 1.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1760.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 426，在当前位置反向滑行，经 Charlie 1 和 Yankee 1 返回登机口。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1760.referenceText: Backtrack at present position, back to the gate via C1 and Y1, CSN3426.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1760.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置反向滑行，经 C1 和 Y1 返回登机口，CSN3426。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1761.audioText: B: Half an hour later, you ask Ground for permission of taxiing again.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1761.audioTextZh: B: 半小时后，你再次向地面申请滑行许可。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1762.audioText: C: China Southern 426, taxi to holding point of runway 36R via Yankee 1 and Charlie 1.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1762.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 426，经 Yankee 1 和 Charlie 1 滑行至跑道 36 right 等待点。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1762.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 36R via Y1 and C1, CSN3426.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1762.referenceTextZh: 经 Y1 和 C1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN3426。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1763.audioText: C: China Southern 426, hold short at intersection between Yankee 1 and Tango 2, 1 Airbus 330 taxiing east on taxiway Tango 2.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1763.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 426，在 Yankee 1 与 Tango 2 交叉口前等待，1 架 Airbus 330 正在 Tango 2 上向东滑行。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1763.referenceText: Holding short, A330 in sight, CSN3426.

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1764.audioText: C: China Southern 426, after Airbus 330 vacating intersection, continue to taxi.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1764.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 426，Airbus 330 脱离交叉口后，继续滑行。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1764.referenceText: After A330 is clear, continue to taxi, CSN3426.

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1765.audioText: B: Your aircraft left wingtip collided with left stabilizer of Airbus 330 during taxiing, report it to the controller and ask for assistance.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1765.audioTextZh: B: 你机左翼尖在滑行中与 Airbus 330 左平尾相撞，向管制员报告并请求协助。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1765.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN3426, our aircraft left wingtip collided with left stabilizer of A330, request airport assistance.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1765.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN3426，我机左翼尖与 A330 左平尾相撞，请求机场协助。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1766.audioText: C: China Southern 426, I’ve reported it to relevant departments. And investigation car is on the way.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1766.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 426，我已向相关部门报告。调查车正在路上。

atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1767.audioText: B: You reported the accident to the company and you got the company’s decision that the passengers would be arranged for another airplane, you request the controller to send shuttle bus soon.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1767.audioTextZh: B: 你已向公司报告事故，公司决定将旅客安排到另一架飞机上，你请求管制员尽快派摆渡车。
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1767.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN3426, request shuttle bus to send passengers back to gate.
atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1767.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN3426，请求摆渡车送旅客返回登机口。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1768.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 102, now call Wuhan Approach and report you are 10 miles north of Hekou, you are continuing approaching.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1768.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 102，现在呼叫 武汉进近，报告你在 Hekou 以北 10 miles，继续进近。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1768.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, we are 10 miles north of Hekou.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1768.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，我们在 Hekou 以北 10 miles。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1769.audioText:
C: Air China 102, Wuhan Approach is with you. Have you got the current ATIS?
B: You give an affirmative reply and report that you have received information Lima.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1769.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 102，武汉进近 收到。你们收到当前 ATIS 了吗？
B: 你肯定回答并报告已收到信息 Lima。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1770.audioText: B: Suddenly you find a sharp drop in RPM, report you have a trouble with starboard engine.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1770.audioTextZh: B: 突然你发现 RPM 急剧下降，报告右发有故障。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1770.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, we have a trouble with right engine, RPM has dropped rapidly.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1770.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，我们右发有故障，RPM 快速下降。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1771.audioText:
C: Air China 102, what is your intention?
B: Tell the controller you intend to land with radar vector.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1771.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 102，你的意图是什么？
B: 告诉管制员你打算接受雷达引导落地。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1771.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, we would like radar vector to land at Wuhan Airport.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1771.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，我们希望雷达引导到武汉机场落地。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1772.audioText: C: Air China 102, continue on your present heading, radar will vector you to ILS approach.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1772.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，保持当前航向，雷达将引导你做 ILS 进近。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1772.referenceText: Continue present heading, radar vector to ILS approach, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1772.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，雷达引导 ILS 进近，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1773.audioText: B: Ask if you could get any airport assistance there, your engine needs maintenance.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1773.audioTextZh: B: 询问那里是否有机场协助，你们的发动机需要维修。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1773.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, could I get any airport assistance there? Our engine needs some maintenance.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1773.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，那里能提供机场协助吗？我们的发动机需要维修。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1774.audioText:
C: Affirm. Maintenance is available at this airport. I will continue to give you instructions and give you all the important information. Are you able to maintain 4200 meters?
B: Tell the controller you could.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1774.audioTextZh:
C: 肯定。本机场有维修。我会继续给你指令并提供所有重要信息。你能保持 4200 meters 吗？
B: 告诉管制员可以。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1774.referenceText: Affirm, we can maintain 4200 meters, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1774.referenceTextZh: 肯定，我们可以保持 4200 meters，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1775.audioText: B: 15 minutes later, you have established localizer, report to the controller.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1775.audioTextZh: B: 15 分钟后，你已建立航向道，向管制员报告。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1775.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, established on localizer.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1775.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，已建立航向道。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1776.audioText: C: Air China 102, descend to 900 meters on QNH 1012, cleared ILS approach runway 18R.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1776.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，按 QNH 1012 下降到 900 meters，许可 ILS 进近跑道 18 right。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1776.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters on QNH1012, ILS approach runway 18 right, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1776.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH1012 下降到 900 meters，ILS 进近跑道 18 right，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1777.audioText: C: Air China 102, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1777.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，联系武汉塔台124.35。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1778.audioText: B: Contact Tower and report you had bird strike.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1778.audioTextZh: B: 联系塔台并报告你们遭遇鸟击。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1778.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, we had bird strike.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1778.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我们遭遇鸟击。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1779.audioText:
C: Air China 102, report your intention.
B: You request to reduce speed to minimum approach speed. You also report that No.1 left windshield is cracked. The inner glass pane become broken.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1779.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 102，报告你的意图。
B: 你请求减速到最小进近速度。你还报告 1 号左风挡有裂纹，内层玻璃破裂。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1779.referenceText: We would like to reduce speed to minimum approach speed. No.1 left windshield is cracked. The inner glass pane become broken, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1779.referenceTextZh: 我们希望减速到最小进近速度。1 号左风挡有裂纹，内层玻璃破裂，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1780.audioText: C: Air China 102, reduce to minimum approach speed. Report runway in sight.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1780.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，减到最小进近速度。看到跑道报告。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1780.referenceText: Reduce to minimum approach speed, wilco, CCA102.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1780.referenceTextZh: 减到最小进近速度，照办，CCA102。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1781.audioText: C: Air China 102, visibility is 8 miles, wind 270 at 10 knots, QNH 1013, landing runway 18R.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1781.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，能见度 8 miles，风 270 度 10 knots，QNH 1013，落地跑道 18 right。

atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1782.audioText: B: You have runway in sight, report it to Tower.
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1782.audioTextZh: B: 你已看到跑道，向塔台报告。
atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1782.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, runway in sight.

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1783.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 303, now call Guangzhou Control and tell him you’ve just passed 3600 meters.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1783.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 China Southern 303，现在呼叫 广州管制，告诉他你刚通过 3600 meters。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1783.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，正在通过 3600 meters。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1784.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, continue climbing to level 4200 meters on QNH 1014.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1784.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，按 QNH 1014 继续爬升到 4200 meters。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1784.referenceText: Continue climbing to 4200 meters, QNH1014, CSN303.

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1785.audioText: B: You find a gradual ice build-up. You think that might be caused by de-icing equipment failure. Require descent to below the freezing level.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1785.audioTextZh: B: 你发现逐渐积冰。你认为可能是除冰设备故障造成。要求下降到结冰层以下。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1785.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, we are getting a gradual ice build-up as a result of suspected deicing equipment failure. We require descent to below the freezing level.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1785.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，我们出现逐渐积冰，怀疑由除冰设备故障导致。我们要求下降到结冰层以下。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1786.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, descend 3000 meters, QNH 1014.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1786.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，下降 3000 meters，QNH 1014。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1787.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, let me know if you require lower, do emergency conditions exist at the moment?
B: You reply that the current level is ok but the de-ice system still refuses working. The emergency condition is still existing.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1787.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，如需更低请告诉我，目前是否存在紧急情况？
B: 你回答当前高度可以，但除冰系统仍不工作。紧急情况仍然存在。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1787.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, that should be sufficiently low enough, but the de-ice system still refuses working. I mean that emergency conditions do exist.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1787.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，这个高度应该足够低，但除冰系统仍不工作。我的意思是紧急情况确实存在。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1788.audioText:
C: Roger, China Southern 303.
B: Tell the controller you intend to dump fuel for 15 minutes then return to land.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1788.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，China Southern 303。
B: 告诉管制员你打算放油 15 分钟，然后返场落地。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1788.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, we will require a return to the field and an extra 15 minutes en-route for fuel dumping.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1788.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，我们需要返场，并在航路上额外 15 分钟放油。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1789.audioText: C: China Southern 303, understand, turn right heading 330, expect runway 02L.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1789.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，明白，右转航向 330，预计跑道 02 left。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1789.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, expect runway 02L, CSN303.

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1790.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, do you expect your approach and landing to be normal?
B: Give an affirmative reply.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1790.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，你预计进近和着陆正常吗？
B: 肯定回答。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1791.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, orbit left from your present position, you may have wide orbits, fuel dumping approved, report on completion.
B: Read-back and tell the controller you’re commencing the fuel dumping.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1791.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，从当前位置左盘旋，可以大范围盘旋，批准放油，完成后报告。
B: 复诵并告诉管制员你们正在开始放油。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1791.referenceText: Left hand orbits, we’re commencing the fuel dump this time, CSN303.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1791.referenceTextZh: 左盘旋，我们现在开始放油，CSN303。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1792.audioText: B: Tell the controller fuel dumping completed, and request a further clearance.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1792.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员放油完成，并请求进一步许可。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1792.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, we’ve completed the fuel dump and request a further clearance.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1792.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，我们已完成放油，请求进一步许可。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1793.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, roger, fly heading 320 and contact Approach on 130.0.
B: Read-back and you are not sure of the Approach frequency. You hear it as 120.0.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1793.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，收到，飞航向 320，联系进近 130.0。
B: 复诵，但你不确定进近频率。你听成了 120.0。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1793.referenceText: Vacating the orbit, flying heading 320, confirm Approach frequency is 120.0, CSN303.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1793.referenceTextZh: 脱离盘旋，飞航向 320，请确认进近频率是 120.0，CSN303。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1794.audioText: C: China Southern 303, negative, contact Approach on 130.0.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1794.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，否定，联系进近 130.0。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1795.audioText: B: Contact Baiyun Approach, tell him you have got information Golf.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1795.audioTextZh: B: 联系白云进近，告诉他你已收到信息 Golf。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1795.referenceText: Baiyun Approach, CSN303, received information Golf.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1795.referenceTextZh: 白云进近，CSN303，已收到信息 Golf。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1796.audioText: C: China Southern 303, Approach, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1014, Left pattern runway 02L, 20 miles to run.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1796.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，进近，按 QNH 1014 下降到 1200 meters，跑道 02 left 左航线，距接地点 20 miles。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1796.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters on QNH1014, CSN303.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1796.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH1014 下降到 1200 meters，CSN303。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1797.audioText: B: Report you have a flap extension problem caused by prior icing issue, perhaps a micro-switch malfunction. You will conduct a flapless landing.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1797.audioTextZh: B: 报告你因先前积冰问题出现襟翼放出故障，可能是微动开关故障。你将进行无襟翼着陆。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1797.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Baiyun Approach, CSN303, we have a flap extension due to prior icing issue; perhaps a micro-switch malfunction, request flapless landing.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1797.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，白云进近，CSN303，由于先前积冰问题，我们有襟翼放出故障，可能是微动开关故障，请求无襟翼着陆。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1798.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, change of runway 02R, which is 200 meters longer. Turn right heading 200 for downwind, now with 10 miles to touchdown, maintain 1200 meters.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1798.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，改用跑道 02 right，该跑道长 200 meters。右转航向 200 加入下风边，现在距接地点 10 miles，保持 1200 meters。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1798.referenceText: Runway 02 right, right turn, heading 200 and maintain 1200 meters, CSN303.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1798.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02 right，右转，航向 200，保持 1200 meters，CSN303。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1799.audioText: C: China Southern 303, contact Baiyun Tower on 118.1. We have notified your condition to Tower.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1799.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，联系白云塔台118.1。我们已将你的情况通知塔台。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1800.audioTextZh: B: 现在联系白云塔台。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1800.referenceText: Baiyun Tower, CSN303, maintain 1200m, left downwind for runway 02R.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1800.referenceTextZh: 白云塔台，CSN303，保持 1200m，跑道 02R 左下风。

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1801.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, continue descent to 900 meters on QNH, you are NO.1.
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1801.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，按 QNH 继续下降到 900 meters，你是 1 号。
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1801.referenceText: Descend to 900m on QNH, NO.1, CSN303.

atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1802.audioText: C: China Southern 303, extend downwind as you wish, turn left at your own discretion to join base. Mind your speed!
atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1802.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，按你的需要延长下风边，自行决定左转加入基线。注意速度！

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1803.audioText:
B: Your call sign is China Southern 230. The aircraft has just landed on runway 02R of Baiyun Airport.
C: China Southern 230, backtrack the runway, vacate the runway via Alpha 5.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1803.audioTextZh:
B: 你的呼号是 China Southern 230。飞机刚在 Baiyun Airport 跑道 02 right 落地。
C: China Southern 230，在跑道上反向滑行，经 Alpha 5 脱离跑道。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1803.referenceText: Backtrack the runway, vacate the runway via A5, CSN230.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1803.referenceTextZh: 在跑道上反向滑行，经 A5 脱离跑道，CSN230。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1804.audioText: C: China Southern 230, visibility 300 meters, low visibility procedure in effect, taxi with caution.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1804.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，能见度 300 meters，低能见度程序生效，谨慎滑行。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1805.audioText: C: China Southern 230, expedite vacating runway, traffic on short final. Contact Baiyun Ground on 120.2.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1805.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，加速脱离跑道，短五边有活动。联系白云地面120.2。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1806.audioText: B: Now contact Baiyun Ground and tell him you have vacated runway
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1806.audioTextZh: B: 现在联系白云地面，告诉他你已脱离跑道。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1807.audioText: C: China Southern 230, stand 35 via taxiway Alpha 5, Alpha, Golf, Echo and Quebec.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1807.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，经滑行道 Alpha 5、Alpha、Golf、Echo 和 Quebec 到 35 号机位。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1807.referenceText: A5, A, G, E and Q to stand 35, CSN230.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1807.referenceTextZh: 经 A5、A、G、E 和 Q 到 35 号机位，CSN230。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1808.audioText: B: You find the taxiway lighting is very dim, and ask for brightening them up.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1808.audioTextZh: B: 你发现滑行道灯很暗，请求调亮。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1808.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN230, can you turn up the taxiway lighting? It’s really dim.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1808.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN230，能否调亮滑行道灯？灯光真的很暗。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1809.audioText:
C: China Southern 230, already on its maximum setting. Taxi with caution.
B: You tell controller that you need a detailed instruction.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1809.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 230，已经是最大设置。谨慎滑行。
B: 告诉管制员你需要详细指令。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1809.referenceText: Roger, request detailed taxi instruction, CSN230.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1809.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求详细滑行指令，CSN230。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1810.audioText: C: China Southern 230, taxi straight ahead, I’ll keep you advised.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1810.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，直行滑行，我会持续给你提示。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1811.audioText:
C: China Southern 230, give way to the outbound traffic on your right, report have it in sight.
B: Tell him you have not found the aircraft.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1811.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 230，给你右侧离场飞机让路，看到后报告。
B: 告诉他你没有看到该飞机。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1812.audioText: C: China Southern 230, hold at present position. Traffic is crossing right to left.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1812.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，在当前位置等待。飞机正从右向左穿越。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1813.audioText: C: China Southern 230, continue taxi, Alpha is the first taxiway on your left.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1813.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，继续滑行，Alpha 是你左侧第一条滑行道。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1813.referenceText: Left turn at first intersection, CSN230.

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1814.audioText: C: China Southern 230, follow taxiway Alpha till next intersection, then right.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1814.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，沿滑行道 Alpha 到下一个交叉口，然后右转。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1814.referenceText: Follow taxiway Alpha, turn right at next intersection, CSN 230.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1814.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道 Alpha，下一交叉口右转，CSN230。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1815.audioText:
C: China Southern 230, you’ve taken a wrong turn. Now you are on Echo Charlie.
B: Apologize to the controller, and ask him what you should do next.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1815.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 230，你转错了。现在你在 Echo Charlie 上。
B: 向管制员道歉，并问他下一步该怎么办。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1815.referenceText: Sorry for that. Request further instruction, CSN230.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1815.referenceTextZh: 对此抱歉。请求进一步指令，CSN230。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1816.audioText: C: Ah, China Southern 230, continue taxi. Once reaching Cargo Apron, make a right 180. Make sure you have enough space to do it.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1816.audioTextZh: C: 嗯，China Southern 230，继续滑行。到达货运机坪后右转 180。确认你有足够空间完成。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1816.referenceText: Roger, Cargo Apron, then right 180, CSN230.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1816.referenceTextZh: 收到，货运机坪，然后右转 180，CSN230。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1817.audioText: B: Tell him you have made a 180.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1817.audioTextZh: B: 告诉他你已经完成 180。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1817.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN230，反向滑行完成。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1818.audioText: C: China Southern 230, taxi eastward via previous route. Do not turn unless I call you.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1818.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，经原路线向东滑行。除非我呼叫你，不要转弯。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1818.referenceText: Eastward via previous route, straight ahead, CSN230.

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1819.audioText: C: China Southern 230, now turn right onto taxiway Quebec. Caution, taxiway is slippery.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1819.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 230，现在右转上滑行道 Quebec。注意，滑行道湿滑。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1819.referenceText: Turn right onto taxiway Q, CSN230.

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1820.audioText: B: Your right main gear skidded off the taxiway. Ask for a tug.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1820.audioTextZh: B: 你的右主起落架滑出滑行道。请求拖车。
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1820.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN230, our right main gear skidded off the taxiway. Request a tug.
atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1820.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN230，我们的右主起落架滑出滑行道。请求拖车。

atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1821.audioText: C: China Southern 230, copied that. Wait a minute.

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1822.audioText: B: You are over Tango Oscar Golf at 35, FL210, you want to descend to FL170, report to Guangzhou Control.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1822.audioTextZh: B: 你在 Tango Oscar Golf 上空 35，飞行高度层 210，想下降到飞行高度层 170，向广州管制报告。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1822.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, over TOG at 35, FL210, request descend to FL170.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1822.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，在 TOG 上空 35，FL210，请求下降到 FL170。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1823.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, can you make FL190 by Tango Uniform X-Ray?
B: You want FL170 because the turbulence is likely to get worse further along the route.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1823.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，你能在 Tango Uniform X-Ray 前达到飞行高度层 190 吗？
B: 你想要飞行高度层 170，因为航路前方乱流可能会加重。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1823.referenceText: That can't be sure, the turbulence is likely to get worse further along the route, FL170 is preferable, ACA412.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1823.referenceTextZh: 无法确定，航路前方乱流可能会加重，FL170 更合适，ACA412。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1824.audioText: C: Air Canada 412, we have to coordinate.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1824.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 412，我们必须协调。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1825.audioText: C: Air Canada 412, your request to Tango Uniform X-Ray FL170 has been approved, at the same time, remain on 215 radial Golf India Lima VOR.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1825.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 412，你到 Tango Uniform X-Ray 飞行高度层 170 的请求已获批准，同时保持在 Golf India Lima VOR 215 径向线上。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1825.referenceText: Cross TUX FL170, remain on 215 radial GIL VOR, ACA412.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1825.referenceTextZh: 通过 TUX 时 FL170，保持在 GIL VOR 215 径向线上，ACA412。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1826.audioText: B: You want to put off the descent, call Control.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1826.audioTextZh: B: 你想推迟下降，呼叫管制。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1826.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, request to delay the descent.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1826.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，请求延迟下降。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1827.audioText:
C: Descend immediately due traffic.
B: You tell the controller that you will run into CBs if you descend right now.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1827.audioTextZh:
C: 因活动立即下降。
B: 告诉管制员如果现在下降，你们会进入 CB。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1827.referenceText: The thunderstorm will be encountered if we decide right now, ACA412.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1827.referenceTextZh: 如果我们现在下降，会遭遇雷暴，ACA412。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1828.audioText: C: Turn right heading 120 to detour the CBs.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1828.audioTextZh: C: 右转航向 120 绕飞 CB。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1829.audioText: B: You tell the controller that you will check out more than 30 miles if you go round the CBs from the right. You ask the permission of a left sight.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1829.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员，如果从右侧绕飞 CB，会偏出超过 30 miles。你请求从左侧绕飞许可。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1829.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, if we go around the CBs from the right, we have to track out more than 30 miles. How about the left side turning?
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1829.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，如果我们从右侧绕飞 CB，必须偏出超过 30 miles。能否从左侧转弯？

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1830.audioText:
C: There is only 15 miles for you to go if you want to detour from the left due restricted area.
B: You need 20 miles.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1830.audioTextZh:
C: 由于限制区，如果你想从左侧绕飞，只有 15 miles 可用。
B: 你需要 20 miles。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1830.referenceText: I need at least 20 miles on the left side, 15 miles is not enough, ACA412.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1830.referenceTextZh: 左侧我至少需要 20 miles，15 miles 不够，ACA412。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1831.audioText: C: I will contact with the military, standby.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1831.audioTextZh: C: 我会联系军方，等待。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1832.audioText:
C: No reply from the military, what do you prefer?
B: You intend to go round the CBs from the left.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1832.audioTextZh:
C: 军方没有回复，你更倾向哪种？
B: 你打算从左侧绕飞 CB。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1832.referenceText: We would like to circumnavigate the thunderstorm from the left, ACA412.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1832.referenceTextZh: 我们希望从左侧绕飞雷暴，ACA412。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1833.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, cleared to detour the thunderstorm from the left.
B: You ran into severe turbulence in CBs, some persons injured.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1833.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，许可从左侧绕飞雷暴。
B: 你进入 CB 遭遇严重乱流，有人受伤。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1833.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, we have encountered the CBs with severe turbulence, some persons injured.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1833.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，我们遭遇 CB 和严重乱流，有人受伤。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1834.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, what's your intention?
B: You want priority landing and medical assistance.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1834.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，你的意图是什么？
B: 你想优先落地并需要医疗协助。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1834.referenceText: Request priority landing and medical assistance, ACA412.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1834.referenceTextZh: 请求优先落地和医疗协助，ACA412。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1835.audioText: C: Air Canada 412, emergency services will be notified. Ambulance will be there waiting for you.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1835.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 412，将通知应急服务。救护车会在那里等你。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1836.audioText: B: Declare Urgency due to port inboard engine flamed out resulting from water ingestion, you are suffering a steep left turn.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1836.audioTextZh: B: 因吸水导致左内侧发动机熄火宣布紧急状态，你们正经历急剧左转。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1836.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA412, port inboard engine flamed out resulting from water ingestion, we are suffering a steep left turn.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1836.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，广州管制，ACA412，左内侧发动机因吸水熄火，我们正在急剧左转。

atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1837.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, roger PAN, report your intention if available.
B: You want emergency landing.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1837.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，收到 PAN，如可能报告你的意图。
B: 你想紧急着陆。
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1837.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, request emergency landing.
atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1837.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，请求紧急着陆。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1838.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 123. The aircraft is parking on the apron and you are ready for ATC clearance. Now contact Delivery for ATC clearance.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1838.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 123。飞机停在机坪，你已准备好取得 ATC 许可。现在联系放行申请 ATC 许可。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1838.referenceTextZh: 放行，ACA123，请求 ATC 许可。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1839.audioText: C: Air Canada 123, you are cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, cruise level 10200 meters, Delta 06 departure, squawk 2315.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1839.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，巡航高度 10200 meters，Delta 06 离场，squawk 2315。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1839.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, cruise level 10200 meters, D06 departure, squawk 2315, ACA123.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1839.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，巡航高度 10200 meters，D06 离场，squawk 2315，ACA123。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1840.audioText: B: You tell the controller that the original flight direct to Beijing has been revised.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1840.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员原直飞北京的航班已被修改。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1840.referenceText: Delivery, ACA123, I have been told that the flight to Beijing has been revised.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1840.referenceTextZh: 放行，ACA123，我被告知飞往北京的航班已修改。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1841.audioText: C: Air Canada 123, I am sorry, I have not got your latest flight plan. Hold on, I will call you back.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1841.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 123，抱歉，我还没有收到你的最新飞行计划。稍等，我会再呼叫你。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1842.audioText:
C: Air Canada 123, your flight plan has been amended, you’ll divert to Charlie Oscar Golf to pick up some cargo and transit passengers, is that right?
B: Tell the controller Yes.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1842.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 123，你的飞行计划已修改，你将改航到 Charlie Oscar Golf 接载一些货物和中转旅客，是这样吗？
B: 告诉管制员是。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1843.audioText:
C: Air Canada 123, have you received departure information?
B: You have got information Kilo, but you don’t know the present information code. You ask about it.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1843.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 123，你收到离场信息了吗？
B: 你已收到信息 Kilo，但不知道当前信息代码。你询问。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1843.referenceText: We have received Information K. What is the current information ? ACA123.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1843.referenceTextZh: 我们已收到信息 K。当前信息是什么？ACA123。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1844.audioText:
C: Information Kilo is not valid, Information Lima is current.
B: Tell the controller you are going to write down the present ATIS.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1844.audioTextZh:
C: 信息 Kilo 已失效，当前为信息 Lima。
B: 告诉管制员你将抄收当前 ATIS。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1844.referenceText: Thank you. We are going to copy the information data right away, ACA123.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1844.referenceTextZh: 谢谢。我们马上抄收信息数据，ACA123。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1845.audioText: B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him you have to delay the departure for about 10 minutes, the moving jet-way to the satellite is not working properly.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1845.audioTextZh: B: 联系地面管制员，告诉他你们必须延误离场约 10 分钟，通往卫星厅的自动步道工作不正常。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1845.referenceText: Ground, ACA123, the moving walkway to our satellite has some problem. We have to delay our departure for about 10 minutes.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1845.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA123，我们卫星厅的自动步道有问题。我们必须延误离场约 10 分钟。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1846.audioText:
C: Air Canada 123, you would expect a delay of 1 hour if you don’t make this slot.
B: Tell the controller that the moving walkway has been fixed. All the passengers will be on the aircraft in a few minutes, but the luggage loading is too slow due an old fashioned loader, you request the controller to inform the ground handling and send a new loader as soon as possible.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1846.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 123，如果你赶不上这个时刻，预计会延误 1 小时。
B: 告诉管制员自动步道已经修好。所有旅客几分钟内会上机，但由于一台老式装载机，行李装载太慢，你请求管制员通知地服并尽快派一台新装载机。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1846.referenceText: Ground, ACA123, the moving jet-way has been fixed. All the passengers will finish boarding in a couple of minutes, but luggage loading has not completed due a slow moving loader, please inform the ground handling to send another 1 as quickly as possible.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1846.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA123，自动步道已经修好。所有旅客几分钟内完成登机，但由于装载机移动慢，行李装载尚未完成，请通知地服尽快再派一台。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1847.audioText:
C: Air Canada 123, I am sorry, there is no loader on hand now.
B: You would like to know if you would be delayed for an hour.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1847.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 123，抱歉，现在没有可用装载机。
B: 你想知道是否会延误 1 小时。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1847.referenceText: Ground, ACA123, do you mean that we will have a delay of an hour if we don't depart on time?
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1847.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA123，你的意思是如果我们不能准时离场，就会延误 1 小时吗？

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1848.audioText:
C: Affirm. My apologies, there is no spare loader at the moment.
B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him that you are ready for engine start up
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1848.audioTextZh:
C: 肯定。抱歉，目前没有备用装载机。
B: 联系地面管制员，告诉他你已准备好开车。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1848.referenceText: Ground, ACA123, ready for start up.

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1849.audioText:
C: Air Canada 123, startup approved.
B: You tell the controller that the ground mechanic has found that No.1 engine is leaking fuel.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1849.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 123，批准开车。
B: 告诉管制员地面机务发现 1 号发动机漏油。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1849.referenceText: Ground, ACA123, the ground mechanic has found that No.1 engine is leaking.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1849.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA123，地面机务发现 1 号发动机漏油。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1850.audioText:
C: Is the leakage serious? What is your intention?
B: You tell the controller that the starboard engine fuel line has been leaking slightly. You are not certain if you can continue the flight. You will contact with the company dispatcher.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1850.audioTextZh:
C: 漏油严重吗？你的意图是什么？
B: 告诉管制员右发燃油管路轻微泄漏。你不确定是否能继续飞行。你将联系公司签派。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1850.referenceText: The starboard engine fuel line has been leaking slightly. I’m not sure if our flight will continue or not. I’ll consult with our company dispatcher, ACA123.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1850.referenceTextZh: 右发燃油管路轻微泄漏。我不确定我们的航班是否会继续。我会咨询公司签派，ACA123。

atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1851.audioText:
C: Air Canada 123, your clearance will expire then, I’ll give you a new slot when you are ready.
B: You tell the controller that your flight has to be cancelled.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1851.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 123，你的许可届时会过期，准备好后我会给你新的时刻。
B: 告诉管制员你的航班必须取消。
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1851.referenceText: Ground, ACA123, we have to cancel our flight.
atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1851.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA123，我们必须取消航班。
